jobs.title: Software Engineer, Growth
jobs.description:
About Us

Garage powers the exchange of critical assets across America’s essential industries. We started with fire departments, where purchasing mission-critical vehicles and equipment used to take months of paperwork, phone calls, and delays. Our agentic platform automates the entire transaction: discovery, payments, freight, paperwork, warranty, and financing. What once took months now takes minutes.

In under a year, we’ve expanded to cities and towns in all 50 states and grown revenue more than 10x. Based in New York, we’ve raised $18M from Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, Infinity Ventures, FJ Labs, and other leading investors. We’re moving fast, growing quickly, and just getting started.

About The Role

Growth engineering at Garage builds the systems that turn our sales motion into a machine. The industry runs on PDFs, phone calls, and software built in 2003, and we'd rather build the modern version in-house than wire together someone else's tools.

You'll work closely with our sales team and the dealers, manufacturers, fleet operators, and government buyers who move specialty assets across the country. This involves owning the data infrastructure, internal tools, and AI-powered workflows that fill our pipeline.

Build the data infrastructure that finds every prospect in the industry by turning fragmented data into pipelines.
Ship internal tools that make our sales team dramatically more effective. This includes outbound automation, lead routing, sequencing, deal-room tooling.
Apply AI and LLMs to unstructured data and turn it into signals that fill our pipeline.
Build agents that work in the background to compound our sales advantage.

You think in systems, not tickets.
You get excited by operating in a high-performance startup environment.
You would love to be customer-facing.
You play for the front of the jersey, having strong opinions, a willingness to question the status quo, and a drive to become a real expert in whatever space you work in. All while being a great team communicator.

Required

Extremely AI-native, living on the cutting edge. AI is how you ship.
A track record of shipping high-quality products at scale, including with and for agents.
Experience designing and working with scalable databases and APIs.

Startup experience as a technical co-founder or early engineer at a Series A/B/C startup.
Experience working with messy real-world data from analog sources.

2+ years of experience.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Compute
jobs.description:
About Nominal

Engineers today are building some of the most ambitious machines humanity has ever seen. They should have AI that’s purpose-built for them.

Nominal is building the Hardware Intelligence Platform that gives engineers increased visibility into complex physical systems, helps them make better decisions, and ultimately gets their products into the real world faster. It brings together the systems, data, intelligence, and applications hardware engineering requires to meet the AI moment. Hardware engineering teams use Nominal to simulate, test, manufacture, and operate the physical systems that keep the world moving, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation energy systems and robotics.

Our customers span aerospace, defense, manufacturing, transportation, energy, and robotics. They include Anduril, Shield AI, Wisk Aero, Pratt Miller Motorsports, Antares, and Shinkei Systems, amongst others, alongside programs within the U.S. Air Force and Navy. Our team draws from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, Tesla, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence. We're a fast-moving team that owns problems end-to-end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software.

Some of the world’s leading technology investors, including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Lux Capital, and Insight Partners, are backing Nominal’s ambition to change how machines are built and operated. We’re looking for engineers who want to take on hard problems and help make a new generation of world-changing hardware possible.

Join Nominal as a Full Stack Software Engineer, Compute

At Nominal, the frontend goes far beyond a visual layer on top of APIs. It's where thousands of high-frequency data sources are streamed and drawn on screen in time for an engineer to decide whether to continue, pause, or abort tests running against real hardware. Our customers monitor mission-critical systems through Nominal, so the data has to be fast, correct, and trustworthy at every layer. Meeting that bar means balancing raw performance with an experience engineers can depend on and understand, so they can build trust in the platform.

We're looking for product engineers who care about high-scale data computation, runtime performance, and device constraints as much as building intuitive interfaces. You'll work at the intersection of product, design, and engineering to turn a highly expressive compute engine into the foundation that every visualization in Nominal depends on, from highly optimized time series charts to flexible user-defined custom visualizations. Success in this role is measured by building a data layer that stays fast, correct, and observable on whatever device and network our customers bring.

You'll partner closely with backend engineers, designers, and product teams to define workflows, shape product direction, and make thoughtful technical tradeoffs in an environment where requirements are often ambiguous and the best solutions aren't immediately obvious. You'll own the shared compute and data layer of the platform’s applications end to end. Your judgment will shape how live and historical data workflows feel across the whole product.

🚀 About the role

Build the data foundation every application stands on

Own the layer between Nominal's compute engine and the user: streaming over WebSockets, orchestrating web workers, handling columnar data formats, caching intelligently, and processing live and historical data on the client. You'll design generalized data and compute capabilities that serve today's product and the use cases we haven't met yet, so that new panels, new query types, and open-ended user-defined visualizations can be built quickly on the stability and guarantees already in place.

Make performance and correctness non-negotiable

Customers stream thousands of high-frequency series into live monitoring dashboards with low-latency expectations and zero tolerance for incorrect data. You'll squeeze everything possible out of varied user hardware, hunt memory leaks down to the allocation, benchmark and profile the render pipeline, and handle out-of-order, late, and missing data so the picture on screen converges on the truth.

Own ambiguous product problems

Partner closely with product, design, and engineering to turn loosely defined ideas into intuitive user experiences. You'll challenge assumptions, validate workflows directly with users, and make confident product decisions when requirements are incomplete.

Bring New Compute Capabilities To Users

Take new features from the compute layer and expose them in a composable, scalable form that end users can understand: new capabilities, aggregations, grouping mechanisms, and transforms that can power every application and workflow in the Nominal platform.

Make complexity feel simple

Design experiences that expose powerful capabilities without overwhelming users. You'll think deeply about information architecture, interaction design, and how technical users reason about their work.

Success in this role comes from combining strong frontend engineering with product judgment. You'll spend as much time thinking about how users reason about complex systems as you will writing React code.

🙌 We'd love to hear from you if you have

3+ years experience building products for technical users where you’ve been involved in the infrastructure behind demanding, data-heavy applications.
Strong experience with TypeScript, and modern frontend architecture, along with an understanding of how frontend systems interact with backend services.
Experience building high-throughput data applications in the browser, with hands-on use of web workers, WebSockets, columnar formats such as Apache Arrow, and canvas or WebGL/WebGPU rendering.
A deep understanding of the web as a runtime: memory allocation and garbage collection, message passing between threads, the performance characteristics of network transports, and how a rendering pipeline actually spends its frame budget.
Strong product instincts. You naturally ask "Why are we building this?" before "How should I implement it?" and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions when you believe there's a better solution for users.
A systems mindset. You enjoy reasoning about data models, user workflows, and how complex systems should behave before jumping into implementation.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical and product tradeoffs clearly across engineering, design, and product teams.

⚡ Skills that supercharge us

Browser Familiarity

A deep understanding of the browser as an environment for data-intensive applications: threading, networking, memory, and the rendering pipeline.

Streaming Real-time Data

Experience building interfaces over live data streams, and balancing the speed, correctness, and resilience they demand.

Performance Engineering

Experience with client-side memory management, benchmarking, profiling, and an obsession with delivering a fluid user experience.

Systems Thinking

Experience designing products around complex object models, relationships, and workflows rather than simple CRUD interfaces.

Product Thinking

Ability to understand user goals, simplify complicated workflows, and make thoughtful product decisions under ambiguity.

Frontend Architecture

Strong experience with React, TypeScript, modern state management, asynchronous data flows, and scalable application architecture.

Backend Collaboration

Comfort reasoning about APIs, data loading strategies, backend constraints, and making architectural tradeoffs across the full stack.

Performance Engineering

Experience optimizing rendering, managing large datasets, virtualized interfaces, streaming updates, caching strategies, and browser performance.

✨ Benefits/Perks

🏥 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance
🏖️ Unlimited PTO and sick leave
🍽️ Free lunch, snacks, and coffee
🚀 Professional Development Stipend
🛠️ In-office hardware lab with a $250 project stipend
✈️ Annual company retreat
👶 12 weeks parental leave
🌱 Fertility and family planning ($15,000 lifetime)
💪 Wellness stipend ($100/month)
🛠️ $500/year hardware sensor stipend
💼 401(k)
📈 Employee-friendly equity terms
🏢 In-office 5 days per week

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Compensation

The base pay range for this role is $179,000 – $310,000 per year.

jobs.description:
About Base

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.

About The Role

This role requires someone who is deeply analytical, strong at systems design, and comfortable owning correctness in distributed systems. This is not a typical CRUD backend role.

Our goal is to move as many members as possible through the pipeline quickly, while scaling the business without scaling manual work linearly. We have digitized workflows around historically manual, fragmented processes. The next step is making those systems reliable, observable, and safe to operate at scale.

Top of Funnel includes the systems that bring members into the pipeline and help us understand what converts. You will build the infrastructure behind experimentation, partner integrations, lead ingestion, attribution, and workflows across direct customers, national homebuilders, and utilities.

Onboarding is where we coordinate the work required to get a battery installed. It is a multi-week process spanning members, internal teams, vendors, market-specific requirements, and automated workflows. You will build the systems that orchestrate that work and keep it correct through retries, partial failures, delayed data, changing requirements, and human intervention.

Retail is how we operate the energy business when we are responsible for powering the member’s home. You will build the software and control systems that automate routine decisions, surface exceptions, and ensure humans intervene where judgment is actually required.

In a steady state, the product needs to reflect what is happening at the home. You will connect member-facing and internal systems to live operational and telemetry data, ensuring they remain accurate and safe during outages, stale or missing data, duplicate events, retries, partial failures, and conflicting updates.

What You’ll Do

Design and build distributed systems that support critical member and operational workflows.
Define clear ownership, state, invariants, and failure handling for processes that span multiple services and teams.
Build systems that remain correct under retries, duplicate events, delayed data, partial failure, concurrent updates, and manual intervention.
Make tradeoffs between consistency, availability, latency, operational complexity, and member experience.
Identify process bottlenecks and turn manual or error-prone work into reliable automation.
Build infrastructure for experimentation, integrations, and workflow orchestration.
Stream live and derived data into internal and member-facing applications.
Write clearly and align technical decisions across engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

Strong systems and API design fundamentals.
Deep analytical ability and sound technical judgment in ambiguous environments.
Experience building or operating distributed systems with real correctness requirements.
Comfort reasoning about idempotency, ordering, state machines, reconciliation, observability, and recovery from failure.
Ability to separate stakeholder requests from the underlying system or product problem.
Strong written communication and a high bar for clarity.
Experience with operationally complex products is a plus.

About The Team

This team is responsible for infrastructure that simultaneously improves growth, reduces cycle time, and makes the member journey more reliable.

The systems we build have real-world consequences. Incorrect state, dropped work, or poorly handled failure modes can leave members without clear answers, create significant operational burden, or affect whether they have power when they need it.

Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.

Our Values

First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.
Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.
Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.
Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.
Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.
Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.
Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.

Do the best work of your life at Base.

jobs.description:
Triangle is solving market failures in politics

We are Triangle Analytics, a startup that delivers behavioral intelligence to the key stakeholders behind new infrastructure development, backed by General Catalyst and Pear VC. Today, communities, public officials, and developers are often making major decisions while flying blind, relying on fragmented public data, polling, and intuition. That makes it difficult to understand what communities truly care about, where interests align, and how projects can create shared value. We are building systems that model community sentiment, helping stakeholders understand the drivers of support or opposition, engage earlier, and better align incentives through smarter outreach, project design, and community benefit frameworks. Triangle is deployed in civic use cases across the country, including a $275 million bond project, where our models guide community engagement.

Role Description

You will be responsible for building the machine learning systems that power our core platform. Your work will focus on turning fragmented signals about individuals, communities, and stakeholders into reliable behavioral predictions at scale. This includes developing new modeling approaches, building training and inference pipelines, integrating structured and unstructured data, deploying and monitoring models, and developing the infrastructure needed to continuously evaluate and improve model performance. This is a role for someone who wants to work across applied ML research and production engineering, developing new models and building the systems required to deploy them at scale. You will work closely with the founders and engineering team and have meaningful ownership over our core machine learning architecture.

Responsibilities and potential impact

You will own the reliability, scalability, and performance of the machine learning systems that power the product. This means leading the full lifecycle, from driving model experimentation to deploying and scaling models in production. You will set the standards for how models are developed, deployed, monitored, evaluated, and improved, and make tradeoffs between speed, model quality, reliability, and engineering complexity.
For the organizations we serve, this work is mission critical. Stakeholder intelligence directly shapes how teams allocate resources, prioritize engagement, and make high-stakes decisions. Most organizations today experience this as friction: fragmented data, inconsistent analysis, and slow feedback loops. The systems you help build will allow teams to continuously turn behavioral signals into reliable predictions, understand what matters earlier, and act with far greater clarity and speed. Over time, this creates a more scalable and effective way to understand stakeholder behavior.

Must haves

Attention to detail and the instinct to produce high quality, concise, consistent, and organized code
Strong proficiency in Python and modern machine learning libraries and tooling
Strong machine learning and statistical modeling background
Deep understanding of machine learning fundamentals: feature engineering, algorithm selection, evaluation methodology, etc.

MLOps and model serving infrastructure

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Data Curation - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer for our Autonomous Vehicles Data Curation team. The role involves applying state-of-the-art techniques to search, curate, and evaluate high-quality datasets and ground truth for autonomous vehicles, a critical aspect of our next-generation products. You will have the opportunity to work with top researchers and engineers in the field of deep learning and computer vision to deliver impact to our customers around the world. Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving car powered by AI can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. The era of AI has begun. NVIDIA's GPUs run Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and act as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human imagination and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and AI come together in our architecture.

NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for Deep Learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI company”. Make your choice to join us today. We are training Deep Neural Networks and developing data search and curation capabilities for NVIDIA's Autonomous Vehicles effort, with the goal to enable autonomous driving. We are seeking Deep Learning/Machine Learning engineers who are passionate about building the datasets and tools that support perception, prediction, planning and control for self-driving cars to achieve full autonomy. Are you interested in applying AI to discover and understand challenging driving scenarios at scale? If so, join us!

What You'll Be Doing

Stay up to date with the latest research and innovations in deep learning, implement and experiment with new ideas.
Foster collaborative partnerships with our researchers and engineers, transforming innovative research into robust, industrial-strength machine learning models.
Taking approaches from initial evaluation and experimentation all the way to shipping.
Defining, collecting, and curating training and evaluation datasets, with a focus on scenario coverage and label quality.
Developing vision-language models and embeddings for scenario search, classification, and automated data curation.
Building training pipelines and scalable inference systems (PyTorch, TensorFlow, TensorRT, Python, C++).

What We Need To See

PhD with 1+ year, or MS (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years, of relevant experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
Proven experience building robust software.
Passionate about Artificial Intelligence for robotics and autonomous navigation
Strive to learn new things and like solving hard problems
Math knowledge
Experience in Deep Learning / Machine Learning. You have a background in Computer Vision and/or multimodal learning.
Programming and debugging skills in C++ and/or Python.
Good communication and analytical skills. Ability to work with multiple teams in a dynamic environment.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Background in applying latest AI methods to solve Computer Vision and Autonomous Vehicles problems
Experience with Unsupervised or Self-supervised Learning and contrastive representation learning.
Experience with vision-language models, agentic search, or automated dataset quality evaluation.

We believe that realizing self-driving cars will be a defining contribution of our generation. We have the funding and scale, but we need your help. NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

#AutonomousVehicles

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 11, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Python / QA Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Python automation, Playwright, Selenium, API testing, and data validation. The role focuses on maintaining software quality throughout the delivery lifecycle, from reviewing business requirements to designing, executing, and certifying end-to-end test scenarios.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience building scalable test automation frameworks, validating complex data pipelines, testing REST and GraphQL APIs, and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, and testing Generative AI and Agentic AI applications is also valuable.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable Python-based test automation frameworks using Playwright and Selenium WebDriver.
Develop and optimize test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and test cases.
Review and validate Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) to ensure requirements are clear, complete, and testable.
Map business requirements to acceptance criteria and maintain a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) connecting requirements, test cases, and test results.
Participate in BRD walkthroughs, requirements reviews, and sign-off meetings with business stakeholders.
Design and execute end-to-end tests across data pipelines, including source systems, Databricks and Snowflake transformations, and dashboard interfaces.
Perform data validation across Databricks Unity Catalog schemas and develop SQL-based validation scripts.
Build automated data quality and regression testing frameworks using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom Python solutions.
Validate data completeness, referential integrity, schema evolution, and consistency across raw and curated data layers.
Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing of REST and GraphQL APIs.
Validate API contracts, request and response schemas, status codes, headers, authentication, and authorization.
Use Postman, Bruno, Python Requests, and Swagger/OpenAPI validators for API testing.
Test API error handling, edge cases, malformed payloads, rate limiting, timeouts, and 4xx/5xx responses.
Conduct API performance and load testing using Locust, k6, or JMeter to evaluate response times, throughput, and concurrency.
Validate API versioning, backward compatibility, and deprecation handling.
Integrate automated UI, API, and data validation tests into CI/CD pipelines to identify defects early.
Collaborate with development, DevOps, data engineering, and business teams to troubleshoot and resolve defects.
Maintain defect tracking, test execution reports, and quality metrics while minimizing escaped defects.
Explore testing approaches for Generative AI and Agentic AI applications, including automated validation of AI-driven workflows.

Required Skills & Qualifications

8+ years of experience in Python development, QA automation, and software testing.
Strong hands-on experience with Python, Playwright, and Selenium WebDriver.
Expertise in building and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks.
Strong experience in API automation and testing REST and GraphQL services.
Hands-on experience with SQL-based data validation and data quality testing.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Remote
jobs.description:
Optum Tech is a global leader in health care innovation. Our teams develop cutting-edge solutions that help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. From advanced data analytics and AI to cybersecurity, we use innovative approaches to solve some of health care's most complex challenges. Your contributions here have the potential to change lives. Ready to build the next breakthrough? Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

Software engineering is the application of engineering to the design, development, implementation, testing and maintenance of software in a systematic method. The roles in this function will cover all primary development activity across all technology functions that ensure we deliver code with high quality for our applications, products and services and to understand customer needs and to develop product roadmaps.

These roles include, but are not limited to analysis, design, coding, engineering, testing, debugging, standards, methods, tools analysis, documentation, research and development, maintenance, new development, operations and delivery. With every role in the company, each position has a requirement for building quality into every output. This also includes evaluating new tools, new techniques, strategies; Automation of common tasks; build of common utilities to drive organizational efficiency with a passion around technology and solutions and influence of thought and leadership on future capabilities and opportunities to apply technology in new and innovative ways.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities

Implement end-to-end features and user stories, including analysis, design, development, validation, deployment, and post-deployment support
Analyze and document business logic in existing and legacy applications, and re-implement it as maintainable, well-tested software
Design, build, and optimize computation-intensive processing - improving the runtime, scalability, and accuracy of calculation-heavy workloads
Build and maintain validation and parity-testing frameworks that verify new implementations produce results consistent with the systems they replace
Work with relational databases and modern data platforms to design, query, and optimize data models and pipelines
Apply security principles and industry best practices when designing and building secure applications and APIs, including safeguarding sensitive and confidential data
Contribute to the design and adoption of architectural patterns, engineering standards, and reusable frameworks
Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines, code quality gates, and test automation frameworks
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues across development, test, and production environments, including correctness and precision defects in calculation logic
Collaborate within Agile development teams, and directly with business and analytical subject matter experts, to translate domain rules into technical requirements and validated solutions
Leverage AI tools (including Copilot and related AI Builder tools) to enhance development productivity and efficiency
Demonstrate solid problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and effective collaboration across teams

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications

4+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, with exposure to modern front-end frameworks such as React.js
4+ years of experience working on modern software engineering technologies, with a solid focus on API development (RESTful services using FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar)
3+ years of experience developing data-intensive or analytical applications using pandas, NumPy, or comparable libraries
3+ years of experience working with relational databases, including data modelling, complex queries, and query optimization
3+ years of experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments
3+ years of experience in cloud-native development using platforms such as Azure, or GCP, and working with containerization (Docker) and orchestration tools (Kubernetes)
1+ years of experience in applying numerical or algorithmic methods - iterative solvers, root-finding, optimization, or convergence and precision analysis
1+ years of experience in developing secure RESTful APIs and service-oriented architectures
1+ years of experience in CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices
1+ years of experience in ability to effectively use AI-powered development tools (e.g., Copilot) to improve productivity

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
Experience modernizing legacy or end-user-computing applications (spreadsheet- or macro-based business logic) into production software
Experience with distributed or parallel computing frameworks (Spark, Dask, Ray, or equivalent)
Experience with Databricks or a comparable lakehouse/data platform, including medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture
Experience with data governance, lineage, quality, and access-control frameworks
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, or similar platforms
Healthcare payer, actuarial, pricing, or financial-modelling domain experience
All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). jobs.title: Gameplay Tools Engineer
jobs.description:
At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories. We believe the spirit with which we build games is reflected in the experiences our players have. The way we collaborate, solve problems, navigate uncertainty, and care for one another ultimately shapes the worlds we create. We're creating magical, shared experiences that bring players together and we know those experiences come from teams that are curious, resilient, ambitious, and deeply committed to one another.

We're a fully remote studio that embraces collaboration, thoughtful iteration, and the courage to explore new ideas. If you're excited by ambiguity, enjoy solving difficult problems with kind, talented teammates, and want to help build worlds where friendships flourish, we'd love to meet you.

As a Gameplay Tools Engineer, you will create custom Unreal Engine tools that support teams across the studio. You will partner with stakeholders to understand the unique needs of their iteration workflows and author bespoke tools using C++ within the Unreal editor and in-game environments that will accelerate those pipelines. You will be a force-multipler for the team, enabling rapid exploration of new features and comprehensive analysis of and decision-making regarding the breadth of content that powers the emergent interactions of our games.

**A Day in the Life:**
======================

* Craft tools that support other disciplines (including art, audio, design) in efficient content creation, iteration and analysis.
* Work with individual developers to build features that can reduce manual effort and accelerate workflows.
* Playtest regularly with the team to understand the creative spaces our games are operating within in order to better support the team.

**What You’ll Do:**
===================

* Own the technical architecture and implementation of multiple tools and supporting systems across the game, partnering closely with stakeholders and the production team to improve iteration throughput.
* Collaborate closely with audio, VFX and design stakeholders to understand the needs of their development pipelines and proactively create solutions that will allow content production at scale.
* Act as a technical bridge between gameplay and backend engineering teams to aid in the development of analysis and diagnostics systems across all aspects of our games.
* Contribute to the stability of the game by proactively assisting in the identification and triage of issues in game systems, collaborating on solutions, and reducing friction in the development process.

**What You’ll Bring:**
======================

* 3+ years of experience building game tools across one or more projects.
* Experience building customized tools via the Unreal editor’s extension mechanisms.
* Familiarity with Wwise or similar audio middleware.
* Experience working closely with VFX systems and artists.
* Clear communication, strong collaboration, and the judgment to work independently, recognize constraints, and seek support when needed.

**Nice to Haves:**
==================

* Previous experience on shipped multiplayer titles using Unreal Engine.
* Prior experience owning the decision-making and implementations of significant portions of the tools ecosystem of a game or engine.
* Experience profiling and optimizing gameplay, engine or infrastructure systems for large-scale content.

**The Team:**
=============

* You will report to the Lead Gameplay engineer.
* You will join a team of gameplay engineers who work closely with other disciplines to champion the values that our games are centered on.

**How We Work**

We believe great games are built by people who care deeply about both the work and one another. Our values guide how we collaborate, solve problems, make decisions, and grow together. They're practical behaviors, not slogans, and they're part of how we hire, give feedback, and support one another every day.

We're looking for teammates who are excited to:

* Stay curious and ask thoughtful questions.
* Adapt when plans change.
* Exercise good judgment rather than chase perfection.
* Care for the success of the whole team, not just their own work.
* Pursue ambitious goals while remaining humble enough to keep learning.
* Commit fully to the shared adventure we're building together.

**You'll Thrive Here If...**

* You enjoy asking questions before jumping to conclusions.
* You adapt comfortably when priorities evolve.
* You balance ambition with pragmatism.
* You communicate thoughtfully and seek feedback.
* You care about helping your teammates succeed.
* You embrace uncertainty as part of creating something new.

**Please Note:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Gardens cannot assist with work authorizations or work visas. Applicants must also be willing to work within North American time zones (EST–PST).

**Our Interview Process**

(all interviews are 1 hour video calls on Google Meet unless otherwise noted)

* Step 1: People Operations Introduction
* Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview
* Step 3: Panel Interview (3 - 1 Hour Sections)
* Step 4: Gardeners Debrief
* Step 5: Offer

**Life at Gardens**

Gardens is a fully distributed game studio founded by creators behind titles including Journey, What Remains of Edith Finch, Blaseball, Dustforce, Ashen, Guild Wars 2, Baldur’s Gate 3, and more.

We're developing our flagship project: a multiplayer fantasy adventure inspired by the friendships, discoveries, and unforgettable stories that emerge when people explore together.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with diverse experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking. Every Gardener helps shape not only what we build, but how we build it.

Each of us arrives by a different path, bringing unique experiences, perspectives, and ways of seeing the world. That range is part of what makes our games and our studio better than any one of us

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

**Position Summary:**

The Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains software applications using modern programming languages and frameworks. Working in an Agile, globally distributed team, this role partners with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical specifications and deliver clean, maintainable, and reliable code.

This individual works with minimal supervision on assigned features, actively learning and adopting the development methods, frameworks, and patterns defined for the role and by the team, and contributes to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result.

**AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations:**

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, following the team’s established best practices, patterns, and coding standards.
* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems.

**Quality and Continuous Improvement**

* Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, functionality, and maintainability, and seek feedback to continuously improve skills.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues and bugs in a timely manner.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Follow and help reinforce the team’s development processes and standards, helping peers understand the benefits and risks of exceptions.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies, and stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.

* Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.
* Apply AI-assisted development techniques throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.
* Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before use.
* Learn and adopt the prompts, skills, agents, and AI-assisted development patterns defined by the team, and share improvements that benefit the team.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.

**Governance and Compliance**

* Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.
* Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.
* Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex, scalable applications.
* Proficiency in C# or Python and familiarity with their ecosystems.
* Working knowledge of relational database development, preferably using SQL Server.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures.
* Familiarity with Git-based version control (e.g., GitHub, Azure Git) and collaborative coding workflows, including pull requests.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team.
* Strong communication skills, openness to feedback, and the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience related to HL7 FHIR. Understanding resource-first FHIR patterns. Comfortable reading FHIR implementation guides.
* Experience in healthcare data domains such as providers, members, prior authorizations, and claims.

Come join the EADGE-T team and be part of an effort to upgrade the program’s technology and bring new capabilities to the UAE customer. The EADGE-T system is an integrated air missile defense, air battle management capability for the UAE integrating existing sensors, weapons as well as new capabilities.

* Perform peer reviews for fellow software engineers and debug issues as they arise
* Participate in technical discussions to define/solve overarching software architecture needs
* Collaborate with cross-functional peers to better understand project requirements and customer/stakeholder needs

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Working at Atlassian**  
  
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities.
  
We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.  
  
**Your Future Team**  
The mission of Atlassian is to unleash potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. AI/ML is significantly transforming how teams come together to plan, track, and deliver work across software and business teams using our products. We are looking for rockstar Machine learning engineers to come help us to further this mission and help make teams more productive leveraging AI across our product portfolio.

Responsibilities:

**What you'll do**  
  
As a Machine Learning engineer, you will work on the development and implementation of the cutting edge machine learning algorithms, training models, collaborating with product, engineering, and analytics teams, to build the AI functionalities into each Atlassian products and services.
  
  
Your daily responsibilities will encompass a broad spectrum of tasks such as designing system and model architectures, conducting rigorous experimentation and model evaluations.
  
  
You will be responsible for application of AI/ML to various product problems to improve Atlassian products and actively contribute toAtlassian Intelligence features.

Pay Ranges:

In The **United States**, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

**Zone A**: $178,200 - $232,650

**Zone B**: $160,380 - $209,385

**Zone C**: $147,906 - $193,100

Qualifications:

**On your first day, we’ll expect you to have**  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree (preferably a Computer Science degree or equivalent experience).  
  
Expertise in Python or Java with and the ability to write performant production-quality code, familiarity with SQL.  
  
Knowledge of Spark and cloud data environments is a plus (e.g. AWS, Databricks)  
  
Experience building and scaling machine learning models using large amounts of data  
  
Experience working in a consumer or B2C space for a SaaS product provider, or the enterprise/B2B space  
  
Experience in developing deep learning-based models and working on LLM-related applications  
  
Excelling in solving ambiguous and complex problems, being able to navigate through uncertain situations, breaking down complex challenges into manageable components and developing innovative solutions  
  
**Compensation**

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
About Ensense 

Ensense AI is building the next generation of Physical AI. Our mission is to bring transparency to public places through scalable sensing and software innovations that empower people, organizations, and governments to make better decisions.
We are building a Physical Intelligence Layer over streets that is continuously updating, captured through innovative multimodal sensing and transformed into actionable intelligence by advanced spatiotemporal AI systems. Our work spans the full stack from sensing to intelligence, enabling a new class of real-time environmental, safety, and infrastructure insights.
Ensense AI is a high caliber, early stage team of engineers, scientists, and operators who value curiosity, engineering precision, and measurable impact. Every team member is hands on and directly responsible for defining and advancing the state of the art in Physical AI.
About the Role

We are looking for a machine learning engineer to build and advance the core intelligence that powers Ensense AI. You will work directly with the founders to design models, build training pipelines, and deploy models that interpret multimodal signals from the physical world. This role is ideal for an ML engineer who enjoys solving real world problems, thrives in early stage environments, and wants meaningful ownership of both the experimentation and production deployment of advanced models.
Responsibilities

Develop and deploy machine learning models that interpret multimodal sensor, audio, video, and environmental data
Build training pipelines, data processing tools, and evaluation frameworks for large scale spatiotemporal learning
Fine-tune foundational models for perception, understanding, and inference in physical environments
Collaborate closely with software and hardware teams to integrate models on device and in the cloud
Prototype and validate new approaches for environmental understanding, anomaly detection, and physical world inference
Design systems that ensure reliability, scalability, and high quality data
Help define modeling strategy, architecture decisions, and long term research direction
Contribute to a culture of engineering excellence, ownership, and speed

Required Qualifications

M.Sc. or higher in computer science or a closely related field
Deep understanding of machine learning fundamentals with the ability to innovate at the algorithmic level
Expertise in signal processing techniques for audio or other sensor data
Strong proficiency in machine learning frameworks such as Pytorch
2+ years of SW/ML engineering experience
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and training workflows
Ability to take models from prototype to production deployment
Strong problem solving and comfort in fast paced environments
Clear and concise communication skills

Preferred Qualifications 

Familiarity with world models and multimodal sensor fusion
Experience with spatiotemporal modeling
Background working with real world data from physical environments such as AVs
Experience deploying models on resource constrained systems
Prior startup experience or history as an early technical hire
High impact publications

Work on real applications, integrations, reports, and automations used across CEC.

jobs.description:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.

Code that saves lives.

As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.

Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).

More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.

We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.

About Millennium

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

Meet the Team

Information Technology is core to the health and growth of our business; the firm’s active, multi-manager business model demands flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including the development of the next generation of analytical and trading capabilities. Within the Digital Assets technology group, the platform team manages the full lifecycle of trading, data and analytics, reconciliation, and reporting platforms. The team analyzes structured and unstructured digital asset data across public and private markets, along with large fundamental blockchain and alternative data sets. Operating across on-prem and cloud-based environments and leveraging cloud-native services as required, the team works closely with other core engineering teams to incorporate data pipelines, data products, and research into the firm’s overall reference, market, and alternative data environment.

What You’ll Do

Partner with the COO of Digital Assets, the Head of Technology, and Digital Assets Engineering Leads to evaluate data providers and implement the strategic roadmap for digital asset data.
Analyze real-time and historical digital asset data sources and integrate them into firm platforms.
Build solutions that transform unstructured data into a form suitable for analysis and platform ingestion, with a strong emphasis on data quality and resiliency.
Ongoing design and development of order management, trading, reconciliation and risk platform.
Support business decisions with ad hoc analysis as needed.

What You Bring

3+ years of hands-on Python experience writing reusable, efficient code for analytics and data processes. Ideally building scalable, reliable data pipelines with platforms such as Snowflake and Airflow.
2+ years of experience deploying and managing AWS environments for data pipelines and intelligence services.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Experience processing large structured and unstructured datasets with strong quality and resiliency controls, and managing connectivity to data vendors in this space for 24/7 systems.
Broad understanding of financial instruments required, with equities, fixed income, or commodities exposure a plus, and a passion for digital assets/cryptocurrency backed by a strong understanding of primary markets and key sources of blockchain data.
Demonstrated passion for AI/ML with hands-on integration across the SDLC (feature engineering, model development/deployment, evaluation/monitoring) to enhance data quality, analytics, and automation.
Positive, self-driven, hands-on engineer who is effective under pressure and makes sound design and architecture decisions.

Salary Range

Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.

Code that saves lives.

As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.

Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).

More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.

We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.

jobs.description:
Zip Zap IT Solutions is seeking a Mobile Application Developer to support the continued enhancement and maintenance of the USDA APHIS Wildlife Services Operations and Reporting System (OARS) mobile applications for iOS and Android. OARS supports field operations and reporting and relies on mobile data synchronization with the Azure-hosted application and services. The developer will enhance the .NET MAUI mobile application, implement and maintain offline data synchronization using SQLite, and help ensure mobile synchronization operations complete within the PWS requirement of 60 seconds.

### **About Zip Zap IT Solutions, LLC**

Zip Zap IT, a national leader in digital transformation, offers one of the most comprehensive portfolios on the market, spanning consulting, systems integration, industry-specific solutions, infrastructure management, and business process services. It provides end-to-end solutions to address the core business needs of federal agencies and other organizations, helping them remain competitive and grow. By combining added value with innovative, high-performance services, Zip Zap IT excels at guiding its clients through their transformation projects to help them make the most of information technology.

### **Description**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop, enhance, test, and maintain OARS mobile application functionality for iOS and Android using .NET MAUI.
* Implement and maintain offline data synchronization using SQLite so mobile users can work with application data when connectivity is limited or unavailable.
* Develop and maintain synchronization between the mobile applications and OARS APIs, meeting the requirement that mobile sync operations complete within 60 seconds.
* Support reliable synchronization behavior, including handling connectivity interruptions, failed or retried exchanges, data consistency, and synchronization errors.
* Integrate mobile application functionality with OARS APIs, Azure-hosted microservices, and applicable external services.
* Support Esri integration and mobile mapping capabilities where required by prioritized OARS requirements.
* Implement new functional and non-functional requirements and participate in Agile sprint planning, development, testing, and review activities.
* Create and maintain unit, integration, automated, regression, and smoke tests as applicable; support performance testing and issue remediation.
* Validate and document Section 508 accessibility requirements for mobile functionality and participate in quarterly accessibility testing.
* Support application security requirements, including mandatory MFA for authentication and FedRAMP Moderate security controls, in coordination with the broader OARS team.
* Support mobile releases and production deployments, troubleshoot mobile application issues, and coordinate with API, backend, QA, and infrastructure personnel.
* Maintain mobile-related architecture documents, user guides, training materials, security documentation, and final release package materials.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Professional experience developing mobile applications for iOS and Android.
* Hands-on experience with .NET MAUI; experience with closely related .NET cross-platform mobile frameworks may be considered where the candidate can demonstrate directly transferable skills.
* Experience with C# and integrating mobile applications with REST APIs or backend services.
* Experience implementing local mobile data storage and offline application functionality using SQLite or a comparable embedded database.
* Experience implementing or supporting synchronization between mobile applications and backend systems.
* Experience testing and troubleshooting mobile applications on iOS and Android devices or platform simulators.
* Ability to collaborate with backend/API developers, QA personnel, and business stakeholders in an Agile development environment.

**Preferred / Differentiating Experience**
------------------------------------------

* Production experience delivering .NET MAUI applications for both iOS and Android.
* Demonstrated experience meeting a defined mobile synchronization performance target, particularly a 60-second completion requirement.
* Experience with offline-first mobile design, synchronization reliability, conflict handling, and data consistency.
* Experience with Esri/ArcGIS mobile mapping or geospatial data integration.
* Experience implementing and testing Section 508 accessibility in mobile applications, including assistive technology and platform accessibility features.
* Experience supporting applications subject to FedRAMP Moderate or comparable federal security requirements and mandatory MFA.
* Experience with mobile CI/CD, automated mobile testing, release packaging, signing, and production support.

#### **Salary**

$110,000 - $115,000 per year

We deliver mission-critical AI/ML, software engineering, digital infrastructure, and cybersecurity capabilities on active DoW and IC programs, with cleared engineers across more than 20 states.

**The Role**

INflow is standing up a GitLab Professional Services practice as a subcontracting partner to GitLab. As a Senior GitLab DevSecOps Engineer, you will deliver GitLab-scoped engagements for GitLab's enterprise and public sector customers, working alongside the GitLab PS team under GitLab's methodology, on GitLab-managed statements of work.

The work is cleared, customer-facing, and runs against defined scopes. You will install and operate GitLab at enterprise scale, migrate agencies off legacy platforms, design CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines, and roll out GitLab Duo and the Duo Agent Platform (DAP) in environments where the mission depends on getting it right the first time.

### **What You Will Do:**

* Administer GitLab Self-Managed and Dedicated environments: install, upgrade, backup and restore, user and group management, runners, Geo replication, and performance tuning.
* Lead enterprise migrations into GitLab from GitHub, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or SVN. Use Congregate and direct transfer. Deploy GitLab reference architectures.
* Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines, including security scanning (SAST, DAST, dependency, container) and compliance framework integration.
* Configure and roll out the GitLab Duo Agent Platform (DAP): build and customize agents and flows, enable AI-assisted development workflows, and advise customers on governance and adoption.
* Deliver customer-facing advisory, clear documentation, and knowledge transfer to agency teams. Lead workshops, cutovers, and secure-environment deployments.
* Operate against defined SOWs with GitLab managing the customer relationship. Scope, estimate, and ship work on schedule.

### **Required Skills:**

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps or platform engineering.
* Hands-on GitLab administration experience in production (Self-Managed or Dedicated).
* Experience designing, running, and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines at enterprise scale.
* Strong consulting instincts: clear written and verbal communication, ability to lead a customer meeting, and discipline working to a defined scope.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites for workshops, cutovers, and secure facilities when needed.

### **Preferred Skills:**

* Active GitLab certifications (GitLab Certified Associate, Professional, or Services Engineer).
* Experience with Kubernetes and Terraform in production.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure in a DevSecOps context.
* Prior work on federal, defense, or intelligence community programs.
* Experience with GitLab Duo, DAP, agentic AI, or AI-assisted development adoption.
* Experience with security scanning toolchains, STIG compliance, or cATO frameworks.

### **What You'll Get:**

* Direct GitLab enablement, training on GitLab PS delivery methods and tooling, and a defined path to GitLab certifications.
* Work on cleared, high-impact engagements across DoW, IC, and civilian federal customers.
* The opportunity to build INflow's GitLab practice from the ground up as a founding member.

### **Clearance Requirements:**

Minimum of a DoD Secret clearance is required. Top Secret highly desired.
  
  
Note: this role requires an active DoD clearance held directly by the candidate at the time of application. Top Secret preferred. Candidates without an active clearance will not be considered.

jobs.description:
### **Our Mission**

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

### **Our Values**

* **Take the Lead:** We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
* **Move Fast:** We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
* **Better Together:** We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
* **Real Talk:** We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
* **Safety First:** We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
* **Spark Fun:** We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

**Program Duration**

The internship program will run from June 1 through August 31, 2027.

**Where you’ll work**

This is a hybrid role that requires in-office collaboration three days per week in either Los Angeles or Palo Alto, California.

**About the Role**

As a Backend Engineer Intern at Tinder, you will partner directly with senior members of the engineering team and be empowered to contribute solutions to Tinder’s backend system. We are deeply invested in improving architecture design, exploring and leveraging new technologies in interesting ways to deliver an app that continues to shape how people connect globally.

### **What you'll do:**

* Collaborate across Tinder Engineering on the expansion of our service platform.
* Develop and operate scalable and resilient distributed services that run on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Build large scale distributed systems that handle billions of data events a day.
* Write unit and integration tests.
* Access to cutting-edge Generative AI tools and the opportunity to apply them in real-world engineering work.

### **What we're looking for:**

* Aspiring backend developer who’s excited to work on large scale challenges with cutting-edge technology.
* Proficiency in coding with at least one language (Java, Scala, Python,Typescript, Nodejs, etc.).
* Foundational knowledge of basic Computer Science principles: data structures and algorithms.
* Curiosity and creativity in leveraging Generative AI to reimagine feature building and development workflows.
* Currently pursuing a BS/BA, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or a related field.

### **Nice to have:**

* Prior internship or work experience on backend systems.
* Completed relevant project experience (i.e. hackathons, personal projects, GitHub, Open Source, volunteer coding experience etc.).
* Knowledge of technologies such as; Protocol Buffers, gRPC, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, ElasticSearch, Redis.
* Aware of AWS technologies like; DynamoDB, S3, RDS, ElastiCache.

$47 - $47 an hour

The compensation range listed above is representative of the hourly rate offered.

*Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in Los Angeles, and Palo Alto, California. This hourly rate will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city, state, and country), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.*

Commitment to Inclusion

At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds.
