jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Software Developer**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Parttime Term  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
We're hiring a software developer to help build and maintain MathDB.
  
  
https://mathdb.com/
  
  
MathDB is a large-scale community database of definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems in mathematics, tracking the latest breakthroughs, and providing a new platform for research and collaboration. Mathematical knowledge is growing at an extraordinary pace. New results, methods and questions are arriving faster than the literature can absorb them, making it increasingly difficult to keep track of what is known, what remains open and how developments fit together. We need a shared database that grows with the subject: a living resource that the mathematical community can continually expand, correct and refine. Much of mathematical knowledge is scattered across papers, books, lecture notes and informal conversations. We aim to bring this knowledge together in a knowledge graph, connecting definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems through implications, equivalences, examples and shared ideas. Making these relationships explicit can reveal connections that are otherwise easy to miss, help researchers navigate unfamiliar areas and accelerate the discovery of new mathematics. Formalization offers another way to make mathematical knowledge precise, reliable and reusable. We are integrating Lean formalizations and automatic proof verification into MathDB, connecting mathematical statements and their explanations with proofs that can be checked by a computer. Our goal is to make it easier to contribute formal proofs, inspect their assumptions and build on verified results, while keeping the relationship between a formal statement and its mathematical meaning clear.  
  
We're looking for someone who has experience building web apps and AI agents, and who can join our effort in building and maintaining web apps, mobile apps, backend servers, databases and Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  

* Assist in the development and maintenance of interactive web and mobile applications for MathDB.
* Support the development and maintenance of backend servers for MathDB.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of MathDB's backend database infrastructure.
* Support the development and maintenance of Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Experience developing interactive web and mobile applications.
* Strong attention to detail in application design, performance, responsiveness, visual presentation, and user interface/user experience (UI/UX).
* Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and incorporate feedback through an iterative development process.
* Experience with version control, software testing, and software engineering best practices.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering polished, production-ready software products beyond the prototype stage.
* Familiarity with cloud computing, containerization, and orchestration technologies.
* Strong interest in mathematical research.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with users and colleagues.
* Familiarity with Lean formalization.

  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume.

  
  
  
**To be considered for this position please visit our web site and apply on line at the following link:** **https://hr.caltech.edu/work/job\_openings**  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

* Proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, including data modeling, dashboard development, visualization, and report maintenance.
* Project management, organization, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Understanding of data quality, data governance, privacy, role-based access, and responsible handling of employee demographic information.

Preferred

* Familiarity with user acceptance testing, change management, training, and continuous-improvement methods.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm's mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we're enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.

You will be matched with a team after completing the interview evaluation process. Your recruiter will work closely with you throughout the process to understand your interests and experience to find the strongest team fit.

### **What you'll do**

* With the support of your team's tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
* You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
* You will support the operations and availability of your team's artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" & on-call efforts.
* You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

### **What we look for**

* You have a total of 1.5+ years of experience as a software engineer.
* You have experience designing, developing and launching backend systems and are proficient in one of Python or Kotlin.
* You are familiar with the building blocks of distributed systems, and the technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
* You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
* You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
* Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
* You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
* This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field.

**Base Pay Grade - L**

**Equity Grade - 6**

Employees new to Affirm *typically come in at the start of the pay range*. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: 165,000 - 225,000 USD

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: 146,000 - 206,000 USD

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

**Benefits designed for you**  
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

* Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
* Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
* Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
* Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We're committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we're happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Sutton**

Sutton is an AI native operating system for growing companies. Manufacturers, distributors and other operations heavy businesses run inventory, production, sales orders, purchasing and warehousing on Sutton, and many also run custom apps we build with them in days, not months. Those apps are the reason customers love us.

Sutton Studio is where anyone can build on top of the platform. You describe an app, dashboard or workflow in plain English, and it is built on live operational data, with Sutton's security and permissions underneath.

We have raised $6.3M from leading venture investors, and our customers run real operations on Sutton at scale, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company with more than 18,000 apartments, a top US research university and precision machine shops. The work you ship here has an impact you can see.

We are a small team with big ownership, and we move fast: the distance between a customer's problem and something live in their hands is measured in days.

**The role**

We are hiring a full stack engineer who can build and run almost anything. You will work directly with our Founding Engineer and our founders.

There are no separate front end, back end or lead roles here. We are a flat group of strong generalists, and everyone owns what they build, from the first line of code to production. The work spans our core product, the apps we build with customers, and the platform that keeps all of it fast and safe.

**What you will do**

You will pick up whatever matters most that week, and the mix will change. Our stack is Node.js, GraphQL and Postgres with a React front end, and we use Claude Code and Cursor every day. Typical work:

* Ship features end to end across a Node.js and GraphQL API, Postgres and a React front end, with AI assisted coding as a daily habit
* Build the platform behind Studio and customer built apps: scoped per customer tokens, a permissions model where each app declares what it touches, server side validation and audit logging tagged by app
* Own reliability for a multi tenant production system: monitoring, alerting, backups and restores, incident response and safe rollbacks
* Build resilient integrations with accounting and commerce systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite and Shopify, with retries, idempotency and an alert when a sync stops
* Extend our API and MCP server so AI assistants and apps can safely read and write operational data like inventory, production and orders
* Work on real world features: barcode scanning, label printing and streams of machine sensor data
* Turn customer feedback into product improvements, shipped in days instead of months

**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for driven builders who understand the business problem behind the code. You think in systems, move quickly, and use AI to multiply your own output. You do not need to be an expert in every layer or fit a single profile. What matters is that you are strong across the stack and committed to creating a customer outcome, with an open mind about how to get there.

* You can design a GraphQL schema, fix a slow Postgres query and debug a React state issue in the same afternoon
* You have built multi tenant SaaS and care about tenant isolation, safe migrations and per customer configuration
* You have run production systems largely on your own, and you know how to monitor, back up, roll back and recover them
* You have solid security fundamentals: authentication and authorization, scoped tokens, secrets handling and audit trails
* You are comfortable reading vendor API docs and building integrations that hold up: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries and idempotency
* You work AI native every day with Claude Code or similar, and have opinions on the tests, CI checks and review that make AI written code safe to ship
* You own outcomes: you talk to the people who use what you build, act without being asked, do what it takes to figure things out, and explain tradeoffs clearly to non engineers

Bonus points for experience with ERP, inventory or accounting systems, Cloudflare Workers, SOC 2, or hardware like scanners and sensors.

**How we work**

Speed and trust are not a tradeoff here, and everyone is expected to ship.

* **Speed is a feature.** We ship small, ship often and learn from customers.
* **Build fast, run safe.** We build on a platform that makes the safe way the easy way.
* **Everyone ships.** Every role puts something real in front of a customer or teammate every week.
* **Small team, big ownership.** You own outcomes, not tasks.
* **Candor with care.** We say the hard thing early, directly and kindly.

**Why Sutton**

You will shape an AI native ERP that customers run real operations on every day, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company and a top research university.

* Help define the product and its architecture, not inherit a pile of tickets
* Direct access to the founders and to real customers
* A small team where your work visibly changes what customers experience
* Location: US based and flexible for the right person, with a bonus for being near our founders in Atlanta or Southern California
* Base salary of $165,000 to $210,000 per year, plus meaningful equity
* Unlimited PTO, 401(k), medical, dental and vision, and team onsites

**How we hire**

The process is short and practical: a short intro call with our Founding Engineer, a coding challenge, a follow up conversation to talk through it, and a meeting with the founders. You will get a real Sutton style app to harden and extend using the AI tools you already use. We look at your speed, your judgment and how you explain your decisions.

Pay: $165,000.00 - $210,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Unlimited paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.description:
Fluent is building the next generation advertising network: Partner Monetize and Advertiser Acquisition. Our vision is to build an ML/AI first network of advertisers and publishers working toward a common objective, elevating relevancy in e-commerce for everyday shoppers.

Fluent is hiring its first dedicated AI Engineer. Over the past year, AI at Fluent has moved from pilots to production: a service desk agent that closes tickets without a human touch, a pipeline that cut modeled audience delivery from days to hours, and an agent that audits cross-system attribution and identifies revenue reconciliation opportunities. All of it was built by people doing it alongside their day jobs. Your job is to make it your day job.

You will sit in Core Engineering and work every day with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Solution Architecture. You will build the agents and automated workflows our business teams have asked for, and you will build them on the Databricks lakehouse that is Fluent's data hub, because the hard part of most of these workflows is not the model. It is getting trusted data and reliable actions in front of it.

You are a builder who ships. You are strong in Python and SQL, you have put at least one LLM-powered application in front of real users, and you know the difference between a demo and a production system: evaluation, monitoring, cost, and a clear owner. You have worked in Databricks or a comparable lakehouse, or you have the data engineering depth to get productive there quickly. You are comfortable sitting with a support lead or an account manager, understanding how they actually work, and turning that into something that runs every day. This role is fully remote in the United States, with occasional travel to our New York headquarters.

### **What you'll do**

* Ship production agents and automated workflows from a prioritized, business-validated backlog. Own each one from scoping with the business owner through build, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and handoff.
* Build the data foundation those workflows depend on in Databricks: Unity Catalog tables and views, Lakeflow pipelines, Lakeflow Connect ingestion from systems like HubSpot, and Genie spaces that let business teams ask questions in plain language. Bring data from our ad-serving and partner platforms, CRM, support desk, and finance systems into one place people can trust.
* Work with Data Science to make agent quality measurable: evaluation sets, accuracy and drift tracking, cost and latency instrumentation, and the audit fields and failure alerts every production workflow carries.
* Integrate with Fluent's systems through APIs, webhooks, MCP servers, and orchestration (Databricks Workflows, n8n, GitHub Actions), and replace brittle point-to-point automations with maintained, observable ones.
* Partner with Core Engineering to expose platform data and actions as APIs, so agents and business teams can use them directly instead of routing requests through engineers.
* Build reusable pieces, not one-offs: Claude skills, MCP connectors, prompt and evaluation libraries, and playbooks that other builders across Fluent can pick up.
* Handle consumer data in line with Fluent's privacy and compliance standards, use only approved AI tools, and work with IT & Security on credentials and access.
* Demo weekly, write things down in Confluence, and share what you learn in brown bags and tech talks.
* Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot review) as a normal part of how you work.

### **What success looks like**

In your first 90 days you will have shipped one workflow end to end, with a named business owner and numbers Finance can validate. By six months you will have several in production, at least one reusable component another builder has picked up, and a clear view of what next quarter's backlog should be.

 **Requirements**  

* 3+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, with strong Python and SQL.
* You have built and shipped at least one LLM-powered application or agent that real users depend on, using tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows) or a comparable lakehouse, or deep enough data engineering experience to ramp quickly.
* Experience integrating SaaS and internal systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and OAuth.
* You test your work, instrument it, and care about cost. You know when a workflow is ready to be owned by someone else.
* You communicate clearly with people who do not write code, and you are comfortable running a working session with a business team.
* Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of a modern engineering workflow.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Nice to have**

* Databricks Mosaic AI (Agent Framework, Model Serving, Vector Search), Genie, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakebase, or Databricks Apps.
* Building MCP servers, or working with the Claude Developer Platform or Agent SDK.
* Workflow orchestration tools such as n8n.
* Integrations with HubSpot, Zendesk, NetSuite, or Jira.
* Experience in ad tech, performance marketing, or another environment that handles regulated consumer data.

  
**Benefits**

At Fluent, we like what we do, and we like who we do it with. Our team is a tight-knit crew of go-getters; we love to celebrate our successes! In addition, we offer a fully stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch, and our office manager keeps the calendar stocked with activity-filled events. When we are not eating, working out, or planning parties, Fluent folks can be found participating in recreational sports leagues, networking with She Runs It, and bonding with across teams during quarterly outings to baseball games, fancy dinners, and pizza-making classes. And we have all the practical benefits, too…

**About Us**

  

We work with leaders of large federal programs and agencies to modernize the systems and data their missions depend on. Our teams build and run platforms that people rely on every day, from housing services for service members and their families to education data used by every state. The work is practical: replacing aging systems without disrupting the people who depend on them, making data reliable enough to act on, and delivering in small, tested increments. We're a team of engineers, architects, and delivery leads who care about doing this well, and we're looking for people who want to do the same.

  

**Position**

  

We are seeking a **Full Stack Software Engineer** to join our team. In this position, you will design, develop, and maintain front-end and back-end components of the platform, working with product owners, UX designers, architects, and other engineers. This position supports a Department of Defense digital services platform that helps military spouses find education and career resources. The position is remote, with occasional travel for onsite events, and can continue through a Permanent Change of Station (PCS) move. Military spouses are encouraged to apply. This position is contingent upon contract award.

  

**What We Offer**

  

* Do meaningful client work and grow professionally, with support for your education and development.

**How We Work**

  

* **Scrum-Aligned Collaboration:** We believe in clear goals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and automated testing. We actively participate in planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* **Team-First Culture:** We seek help early and offer help freely. We elevate our standards through design reviews, pair programming, and shared knowledge management.
* **Outcome-Driven Delivery:** We measure our impact (mission, performance, quality, cycle time), iterate on our processes, and stay focused on delivering customer value.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Full Stack Development:** Design, develop, and maintain both front-end (Angular and TypeScript) and back-end (Microsoft .NET and C#) components of a cloud-hosted enterprise digital services platform in AWS GovCloud (IL4)

* **APIs & Integrations:** Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and back-end services that support data exchange across multiple systems, including the Government’s SOAP-based authentication service (DEERS and DS Logon) and REST and SFTP partner data feeds
* **AI Features:** Integrate Government-approved AI capabilities through Amazon Bedrock, such as job matching, resume and document extraction, and drafted text
* **Testing & DevSecOps:** Contribute to automated unit and regression testing, code quality practices, and CI/CD pipelines (Git flow, AWS CodeBuild, and AWS CodePipeline) within a DevSecOps delivery model that includes static security scanning, dependency checks, and automated Section 508 checks on every build
* **Troubleshooting:** Support troubleshooting, performance optimization, and operational improvements across application components

  

**What We're Looking For (Must Have Qualifications):**

  

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical field
* **5 or more years of experience** developing web applications or enterprise software systems
* **Angular & .NET:** Proficiency in Angular and TypeScript for client-side development and in Microsoft .NET (C#) for server-side development
* **APIs & Web Services:** Experience developing RESTful APIs and back-end services and integrating SOAP web services supporting web applications
* **Relational Databases:** Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server) from application code, including writing SQL
* **Accessibility:** Experience building web applications that conform to Section 508 and WCAG accessibility standards
* **Agile:** Experience working within Agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams
* **DevSecOps:** Experience contributing to DevSecOps practices including Git version control, peer code review, automated builds, and CI/CD pipelines
* **Teamwork:** Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively within engineering teams
* **Eligibility:** U.S. citizenship and a favorably adjudicated Tier 3 background investigation or higher (an active DoD Secret or Top Secret clearance qualifies) before starting work.

**About Conduit Health**
------------------------

Conduit Health is transforming one of the hardest, most outdated corners of post-acute care — getting essential medical equipment and supplies into patients’ homes. We’ve built the first vertically integrated, AI-powered platform that unites ordering, telehealth, prescriptions, insurance, and fulfillment into one seamless experience. We're the easy button for one of the least-easy parts of managing a chronic condition.

We’ve raised $22M+ from some of the best VCs across the country, growing fast, and building the team that will define the future of post-acute care in the U.S.

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for software engineers who are excited to build the next generation of Conduit Health’s patient experience. You’ll be responsible for owning and shipping high impact products that directly affect outcomes. You'll join a small (but quickly growing!) team of engineers building the platform that's transforming patients’ access to medical equipment.

Our product-market fit is proven and demand is growing every day. We are scaling up our engineering team to meet that demand.

You'll implement major features end-to-end, make architectural decisions that affect the entire platform, and have the ability to directly influence the engineering culture and how we build software.

You can expect to tackle a wide range of challenges:

* **Streamlining fulfillment**: turning complex manual workflows into elegant automations, leveraging a combination of traditional deterministic approaches and modern AI/agentic tools.
* **Enhancing our end-user experience**: building high growth customer-facing applications that directly impact our patients and their caretakers
* **External integrations**: Building external facing APIs and other creative AI-driven solutions to give our partners ways to automate their workflows
* **Being scrappy**: Running experiments, proof of concepts, and being genuinely curious in ways that shape the product roadmap.

All while elevating the bar of how Conduit Health approaches engineering. This role reports directly into the Head of Engineering.

**You’re the right fit if:**
----------------------------

* You’re a builder who enjoys being hands on and excited about owning features from 0 to 1
* You're a product minded engineer who likes to be involved in the "what" and "why" of the features we build
* You're a strong communicator, both technically and non-technically.
* You’ve worked in early stage, high growth startup environments where you’ve had a measurable, direct impact
* You have a team-oriented mindset: you are low-ego, deeply value good communication, documenting your thought processes, giving/receiving constructive feedback, and embracing collaboration.
* You’re comfortable working across the stack (although we understand when folks lean towards one side)
* You have deep experience in at least some parts of our stack: Python, Typescript, React, Postgres, MongoDB, Kubernetes, AWS
* Your workflow involves deep usage of LLMs/agentic tools, and you know how to use them most effectively
* You know how to stay nimble, flexible, and deal with natural ambiguity in a growing startup environment

**Bonus points if:**

* You have experience in the healthcare industry
* You’ve dealt with compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC2, etc)

**Working with us**
-------------------

Conduit Health is based in NYC, with an office in Union Square. Our engineering team works mostly remotely, with a preference for team members within commuting distance for ad-hoc team rituals.

**Why join us**
---------------

* Opportunity to have a real impact on the patient experience
* Competitive base salary + equity
* Unlimited PTO + 9 company holidays
* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
* 401k

**What to expect in the process?**
----------------------------------

* Introductory call with the Head of Engineering

Compensation Range: $150K - $225K

3–6 years of experience in technology risk, IT controls, technical audit support, software engineering, infrastructure engineering, cybersecurity governance, or a closely related discipline

jobs.title: Accounting & Finance Data, Reporting, and Automation Engineer - State, Local, and Higher Education
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Work You'll Do

As a Senior Consultant for General Business Finance Data Analytics & Insights team, you will be responsible for the design, build, and maintain automations that streamline accounting and finance processes for state, local, and higher education clients. You will work closely with client finance teams and our consultants to turn manual, error-prone work into reliable, auditable, and scalable workflows. You will also build the data pipelines, reporting tools, and control checks that help clients close faster, reconcile with confidence, and stay ready for audit.

Design and build automations for recurring finance and accounting processes, such as bank reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable matching, journal entry preparation, accrual calculations, and month-end and year-end close checklists.
Develop process automation and workflow solutions using tools such as Power Automate, UiPath, or similar platforms, with appropriate exception handling and human review points.
Build and maintain data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) pipelines that pull data from ERP and other information systems, including Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, into reporting environments.
Write SQL queries and scripts to validate data, identify anomalies, and support general ledger analysis, reconciliations, and chart of accounts clean-up.
Design and maintain dashboards and recurring financial reports for controllers, treasurers, budget offices, and boards, including fund-level, grant-level, and capital asset reporting.
Build automated control testing and monitoring routines aligned to the COSO framework, producing evidence that supports internal audit, external financial statement audits, state audits, and Single Audits under Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200).
Document automations thoroughly, including process maps, logic, data lineage, access controls, and runbooks, so that clients can maintain and audit them independently.
Establish version control, testing, and change management practices for automations, and ensure they comply with client IT security and data governance policies.
Train client staff on how to operate, monitor, and modify automations, and transition ownership to permanent teams at the end of an engagement.
Evaluate client processes to identify automation opportunities, estimate return on investment, and recommend a prioritized roadmap.
Support backfill and interim engagements where automations reduce workload for embedded consultants, and ensure those automations are documented for the returning staff member.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

The General Business Finance Data Analytics & Insights team helps finance organizations turn financial and operational data into reliable reporting and actionable insights.

The team combines data engineering, analytics, visualization, and finance process knowledge to support decisions across planning, performance management, and business operations.

Professionals collaborate with stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and access to information.

Qualifications

Required :

Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, information systems, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
Building finance or accounting automations using RPA, AI, or other workflow tools;
Developing query-based reporting output, data validation, or ETL processes;
Scripting in various languages for financial data analysis; or
Implementing ERP, reporting, or data integration solutions for finance teams.

Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals, including general ledger structures, reconciliations, journal entries, and the chart of accounts. Familiarity with fund accounting and GASB or FASB standards is preferred.
Hands-on experience with automation and intelligence platforms or a business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
Understanding of internal controls, COSO principles, and audit requirements, with the ability to design automations that produce audit-ready evidence.
Familiarity with data governance, information security, and access controls in regulated environments.
Ability to obtain/maintain and security clearances needed for the client and/or project.
Ability to work independently across multiple client environments, manage competing priorities, and travel as needed.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, window functions, and query optimization, with experience working against relational databases.
Experience with ERP (such as SAP, Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft) or other systems (for example Workiva, Balckline, One Stream, Anaplan, etc), is preferred.
Experience supporting federal, state, local government, or higher education clients
Experience with data warehousing or lakehouse architecture
Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) orchestration tools
Experience working in Agile delivery environments
Experience using Git-based version control and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines
Master's degree in Computer Science, Accounting Information systems, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or Statistics
Strong documentation skills and the ability to explain technical solutions clearly to non-technical finance stakeholders.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

About This Role

Your team

The Regulatory Reporting engineering team builds and supports enterprise-scale technology that enables accurate, timely, and compliant regulatory reporting. The team works across product, compliance, operations, architecture, and engineering functions to develop scalable solutions that respond to evolving regulatory requirements. The work combines modern software engineering with the controls, reliability, security, and auditability expected of regulatory reporting platforms.

Your role and impact

As a Java Developer, you will design, build, and support high-performance applications and data-processing capabilities for Regulatory Reporting. You will help translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions while contributing to architecture, platform modernization, and engineering standards. jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Elevator Pitch: Why will you enjoy this new opportunity?

The Virtual Machine Monitor Group (“Monitor Group”) is responsible for the core CPU and memory virtualization technology used in all of Broadcom's VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) Division products. You will have the opportunity to work with bleeding edge CPU technology, VT-x/AMD-V, interrupt virtualization, memory virtualization/management, and virtualization of other forms of compute technologies and accelerators.

The VCF Division works to build products and solutions that power the hybrid cloud. Working alongside other highly motivated and capable engineers you will get to interact with our largest customers to define the next generation of Broadcom's industry-leading VMWare Cloud Foundation platform.

Success in the Role: What are the performance outcomes over the first 6-12 months you will work toward completing?

The Monitor Group’s principal function is to maintain and develop the virtual CPU and memory aspects of the virtual machine platform that runs guest operating systems.

In the first 6 months, you will be expected to get up to speed with one of the specialization areas, such as new CPU feature enablement, x86_64 instruction set (ISA) virtualization, confidential computing, modernization of the monitor architecture, hardware accelerators, power-aware compute or aspects of guest timekeeping. By year 1 you would be expected to have impactful, core engineering contributions and enhancements in your area of specialization.

The Work: What type of work will you be doing? What assignments, requirements, or skills will you be performing on a regular basis?

This role requires you to possess a deep understanding of processor architecture and low-level OS kernel internals, system software including memory management, resource management, and interrupt architecture. The principal programming language used is C, with assembly code used whenever needed to deal with machine-specific constructs.

You will work independently and as a member of a team of software engineers to design and deliver features in support of new processors or a proposed enhancement for the virtual machine monitor architecture. As an example, you might be involved in the design and implementation of upcoming CPU instruction set updates in a virtualization context. Similarly, you may be assigned to contribute to an aspect of memory virtualization/management features as part of a monitor modernization effort. For more senior roles you would be expected to make proposals that help define the design roadmap, or drive a technical effort leading other engineers.

What is the leadership like for this role? What is the structure and culture of the team like?

You will be joining as a Virtual Machine Monitor Engineer as part of the Monitor Group. The Monitor Group is a part of the VMWare Cloud Foundation (VCF) Division under Broadcom. This organization handles all aspects of virtual machine engineering and has deep roots in the history of the company. The Monitor Group is highly collaborative in nature, with a well-established culture of engineering discipline. Here you will have the opportunity not only to interact with other team members within the Group, but also other groups working on core aspects of vSphere. You will lead your part within the projects, as well as frequently be given the opportunity to present your work to others and learn about the novel work of other engineers.

Job Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field and 8+ years of related experience or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field and 6+ years of related experience or PhD plus 3+ years.
Experience in C, and assembly programming
Experience working on the kernel and /or virtualization space
Proficient in x86_64 CPU architecture

Must have legal authorization to work in the US.

jobs.title: Foundation Model Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Sciforium is an AI infrastructure company developing next-generation multimodal AI models and a proprietary, high-efficiency serving platform. Backed by multi-million-dollar funding and direct sponsorship from AMD with hands-on support from AMD engineers the team is scaling rapidly to build the full stack powering frontier AI models and real-time applications.

Role Overview

Sciforium is seeking a highly technical and visionary Foundation Model Data Engineer
to lead the strategy, creation, and curation of the massive datasets that power our foundation models. We believe that in the era of LLMs, data is the primary competitive advantage. In this role, you will own the end-to-end data lifecycle—from raw web-scale crawling to the fine-grained human-alignment datasets that define model behavior.

This position is ideal for a scientist who views data as a high-scale engineering challenge and an analytical puzzle. You will not just "provide" data; you will design the taxonomies, filtering heuristics, and post-training pipelines that ensure our models are world-class in reasoning, safety, and multimodal understanding.

Key Responsibilities

Foundation Dataset Strategy: Own the end-to-end creation of pre-training datasets for LLMs. This includes defining the mix of web data, code, books, and technical papers to optimize for downstream model performance.
Petabyte-Scale Curation: Design and implement sophisticated pipelines for data cleaning, exact/fuzzy deduplication, and high-quality signal extraction from petabytes of raw, unstructured data.
Post-Training & Alignment Data: Lead the development of high-quality post-training datasets, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) instructions, multi-turn dialogues, and preference modeling data (RLHF/DPO).
Multimodal Expansion: Drive the acquisition and processing of vision and video data, navigating the complexities of multimodal alignment, video compression, and temporal data consistency.
High-Performance Engineering: Develop high-throughput data processing scripts using Python, leveraging multiprocessing and multithreading to handle massive-scale ingestion and transformation without bottlenecks.
Data Profiling & Analysis: Conduct deep-dive statistical analysis on training corpora to identify biases, gaps in knowledge, and quality regressions, ensuring the "diet" of the model is mathematically balanced.
Synthetic Data Generation: (Added Value) Design pipelines to generate high-reasoning synthetic data to augment gaps in natural datasets, utilizing existing models for data labeling and refinement.

Must-Haves

5+ years of industry experience in Data Science or Machine Learning, with a proven track record of building and managing datasets for foundation models.
Deep Proficiency in Python: Expert-level skills with a focus on high-performance code, including multiprocessing, multithreading, and efficient memory management for large-scale data tasks.
Petabyte-Scale Experience: Demonstrated experience working with petabyte-scale datasets that have been directly used to train production-grade LLMs or Large Vision Models.
Dataset Reconstruction: Experience building massive LLM training sets from scratch, including raw web crawls (e.g., Common Crawl) and specialized domain data.
Post-Training Expertise: Hands-on experience building datasets for RLHF, DPO, and multi-turn instruction following, including the management of human-labeling workflows and quality gold-sets.
Data Tooling: Mastery of data-at-scale frameworks such as Spark, Ray, or high-performance data-loading formats (e.g., WebDataset, Parquet).

Nice-to-Haves

Computer Vision (CV) Curation: Experience building large-scale image or video datasets from scratch (e.g., LAION-style pipelines).
Multimodal Crawling: Familiarity with large-scale crawling of multimodal data and the associated challenges of video processing, codecs, and compression.
Taxonomy Design: Experience in designing complex labeling schemas for reasoning, coding, and mathematical benchmarks.
Research Background: A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field with a focus on data-centric AI or information retrieval.

Benefits include

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401k plan
Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages
Flexible time off
Competitive salary and equity

Equal opportunity

jobs.title: Accounting & Finance Data, Reporting, and Automation Engineer - State, Local, and Higher Education
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Work You'll Do

As a Senior Consultant for General Business Finance Data Analytics & Insights team, you will be responsible for the design, build, and maintain automations that streamline accounting and finance processes for state, local, and higher education clients. You will work closely with client finance teams and our consultants to turn manual, error-prone work into reliable, auditable, and scalable workflows. You will also build the data pipelines, reporting tools, and control checks that help clients close faster, reconcile with confidence, and stay ready for audit.

Design and build automations for recurring finance and accounting processes, such as bank reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable matching, journal entry preparation, accrual calculations, and month-end and year-end close checklists.
Develop process automation and workflow solutions using tools such as Power Automate, UiPath, or similar platforms, with appropriate exception handling and human review points.
Build and maintain data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) pipelines that pull data from ERP and other information systems, including Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, into reporting environments.
Write SQL queries and scripts to validate data, identify anomalies, and support general ledger analysis, reconciliations, and chart of accounts clean-up.
Design and maintain dashboards and recurring financial reports for controllers, treasurers, budget offices, and boards, including fund-level, grant-level, and capital asset reporting.
Build automated control testing and monitoring routines aligned to the COSO framework, producing evidence that supports internal audit, external financial statement audits, state audits, and Single Audits under Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200).
Document automations thoroughly, including process maps, logic, data lineage, access controls, and runbooks, so that clients can maintain and audit them independently.
Establish version control, testing, and change management practices for automations, and ensure they comply with client IT security and data governance policies.
Train client staff on how to operate, monitor, and modify automations, and transition ownership to permanent teams at the end of an engagement.
Evaluate client processes to identify automation opportunities, estimate return on investment, and recommend a prioritized roadmap.
Support backfill and interim engagements where automations reduce workload for embedded consultants, and ensure those automations are documented for the returning staff member.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

3+ years of experience using calibration tools for embedded software/controls.

Direct experience troubleshooting embedded control systems integrated into a vehicle platform.
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English (additional languages a plus).

Ability to understand embedded C/C++ code or Python scripts and make minor software updates.
Hands‑on experience conducting lab work, including sensor mounting adjustments, vehicle modifications, wiring/instrumentation (e.g., DGPS), and troubleshooting test‑equipment architectures.

Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain systems within a microservices architecture that power rate visibility and autonomous booking.

Ensure high-quality standards by incorporating metrics, monitoring, and applying learnings from post-mortems to all services.

A passion for simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.

Experience with elements of our tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, React, AWS.

A bias for action:

Improve playback quality of experience (QoE) metrics such as play startup time, rebuffering, and error rates. Trace problems to their root cause across the player, device, network, and backend.
Extend reach across the device ecosystem by bringing features to memory-constrained and low-power TV devices and to the range of browsers that run the Web Player.
Partner with UI, Encoding, Streaming Algorithms, Security, Open Connect, and device partner teams on feature development and experimentation.
Contribute to continuous integration, test automation, and release management for the video player.

Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values.

You have 3+ years of software development experience with streaming media playback or with software that manages audio and video playback on devices.
You have strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js with a track record of writing clean, readable, and maintainable code. Experience with C++ is a plus.
You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer, Growth
jobs.description:
About Us

Parabola is a workflow builder that makes it easy to organize and transform messy data from anywhere—even PDFs, emails, and spreadsheets—so that forward-thinking teams can automate the work they thought would always be manual.

Teams at fast-moving companies like Brooklinen, On Running, and Flexport use Parabola to save hundreds of hours and finally take on the projects that used to feel out of reach. Whether it’s reconciling inventory across multiple 3PLs, auditing invoices, or manually exporting the same report every Monday, Parabola gives teams the power to automate it—all without needing engineering support.

Parabola is backed by OpenView Partners, Matrix Partners, Thrive Capital and more.

About The Role

The Applied AI team at Parabola is the conduit through which our largest and most strategic accounts pass through on their way to unlocking the maximum value from our product.

As an Automation Engineer on our Growth team, you will be directly responsible for partnering with key accounts post implementation to ensure value realization continues throughout their lifecycle.

Your mission is to drive sustained adoption, expansion of use cases, and measurable business impact across complex organizations. You’ll proactively monitor account usage and engagement signals, identify opportunities to deepen value, and work directly with customers to design and deploy new workflows that solve evolving business challenges.

You’ll serve as a trusted partner to both technical and business stakeholders, ranging from the C-Suite to the analyst, for QBRs, workshops and building sessions.

You will own customer strategy, technical execution, stakeholder alignment, commercial renewals, and long-term success. You’ll make sure that your portfolio of growing customers continue to see Parabola as a core part of their operations.

You’ll lead with data, move fast, and operate comfortably in ambiguity while shaping how we support our most customers. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales to solve customer problems and help shape what we build next.

About You

You love customers and are naturally curious about how their businesses truly work. You enjoy learning the ins and outs of their organizations, mapping company level goals to functional outcomes, and helping teams leverage automation to accelerate meaningful results.

You’re energized by meeting new teams, uncovering new use cases, learning new systems, and turning ideas into deployed, repeatable solutions. Along the way, you naturally build playbooks and best practices that scale across accounts.

You’re equally comfortable facilitating strategic conversations with senior leaders and getting your hands dirty technically. You can present confidently to executives, lead collaborative workshops, and seamlessly transition into working with APIs, prompting the latest AI models, and bringing Parabola flows to life.

You’re skilled at managing multiple initiatives at once, creating clear project plans, and maintaining momentum in complex customer environments.

Above all, you are a trusted advisor that is thoughtful, confident, and personable. You represent Parabola professionally, advocate for the customers you support, and take ownership of ensuring they continue to realize and expand value with our product.

What You'll Be Doing

Own post-implementation relationships for ~15-30 Mid-Market accounts, serving as a trusted advisor from executive sponsors to hands-on operators
Monitor and analyze product usage and engagement metrics to assess account health, identify risk, and surface expansion opportunities
Partner with customer stakeholders to map organizational goals to functional initiatives and high-impact automation use cases
Adapt your approach and be able to effectively context switch across the range of personas we serve, and tailor each conversation to what matters most to them
Quantify the value and ROI customers get from Parabola, and build frameworks to measure it consistently across your portfolio
Design, build, and deploy new workflows alongside customers, supporting end users through hands-on co-building and technical guidance
Lead QBRs, trainings, lunch-and-learns, and workshops
Develop and refine repeatable playbooks and best practices to drive sustained adoption across mature accounts
Build and maintain plans, timelines, enablement materials, and executive-facing presentations
Drive non-upsell renewals from start to close, handling proposals, negotiations, and the contracting process
Partner with Account Executives and internal Product/ Engineering teams to identify upsell opportunities, and surface actionable product feedback

What (we Think) You'll Need To Do It

2-5 years of experience in a customer-facing role, such as Technical Account Management, Technical Customer Success, Implementation Consulting, or Sales Engineering
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to quickly build trust and rapport across a wide range of stakeholders
Polished presentation and facilitation skills, including comfort presenting to executive audiences
Strong prioritization skills so you can focus your time where it will have the greatest impact within your book of business
Experienced in quantifying ROI and building business cases that clearly communicate impact and value to executive stakeholders
Comfort and familiarity with prompting modern AI models and applying them in real-world business contexts
Experience working with data and systems (Excel, SQL, and with APIs)
Strong problem-solving skills, with a passion for breaking down complex challenges and designing effective solutions across industries
High ownership and intellectual curiosity with the ability to ramp rapidly in new industries, systems, and workflows
Based in San Francisco or New York City, with the ability to commute to the office 3–4 days per week

Nice To Haves

Previous experience working with AI tools
Previous experience working with ERPs, WMSs, TMSs (NetSuite, Uber Freight TMS, Microsoft Business Central, Blue Yonder)
Experience working in a project based role - i.e. consulting
Knowledge of supply chain fundamentals or finance/accounting
Previous experience working in a start up environment

OTE Range: $130,000 - $165,000

This OTE represents the minimum and maximum for this role based in San Francisco and New York. The salary given for this position is dependent on multiple factors, including years of experience, interview performance and anticipated responsibilities of the role. Our base salary is one component of Parabola’s competitive total package, which also includes equity and premium health and wellness benefits.

jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Description

Tyndall Federal Credit Union is an established Credit Union based in Panama City, Florida with branches across the Florida Panhandle and South Alabama. We offer our employees a family-orientated work environment with numerous exciting benefits and career growth. We are looking for the next member of our #TeamTyndall family!

Our Mission

Tyndall Federal Credit Union is committed to making a meaningful difference in the lives of our members. We take pride in the great care we offer our members and employees alike!

Our Credit Union serves more than 100,000 members.
We believe in helping our members reach their financial goals and making dreams come true along the way!
We believe having a diverse workforce yields greater innovation, inclusion, and creativity.
Tyndall Federal Credit Union knows the importance of philanthropy in our communities. That’s why in addition to giving back through community service grants and sponsorship, we encourage our employees to volunteer in their community – and get paid while they’re doing it!

Benefits:

Family First Leave- Providing 12 weeks of 100% paid bonding time to all Full Time Eligible employees.
We offer an excellent 401(k) plan with generous employer matching.
All employees receive 16 paid community volunteer hours.
Full Time (up to 40 hours per week) positions also offer 11 paid holidays, paid time off, excellent health/vision/dental benefits and more!
Part Time (up to 35 hours per week) positions are offered 11 paid holidays, and paid time off!

The Location:
Tyndall Federal Credit Union is based in Panama City, Florida. This position is a remote opportunity; however, we have a strong preference for candidates who reside within one hour of our Operations Center (3109 Minnesota Ave, Panama City, FL 32405).

Why Should You Apply?
Tyndall Federal Credit Union offers an exceptional employee experience that includes comprehensive benefits, a culture of appreciation, flexibility, a family-oriented atmosphere, and rewarding work.

Role

Manage the full lifecycle of the credit union's core banking environment, including the development, testing, and deployment of program updates, reporting extracts, and automated job schedules. Coordinate core releases by balancing technical deployment with guiding operational teams through process changes, including documentation updates, communicating staff training needs, and process optimization. Build and maintain secure, efficient interfaces with third-party partners, such as mobile banking and credit reporting services, to automate workflows which reduce both manual work and additional back-office tasks. Serve as a departmental leader and technical escalation point, providing mentorship on programming, projects, and stepping in for the Director of Core Systems as needed. Prioritize system uptime since even minor bugs in core banking code can have significant operational and financial repercussions for the credit union and our members. Ensure the core banking system is fully compliant with financial regulations through robust audit trails, data and backup encryption, and strict access controls. Demonstrating and upholding our Core Values and WE Standards is a fundamental responsibility of every employee and is required in all positions throughout the organization.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Develop and maintain robust application software by writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code in our core programming languages. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions with credit union systems, ensuring high performance, scalability, and strict adherence to financial security standards.
Analyze, develop, and test new processes as well as modify existing processes. Automate manual processes and tasks whenever possible. Develop and maintain credit union data processing schedules including assuring documentation is updated and modified as required.
Coordinates the installation of core system software releases, patches, and updates. Assists in pre-testing and implementation of core system software.
Maintains an up-to-date working knowledge of core system software, keeping abreast of the capabilities of the system with each new release. Coordinates with the software vendor(s) and analyst teammates on implementation, configuration, and interface builds related to core banking software and hardware.
Ensures high availability, redundancy, and recoverability of the core banking systems. Monitors resources of the core system in terms of disk space and allocation, memory usage, processor usage, and end-user response-time. Makes proactive recommendations to supervisor regarding system upgrade requirements.
Assures that all core system software and hardware problems are resolved in a timely manner. Maintains up-to-date documentation of all system issues. Provides general support for other technology or data processing issues related to core banking.
Manages projects ensuring project deliverables are provided on time with a high level of quality and accuracy.
Provides technical training and mentorship for fellow teammates, developing their technical skill sets. Keep communication with colleagues and peers within IT and across the organization clear and professional.
Ensure compliance with all regulatory programs including but not limited to the Bank Secrecy Act, Office of Foreign Asset Control Program and Customer Identification Program. Assist other department personnel and performs other duties as assigned. Remote employees must adhere to their agreed-upon work schedule from a secure location, participating in virtual meetings, video conferences/other communications, and maintaining regular, responsive communication during working hours. Demonstrate flexibility to work varied hours as needed, including evenings and weekends, to support system coverage and departmental needs, including coverage during employee absences, training periods, or equipment issues.

Performance Measurements

Demonstrates proficiency in core banking programming and scripting languages by delivering accurate and efficient code solutions for core banking applications.
Develops, implements, and optimizes processes for automation and workflow improvements, resulting in increased operational efficiency and reduced manual intervention. Comprehensive expertise in managing the core banking job schedular so that no business process is interrupted. Complete assigned period end processing and reports on schedule, with zero errors.
Coordinates software releases for core system applications, performing thorough testing and validation to ensure timely, error-free deployments in accordance with release schedules.
Maintains up-to-date knowledge of core system software, effectively collaborating with vendors to address issues and facilitate enhancements.
Monitors system availability and performance metrics, proactively identifying and resolving resource bottlenecks to ensure continuous, high-quality service delivery. Keep management informed of service interruptions and minimize downtime to off-peak time hours.
Resolves complex software and hardware issues promptly, documenting actions and outcomes to build a knowledge base and support future troubleshooting efforts.
Manages projects by adhering to defined timelines, budgets, and quality standards, ensuring that all deliverables meet business and regulatory requirements.
Provides technical training, guidance, and mentorship to colleagues, enhancing team capabilities and supporting ongoing professional development.
Act as a reliable bridge between IT and non-technical departments, demonstrating success by simplifying complex findings into clear, actionable guidance that supports informed decision-making. Exhibit intentional communication style by prioritizing clarity, brevity, and structured formatting to ensure your key messages are easily understood and respected by peers throughout the credit union.
Provide friendly, professional and accurate service and support to all members and associates Ensure staff interactions are built upon trust, integrity, patience, and respect.

This Job Description is not a complete statement of all duties and responsibilities comprising the position.

Requirements

Experience:

Five years to eight years of similar or related experience.

Education

(1) A two-year college degree, or (2) completion of a specialized certification or licensing, or (3) completion of specialized training courses conducted by vendors, or (4) job-specific skills acquired through an apprenticeship program.

Interpersonal Skills

Work involves much personal contact with others inside and/or outside the organization for the purpose of first-level conflict resolution, building relationships, and soliciting cooperation. Discussions involve a higher degree of confidentiality and discretion, requiring diplomacy and tact in communication.

Other Skills

Able to create simple PC-based software applications and reports. Ability to type, use computer and general office equipment including 10-key calculator. Requires basic to intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Word, Outlook and Excel. Knowledge of Summit Spectrum Back-Office Operations is preferred. The ability to travel locally and out of town on credit union related business and training may be required. Understanding of database administration concepts to include working knowledge of UNIX and Windows.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands, and is required to talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, sit, and walk occasionally for long periods at a time. The employee may occasionally be required to reach with hands and arms and move objects up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, and ability to adjust focus. In addition, abilities for assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned is required.
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment

Maintain a professional, business-appropriate appearance in accordance with the credit union’s dress code.
This position is eligible for remote or hybrid work. Must minimize home office distractions and comply with applicable organizational policies.
Tyndall Federal Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an equal opportunity employer, Tyndall Federal Credit Union does not discriminate against any employee or candidate on the basis of age, race, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by all applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking a Physical Scientist/Software Developer with a background in physics and/or mathematics and strong software coding skills to work onsite at the Stennis Space Center, Mississippi. As a Physical Scientist/Software Developer you will contribute to ongoing Navy Research Laboratory (NRL) research and development of operational tools for Navy use. This project consists of the implementation and analysis of algorithms that model problems in underwater acoustics.

What You Will Do:

This endeavor involves experimentation with state-of-the-art techniques for advancing the science in characterizing undersea acoustic propagation and predicting sonar range for operational Navy use. You will contribute by:

Collaborating with mathematics, physics, and acoustics researchers
Writing code, usually in Python or Matlab, to prototype capabilities
Develop algorithms in collaboration with researchers
Converting prototypes into executable programs in Python, C/C++, or FORTRAN
Interfacing with libraries developed in these and other languages, such as Python or Java
Preparing software for delivery to the fleet
Documentation of software in the form of a user manual, an API for developers, and a test description

Qualifications

What you will need:

Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with PhD
Ability to obtain a Secret Clearance
U.S. citizenship
Strong background in mathematics and/or physics
3+ years' experience in active software development; may include graduate or advanced undergraduate education
Experience writing clear, detailed documentation of how software works and how it is supposed to be used
Experience porting software prototyped or developed in one language into another
Experience developing software in one language (e.g., C/C++) while interfacing with another (e.g., FORTRAN)

jobs.description:
Role Descriptions & Responsibilities

We are looking for a PowerFLOW Discretizer Software Engineer to work on software to automatically prepare simulation ready geometric models for PowerFLOW, Lattice-Boltzmann method (LBM) based fluid solver of Dassault Systemes, using various state-of-the-art geometry operations. AI-based surrogate modeling and physics-based simulation are increasingly being adopted in early-stage design to accelerate design feedback and enable broader exploration of the design space. Both approaches rely on volumetric meshes to either perform numerical simulations or represent and report predicted results.

As a member of the team, you will be responsible for enhancing LBM mesh generation technology using AI-assisted code agent to produce simulation meshes in real-time utilizing the power of GPU computing. Additionally, you will be responsible to develop and support computationally intensive stages of the meshing process using distributed parallelization on large clusters. This is a highly visible, key position in SIMULIA's software development organization offering the opportunity for significant leadership and impact.

Qualifications

Demonstrated experience delivering successful software development projects
Experience developing in conjunction with AI code assistant tools – ideally in areas dealing with 3D geometry
Experience with GPU computing
Experience with parallel processing
MS or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent
Excellent C++ programming skills
Experience designing and developing complex object-oriented software
Solid grounding in computer science
A genuine enthusiasm for exploring new technologies, learning about unfamiliar problem domains, and continuously expanding your technical knowledge will be a definite plus
Excellent English written and verbal communication skills
Strong problem-solving skills
Experience with numerical simulation techniques is a definite plus
