jobs.title: Software Engineer 5 - TV & Web Player
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is passionate about streaming media security and playback to join the TV & Web Player team. Our team powers the player client engine behind Netflix streaming across hundreds of millions of living room CE devices (such as Smart TVs, STBs, and streaming sticks) and web browsers via www.netflix.com. In this role, you will lead client content protection architecture, design DRM solutions, and secure client-server communications across the entire player client stack. You will manage streaming media content for different streaming modes (Live, Ads, SVOD), extend Digital Rights Management to enforce new content policies, and influence player UX interfaces. You will also partner with cross-functional teams in Streaming Algorithms, Encoding Technologies, Security, Content, and Device Partners to build secure, high-performance playback solutions optimized for memory and QoE.

About The Role

Lead the client content protection architecture and the security aspects of client-server communication across TV & Web player clients.
Design, develop and deliver playback foundational capabilities required to support different streaming modes such SVOD, Live and ad-supported viewing, including dynamic ad insertion, across both TV and Web Player Clients.
Write design documents, drive them through review with partner teams, and make architecture decisions that hold up as the player, device ecosystem, and product evolve.
Own the investigation of complex, hard-to-reproduce playback problems that span the player, device, network, and backend, and fix the underlying cause rather than the symptom.
Define and run A/B experiments for new encodes, player behavior, and streaming algorithms. Use the results to decide what ships, and set the experimentation standards for the team.
Set and improve playback quality of experience (QoE) targets such as play startup time, rebuffering, and playback error rates, and lead the work to reach them.
Rethink and rebuild existing designs where the data shows a better approach, including player components that must run on memory-constrained and low-power TV devices.
Partner with UI, Encoding, Streaming Algorithms, Security, Open Connect, and device partner teams to shape product requirements and technical plans.
Improve continuous integration, test automation, and release management for the video player so features ship safely at scale.
Mentor engineers through code review, design review, and pairing, and help peers grow in scope and technical depth.
Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values.

What Sets You Apart

You have deep knowledge of DRM systems and content protection handling for streaming media, with extensive experience in client-server security protocols and adaptive streaming technologies such as MPEG-DASH, HTML5 MSE, and EME.
You have 8+ years of software development experience, with expertise in streaming media playback and content protection technologies. Experience with live streaming or Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) is a plus.
You have architected content security and player solutions to complex problems in the streaming space and carried them from design through production rollout.
You are an expert in TypeScript, Node.js and proficient in C++. You set the bar for code quality and maintainability on your team.
You have a solid understanding of networking protocols HTTP, TCP, UDP and WebSockets and transport security mechanisms.
You have designed experiments, analyzed the data, and used it to improve streaming quality and to influence decisions beyond your own team.
You have shipped software at scale and developed software for Smart TVs, set-top boxes, or streaming sticks.
You have grown and mentored other engineers, and peers seek you out for design feedback and technical judgment.
You go deeper to find root causes, and you can reason through client, network, and backend interactions in a domain where playback failures are often hard to reproduce.
You communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineers, product managers, data science partners, and leadership, and you build collaboration across team boundaries.
You are curious, self-motivated, selfless, and seek other perspectives to improve your ideas.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. Meet the Team

Our dedicated team members are engineering the foundation of Cisco’s core technologies across the globe, including teams in Engineering like Common Hardware Group, Network Product Eng, Infrastructure & Security. You will be an essential contributor to the development of next-generation innovations in operating systems, firmware, networking stacks, and security infrastructure. Working on these teams, you will gain hands-on experience with hardware-software integration and low-level networking technologies that power Cisco’s critical products. Discover the possibilities when deep technical expertise meets creativity and help build solutions that transform how the world connects and communicates.

Your Impact

You are a passionate engineer skilled in low-level programming, networking protocols, and hardware-software integration, with strong communication and collaboration abilities. You thrive in solving complex challenges through innovation and precision, while being highly organized and process-driven. Your work develops and maintains critical software and tools that ensure hardware compatibility, network performance, and security for Cisco’s core products like operating systems, firmware, and networking stacks. By effectively managing your time and streamlining processes, you deliver high-quality solutions that embed resilience and efficiency into global communications infrastructure, directly contributing to Cisco’s leadership in trusted, scalable networking technologies.

Minimum Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree with 0 years of work experience; or
An educational or workforce development program (e.g., Associate’s, Apprenticeship, Boot camp, or Certification) with 1 year of work experience; or
High school diploma (or equivalent) with 2 years of work experience.

Proficiency in C programming and experience working in embedded Linux environments, including a solid understanding of operating system fundamentals.
Working knowledge of core networking principles, routing protocols, and general network architecture concepts.
Hands-on experience developing automation scripts (e.g., Python or Bash), utilizing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and applying DevSecOps practices within software workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

Conceptual understanding or hands-on experience with AI/ML.
Understanding of cybersecurity principles and security protocols.
Experience with FPGA development.
Knowledge of signal and power integrity, and PCB design.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Jr Software Developer - TS/SCI
jobs.description:
Junior Software Developer - TS/SCI Clearance

Strategic Business Systems, Inc. (SBS)
is seeking a motivated Junior Software Developer
to support a cutting-edge modeling and analytics framework for the U.S. Intelligence Community (IC).

This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career software developer to work alongside experienced technical leaders in cloud computing, software engineering, and data analytics. The selected candidate will contribute to the modernization, enhancement, and operational support of a mission-critical application leveraged across the Intelligence Community to support real-time decision-making.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in Java development, an interest in cloud technologies, and a desire to grow their technical skills while supporting important national security missions.

Security Clearance Requirement: Candidates must possess an active TS/SCI clearance and willing to obtain a CI Polygraph.

Job Responsibilities

Assist in the design, development, testing, debugging, and maintenance of software applications using Java and related technologies.
Support enhancements and modifications to existing applications under the guidance of senior developers.
Develop and maintain software components, APIs, and application features.
Participate in troubleshooting and resolving software defects and application performance issues.
Collaborate with senior engineers, software architects, and project team members to understand technical requirements and implement solutions.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and software quality assurance activities.
Support software integration efforts across applications, platforms, and environments.
Assist with application deployments and configuration management activities.
Contribute to technical documentation, development procedures, and software design discussions.
Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, daily standups, and team collaboration.
Continuously develop technical skills and stay current with emerging software development and cloud technologies.

Basic Requirements

1–3 years of professional software development experience, including relevant internships, academic projects, or hands-on technical experience.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Foundational knowledge of Java programming and object-oriented programming principles.
Familiarity with the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Basic understanding of RESTful APIs and web application development.
Familiarity with Unix/Linux operating systems.
Experience with or exposure to software version control tools such as Git or Subversion.
Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and work collaboratively to identify solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Willingness to learn new technologies and work in a collaborative Agile development environment.
Active TS/SCI security clearance required, with CI Poly

Desired Qualifications

Hands-on experience developing applications using Java.
Familiarity with the Spring or Spring Boot framework.
Exposure to RESTful web services and API integration.
Basic understanding of Amazon Web Services (AWS) and cloud computing concepts.
Experience with Git, Maven, Gradle, or similar development tools.
Familiarity with relational databases and SQL.
Exposure to automated testing frameworks such as JUnit.
Experience working in Linux-based development environments.
Understanding of software configuration management and CI/CD concepts.
Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker.
Exposure to mission management, planning, modeling, or analytics systems.
Previous internship or project experience supporting Federal Government or Intelligence Community programs.

Why Join SBS?

At Strategic Business Systems, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful national security missions while building your career in software engineering.

You'll work with experienced developers and technical leaders, gain exposure to modern cloud and application technologies, and contribute to the modernization of systems used throughout the Intelligence Community.

This role offers an excellent opportunity for a junior developer looking to expand their Java development skills and grow within a mission-focused technical environment.

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; HSA-eligible plan options available

Annual professional development support for AWS certifications, training, and conferences

jobs.title: Research Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Advertising Summary:
Accelerate biomedical research for a healthier Virginia as a Research Data Engineer with the Wright Center at VCU! In this hybrid role (2 days/week in Richmond), you will build, harmonize, and validate complex health data pipelines—integrating EMR, claims, and OMOP datasets using SQL and Python to power breakthrough clinical studies. If you have 2+ years of data engineering experience, strong SQL/Python skills, and a passion for turning complex health data into impactful research tools, join our collaborative team and apply today!

Unit:
VP Research MBU

Department:
Center for Translational Science

Department
Summary:
At the VCU Office of the Vice President for Research and Innovation, our mission is to foster transformative research, discovery, and innovation at Virginia Commonwealth University through service excellence.

We partner with faculty in all schools and departments as they seek funding, plan studies, establish collaborations, calculate budgets, submit grant applications, negotiate industry contracts, and secure patents and licensing agreements.

Our commitment to supporting and elevating the research community at VCU has resulted in record levels of sponsored research and has placed VCU among the nation’s premier public research universities.

Through our passion for discovery and willingness to take on challenges, we continue to advance the work that matters most and position the university as a national leader in research, innovation, creativity, and scholarship.

Duties & Responsibilities

We are looking for a Research Data Engineer to join the informatics team at the Wright Center for Clinical and Translational Research. Our team is highly collaborative, takes ownership of its projects, and enjoys building novel solutions to technical problems, all in service of accelerating research for a healthier Virginia. In this role, you will build, validate, and maintain the data infrastructure that supports biomedical research at Virginia Commonwealth University, integrating sources such as claims, electronic medical records, OMOP data, and public health data. This position requires at least two days per week in person at our Richmond office.

Integrate and harmonize data from disparate sources, including medical claims, electronic medical records (EMR/EHR), and public health surveillance data
Design and execute data validation and quality testing across source systems, pipelines, and data warehouses (completeness, accuracy, consistency, and plausibility checks)
Write, version, and document SQL and Python code following reproducible, peer-reviewed coding practices
Maintain data dictionaries, lineage documentation, and metadata catalogs
Build and maintain dashboards and visualizations that communicate data quality metrics, cohort characteristics, and research findings
Collaborate with investigators, biostatisticians, clinicians, and informaticists to translate research needs into data solutions

Qualifications

Only applicants who do not require current or future sponsorship for employment will be considered.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, health informatics, biostatistics, data science, public health, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience)
2+ years of experience in data engineering, database development, or data management
Proficiency in programmatic data manipulation using Python or SQL
Experience working with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server)
Experience building ETL processes and performing data validation or quality assurance
Strong written and verbal communication skills, and ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to work in and foster an environment of respect, professionalism and civility with a population of faculty, staff, and students from all backgrounds and experiences, or a commitment to do so as a staff member at VCU.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of experience working with health data, ideally in an academic, health system, payer, or public health setting
Experience creating dashboards or data visualizations (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)
Hands-on experience with OMOP CDM, including ETL implementation and use of OHDSI tools (e.g., Achilles, Data Quality Dashboard, ATLAS, WhiteRabbit/Rabbit-in-a-Hat)
Experience with claims data (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, commercial, or all-payer claims databases) and EMR data (e.g., Epic Clarity/Caboodle, Cerner)
Knowledge of healthcare terminologies and code sets (ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, SNOMED)
Experience with Microsoft Fabric or similar cloud data warehouses
Working knowledge of HIPAA, human subjects research regulations, and data governance principles

Salary Range:
$80,000-$115,000, commensurate with experience

Use approved AI tools extensively to draft and revise assessments, standard operating procedures, control narratives, technical summaries, and audit responses, while retaining accountability for accuracy and completeness

jobs.description:
Job Summary

This role helps build and support secure, seamless Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) experiences across Manulife’s digital channels. You will develop customer-facing applications and services using React and Node.js, contributing to capabilities such as registration, authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), consent, profile management, and account recovery.

Working within the CIAM team, you will turn customer and business needs into reliable software. You will apply modern identity standards and secure engineering practices while helping improve customer journeys and the operation of identity services.

Position Responsibilities

Develop, test, and maintain full-stack CIAM capabilities using React, Node.js, and related technologies.
Build accessible, responsive customer experiences for registration, sign-in, MFA, consent, profile management, and account recovery.
Develop and maintain APIs and backend services that support identity journeys and application integrations.
Integrate digital applications with CIAM platforms using standards-based protocols such as OIDC/OAuth2, SAML, SCIM, and JWT.
Implement authentication, authorization, token handling, session management, and logout flows following established security practices.
Collaborate with product owners, designers, architects, and security teams to refine requirements and deliver maintainable solutions.
Contribute to technical designs, API contracts, development standards, and reusable components.
Apply secure coding practices and address vulnerabilities through code reviews, automated testing, and dependency updates.
Build and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for applications, services, and identity journeys.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment configurations that support safe, repeatable releases.
Help deploy and support cloud-based solutions, preferably on Azure.
Use logs, metrics, traces, and alerts to troubleshoot issues and improve reliability.
Participate in production support, incident response, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
Work with fraud and risk teams to support risk signals and adaptive authentication.
Document technical designs, integration patterns, and operational procedures.
Share knowledge and contribute to strong engineering practices across the team.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of software engineering experience building or supporting production web applications.
Hands-on experience with React and modern JavaScript or TypeScript.
Experience building backend services or APIs with Node.js.
Experience designing or integrating REST APIs and working with distributed systems.
Understanding of identity and access management concepts, preferably including OIDC/OAuth2, SAML, and JWT.
Familiarity with authentication, authorization, MFA, or other customer identity capabilities.
Understanding of secure coding practices, code reviews, and automated testing.
Experience with source control, build tools, testing frameworks, and CI/CD workflows.
Experience deploying or supporting cloud-based applications; Azure experience is an asset.
Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise CIAM platforms such as IBM Security Verify, RSA, or comparable identity providers.
Familiarity with WebAuthn/FIDO2, passkeys, adaptive authentication, device intelligence, identity proofing, or bot mitigation.
Exposure to Azure services such as App Services, Functions, API Management, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, or Application Insights.
Familiarity with containers, infrastructure as code, or cloud-native application design.
Experience building accessible, internationalized, and responsive customer experiences.
Exposure to observability tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Datadog, or Splunk.
Financial services, insurance, or other regulated-industry experience.
Experience working in Agile teams and with delivery tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or GitHub.
Relevant cloud, software engineering, identity, or security certifications.

jobs.title: Service Management Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Empowered to live. Inspired to work.

Compeer Financial is a member-owned cooperative located in Illinois, Minnesota and Wisconsin. We bring together team members with a variety of backgrounds and experiences to help provide financial services to support agriculture and rural communities. Join us in a culture that not only promotes meaningful work and professional development, but provides a flexible, hybrid work environment and excellent benefits, which empower you to thrive both personally and professionally.

How We Support You

Hybrid model – up to 50% work from home
Flexible schedules including ample flexibility in the summer months
Up to 9% towards 401k (3% fixed Compeer contribution plus up to 6% match)
Benefits: medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, life & AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability, wellness program & EAP
Vacation, sick leave, holidays/floating holidays, parental leave, and volunteer paid time off
Learning and development programs
Mentorship programs
Cross-functional committee opportunities (i.e. Inclusion Council, emerging professional groups, etc.)
Professional membership/certification reimbursement and more!

Casual/seasonal & intern team members are not eligible for benefits except for state-mandated programs.

To learn more about Compeer Financial visit www.compeer.com/careers.

Where you will work:
This position offers a hybrid work option up to 50% remote and is based out of the Mankato, MN; Lakeville, MN; Sun Prairie, WI or Bloomington, IL office locations.

The contributions you will make:
This position engineers, configures, and supports the organization's enterprise service management platform and related workflow, automation, integration, reporting, and configuration-data capabilities. Independently translates service-management and business requirements into secure, reliable, scalable, and supportable platform solutions that improve technology operations and the client and team member experience. Partners with service management, infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, architecture, data, product, operations, and vendor teams to deliver platform enhancements, maintain platform health, and strengthen incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, configuration, asset, and service-level practices.

A Typical Day

Platform Engineering, Configuration & Automation

Designs, configures, tests, deploys, and maintains workflows, forms, tables, business rules, scripts, notifications, approvals, service catalog items, portals, reports, dashboards, and related platform capabilities.
Develops reusable automation, integrations, APIs, data imports, orchestration, and self-service solutions that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and enable consistent service delivery.
Translates process, business, security, compliance, and operational requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, test cases, release documentation, and support procedures.

Platform Reliability, Security & Lifecycle Management

Monitors platform health, performance, capacity, integrations, jobs, errors, data quality, and service availability; troubleshoot incidents and implement durable corrective and preventive actions.
Plans and executes platform upgrades, patches, releases, clones, testing, access changes, and environment-management activities while following change, security, audit, and separation-of-duties controls.
Supports configuration-management and service-model data, integrations, platform security, role-based access, licensing, technical debt, and lifecycle decisions in partnership with platform owners and architects.

Partnership, Standards & Continuous Improvement

Partners with process owners, analysts, engineers, architects, cybersecurity, data, vendors, and business stakeholders to refine requirements, evaluate options, manage dependencies, and deliver measurable outcomes.
Maintains platform documentation, technical standards, design records, data maps, runbooks, test evidence, and knowledge articles; communicate risks, impacts, decisions, and progress in clear business and technical language.
Mentors associate practitioners, participates in peer reviews and agile ceremonies, and contributes to the platform roadmap, backlog, governance, adoption, and continual-improvement priorities.

The Skills And Experience We Prefer You Have

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job.
Minimum of four years of progressive experience in enterprise platform engineering, ServiceNow development or administration, workflow automation, application development, systems integration, IT service management, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience configuring and supporting enterprise service-management capabilities such as incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, configuration, asset, or service-level management.
Experience with scripting, APIs, integrations, data imports, workflow design, testing, release management, platform security, reporting, and production support.
Strong knowledge of enterprise service-management platform architecture, configuration, workflow automation, data models, security, integrations, reporting, and lifecycle practices.
Proficiency with scripting, APIs, integration patterns, data transformation, debugging, source control, testing, and repeatable deployment practices.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to identify root causes and design sustainable platform solutions.
Working knowledge of IT service management processes, configuration-management information, service modeling, change controls, cybersecurity, and operational resilience.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts, options, risks, and impacts for different audiences.
Ability to balance platform standards, user experience, business value, security, reliability, maintainability, and delivery timelines.
Ability to collaborate effectively, manage multiple priorities, and influence outcomes without relying on formal authority.
Valid driver's license.

How We Will Take Care Of You

Our job titles may span more than one career level (associate, senior, principal, etc.). The actual title and base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role is eligible for variable compensation and other benefits.

Base Pay

$75,600 - $114,200 USD

Compeer Financial is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Compeer is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

About Us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What You'll Do

This is a role for an Embedded Software Engineer within Viasat Government - High Assurance Encryption Systems experienced in the Rust programming language who is eager to contribute to a small, fast-paced team. You will develop software to support encrypted communications systems including Layer 2 and Layer 3 In-line Network Encryptors, embedded cryptographic devices, and emerging cryptographic solutions. You will interface and collaborate with system, test, and hardware engineers as new capabilities are developed and transitioned into service.

Members are part of a team that works with and helps clarify requirements while continuously supporting development, integration, automation, and test of the final product through certification.

The day-to-day

Design and implementation with embedded software in Rust and C/C++
Be a part of an agile multidisciplinary development team
This is an onsite role at the locations listed

What You'll Need

Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field
At least 2 years of Rust experience, ideally writing production code for embedded devices. If you do not have Rust experience, don't worry, we have other job postings to check out!
Design and implementation experience with embedded software in C/C++
At least 1 year Linux OS use, ideally for an embedded environment
Basic understanding of TCP/IP
Ability to plan, track and report on progress
Good oral and written communications skills
US citizenship and an active SECRET or TOP SECRET security clearance is required
Ability to travel up to 10%

What Will Help You On The Job

Agile Scrum development experience
Familiarity with Linux kernel driver development/modifications
Familiarity with bare metal embedded device drivers
Experience with microprocessors and embedded processors (NIOS, ARM, RISC-V, etc.)
Experience with Emulation Environments
Experience with networking protocols (e.g. IPSec, MACsec, TLS, etc.)
Experience with Python
Familiarity with standalone embedded applications
Experience participating in multi-disciplinary teams

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape how quality is built into technology at ProAg. As a Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you’ll partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, developers, architects, DevOps, and other quality professionals to understand business outcomes, identify risks, and create maintainable automated testing solutions. You’ll use automation and practical AI capabilities to improve testing efficiency, reliability, and feedback throughout the development lifecycle. Through this work, you’ll help reduce delivery risk, improve customer experiences, and support the technology behind the people who grow America’s food, fuel, and fiber.

In This Exciting Opportunity, You Will

Participate throughout the Agile software development lifecycle, helping define acceptance criteria, testability, and quality risks early, and translating business requirements and technical designs into practical test strategies, plans, scenarios, and automated checks.
Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated and manual tests for web applications, APIs, service-oriented architectures, and integrated business workflows using approved technologies such as Playwright or Selenium, C#, NUnit, and related tools to create reliable, reusable, and supportable solutions.
Apply AI-assisted tools responsibly to accelerate automated test design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, documentation, and maintenance, while validating outputs for accuracy, security, and quality.
Analyze test failures and operational information to isolate root causes, clearly communicate and support defects through resolution and verification, identify coverage gaps and defect trends, and improve product quality, reliability, and maintainability.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to provide fast, trustworthy feedback across environments, while participating in peer reviews of test code, test cases, test plans, and defects and contributing to shared engineering standards.
Support risk-based testing decisions that balance speed, coverage, maintainability, and business impact, while documenting automation frameworks, testing processes, tools, and workflows and continuously improving ProAg’s quality engineering strategy, frameworks, and skill-based ways of working.

What You Bring

Relevant professional experience in software quality assurance, automated testing, software development, or a closely related discipline, along with a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent education and/or experience.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, emphasizing clarity, collaboration, confidentiality, tact, and diplomacy, combined with curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset, including an interest in applying AI and emerging technology to improve quality engineering outcomes.

jobs.description:
CoAspire
is a cutting-edge defense manufacturing leader in Northern Virginia, specializing in the precision assembly of advanced weapons systems. With over thirteen years of a legacy of innovation, we're at the forefront of building reliable, affordable mass weapons that protect and empower our nation’s warfighters. Our tight-knit team thrives in a collaborative environment where safety, quality, and work-life balance come first with a focus on professional growth at our new 27,000+ sq. ft. facility. Join us to make a tangible impact on mission-critical technology while enjoying Northern Virginia's vibrant community.

What you will do:

You will contribute to the design, development, integration, and test of embedded and application software for advanced missile programs. This cross-functional role involves close collaboration with systems engineering, electrical/hardware design, guidance, and test teams to deliver reliable, real-time software solutions. There are multiple needs: supporting embedded operational flight program (OFP) efforts, creating test and automation software (primarily on Windows platforms), implementing specialized flight algorithms, and supporting integration and qualification testing — all while ensuring compliance with performance, safety, security, and (near) real-time requirements.

Location
: Manassas, VA

Responsibilities:

Support the design, development, modification, and review of embedded software in C/C++ for missile flight control and supporting subsystems.
Develop test programs, automation scripts, and graphical user interfaces (GUIs), primarily on Windows platforms, to support software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL), integration, and qualification testing.
Implement, optimize, and verify guidance, control, and signal-processing algorithms.
Support software-hardware integration, including debugging, interface definition, and real-time performance analysis.
Conduct unit and system testing, end-to-end integration testing, code reviews, and support system-level verification and flight-worthiness testing.
Perform root-cause analysis on software issues, implement fixes, and support configuration management and change processes.
Generate and maintain software documentation (in line with Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) expectations), including requirements specifications, design descriptions, test plans, and reports.
Ensure all software complies with customer-required guidelines, coding standards and security requirements.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
1-5 years of software engineering experience in aerospace/defense or related field.
Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded or real-time applications.
Experience with embedded software development, debugging tools, and version control (e.g., Git, GitHub, Kanban-based agile development).
Familiarity with real-time systems, multithreading, and basic software-hardware interfacing.
U.S. citizenship and current Secret clearance (or ability to obtain and maintain one).
Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript for test application and GUI development.
Experience with Windows-based test environments, automation frameworks, or lab integration tools.
Familiarity with Cameo for MBSE efforts.

What We Offer:

Beyond competitive pay, we offer:
Full benefits beginning first of month following hire: medical, dental and vision
401(k) with generous company match and immediate vesting
PTO and Federal holidays

jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.description:
About the Company

We are HCLTech, one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world and home to 230,000+ people across 60 countries, supercharging progress through industry-leading capabilities centered around Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

About the Role

We are building a browser-based 3D virtual science lab. Students assemble apparatus, perform experiments, and are assessed on their technique — all rendered in real time with React 19, React Three Fiber (Three.js), and Zustand, built with Vite. The simulation runs on ordinary school hardware, including low-end Chromebooks, so it has to be both convincing and fast, and its behavior has to be deterministic enough to score reliably.
A defining characteristic of how we work: much of this product is built with AI coding agents (Claude Code) across a multi-worktree setup, directed by engineers who scope the work, review every change critically, and encode our conventions so the agents stay on the rails. We are looking for a senior front-end engineer who is excellent at the fundamentals and genuinely effective at directing AI agents — not one or the other.
What you'll do

Build and own complex React Three Fiber features: interactive 3D equipment, a selection-driven action system, real-time visual effects, and the UI around them.
Keep the app fast on low-end hardware — profile and tune the render loop, manage GPU/CPU cost, and hold a frame budget on Chromebook-class devices.
Keep application state coherent as it grows (simulation state, equipment state, an event log used for assessment, and UI state) using Zustand.
Make accessibility real: full keyboard operation, focus management, ARIA, and screen-reader support are core requirements here, not polish.
Direct Claude Code effectively — decompose work into well-specified, agent-sized tasks, review the output with a senior eye, and know when to write something by hand instead.
Help maintain the conventions, CLAUDE.md guidance, and repo structure that keep AI-generated code consistent and safe.
Collaborate with our 3D technical artist to integrate assets and shaders cleanly.

Required skills and experience

Front-end engineering (the foundation — non-negotiable):

Deep, senior-level React
(React 19 / modern React): the render model, hooks discipline, memoization, effect timing, and a real feel for where re-renders and stale closures come from — which matter acutely in an app running a physics loop every frame.
Three.js and React Three Fiber in production.
Real command of the scene graph, geometry and materials, the useFrame render loop, and disposal / memory management (WebGL leaks are a real hazard). This is the heart of the role and the skill we weight most heavily — React experience without R3F is not a substitute.
Real-time performance discipline.
You think in frame budgets, know what drives GPU vs CPU cost, can profile a render loop, and habitually design for the weakest target device.
State management at scale
with Zustand (or clearly transferable experience), keeping a growing state model coherent rather than tangled.
Accessibility as a first-class skill
— keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA, WCAG AA, screen-reader testing. For an education product this is a core requirement and a procurement gate, not an afterthought.
TypeScript, testing, and modern tooling
— TypeScript fluency, Vite, a real testing discipline (we favor testing real behavior over mocks), and the judgment to set the quality bar for others.

Working effectively with AI coding agents (the differentiator — evaluated seriously):

You can decompose work into agent-sized units
— scoping a task with enough context, clear boundaries, and defined done-conditions so an agent produces good work. You write specifications, not wishes.
You review AI output critically
— reading every diff with the skepticism you'd bring to a junior's PR, catching the plausible-but-wrong, the convention drift, and the code that passes tests but violates an architectural rule. You never ship output you don't fully understand.
You know when not to use the agent
— a feel for which tasks fit an agent well and which are faster or safer done by hand.
You are comfortable with the operating environment
around the agent: context management, CLAUDE.md / skills / MCP, and structuring a repo and its conventions so agents produce consistent results. (Multi-worktree / parallel-agent experience is a strong plus.)
You have honest calibration
about the tool — neither refusing it nor over-trusting it, with real intuition, from experience, about where it's strong and where it approximates or fabricates.

Strongly preferred:

WebGL / GLSL literacy — enough to collaborate with a technical artist and debug shader and asset integration.
glTF / GLB loading and the asset pipeline.
Prior educational, assessment, scientific, or simulation software experience.

Equal Opportunity Statement

HCLTech is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, physical disability or genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state, and/or local law. Should any applicant have concerns about discrimination in the hiring process, they should provide a detailed report of those concerns to secure@hcltech.com for investigation.

Compensation and Benefits

A candidate’s pay within the range will depend on their work location, skills, experience, education, and other factors permitted by law. This role may also be eligible for performance-based bonuses subject to company policies. In addition, this role is eligible for the following benefits subject to company policies: medical, dental, vision, pharmacy, life, accidental death & dismemberment, and disability insurance; employee assistance program; 401(k) retirement plan; 10 days of paid time off per year (some positions are eligible for need-based leave with no designated number of leave days per year); and 10 paid holidays per year.

How You’ll Grow

At HCLTech, we offer continuous opportunities for you to find your spark and grow with us. We want you to be happy and satisfied with your role and to really learn what type of work sparks your brilliance the best. Throughout your time with us, we offer transparent communication with senior-level employees, learning and career development programs at every level, and opportunities to experiment in different roles or even pivot industries. We believe that you should be in control of your career with unlimited opportunities to find the role that fits you best.

About the Role

Lori Vision Studio is building WowNow, a software-and-hardware platform connecting digital creation, commerce, and physical production through connected TimeForge devices. We are seeking a senior, hands-on engineer to own architecture and production delivery across customer-facing web applications, internal admin workflows, Android kiosk experiences, and the services that connect our platform to physical machines.
You will partner with the Technical Lead and Product, Design, Hardware, and Operations teams. You will lead technical design within your scope, make pragmatic architecture decisions, mentor engineers through code reviews, and be accountable for system quality, reliability, and release outcomes. This is an application/software engineering role, not a mechanical, electrical, firmware, or Android OS-driver position.

What You Will Own

Lead architecture, implementation, testing, and production operation of customer WebApp features using React and TypeScript; define maintainable component, state, authentication, and data-access patterns.
Own integration across WebApp, admin tools (currently Vue 3), backend APIs, order and production workflows, and device-facing applications; make clear tradeoffs and document architecture decisions.
Design robust Android kiosk application experiences using React Native/Expo or appropriate existing approaches, including offline/timeout/retry/recovery states, device APIs, observability, controlled OTA rollout, diagnostics, and rollback.
Design and implement reliable REST/gRPC services using existing Go or Node.js stacks; work with PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, and MQTT/EMQX where relevant. Apply idempotency, acknowledgement, retry, deduplication, state transitions, and partial-failure recovery to device and order workflows.
Own production readiness: automated tests, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployment practices, health checks, logging/metrics, incident investigation, secure configuration, and operational runbooks; partner with platform owners on infrastructure rather than independently owning every infrastructure component.
Drive engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, mentorship, pragmatic technical-debt reduction, and collaboration with product, design, hardware, and field operations.
As an initial priority, lead technical execution of the corporate website rebuild, including architecture selection, CMS integration/migration, technical SEO, analytics, redirects, accessibility, launch verification, and handoff. This is an initial project, not the long-term center of the role.

Required Qualifications

6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years owning complex, production-grade features or systems from technical design through deployment and ongoing support; equivalent demonstrable experience considered.
Deep production experience with React, TypeScript/JavaScript, modern frontend architecture, browser performance, accessibility, and secure authentication/authorization patterns.
Demonstrated full-stack ownership: designing APIs, working with relational databases, managing data integrity, debugging distributed failures, and delivering production releases.
Strong proficiency in at least one production backend stack (Go or Node.js preferred), plus ability to work effectively in an unfamiliar codebase.
Experience designing reliable asynchronous or event-driven integrations, including retries, idempotency, observability, and recovery from partial failures.
Practical production experience with testing, Git/code review, CI/CD, containers, deployment and rollback; able to diagnose live incidents and communicate risk.
Evidence of senior-level technical judgment: architecture proposals, cross-team technical leadership, maintainable design decisions, mentorship, and independent problem-solving.
Able to work with physical test devices at our Ontario location when integration or troubleshooting requires it, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Strongly Preferred

Production experience with Android kiosks, React Native/Expo, device APIs, MDM/ADB, OTA updates, or connected IoT products.
Experience with order/payment/fulfillment or hardware-integrated workflows, and reliable machine-to-cloud communication.
Vue 3/Pinia; Go/go-zero/gRPC; PostgreSQL/PostGIS; Redis; RabbitMQ; MQTT/EMQX.
AWS, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, GitOps, and production observability.
WordPress engineering or Next.js/headless CMS; technical SEO and high-stakes website migrations.

Technology Landscape

Customer: React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Router/Query, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, HeroUI. Admin: Vue 3, Pinia, Vben/Naive UI. Kiosk: React Native, Expo, Android. Services: Go/go-zero, Node.js/Fastify, REST, gRPC, SSE. Data/messaging: PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Redis, RabbitMQ, EMQX/MQTT. Delivery: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Kuboard, AWS. Familiarity with every tool is not required.

Success in the Role

First 30 days:
Understand system architecture and device workflows; identify top reliability risks; ship a reviewed production improvement; propose a website migration and measurement plan.
First 90 days:
Lead delivery of a meaningful end-to-end product or device integration; reach an agreed website launch milestone; implement measurable reliability/diagnostic improvements and document operational handoffs.
First 6 months:
Own a critical product/device software domain; improve agreed release-quality and reliability metrics; mentor peers; establish repeatable architecture, incident-response, and deployment practices.

Adobe is seeking dedicated and curious Software Engineer interns to help design, build, and evolve the systems that power our products and platforms.

As an intern, you’ll work in an AI-enabled development environment, where modern tools accelerate how software is built and tested. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers and multi-functional partners, including designers and product managers, to contribute to real-world systems while continuing to build your technical and problem-solving skills.

Software engineering opportunities at Adobe span a broad range of products, technologies, and technical problem spaces. Whether you're passionate about creating intuitive user experiences, building scalable systems, or solving complex engineering challenges, we'll consider your technical skills, interests, and team needs when identifying the best opportunity within our engineering organization.

This role is designed for early-career engineers who are excited not only about writing code, but also about understanding how software works end-to-end, validating solutions, and connecting technical decisions to real user and product outcomes.

All 2027 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.

What You’ll Do

Develop high-quality, reliable, testable, and maintainable code using modern engineering practices
Contribute to all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation
Work with AI-assisted development tools to support coding, testing, and debugging, while learning how to validate outputs for correctness and quality
Review and improve code ensuring performance, scalability, and maintainability
Collaborate with engineers through stand-ups, code reviews, and design discussions
Contribute to solution design and help improve product quality, reliability, and performance with guidance from experienced engineers
Solve issues, debug problems, and iterate on solutions in a fast-paced environment
Communicate clearly and effectively with teammates, sharing ideas, asking questions, and incorporating feedback
Grow your technical and professional skills while contributing to a positive, inclusive engineering culture

What You Need To Succeed

Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s academic program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, with graduation between December 2027 - June 2028
Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and coding principles
Experience through coursework, personal projects, or internships building applications or systems
Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript
Familiarity with the software development lifecycle - designing, building, deploying, and maintaining applications
Exposure to or interest in modern development tools, including AI-assisted tools, and an understanding of how to use them responsibly
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and reason through technical challenges
Ability to learn quickly, adapt to new technologies, and take initiative in solving problems
Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within a team
Ability to participate in a full-time internship between May-September

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

Expected Pay Range:

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $38.00 - $51.00 hourly. Your recruiter can share more about the specific pay rate for your job location during the hiring process.

You have the knowledge, now gain the experience!

Bobcat’s student program is an opportunity created to empower young professionals, like you. Develop embedded software, scripts, and internal utilities using C/C++, C#, Python, Qt, and/or Matlab/Simulink.
Create and execute unit, hardware, and on-machine tests to ensure software quality and functionality.
Participate in code reviews, manage requirements, and utilize project tracking systems.
Operate equipment, construct electrical harnesses, log, and analyze test data

Sophomore, Junior, Senior standing in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity Engineering, or equivalent

Communication and collaboration skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Open roles for new graduates

We are looking for the best and brightest spring/summer of 2027 college graduates to help us make live entertainment even better! Experience is preferred, but not required – in fact, we look forward to supporting you by teaching you new technologies and mentoring you in software development craft as a member of our world-class engineering team.

Backend (Python, Go, C#)
Frontend Web (Typescript + React)
Mobile (Kotlin, Swift)
Platform (AWS, Docker, Python, Go)
Machine Learning (PyTorch, lightGBM, LangChain, Strands)

Solve unique and challenging customer problems
Work with leading-edge tech in the cloud or on web and mobile
Leverage cutting-edge AI tools to bring ideas to life faster than ever while upholding SeatGeek’s technical and product standards; no token limits
Help scale our software as we grow our booming business
Take on the challenges of building software for a many-sided marketplace
Empower decision-making at a rapidly growing data-driven company
Run experiments and evaluate new technologies that will determine the future of our business for years to come
Build performant, beautiful, inclusive user interfaces that delight our users and enhance our brand

What You Have

You are a college student graduating in the spring/summer of 2027, ideally in computer science or a related degree
Experience in building software. We'll be interested in hearing about what you've built and how you built it
Problem solving abilities, adept at handling technical challenges. SeatGeek engineers create custom solutions to unique ticketing problems, including venue mapping, inventory tracking, and event matching. We'll be excited to hear about the problems you've solved
Passion for software craftsmanship and product. You hold yourself and your code to a high standard
Commitment to your teammates. You enjoy working with a diverse group of people with different experiences and take pride in mentoring and learning from others

Our stack

Datastores: Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch
Cloud: AWS
Version control: Gitlab

Perks

Equity stake
Discretionary annual bonus
A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
Unlimited PTO
Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave
401(k) matching
Student loan matching program
Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care
$500 per year for wellness expenses
Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical
$360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events
Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This role will work a hybrid schedule coming into the Des Moines, Iowa office.

This entry level position contributes to the development, maintenance, and support of Commercial Agribusiness applications and services. The associate will deliver defined software work with guidance from experienced team members, following established requirements, design direction, coding practices, security controls, and delivery processes. The team is a full-stack build-and-run team supporting applications and APIs used by members, agency partners, and internal associates.

Key Responsibilities

Implement, configure, test, debug, document, and maintain application code, APIs, and interfaces for assigned work. Break down defined tasks, raise questions when requirements or impacts are unclear, and communicate progress or risks to the team.
Learn the supported application landscape, data flows, and business processes. Develop working knowledge of the teams applications.
Contribute to application maintenance and modernization using technologies including Java, Spring Boot/Spring MVC, Angular, REST APIs, relational databases, CI/CD, and container platforms.

Desired background

A foundation in computer science, information systems, software development, or a related area is appropriate for the role. Relevant programming coursework or experience, basic understanding of the software development lifecycle, and willingness to learn team tools. Previous internship experience is valued.

Job Description Summary

If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!

As a Software Engineer, you will focus primarily on providing high-quality, efficient technology solutions to business partners by crafting new software applications or modifying and/or supporting existing packaged or custom-built applications. In this capacity, you’ll code, configure, test, debug, document, and maintain applications.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Develop, test, debug, document, and deploy software according to engineering standards and best practices.
Apply secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
Use DevSecOps practices, tooling, and techniques.
Demonstrate continuous improvement and learning.
Review and process project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables proactively.

Reports to a Technology Manager/Director.

Education
: Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems or other related degrees are preferred. Technology experience or non-traditional technology certificates can be substituted for an undergraduate degree.

Experience
: Early career opportunity with one or more years of technology experience.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills
: Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, C++, Python, JavaScript. Knowledge of software development lifecycle. Good problem-solving skills. Ability to thrive in a team environment. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus.

Other criteria, such as competencies and experiences, may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the Director and HR Officer.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I, Fullstack (Search)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Search has become the default way consumers discover where to shop, compare options, and decide what to buy across platforms like Google, TikTok, and even Klarna. As we build a new Ads business and evolve Marketplace into a best in class shopping experience, improving search is one of our highest leverage investments to create an experience users choose and merchants want to invest in.

What You'll Do

With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals.
You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade-offs related to your work.
You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime.
You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities.

What We Look For

You have previous work or internship experience working with Javascript/Typescript.
You have previous work or internship experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale and are experienced using Python or Kotlin.
You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade
- J

Equity Grade
- 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year:
$130,000 - $180,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year:
$115,000 - $165,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$72,200.00 - $119,000.00

Target Openings

50

What Is the Opportunity?

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role.

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in early September. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible

Innovative thinking, creative problem-solving, and a determination to challenge the status-quo, these are some of the defining qualities for participants of our Engineering Development Program (EDP). The EDP is a one-year program where you will be placed in one of the four designated Engineering tracks: Software, Data, Cybersecurity or Infrastructure & Cloud. Each track is designed to grow and develop your technical and self-leadership skills. Within your assigned track, you will receive a combination of hands-on opportunities, an immersive learning journey, and a mentoring program to prepare you for a dynamic career. You will have the opportunity to explore multiple technologies while learning from different engineers within Travelers.

Our five-week long technical learning accelerator consists of a mix of classroom, independent, and hands-on learning that is designed to fine-tune your skills and introduce you to Travelers technology. The accelerator focuses on providing you valuable training on multiple tools and technologies, but from a Travelers perspective. You will also learn about our software development lifecycle, enterprise engineering environments, artificial intelligence-enhanced practices, and working with Agile methodologies.

As an EDP participant, you will model the way for others and set a personal example of what is expected. You will positively challenge processes, embrace change, actively listen to and support diverse points of view, and celebrate the success of others. Travelers offers a hybrid work location model designed to support flexibility.

You are a self-starter who goes beyond required job or educational commitments to explore new technologies, applications, and environments. You take strong ownership of your actions, performance, and outcomes, proactively managing your time while juggling multiple projects simultaneously. You collaborate effectively and maintain a positive attitude whether working independently or as part of a team. You also demonstrate strong analytical aptitude—identifying current or future problems and opportunities, synthesizing and comparing data, recognizing cause-and-effect relationships, and exploring alternative solutions to support sound decision-making.

What Will You Do?

Travelers’ Software Engineers contribute to the overall software design strategy by planning, developing, debugging, testing, troubleshooting, documenting, and implementing software solutions that enable our products, distribution workflows, customer, agent, and employee experiences.
EDP participants in this track will have duties that vary based on the specific opportunities presented within each experience. These experiences include leveraging modern software engineering and analytic tools and practices, design, deliver, and support state-of-the-art and high performing infrastructure platforms and services enabling business operations and technology solutions. You will leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms, applying critical thinking to evaluate the limitations, quality, and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
Additional program components include mentoring, networking, and career guidance.
Please note that occasional travel for business meetings and events is an expectation of program participants.
Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or greater preferred.
Suggested majors include (but not limited to): Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.
Exposure to object-oriented programming (OOP) in one or more major languages.
Experience with algorithms, data structures, systems design, and networking.
Knowledge of APIs and Web Development i.e. use of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Eventing and modern front-end technologies such as React, NextJS, etc.
Familiarity with relational databases and SQL, as well as an awareness of NoSQL/document database concepts.

What is a Must Have?

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or completion of licensed/accredited technical bootcamp.

What Is in It for You?

Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

The Opportunity

Adobe is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who will apply AI and machine learning techniques to big-data problems to help Adobe better understand, lead and optimize the experience of its customers. Partnering with the business units, the candidate will be building various products that address challenging business problems through our customers’ full lifecycle, from customer analytics to marketing media optimization.

By using statistical and econometric methods, predictive models, experimental design methods, and optimization techniques, the candidate will be working on the research and development of exciting projects like attribution, media mix modeling, budget optimization, personalization, causal analysis, time series analysis.

Ideal candidates will have a strong academic background as well as technical skills including applied statistics, machine learning, data mining, and software development. Familiarity with working with large-scale datasets and big data techniques would be a plus.

What You’ll Do

Develop predictive models on large-scale datasets to address various business problems with advanced statistical modeling, machine learning, and analytics techniques.
Develop and implement scalable and efficient modeling algorithms that can work with large-scale data in production systems
Collaborate with product management and engineering groups to develop new products and features.

PhD or MS in Computer Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, Operations Research, Econometrics or equivalent experience required with an expected graduation date of December 2026 – June 2027

Thank you for dedicating your time and talent to Lowe’s. We want to give you more opportunities to learn and grow, so if you find a position you’re interested in below, we encourage you to apply!

Build the frontend platforms and frameworks that help engineering teams across Lowe’s build better products, faster.
