jobs.title: Software Engineer III - Scala Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

You're ready to gain the skills and experience needed to grow within your role and advance your career — and we have the perfect software engineering opportunity for you.

As a Scala Engineer within JPMorgan Chase's Corporate Technology, you will execute standard software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting. you are part of an agile team that works to enhance, design, and deliver the software components of the firm's state-of-the-art technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As an emerging member of a software engineering team, you execute software solutions through the design, development, and technical troubleshooting of multiple components within a technical product, application, or system, while gaining the skills and experience needed to grow within your role.

Job Responsibilities

Executes standard software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting
Writes secure and high-quality code using the syntax of at least one programming language with limited guidance
Designs, develops, codes, and troubleshoots with consideration of upstream and downstream systems and technical implications
Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain to improve the value realized by automation
Applies technical troubleshooting to break down solutions and solve technical problems of basic complexity
Gathers, analyzes, and draws conclusions from large, diverse data sets to identify problems and contribute to decision-making in service of secure, stable application development
Learns and applies system processes, methodologies, and skills for the development of secure, stable code and systems
Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
Proficient in coding in one or more languages in this order: Scala, Java, Python
Strong Big-Data and database skills
Experience with AWS cloud computing using ECS, EKS, EMR, Lambda, etc.
Well-versed with data structures and algorithms and efficient coding practices
Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment
Ability to collaborate well with global teams in geographically distributed locations across time zones
Self-starter, able to reach out to various team members, users and partner teams to get solutions delivered
Familiar with agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum) and CI/CD, Applicant Resiliency, and Security
Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Familiarity with Spark and distributed computing

ABOUT US

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Veterans

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

At Reddit, machine learning sits at the heart of how millions of people discover, connect, and engage with the world's largest collection of human conversations. From powering personalized recommendations and search to optimizing advertising systems and marketplace dynamics, our ML engineers tackle some of the most interesting and impactful problems in large-scale applied machine learning.

We hire Machine Learning Engineers across both our Consumer and Ads organizations, giving you the opportunity to work on a wide range of high-impact problems across the Reddit ecosystem.

We are looking for Machine Learning Engineers who are excited to build systems end-to-end, from research and modeling to production deployment, — and who want to help shape the future of discovery, relevance, and monetization at Reddit.

If you love working on complex, real-world ML problems at massive scale, this role is for you.

What You'll Work On

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Reddit, you will design and build production ML systems that power core experiences across the platform, including:

Personalized recommendations, search, and ranking systems that help users discover the most relevant content and communities
Intelligent advertising systems including ranking, bidding, measurement, and optimization
Content, Advertisers, and User understanding, from building foundational content/user representations to deriving insightful signals
Large-scale machine learning pipelines, model serving infrastructure, and real-time decision systems
Applied AI and LLM-driven experiences that improve relevance, discovery, and user engagement

You'll work on high-impact systems that operate at internet scale and directly influence user experience, advertiser value, and business outcomes.

What You'll Do

Design, build, and deploy production-grade machine learning models and systems at scale
Own the full ML lifecycle: from problem definition and feature engineering to training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring
Build scalable data and model pipelines with strong reliability, observability, and automated retraining
Work with large-scale datasets to improve ranking, recommendations, search relevance, prediction, content/user understanding, and optimization systems.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to translate complex problems into ML solutions
Improve system performance across latency, throughput, and model quality metrics
Research and apply state-of-the-art machine learning and AI techniques, including deep learning, graph & transformers based, and LLM evaluation/alignment
Contribute to technical strategy, architecture, and long-term ML roadmap

Basic Qualifications

3-5+ years of experience building, deploying, and operating machine learning systems in production
Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Go, or similar languages, with solid software engineering fundamentals
ML Fundamentals: a strong grasp of algorithms, from classic statistical learning (XGBoost, Random Forests, regressions) to DL architectures (Transformers, CNNs, GNNs)
Hands-on experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)
Experience designing scalable ML pipelines, data processing systems, and model serving infrastructure
Ability to work cross-functionally and translate ambiguous product or business problems into technical solutions
Experience improving measurable metrics through applied machine learning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with recommender systems, search/ranking systems, advertising/auction systems, large-scale representation learning, or multimodal embedding systems
Familiarity with distributed systems and large-scale data processing (Spark, Kafka, Ray, Airflow, BigQuery, Redis, etc.)
Experience working with real-time systems and low-latency production environments
Background in feature engineering, model optimization, and production monitoring
Experience with LLM/Gen AI techniques, including but not limited to LLM evaluation, alignment, fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, RAG/agentic systems and productionizing LLM-powered products at scale
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related quantitative field

Potential Teams

Ads Measurement Modeling
Ads Targeting and Retrieval
Advertiser Optimization
Ads Marketplace Quality
Ads Creative Effectiveness
Ads Foundational Representations
Ads Content Understanding
Ads Ranking
Feed Relevance
Search and Answers Relevance
ML Understanding
Notifications Relevance

Benefits

Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
401k with Employer Match
Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
Family Planning Support
Gender-Affirming Care
Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:

$185,800—$260,100 USD

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I, Fullstack (Search)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Search has become the default way consumers discover where to shop, compare options, and decide what to buy across platforms like Google, TikTok, and even Klarna. As we build a new Ads business and evolve Marketplace into a best in class shopping experience, improving search is one of our highest leverage investments to create an experience users choose and merchants want to invest in.

What You'll Do

With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals.
You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade-offs related to your work.
You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime.
You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities.

What We Look For

You have previous work or internship experience working with Javascript/Typescript.
You have previous work or internship experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale and are experienced using Python or Kotlin.
You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade
- J

Equity Grade
- 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year:
$130,000 - $180,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year:
$115,000 - $165,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Agents
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Sr. Software Engineer, Agents

Team:
Engineering

Location:
Onsite - Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica & West LA)

Employment Type:
Full-time, Salary, Exempt

Reports To:
Head of Engineering

About Plug

Plug is the marketplace for used electric vehicles. Consumers get an instant cash offer backed by battery-health data, and dealers across the US bid in real time on that inventory. Former Tesla executives founded Plug in 2023. We’ve raised a $20M Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Why Plug

You’ll help build the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive.
You’ll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.
You’ll be part of an AI-native company. We’re rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level.
You’ll work directly with operators who have scaled multi-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces.
You’ll ship constantly, with high autonomy and a direct line to company outcomes.

The Opportunity

Plug runs on a lot of manual work: reading titles and inspection reports, chasing paperwork with dealers, checking vehicle details, answering sellers, and moving each car from offer to sale. Much of that work can be done by agents. We already run LLM features in production, and our engineers own the core platform: the marketplace, pricing, and the systems that tie them together. What we need now is someone who can turn a stream of real operational problems into agents that work reliably, one after another.

What You’ll Do

Build and ship agents and multi-agent workflows for operations, dealers, and sellers: document extraction, inspection and title review, dealer and seller communication, and internal tooling.
Use LangChain and LangGraph to build agents, and LangSmith or Langfuse to trace, debug, and evaluate them.
Write evals, build datasets from real cases, measure accuracy and failure modes, and make regressions visible.
Integrate agents with the services the team already owns, through clean APIs and tools. Work within the existing architecture and raise design concerns with the owning engineer instead of routing around them.
Monitor agents in production: cost, latency, error rates, and human-review rates. Fix what breaks and tighten prompts, tools, and guardrails over time.
Ship full-stack when the job calls for it: the TypeScript and React screens where people review and correct agent output, and the backend endpoints behind them.
Help the rest of engineering adopt the same patterns. Build reusable tools, examples, and short write-ups that make the next agent faster to build.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years of full-time industry software engineering, with a track record of shipping features to production and supporting them after launch.
Strong TypeScript or Python, and comfort working across the stack: APIs, databases, and frontend when needed.
Hands-on experience building LLM features in production: tool use, retrieval, structured output, and above all, evaluation.
Experience with an agent framework and observability stack, ideally LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or Langfuse. If you’ve used something else, show us what you built and how you knew it worked.
You work agent-first. You’ve built your own tooling around coding agents, such as skills, MCP servers, custom workflows, or evals.
Comfort building inside systems other people designed. You can disagree, make your case, and then ship the agreed plan.
A habit of writing things down: short design notes, eval results, and runbooks that others can pick up.
You enjoy being part of a small team: pairing, reviewing each other’s work, and sharing credit.
High agency in an ambiguous, fast-moving startup. You find the most valuable workflow to automate and ship against it without waiting for a perfect spec.
BS in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

Experience with document-heavy workflows such as titles, registrations, inspections, lending, or insurance.
Experience with vehicle, marketplace, or auction products.
Experience with human-in-the-loop review tools, or with fine-tuning and prompt optimization for production LLM features.

Compensation And Benefits

Annual salary: $175,000 to $200,000

Salary ranges come from independent, third-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and market conditions. We review ranges periodically and may adjust them as the market changes.

Benefits & Perks

Health, Vision, and Dental insurance
401(k) plan
Daily lunch stipend
Equity (based on role and performance)
30-day remote work from anywhere policy
Unlimited PTO
Fully stocked kitchen
Dog-friendly office
Ongoing opportunities for growth and development

This full-time position is an in-person role based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). Relocation assistance will not be provided for successful candidates. Sponsorship not available at this time.

jobs.title: Project - Full Stack Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
Our AI & Engineering team helps transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and deliver meaningful impact for clients. In this role, you will work with professionals who are reimagining and reengineering business-critical operations and processes. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, launch new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Project Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for:

Assist development teams in delivering technical solutions using software development life cycle methodologies, including Scrum and Agile
Help design, develop, and enhance software systems and custom components using modern development tools and frameworks
Analyze user requirements, system flows, data usage, and performance standards to define technical designs and identify problem areas
Integrate existing software into new or modified systems and develop and execute test procedures for software components
Plan, track, and manage deliverables across short-term sprints and long-term software deployments

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Engineering as a Service offering provides end-to-end design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We help transform engineering teams, modernize technology, & deliver complex programs with a product engineering mindset. Our flexible delivery models- traditional teams, pools, or pods, are tailored for each client's needs, offering engineering-led Advise, Implement, & Operate capabilities to accelerate innovation.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or Management Information Systems
2+ years of full-stack software development experience
2+ years of experience with Modern Full Stack languages (Java, Python, React, Angular, etc.)
Experience orchestrating in cloud and/or serverless environments
Experience with Relational and Non-relational DBs (Postgres, SQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.)
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
Active Top Secret security clearance

Preferred:

Experience with Gen AI, Agentic AI, ML/NLP environments and tools
Major Cloud provider certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)
AI related certifications (Anthropic, Github, etc.)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $74,900 to $147,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Remote (Must currently reside in EST or CST time zones)
Contract:
W2 Contract

Full US Working Rights Required (No C2C / Visa Sponsorship available)

Join our active network of go-to tech contractors.

The software market moves fast
. When our clients get a project greenlit or hit a sudden roadblock, they don't have weeks to spare for a traditional recruitment cycle. They need developers who can interview at a moment's notice and essentially be ready to start yesterday.

Note:
This is not an ad for an active role, but more to gather interest so that when a role comes live, we can reach out directly and quickly. We are building a vetted, active list of software development contractors residing in EST and CST so we can meet that exact speed.

Why this benefits you

As a contractor, your time is your currency. We built this active list to completely bypass the traditional, slow recruitment process and get straight to matching you with projects.

Zero Spam:
We won't flood your inbox with generic, irrelevant job alerts.
Direct Lines Only:
We only reach out when we have an actual, vetted project that matches the exact rate, tech stack and timeline you specified in your survey.
Fast-Track Delivery:
Because we already know your baseline preferences, we can completely skip the generic introductory interviews. The minute a project drops, we can call you immediately to pitch the specific role and get your green light to present your profile to the client.

Our Industry Focus

While we work with clients across various sectors, we have a particularly high demand for contractors with deep experience in Fintech and Financial Services
(including banking, trading platforms, payments and wealth tech). If you understand the complexities of high-throughput systems, data security and financial compliance, we want to talk to you.

Not from a finance background? Don't worry, we also partner with fast-growing companies in health tech, e-commerce and enterprise SaaS, so we are absolutely open to top-tier developers from other industries.

The Skill Sets We Move Quickly On

We regularly see high-priority contracts for mid-to-senior Frontend, Backend and Full-Stack Developers
. While we work across multiple technologies, our most frequent and urgent requests lean heavily into the following ecosystems:

Backend & Systems:
Heavy enterprise-scale development using Java
(Spring Boot), .NET
(C#, .NET Core), or Python
(Django, FastAPI). Experience with distributed systems and microservices architecture is highly valued.
Frontend UI/UX:
Modern, highly responsive web development utilizing TypeScript
, React
, Angular
or Vue.js
.
Data & Integration:
Strong SQL/NoSQL database skills (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB) and experience building or integrating complex, secure RESTful/GraphQL APIs
.
Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure:
Hands-on experience writing code deployed in AWS, Azure, or GCP
, alongside modern CI/CD pipelines, Docker and Kubernetes.

Core Requirements

To join this proactive talent network, you must meet the following baseline criteria:

Time Zone & Location:
You must currently reside
in the EST or CST
time zones. No relocation at this time.
Engagement Type:
You must be looking for W2 contract roles
. Please note: We strictly do not operate on a Corp-to-Corp (C2C) basis for these engagements.
Work Authorization:
You must hold full US working rights.

How the Process Works (What to Expect Next)

Because we anticipate a very high level of interest in this network, we won't be able to hop on a call with everyone.
We want to respect your time, so we've streamlined how we get you onto our list:

Apply:
Submit your resume via this ad.
The Survey:
If your profile aligns with our core requirements (location, W2 availability, and core dev skills), we will send you a quick, targeted survey.

Tell Us Your Preferences:
This survey is your chance to outline what you are looking for. Your specific tech stack, industry preference, ideal hourly salary expectations and upcoming availability.
Direct Matching:
Once your details are in our database, we monitor upcoming projects on your behalf. The moment a live contract hits our desk that aligns with your tech stack, rate and availability, we will reach out directly to see if the role is a good fit for you.

Ready to partner up for your next contract?

If you want to be positioned at the front of the line for upcoming software development projects, hit apply and submit your resume today.

TO THIRD-PARTY AGENCIES & VENDORS:
We want to be respectful of your time and ours: we are strictly building this network for individual, direct W2 contractors. We do not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles or partnership requests from external staffing firms, recruitment agencies, or C2C vendors. Please do not submit candidates through this ad, as they will not be reviewed.

jobs.title: Project - Full Stack Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
Our AI & Engineering team helps transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and deliver meaningful impact for clients. In this role, you will work with professionals who are reimagining and reengineering business-critical operations and processes. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, launch new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Project Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for:

Assist development teams in delivering technical solutions using software development life cycle methodologies, including Scrum and Agile
Help design, develop, and enhance software systems and custom components using modern development tools and frameworks
Analyze user requirements, system flows, data usage, and performance standards to define technical designs and identify problem areas
Integrate existing software into new or modified systems and develop and execute test procedures for software components
Plan, track, and manage deliverables across short-term sprints and long-term software deployments

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Engineering as a Service offering provides end-to-end design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We help transform engineering teams, modernize technology, & deliver complex programs with a product engineering mindset. Our flexible delivery models- traditional teams, pools, or pods, are tailored for each client's needs, offering engineering-led Advise, Implement, & Operate capabilities to accelerate innovation.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or Management Information Systems
2+ years of full-stack software development experience
2+ years of experience with Modern Full Stack languages (Java, Python, React, Angular, etc.)
Experience orchestrating in cloud and/or serverless environments
Experience with Relational and Non-relational DBs (Postgres, SQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.)
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
Active Top Secret security clearance

Preferred:

Experience with Gen AI, Agentic AI, ML/NLP environments and tools
Major Cloud provider certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)
AI related certifications (Anthropic, Github, etc.)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $74,900 to $147,600.

Partnering with engineering teams to define SLIs and SLOs and build the observability dashboards, alerts, and tooling needed to measure and maintain system health.
Developing reliable, intuitive performance and health visualizations that streamline troubleshooting for support analysts and significantly reduce time to resolution.

Aggressively identifying operational toil across support, infrastructure, and release processes, then design automation or process improvements that reduce overhead and scale team capacity.
Leading incident response for complex, multi‑team issues - diagnosing unknown systems, analyzing logs and source code, determining immediate fixes, and implementing long‑term reliability improvements.

The Senior Software Engineer owns KRS (K Retail Solutions), our live retail platform that runs in-store POS, the store Back Office, KRS Admin, and the KRS Store App across multiple store tenants. This role combines deep, hands-on knowledge of KRS with an AI-driven way of working: the engineer directs AI coding tools in natural language ("vibe coding") to deliver features quickly, while personally owning the system architecture and design decisions that keep KRS reliable. Just as importantly, the engineer reviews, tests, and corrects AI-generated code and designs, as well as vendor deliverables, before anything reaches our stores. As a senior member of the team, the role makes key technical decisions, is accountable for release quality and production stability, and mentors and supports other developers.

Job Description

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

AI-Driven Development (Vibe Coding) — Build and enhance KRS features by directing AI coding assistants in natural language. Break work into clear, verifiable tasks, guide the AI through implementation and testing, and deliver working features across POS, checkout and payments, refund/exchange, Back Office, KRS Admin, and the KRS Store App.
Architecture & Technical Design — Own the KRS architecture on the Odoo framework (KRS Admin on Odoo 18) in a multi-tenant environment. Design integrations with payment terminals and processors (CodePay, Elavon/Converge), the Snowflake data platform, and enterprise systems. Write design documents and decision records, and evaluate vendor designs and effort estimates.

Check it against the business specification and the actual code, find defects, missing work items, and hidden risks (for example, a module dependency that could take POS offline), and correct them. Review vendor merge requests and provide clear feedback.
Production Quality, Deployment & Incident Response — Own release quality for KRS: feature branches and merge requests, Dev → Staging → Production deployments through Jenkins, module upgrades across store tenants, and post-deployment verification. Lead root-cause analysis and hotfixes for production issues, especially card-payment, refund, and end-of-day settlement issues, and maintain automated tests.
KRS Domain Ownership & Stakeholder Collaboration — Serve as the go-to expert on KRS and on store operations. Work with Sales Operations, store teams, the project manager, and vendors to turn specifications and Figma designs into clear, deliverable scope; take part in project meetings and track schedule risks.

The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This job delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). It involves advising management on project-level issues, guiding junior engineers, operating with little supervision, and applying knowledge of technical best practices. Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

Acts as a project or system leader, coordinating the activities of other engineers on the project or within the system
Determines the technical tasks that other engineers will follow
Actions result in the achievement of customer, operational, program or service objectives
Proactively improves existing structures & processes
Exercises judgement in reconciling diverse and competing priorities (time, quality, complexity risk) to identify optimal solutions to problems
Notices patterns and condenses repetition into densely meaningful generalized solutions
Collaborates with management to set/improve standards for engineering rigor
Trusted to represent PayPal, Inc to the outside world via interactions with partners, customers, or industry organizations

Minimum Qualifications:

5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Engineering at Venmo

At Venmo, we are creating a product that people love. We strive to create a delightful user experience while connecting the world and empowering people through payments. We are looking for intellectually curious people who want to be inspired and inspire others to change the world.

Engineering is a craft, and at Venmo we want the internals of our software to be as elegant as the end user experience we are designing. We spend our days scaling our infrastructure and building new features to meet and exceed our users’ needs and wants. We work with a product team that is data-driven and human-centered in its design principles. We teach and learn from one another and push each other to be at our creative and analytical best.

Our team is dedicated to ensuring the seamless operation of all user-facing services, as well as production and development systems. We manage Venmo’s infrastructure comprehensively, encompassing operations, automation, security, compliance, and release engineering. While we are focused on Cloud Engineering, our work integrates elements of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps projects as well.

On the DevOps front, we oversee CI/CD infrastructure, develop smart and secure pipelines, implement self-service secret management systems, create development environments, and establish microservices scaffolding and testing frameworks. The quality of the systems we build is paramount to the company, and we prioritize it highly. Our infrastructure must be delivered automatically, thoroughly tested, and scanned for vulnerabilities through synthetic tests.

As a Senior Engineer on the AI Tooling team, you will design and build AI-powered tools and integrations that directly improve how Venmo's Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps engineers work. You are a hands-on contributor who bridges deep cloud/DevOps knowledge with applied AI development—building solutions like LLM-powered runbook assistants, intelligent alerting systems, AI-assisted infrastructure code generation, and autonomous remediation tooling. You teach by example and mentor other engineers on how to effectively integrate AI into engineering workflows.

Our technical stack: AWS, EKS, Docker, GitHub Enterprise, Terraform, GitHub Actions, DataDog, Bash, Python, Go.

What You'll Do

Act as a hands-on contributor, while leading by example
Mentor junior engineers
Enjoy a high degree of independence in decision-making while being accountable for results of yourself and your team
Be part of a team dedicated to driving the scalability and reliability of Venmo's AWS cloud infrastructure
Contribute to initiatives: internal teams rarely have dedicated project managers. You will define the design, identify stakeholders, navigate risks and changes, coordinate colleagues' work, implement solutions, and be accountable for timely and quality project delivery
Troubleshoot incidents, identify root causes, fix and document problems, and implement preventive measures
Lead by example, making meaningful contributions to the improvement of engineering teams' production operations
Develop and improve tools and automation to manage infrastructure and application configuration as code
Enhance the quality, reliability, and stability of our infrastructure and operations
Design and build LLM-powered tools that assist Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps engineers with tasks such as runbook generation, incident triage, configuration review, and root cause analysis
Develop AI-assisted automation pipelines that reduce toil and accelerate common infrastructure workflows (e.g., provisioning, scaling, deployment)
Integrate AI capabilities into existing developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms
Build and maintain internal AI platforms and APIs that enable other engineering teams to leverage LLM and ML capabilities in their own workflows
Evaluate and drive adoption of emerging AI tools, frameworks, and models relevant to cloud and DevOps use cases
Establish best practices for responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including evaluation, safety, and observability of AI-generated outputs

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's in computer science or related field of study
5+ years' experience in software development or a related field
3+ years' experience operating distributed applications 24x7x365, as part of a Cloud Engineering, DevOps, and/or SRE team
Extensive hands-on experience with designing, implementing, and supporting infrastructure (AWS experience preferred) to support global-scale services
Deep hands-on experience with IaaS and PaaS solutions from AWS (or similar cloud provider)
Hands-on programming and scripting (Python, Java, Bash, Go)
Hands-on experience with containers and container orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes
Strong communication skills with the ability to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience
Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs or generative AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI API, Amazon Bedrock, or similar)
Experience with prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLM evaluation techniques
Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into developer tools, CLIs, chatbots, or internal platforms
Familiarity with AI observability, output safety, and responsible AI practices in production systems
Experience with ML model serving, vector databases, or embedding pipelines is a plus
Ability to translate ambiguous engineering pain points into well-scoped AI-powered solutions

jobs.title: Software Engineering SMTS / LMTS - AI Core (REMOTE)
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Engineering at Qualified

Engineering at Qualified is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where engineers ship customer-facing product to real enterprises at scale. We're building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and

embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.

Following our acquisition by Salesforce, we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup, backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback.

You'll work alongside a high-talent-density team that cares deeply about craft, performance, reliability, and user experience, and that raises the bar through collaboration, code review, and strong engineering principles. You'll make architecture decisions, solve meaningful system design challenges, and see your work land quickly with customers, without layers of approvals slowing you down.

The Role

As an Engineer on the AI Core team, you'll operate as a technical leader who turns ambiguous, high-stakes AI problems into durable, high-quality systems, while raising the technical bar for the broader team. AI Core builds the retrieval systems and agent infrastructure that power how our AI agents find, trust, and use knowledge, and the developer tooling that lets engineers across the company ship production agents quickly and safely.

You'll lead significant initiatives end to end: faithful answering over a customer's own knowledge, retrieval that combines RAG and hybrid search, content lifecycle controls such as freshness, deduplication and source precedence, transcript processing, and the frameworks, registries, and evaluation tooling that make building a production agent a paved path. You'll partner closely with product, design, and engineering leadership to decide what we build, how we build it, and how we measure whether answers actually got better.

What You'll Do

Lead retrieval initiatives end to end: Design, build, and operate retrieval systems using RAG and hybrid search (lexical plus vector, reranking, filtering) so agents answer from the right content with the right amount of context. Own delivery from scope and design through launch, monitoring, and iteration.

Build developer tooling for production agents: Drive technical design for the frameworks and platform pieces our engineers use to build agents, including multi-agent orchestration, shared primitives for prompts, tools, tracing, and evaluation.

Own answer quality: Diagnose why answers are thin, wrong, or inconsistent by separating retrieval problems from generation problems (prompt, token budget, model choice). Set a quality bar we can test against, and lead the

work to reach it.

Design content and data models: Define how content from documents,

knowledge bases, and call transcripts is ingested, segmented, labeled, and retrieved, including the primitives behind freshness, dedupe, source

precedence, and internal versus external visibility.

Make AI changes safe to ship: Build evaluation, observability, and rollout

practices (offline evals, online monitoring, regression detection) so we can change prompts, models, and retrieval with confidence. Evaluate multiple

solution paths and know when to trust, redirect, or override model and agent output.

Set performance and scaling benchmarks across the platform we own:

Define and track targets for retrieval and indexing, LLM provider usage, and agent orchestration.

Own operational health: Ensure the reliability and performance of the systems your team owns. Participate in on-call, lead incident resolution for your area, and communicate clearly with the team and stakeholders during incidents.

Use agentic development to raise leverage: Use coding agents by default for implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation while holding a high validation bar. Create reusable workflows, patterns, and tooling that raise the effectiveness of your team beyond your own output.

Partner across functions: Work with product, design, and engineering

leadership to shape roadmap, tradeoffs, and requirements, and to translate strategy into concrete execution plans.

Raise team effectiveness: Mentor engineers, give high-quality code review and technical guidance, and improve standards, tooling, and processes.

Who You Are

Proven experience shipping production AI or backend systems in a high ownership environment, with a recent focus on LLM-powered applications.

Expertise building retrieval systems using RAG and hybrid search, including chunking and indexing strategy, embeddings, vector and lexical search,

reranking, and measuring retrieval quality.

Expertise building developer tooling that lets developers build production agents, which can include frameworks for multi-agent orchestration, an agent and tool registry, and shared infrastructure for tracing and evaluation.

Experience owning platform initiatives from design through adoption,

across systems such as retrieval and indexing, LLM provider integrations, and agent orchestration, including driving adoption and evolving the platform as usage grows.

Demonstrated technical leadership: you lead significant projects, design solutions for non-trivial problems by weighing tradeoffs, and influence architecture and execution beyond your immediate workstream.

Strong track record delivering complex projects with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, or phases.

Strong backend engineering fundamentals and proficiency in languages such as Ruby on Rails, Python, JavaScript, or Go, with SQL and RDBMS experience (PostgreSQL preferred).

Hands-on experience with the AI application lifecycle: experiment setup, dataset curation, offline evaluation, error analysis, deployment, and online evaluation.

Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity: you can frame problems, propose solutions, and align others.

Strong communicator across functions, able to explain technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences and to translate complex concepts into business impact.

Ownership mindset and bias for action. You raise the bar for the team through mentoring, code review, and your own work.

Curious and continuously learning, with an agent-forward approach to how you build software.

Nice to Have

Experience with pgvector or other vector indexes, and with query performance at scale.

Experience with content ingestion from third-party systems (document stores, knowledge bases, CRM knowledge objects) and the lifecycle problems that follow: sync state, dedupe, source conflict.

Experience processing conversation or call transcripts, including handling PII and consent constraints.

Experience designing evaluation suites that score qualities such as thoroughness and faithfulness, not only correctness.

Experience with voice or real-time conversational agents.

Experience with enterprise SaaS (especially B2B marketing or sales tech) or Salesforce/CRM integrations.

Startup experience and rapid shipping.

Why Join Qualified

Foundational impact: Shape how our AI agents retrieve, reason, and answer, and the tooling every engineer here uses to build them.

Lead real initiatives: Own significant projects end to end, with scope and

influence that grow as you deliver. You'll own the platform as it scales, from retrieval to model providers to agent orchestration, and set the performance and reliability bar that grows with the company.

AI as a core product surface: Turn new AI capabilities into dependable

experiences that customers trust, with strong engineering around evaluation, observability, and iteration.

High bar, low bureaucracy: Work with a team that values craft and decisive execution, where strong ideas win and shipping is the default.

Room to grow: Take on larger technical and product scope over time: leading projects, influencing architecture, and leveling up quickly.

If you're excited to build retrieval systems and agent infrastructure at the intersection of AI and enterprise software, we'd love to hear from you.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER

As a Site Reliability Engineer focused on campus reliability, you will design what the campus watches and trusts, technically command cross-discipline SEVs, and build the guardrails that make the next incident smaller. You are the connective tissue across compute, network, storage, power, and cooling on one of the largest AI training campuses in the world. This role demands calm incident leadership, fleet-scale observability judgment, and the ability to drive reliability work across software and facility boundaries. We are looking for candidates from power plants, nuclear power plants, data centers, or people who currently work or have worked in facilities like SpaceXSI with power, compute, cooling, and related plant systems.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Own monitoring architecture and signal quality across GPU and host telemetry (DCGM, Prometheus/Grafana) and facility telemetry (BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, CDU / direct liquid cooling): what we alert on, suppress, and trust. Consume NOC noise-disposition feedback to drive suppression and redesign. Treat alert noise as a design failure, not an operator failure
Provide SEV command support: technical incident leadership, bridge coordination with the NOC, paging and escalation (e.g., PagerDuty), and timeline and severity hygiene
Run blameless postmortems and drive corrective actions to closed, not filed
Gate high-risk change: fleet-scale firmware/BIOS/BMC rollouts (Redfish, canaries, rollback) and SOP/MOP/EOP-governed work on power and cooling systems through a disciplined change management process
Lead cross-functional reliability projects spanning compute, network (InfiniBand/RoCE), storage, and facility signal boundaries, including grey failures that cross those boundaries (e.g., NVLink flapping, thermal throttling, power sequencing)
Partner with Hardware Failure Analysis on systemic failure classes: turn fleet data (MTBF/AFR, repeat-RMA trends) into monitoring, stop-rules, and vendor RCA inputs
Build and maintain playbooks, run game days, and keep cross-discipline dependency maps current. Own runbook quality jointly with the NOC (SRE designs; NOC operates and corrects)
Define error budgets and availability objectives at campus and service boundaries as adopted by the business
Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for SEV-class events in the Memphis / Southaven data center campus
Demonstrate monitoring and observability design at fleet or campus scale, including alert hygiene, suppression, and signal quality
Treats alert noise as a design failure, not an operator failure
Improve mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR) for severity-class events, and ensure blameless postmortems with closed action items.
Increase the alert actionable ratio and reduce recurrence of incident classes.
Expand monitoring coverage of critical dependencies across compute, network, storage, power, and cooling.
Minimize GPU fleet availability lost to infrastructure events.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree in systems engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or STEM discipline
5+ years of experience in site reliability, systems engineering, plant operations, or large-scale production operations
Experience with at least one of: Prometheus/Grafana, NVIDIA DCGM, or industrial telemetry and controls (SCADA, BMS/BAS, EPMS, DCIM, PLCs, Modbus/BACnet)
Experience working across at least two of: compute, network, storage, power, and cooling / facilities telemetry
Experience writing and operating playbooks, runbooks, or SOP/MOP/EOPs with a 24/7 operations, control room, or NOC partner
Experience with scripting (Python, Bash) for automation and analysis

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

General experience in at least one systems language (C, C++, Java, Go, Rust, or similar) – not required to be expert in all of them
Excellent problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to reliability engineering
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including NOC, data center operations, hardware failure analysis, and infrastructure engineering
Proven large-scale incident command experience and calm technical leadership on a bridge, whether from an SRE/NOC bridge or a plant control room
Demonstrated monitoring and observability design at fleet or campus scale, including alert hygiene, suppression, and signal quality
Experience in power plants, nuclear power plants, high-performance computing, data center environments, or other high-consequence industrial control environments (ICS/OT)
Current or prior work in data centers or facilities like SpaceXSI spanning power, compute, cooling, and related plant systems, including CDU / direct liquid cooling
Experience in AI/ML infrastructure or supercomputing environments: GB200/NVL72 or H100/H200-class GPU fleets, NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE, Slurm or Kubernetes
Fleet firmware and BMC management (Redfish, IPMI), including firmware release validation and staged rollouts
Reliability engineering methods: MTBF/AFR analysis, reliability-centered maintenance, grey-failure diagnosis, and vendor RCA/RMA partnership
Experience with CMMS (e.g., Maximo) and commissioning / integrated systems testing (IST) and operational turnover
Hands-on definition and use of SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets at service or campus boundaries
Experience running game days, dependency mapping, and closed-loop corrective action programs
Familiarity with data center hardware and plant signals (servers, GPUs, networking, power, cooling) in addition to software telemetry
Prior work in a fast-paced startup or tech company like SpaceXSI
Experience in power plants, nuclear power plants, data centers, or facilities like SpaceXSI — current or prior — spanning power, compute, cooling, or related plant systems
Proven large-scale incident command experience and calm technical leadership on a bridge; nuclear control-room, shift supervisor / Senior Reactor Operator (SRO), Shift Technical Advisor, or Navy nuclear experience counts as incident command
Cross-team facilitation and systems engineering depth across software and facility boundaries

Experience with electrical design standards and ability to complete power and controls system designs using standard CAD design tools.

Ability to mentor and train junior engineers

Job Title:
Sr. Applied Machine Learning Engineer

Team:
Engineering

Onsite - Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica & West LA)

Head of Engineering

About Plug

Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers and commercial partners trade in, sell and auction used EVs on a platform built only for electric vehicles. Nothing in it is adapted from legacy automotive.

Consumers get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data-driven pricing and battery state-of-health analysis. Pickup, payment and title transfer are handled end to end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers and commercial partners. Sellers get a fast, fair exit, and dealers get a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory.

Plug was founded in 2023 and is led by former Tesla executives. It is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI-native startup team in Los Angeles: operators, engineers and ML researchers building the transaction rails for the fast-growing used EV market.

WHY PLUG

You'll help build the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive.
You'll work on a platform built only for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.
You'll be part of an AI-native company that is rethinking how work gets done.
You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi-billion-dollar businesses in automotive, EV and marketplaces.
You'll work alongside a small, senior team, with high autonomy and a direct line to company outcomes.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Every car on Plug starts with a number: what is this EV worth today, and what will a dealer pay for it tomorrow? Those numbers come from our models. They draw on auction results, market data, vehicle telematics and battery health. As volume grows, our models have to get more accurate, update faster, and be easier to trust and explain.

You'll join our Intelligence team and work alongside our ML engineer and data team, who built the models behind pricing and battery health. Together you'll take those models further: sharper price and volume forecasts, battery state-of-health models built from telematics, and LLM pipelines that pull structured data out of vehicle, title and inspection documents.

What You'll Do

Build and ship agents and multi-agent workflows for operations, dealers, and sellers: document extraction, inspection and title review, dealer and seller communication, and internal tooling.
Trace every agent so you can see each step, tool call, and decision. Use those traces to debug failures and turn them into new eval cases.
Write evals before and alongside each agent: build datasets from real cases, measure accuracy and failure modes, and gate changes to prompts, models, and tools on the results.
Make model and prompt decisions with data: compare options on accuracy, cost, and latency, and run upgrades when a model is deprecated or a cheaper one holds up.
Integrate agents with the services the team already owns, through clean APIs and tools. Work within the existing architecture and raise design concerns with the owning engineer instead of routing around them.
Ship full-stack when the job calls for it: the TypeScript and React screens where people review and correct agent output, and the backend endpoints behind them.
Help the rest of engineering adopt the same patterns. Build reusable tools, examples, and short write-ups that make the next agent faster to build.

What You'll Bring

5+ years of full-time industry software engineering, with a track record of shipping features to production and supporting them after launch.
Hands-on experience shipping LLM features to production: tool use, retrieval, and structured output.
Experience building evals and tracing for LLM systems: datasets drawn from real cases, automated scoring, and production traces you used to find and fix failures. We care less about which agent framework you used (e.g., Claude Agent SDK, LangChain Deep Agents) than how you knew it worked.
Strong TypeScript or Python, and comfort working across the stack: APIs, databases, and frontend when needed.
You work agent-first. You’ve built your own tooling around coding agents, such as skills, MCP servers, custom workflows, or evals.
You enjoy being part of a small team: pairing, reviewing each other’s work, sharing credit, and building inside systems other people designed. You can disagree, make your case, and then ship the agreed plan.
A habit of writing things down: short design notes, eval results, and runbooks that others can pick up.
High agency in an ambiguous, fast-moving startup. You find the most valuable workflow to automate and ship against it without waiting for a perfect spec.
BS in computer science, math, statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Compensation And Benefits

Annual salary:
$164,000 – $200,000

Salary ranges come from independent, third-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs and market conditions. We review ranges periodically and may adjust them as the market changes.

Benefits And Perks

401(k) plan
30 days of work from anywhere per calendar year
Daily lunch stipend
Equity (based on role and performance)
Unlimited PTO
Fully stocked kitchen
Dog-friendly office
Ongoing opportunities for growth and development

This is a full-time, in-person role based in our Los Angeles office in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). We provide relocation assistance for candidates who need to move. Sponsorship is not available at this time.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

This is a Sr. Software Development Engineer II
(SDE) role in the CTIO
team that is bringing multiple AI-based strategies together into an integrated capability on our next-generation sensor (lightweight agent) across macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms. The Sr. SDEs in the team own the design and development of the features that put AI on the endpoint: operationalizing machine learning models inside the sensor, building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on-device inference, and integrating those capabilities with the core sensor features. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking, and many are built with shared components across platforms. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently.

The CTIO
team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends.

What You’ll Do:

Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives.
Conceptualize and develop new product features.
Provide guidance and support to development teams in designing and implementing software for cross-platform delivery (Windows, macOS, Linux).
Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint.
Engage in cross-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations.

What You’ll Need:

Deep knowledge of C/C++; Swift experience required for macOS-focused candidates; Windows OS Kernel and Driver Development experience required for Windows-focused candidates.
Hands-on experience operationalizing machine learning models on the endpoint, including building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on-device inference.
Extensive, fundamental understanding of internals for your primary platform (macOS, Linux, or Windows)
Proven experience in debugging memory corruption issues, process contentions, and system performance bottlenecks.
Demonstrated experience collaborating with teams to successfully deliver major features and releases.
Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, and operate effectively within a geographically distributed team.

Experience with eBPF
