Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About The Role

Our software team is growing, and we are looking for talented engineers to join us and be instrumental to one of the following areas: Data Platform, Simulation, and Technical Infrastructure.

Data Platform: The Data Platform serves as a comprehensive management system for Nuro AI Driver's data, labels, and metrics, facilitating seamless access functionality. The team focuses on data annotation across various domains, including 2D/3D perception, mapping, behavior trajectory, and language/text. It also handles data ingestion and mining, employing methods such as heuristics and embedding search. Additionally, the platform supports the autonomy evaluation infrastructure by providing detailed introspection.
Simulation: The Simulation team builds the simulator that allows us to develop and test our autonomous driving technology in a virtual setting. We work on the core simulator and simulation frameworks, sensor simulation, scenario generation, and solutions that combine real-world data with synthetic techniques to push the boundaries of what can be simulated, collaborating closely with teams across Autonomy and AI Platform to allow us to simulate realistically and reliably at scale.
Technical Infrastructure: this group owns few fundamental services for entire engineering organizations: generic compute platform to host mission-critical workflows such as data processing and simulation, storage management service which manages hundreds of PB of data, cloud infrastructure serves as IaaC which provisions and maintains all cloud resources, engineering productivity provides tools such as build and CI/CD to make engineering work more efficient.

2+ years of relevant industry experience in addition to a Bachelor’s Degree, Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or related field.
Must have strong programming skills in Python, C++ or Go

jobs.description:
Department:
Software

Location:
Redondo Beach

Compensation:
$130,000 - $280,000 / year

Description

As a Flight Software Engineer
at Impulse, you will be responsible for the design, development, and integration of the software that powers our Space Vehicles. You will work closely with avionics engineers, GNC engineers, propulsion engineers, and other cross-disciplinary teams to deliver high-reliability, high-performance software for in-space transportation.

Responsibilities

Contribute to the design, implementation, integration, and verification of software for:
Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) algorithms
Command and telemetry handling
Mission sequencing, autonomy, and fault management
Closed-loop control of propulsion, attitude control, and other time-critical systems

Implement features for Impulse’s real-time flight software framework to meet deterministic performance requirements in space environments.
Develop detection and mitigation algorithms for anomalies such as sensor failures, actuator malfunctions, or radiation-induced faults.
Direct and participate in code reviews, ensuring compliance with software safety, reliability, and maintainability standards.
Support mission operations and troubleshoot real-time issues during ground integration, environmental testing, and on-orbit operations.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related degrees
2+ years writing C++ code for an embedded system or vehicle of some kind (robot, car, drone, spacecraft, etc)
Demonstrated understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, data structures, and computer networking
Experience with Real Time Operating Systems (RTOS) or with Embedded Linux
Experience using version control, test cases, and other software best practices

Preferred Skills And Experience

Proven track record delivering flight software for spacecraft— including launch vehicles, OTVs, upper stages, or other in-space propulsion systems.
Familiarity with NASA cFS, ROS2, or custom middleware for space applications.
4+ years of demonstrated experience in designing software for deterministic timing and hard real-time constraints.
Participation in successful integration, testing, launch, and mission operations of a space vehicle.

Additional Information

Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options
, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage
as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan
.

jobs.description:
About Us

Join us at WinCo Foods, where we're more than just a grocery retailer - we're a growing family of over 140 supermarkets in 10 states with over 22,000 employee owners. Our purpose is to make the lives of our customers and employee owners better by offering the lowest possible prices to feed their families. Currently, WinCo is the second largest Employee-Owned company in the United States. With more than 500 millionaire employee-owners in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Our benefits, including top-tier medical plans and tuition support set us apart. In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Position is On-site

Job Summary

A Software Developer researches and analyzes business requirements and user specifications to effectively design, code, test, document, and implement new and maintain existing software applications.

Typical Duties And Responsibilities

Analyzes user specifications and requirements.
Analyzes, reviews, and alters programs to increase operating efficiency or adapt to new requirements.
Gathers information from the end-user through conducting interviews and business process review.
Formulates plan—and outlines the steps required--to develop program, using structured analysis and design.
Converts project specifications into detailed instructions, tasks and logical steps for coding.
Plans, code, tests, and documents software programs, applying knowledge of programming techniques.
Consults with users to identify current operating procedures and clarify program objectives.
Identify, prioritize and execute tasks in the software development life cycle.
Designs and creates the user interface within application standards.
Develops tools and applications by producing clean, efficient code.
Automates tasks through appropriate tools and scripting.
Participates in code review, debugging and quality assurance.
Conducts thorough testing of software applications.
Trouble-shoots and provides resolution to software issues.
Collaborates with internal teams and vendors to maintain and improve software.
Ensures software is up to date with latest technologies.
Enhances development skills through reviewing technical manuals, periodicals, and participating in technical community forums.
Contributes as a member of a development team.

Requirements

Education/Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer information systems or equivalent academic achievement or equivalent experience.
Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools.
Knowledge of database analysis, design and normalization.
Knowledge with data integration and data orchestration tools and related best-practices.
Knowledge with service-oriented architectures.
Experience with operating systems (Microsoft Windows)
Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)

Ability To

Work effectively in a team-oriented environment, establishing and maintaining good rapport with co­workers, supervisors, and others.
Demonstrate high level of quality in coding and testing applications.
Apply analytical and problem-solving skills
Complete projects within expected deadlines or defined time estimates.
Demonstrate strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Perform all duties with efficiency and accuracy.
Perform all tasks with integrity and confidentiality.
Be self-directed and demonstrate time management skills.
Utilize strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
Work independently on assigned tasks.
Serve in an on-call production support rotation to resolve problems.

Machines And Equipment Operated

Office machines (e.g., copy machine, computer terminal, telephone, fax, etc) and other devices.

Preferred Credentials

IBM iSeries platform, RPG, CL, SQL, DB2, HTML, JavaScript, FTP, Rest API, XML & JSON, PHP, node.JS, C#.Net, Net , Java, MS SQL Server and modern other Web-oriented technologies.
Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools for automation and integration of software development processes.
Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
Knowledge of IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL).

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by the employees assigned to this job. All employees must comply with Company policies and applicable laws. The responsibilities, duties and qualifications required of personnel may vary.

EEO/Inclusivity

As the WinCo Foods community continues to grow, our variety of perspectives and wide range of experiences are essential to our strategy and success. We are committed cultivating and celebrating an inclusive environment in which all employees are valued and respected.

Description

AI Software Engineer (AI Agent Development)

Title:
AI Software Engineer (AI Agent Development)

Location:
Cartersville, GA (Qcells Cartersville Factory)

Department:
Smart Intelligence Team

The AI Software Engineer will design, build, and operate AI agent systems that support engineers and managers across Qcells’ solar manufacturing lines (ingot, wafer, cell, and module) at the Cartersville (CTV) and Dalton (DLT) plants. The team runs a production multi-agent platform in which domain agents answer process questions in natural language, query manufacturing data through tools, monitor equipment in real time, send early-warning alerts, and generate reports for engineering and management. This role focuses on agent development: tool design, data integration, LLM orchestration, evaluation, and reliable 24/7 operation on the factory floor. Machine learning models built on vision and process data are developed and served as tools that the agents use.

Responsibilities

Design and develop LLM-based AI agents for manufacturing domains (ingot, wafer, cell, module), including tool/function calling, multi-step reasoning, intent routing, and conversation context
Build agent tools that safely access manufacturing data (MES, Oracle/MariaDB process databases, REST data gateways, inspection image stores), with SQL guardrails, query validation, and access controls
Develop real-time monitoring and alerting agents that detect equipment and process anomalies, attach evidence (charts, images, video), and deliver actionable alerts to engineering chat rooms (e.g., Telegram, Microsoft Teams)
Build automated reporting and analysis workflows in which agents generate daily/weekly reports, root-cause analyses (RCA), and documents or slides from live production data
Manage LLM serving and routing across cloud APIs (e.g., Claude) and on-premise open-weight models on local GPU servers, including prompt management, prompt caching, and cost/latency optimization
Build domain knowledge bases and retrieval (RAG) from SOPs, engineering reports, and team conversations
Develop and deploy ML models that agents use as tools, such as image-based failure prediction, defect classification, and anomaly detection, with automated retraining and performance monitoring
Establish evaluation and quality controls for agents: answer verification, user feedback loops, regression tests, and guardrails against incorrect or fabricated answers
Integrate agents with factory systems such as digital twin platforms, web dashboards, and production simulators
Work directly with process, equipment, and quality engineers to turn field requests into agent features, and own those features in production

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field)
2+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, machine learning, or data engineering
Hands-on experience building applications on LLM APIs, including tool/function calling, structured outputs, and prompt design
Strong proficiency in Python, including backend services, asynchronous programming, and REST APIs
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases
Experience deploying and operating services on Linux (scheduling, logging, monitoring, troubleshooting)
Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers, suppliers, and stakeholders from different technical backgrounds, and to turn ambiguous requests into working tools

Preferred Qualifications

Professional working proficiency in Korean (speaking, reading, and writing) to collaborate with Korean-speaking engineers and headquarters teams and to build agents that serve Korean-language users
Experience with agent frameworks and protocols (e.g., Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol)
Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, and embedding models
Experience serving open-weight LLMs on premise (e.g., vLLM, Ollama) and managing GPU servers
Experience with computer vision or time-series machine learning (PyTorch) and MLOps practices
Experience with manufacturing data (MES, equipment logs, inspection images), especially in solar, semiconductor, or display industries
Experience with messaging bot integrations (e.g., Telegram, Slack, Microsoft Teams) and web dashboards
Experience with Docker, Git, and CI/CD

jobs.title: Field Application Engineer (FAE)
jobs.description:
About the Role

Orbbec is seeking a Field Application Engineer (FAE) to join our North America technical support team, based in the Bay Area.
This position provides technical support across Orbbec's full product portfolio, including 3D vision cameras, data acquisition products, and related hardware and software solutions. The role involves supporting customers in robotics, computer vision, automation, AI, and other emerging applications.
The ideal candidate has a strong technical background, hands-on software development and troubleshooting experience, and excellent communication skills in both English and Mandarin Chinese. The position requires close collaboration with engineering and product teams in China, along with the flexibility to support customers on-site, travel for business, and participate in industry events.
Key Responsibilities

Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support across Orbbec's full product portfolio, including 3D cameras, data acquisition systems, and related solutions.
Support customers with product evaluation, system integration, software configuration, troubleshooting, and application development.
Assist customers with integrating Orbbec products into their hardware and software environments, including SDKs, APIs, drivers, and related tools.
Support data acquisition products and workflows, including device setup, configuration, recording, synchronization, data management, and troubleshooting.
Build, run, modify, and troubleshoot SDK sample applications to reproduce customer issues and validate solutions.
Troubleshoot software installation, compatibility, connectivity, and integration issues across Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, and relevant embedded platforms.

Independently investigate customer-reported issues, analyze logs and code, identify potential root causes, and coordinate with internal R&D teams to develop solutions.
Serve as a technical liaison between North American customers and engineering and product teams in China, ensuring effective bilingual communication and issue resolution.
Provide on-site technical support, customer training, product demonstrations, and troubleshooting as business needs require.
Support trade shows, industry events, customer visits, and technical demonstrations, including preparation, setup, and event support.
Collect customer requirements and technical feedback and communicate findings to internal product and engineering teams.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, sample applications, and FAQs.
Independently manage customer technical support cases, prioritize issues, and ensure timely follow-up and resolution.
Collaborate with teams across time zones and provide timely support for urgent technical issues outside regular business hours when necessary.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
3+ years of experience in field application engineering, software engineering, technical support, or a related engineering role.
Strong software development and debugging background, with proficiency in C++ and/or Python and the ability to independently investigate software-related technical issues.

Hands-on experience with Windows and Linux development environments, along with familiarity with macOS and Android platforms and their software troubleshooting workflows.

Familiarity with SDKs, APIs, Git, development tools, and software-hardware integration.
Ability to read and understand source code, work with SDK examples, and troubleshoot software build, dependency, and compatibility issues.
Basic understanding of hardware interfaces, device connectivity, and common communication protocols.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Mandarin Chinese
, with the ability to independently communicate with North American customers and collaborate with engineering teams in China.
Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and professionally.
Ability to learn and support a broad range of hardware and software products, including new and evolving technologies.
Ability to work independently while collaborating with geographically distributed teams.
Flexibility to participate in meetings across time zones and respond to urgent technical issues outside normal business hours when necessary.
Must be based in the Bay Area and available for on-site customer support, technical demonstrations, and other local business activities as needed.
Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally for customer visits, technical support, trade shows, and industry events.

Preferred:

Experience with 3D cameras, depth sensing, computer vision, or image processing.
Familiarity with robotics platforms, ROS/ROS2, and related development tools.
Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, ARM-based Linux systems, or embedded computing platforms.
Experience with data acquisition systems, sensor synchronization, recording workflows, or multimodal data collection.
Experience with OpenCV, point cloud processing, camera calibration, or 3D perception applications.
Familiarity with USB, Ethernet, GMSL, camera streaming, device drivers, or related hardware interfaces.
Experience with CMake, cross-platform application development, or third-party SDK integration.
Experience with Android Studio, Android SDK/NDK, Xcode, or native application development on macOS or Android.

Experience supporting robotics, automation, AI, or related applications.
Previous experience in a customer-facing FAE or application engineering role.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a technically capable, self-motivated engineer who can independently support customers across Orbbec's diverse and evolving product portfolio.
The successful candidate should combine strong troubleshooting abilities, practical software experience, excellent bilingual communication skills, and a proactive approach to customer support.
This is a field-based position requiring residence in the Bay Area, with flexibility for customer site visits, business travel, cross-time-zone collaboration, and industry events.

jobs.description:
DiDi develops autonomous driving technology and aims to integrate it into shared mobility. The Machine Learning Engineer - Agentic AI will build agentic systems and self-improvement workflows that develop, evaluate, and deploy autonomous driving software, while shaping onboard architecture.

Responsibilities

Build agentic harnesses for autonomous driving. Agents get permissioned access to the driving stack, data, training infrastructure, and evaluation environments, along with automatic scenario setup and pass/fail checks, so they can run experiments without a person in every step
Develop recursive self-improvement (RSI) loops. These include failure mining, candidate generation, evolutionary search, and targeted data generation aimed at the policy's current weaknesses. Each round should also improve the process that produces the next one
Curate a reusable skill library. Verified fixes become knowledge that later tasks can build on, with checks that a skill actually helps before it is promoted. Train LLMs on our own agent data
Turn development trajectories into training data, and fine-tune LLMs to work fluently with our software stack, tools, and codebase
Advance agent-as-policy approaches. Agents improve driving behavior directly: they write policy logic, curate data, adjust training recipes and objectives, and trace driving failures back to their causes. Shape the onboard architecture
Decide what runs on the vehicle and what stays offline, within onboard limits on latency, compute, determinism, and safety
Work closely with the prediction, planning, simulation, and onboard teams to turn prototypes into production workflows

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer (Rust)
jobs.description:
Umbra is an American space technology company delivering advanced systems, from sensors to spacecraft, that empower customers worldwide with unmatched access to critical information from space. Our mission is simple and ambitious: redefine space—for people, systems, and missions in every domain. Umbra's ecosystem operates through three business units: Remote Sensing (the data), Space Systems (the components), and Mission Solutions (the platforms).Together, our teams develop capabilities that deliver persistent access, resilient performance, and mission-ready solutions, advancing U.S. space leadership while keeping the world safe and informed.

About The Team

Space Systems - The Components

Space Systems is where Umbra turns hardware and software designs into on-orbit realities; developing, implementing and iterating mission-ready core technology, while simultaneously advancing the next generation of our own satellite constellation. Space Systems is vertically integrated across the satellite architecture, thus the team designs, builds, and tests an array of critical components and subsystems, including power systems, communications, control systems, deployment hardware, avionics, and payloads, as well as the flight software, firmware and digital design solutions to support the entire hardware stack. Our focus is on first principles engineering, and our mandate is simple: it has to work when it counts. Every bolt, board, and binary is proven on our own SAR constellation, ensuring flight-proven reliability where failure is not an option.

If you want to work on cutting edge space technology while maintaining the highest standard for innovation and mission ready performance, you belong here at Umbra.

About The Job

We are seeking a Flight Software Engineer
who has experience in Rust programming language to take an active role in the development and delivery of embedded flight software specifically tailored for Umbra missions. In this pivotal role, you will be tasked with a range of critical responsibilities, including but not limited to the formulation and specification of software requirements, the comprehensive design of robust software architecture, and the actual writing and implementation of code. You will take lead responsibility for the essential processes of system integration and testing, ensuring that all components function seamlessly together.

In addition to your core development responsibilities, you will also be expected to provide expert guidance and mentorship in various aspects of software design, code development, and peer code reviews. Your role will include oversight of thorough documentation practices and the meticulous integration of the flight software with flight hardware, which encompasses conducting unit testing to ensure reliability and performance. Your contributions will be vital to the success of our missions, driving innovation and excellence in software engineering within our team.

This position is based on-site in either our Santa Barbara/Goleta, CA office, Arlington, VA office, or Reston, VA office.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with a cross-disciplinary engineering team to design, develop, and maintain reliable, fault-tolerant flight and payload software.
Implement software to meet requirements while managing interfaces with multiple spacecraft subsystems and ground systems hardware.
Develop command and control software for spacecraft flight operations, payloads, and peripheral electronics.
Participate in and contribute to test campaigns, from unit-level testing to automated system and subsystem-level testing.
Create and maintain documentation for software operation and interfaces with other system components.
Take on additional professional duties as assigned.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of proven experience in high-reliability software development with Rust or C/C++.
1+ years developing concurrent code with asynchronous Rust.
3+ years of embedded software development with Rust or C/C++.
Experience programming on embedded ARM cores supporting SoC architectures in Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal environments.
Strong understanding of processor architecture, with the ability to optimize code for performance and memory usage.
Experience leading software development processes, including version control, CI/CD, bug tracking, and design documentation.

Desired Qualifications

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with 5+ years of relevant experience.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic development environment.
Experience with software used in autonomous, fault-critical systems.
Familiarity with Python programming.
Background in developing, deploying, and maintaining software product lines.
Knowledge of hardware interfaces such as Ethernet, SPI, I2C, UART, and PCIe.
Experience with kernel development using Yocto.
Knowledge of dynamics and control systems.
Able to travel up to 10-15%.

Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, LTD, STD (employer funded)
Vol Life, Critical Illness, Accidental, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance (employee funded)
401k with 3% non-elective company contribution

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Amazon Security Experience
jobs.description:
Description

The Amazon Security Experiences (ASE) organization is the data intelligence backbone of Amazon Security. We build and operate the data platform that powers security insights, builder experience analytics, and tooling decisions across Amazon's security ecosystem. Every insight surfaced to security leadership, from builder productivity trends to security issue quality metrics, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains.

We operate at scale, processing large volumes of security and operational data daily through hundreds of pipelines consisting of transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems across AWS and SDO (Security, Developer, and Operations) data domains to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.

We are seeking a Data Engineer I to join our Security Data Intelligence (SDI) team. In this role, you will build and maintain data pipelines that power security analytics across Amazon. Working with well-defined requirements and guidance from senior engineers, you will create physical data models, optimize data pipelines for defined datasets, and deliver reliable, well-documented solutions on schedule. You will partner with teams across ASE, BizOps, MapSec, and other security organizations to implement data ingestion flows and support analytical models that serve the broader Amazon Security organization.

Key job responsibilities

Learn and apply team-established data processing guidelines and best practices when building and testing pipelines. Measure and improve dataset quality across owned pipelines, identifying issues and proposing solutions to the team. Flag limitations or opportunities in data processing tools to senior engineers for evaluation.

Learn and understand the team's existing data architecture, including how security data flows through ingestion, transformation, and serving layers. Build data solutions at the component level within the established team data architecture, following defined logical data models. Create physical data models for assigned datasets, applying appropriate persistence and integration techniques. Understand the implications of implementation decisions (e.g., normalization, distribution) and seek guidance from senior engineers on trade-offs.

Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code with minimal defects, following team coding standards. Clearly document solutions for ease of use and maintainability by teammates and data consumers. Get all data models, pipeline designs, and code reviewed by senior engineers before deployment. Test code thoroughly and understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of delivered solutions.

Build and maintain data pipeline infrastructure for assigned datasets using team-established patterns and tools. Apply basic database optimization techniques such as partitioning, distribution, and indexing as directed. Understand the underlying system infrastructure that data solutions depend on, including differences between data persistence solutions. Follow team guidelines for infrastructure management, security compliance, and automation practices.

Solve straightforward, well-defined problems with guidance from senior engineers, for example, building ingestion pipelines for a new security data source where the schema and requirements are defined, or troubleshooting data quality issues in existing datasets by researching root causes and thoroughly resolving defects. Handle problems even outside your own domain by either resolving them or ensuring a clear hand-off to the right owner.

Take well-defined requirements and deliver solutions on schedule within assigned scope. Participate in team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions to understand project context. Manage your own task execution effectively, seeking guidance when blocked or uncertain. Communicate progress and dependencies clearly to your team lead and senior engineers.

Build good working relationships with teammates, peer engineers, and data consumers across ASE and SDO. Partner effectively with Business Analysts, Data Scientists, and peer SDEs to understand data requirements. Help train and mentor DE interns when applicable. Participate in the interview process. Recognize discordant views and participate in constructive dialogue with peers.

Follow team-established best practices for data discovery, naming conventions, and data security. Classify, store, and handle data per Amazon security and compliance policies. Ensure proper access control, data integrity, and auditability for all produced datasets. Track security risks in data handling, mitigate issues, and escalate in a timely manner.

Identify data quality issues and pipeline deficiencies in owned components and propose solutions to the team. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning sessions. Make small improvements to team development processes when directed. Actively seek knowledge of team data architecture and apply learnings to improve your data solutions.

Participate in on-call rotation and respond to pipeline incidents following established runbooks and escalation procedures. Understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of team data systems. Contribute to monitoring and alarming setup for owned pipelines with guidance from senior engineers. Document incident resolutions and contribute to runbook updates for owned components.

Basic Qualifications

2+ years of data engineering experience
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Clinical Operations
jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Position Summary

As a Data Engineer
, you will play a vital role in supporting the broader Data Engineering community to deliver cutting-edge data and analytics platforms for our Global Drug Development (GDD) IT
group — specifically within the Cross Study Operations and Specimen Management
domain.

We seek a candidate who excels at creating innovative, reliable, secure, and easy-to-use data ecosystems that support the full data product lifecycle
— including ingesting, storing, processing, governing, and interacting with data. You will be a hands-on technical expert and individual contributor
, applying expertise in data engineering, cloud platforms, and Generative AI to solve complex clinical data challenges across cross-study operations and biospecimen workflows, delivering high-quality, scalable data solutions.

You will collaborate closely with BI&T partners, business analysts, and data engineers, as well as Clinical Operations specialists, Specimen Management professionals, Cross-Study Operations leads
, and other domain experts to support various data-driven initiatives and enhance the overall BMS data ecosystem. You will be expected to leverage Generative AI (GenAI), Databricks
, and semantic technologies
to drive innovation and efficiency within our data platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with BI&T partners, cross-study operations leads, specimen management specialists, clinical study teams, clinical trial analysts, trial managers, domain experts, and cross-functional leaders in data engineering, data product teams, and data operations to support effective adoption of our Data Platform.
Design, build, and maintain scalable, production-grade data pipelines and platform components supporting Cross Study Operations and Specimen Management product lines, including cross-trial data aggregation, specimen tracking, and biobanking workflows.
Develop and enhance data solutions to accelerate data usage across cross-study clinical R&D programs, ensuring robustness, interoperability with consumer applications, and scalability.
Optimize data platform components for performance, scalability, interoperability, availability, and cost-effectiveness using techniques such as cloud-native parallel processing, Databricks Delta Lake, caching, and partitioning.
Help design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data models using Databricks, Delta Lake, cloud-native tools, semantic modeling, and interoperability standards for large, complex cross-study and specimen datasets in life sciences.
Partner with business and data product owners to deliver hands-on technical solutions for data product development, standardization, testing, lineage, meeting latency requirements, and ensuring access governance across cross-study and specimen management data assets.
Utilize Databricks Unity Catalog to enforce data governance, manage metadata, and ensure end-to-end data lineage across cross-study and specimen management data products.
Contribute to the development of self-service data discovery solutions, fostering findability, accessibility, and reusability of cross-study operational and specimen data assets.
Maintain thorough documentation of processes, data structures, and technical solutions; deliver clear technical recommendations and execute solutions effectively across the enterprise.
Help build and deploy GenAI-powered and NLP-driven applications that deliver measurable outcomes across cross-study operations and specimen management, including efficiency gains, specimen traceability improvements, cross-study insight generation, risk mitigation, and compliance automation.
Develop and operationalize cloud-based GenAI and LLM-powered applications in collaboration with data product owners, engineers, and data scientists, utilizing techniques such as RAG, fine-tuning, and vector embeddings to deliver high-quality data discovery and consumption features for cross-study and specimen management workflows.
Leverage Databricks Mosaic AI and MLflow to develop, track, deploy, and manage machine learning and GenAI models at scale within cross-study and specimen management contexts.
Stay current on technology trends in GenAI, RAG, semantic search, Databricks, cloud orchestration, and containerization; apply emerging best practices to optimize platform performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
Serve as a go-to technical expert within the Cross Study Operations and Specimen Management domain, providing guidance and mentorship to junior analysts, interns, and vendor resources on Databricks, technical best practices, and business alignment.
Foster a culture of continuous learning, engineering excellence, and knowledge sharing across the data engineering community.

Qualifications & Experience

0-2 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Analytics, and AI/ML, with demonstrated expertise implementing and operating data capabilities and solutions in a cloud environment.
Hands-on expertise with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, Mosaic AI, and MLflow; Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional) is a strong plus.
Demonstrated expertise in cloud-native data platforms, ETL/ELT pipeline design, data modeling, and semantic analytics for large-scale, complex datasets, with hands-on DevOps experience.
Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark (including PySpark on Databricks), and GenAI frameworks; hands-on experience with LLM architectures, RAG, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks.
Proficiency in creating and maintaining optimal data pipeline architecture for large, complex datasets, including semantic modeling within a domain — preferably life sciences, clinical trial operations, or specimen/biobanking workflows.
Demonstrated experience delivering production-grade GenAI applications, predictive models, and self-service analytics tools supporting critical clinical or research business functions.
Working knowledge of LLM and GenAI-driven approaches, including RAG, Chain-of-Thought, fine-tuning, vectorization, agentic frameworks, and prompt engineering techniques for improving the accuracy of LLM-based responses.
Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills; ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and drive adoption of data solutions across functional teams.
Commitment to engineering excellence, documentation, and process improvement; functional knowledge of Life Sciences R&D and clinical trial operations is highly preferred.

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Compensation Overview

Princeton - NJ - US: $65,540 - $79,413

The starting pay range(s) listed above is for full-time employees (FTE). You may also be eligible for additional discretionary incentive cash and stock opportunities. We determine starting pay thoughtfully – carefully considering the nature of the role, required skills, work location, schedule and the knowledge and experience you bring. Final compensation is guided by pay equity principles and applicable employment laws. Compensation programs are reviewed on an ongoing basis and may be adjusted over time to reflect evolving market factors, and individual, team or Company performance.

Benefits

Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, you may be eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefit plans – including wellbeing support, retirement and financial protection benefits, and insurance offerings (medical, dental, vision, life and disability).

U.S.-based exempt employees are eligible for Flexible Time Off (FTO), which provides paid time off without a set accrual limit, subject to manager approval, along with 11 paid company holidays each year.

Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP.

You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software.

A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share.

Technologies We Use

Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs
Open-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg
Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub
Shared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms

Build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connectors, improving performance and extending support for imports, exports, change data capture, interactive queries, and writeback as external systems and customer needs evolve.

Design and maintain connectivity SDKs for internal teams and end users, with clear APIs, documentation, testing utilities, and development workflows that make integrations easy to author and maintain.

Lead incremental migrations onto shared infrastructure, manage compatibility, and retire older implementations while preserving the workflows customers depend on.

Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability.

Empathy for developers and end users, reflected in usable SDKs, clear configuration, actionable errors, and useful diagnostics.

As a Software Engineer, Training/Inference (C++), you will design and optimize large-scale model serving systems end-to-end. You will own everything from distributed infrastructure – global KV cache, continuous batching, load balancing, auto-scaling – to deep low-level optimizations, including GPU kernels, quantization, speculative decoding, and tail latency. This is a high-impact role where your work directly determines how fast and reliably users interact with Grok at massive scale.

Architect and implement scalable distributed infrastructure for model serving (load balancing, auto-scaling, batch scheduling, global KV cache)

Benchmark, fine-tune, and accelerate inference engines (including low-level GPU kernel work and code generation)
Develop custom tools to trace, replay, and fix issues across the full stack — from orchestration down to GPU kernels

Accelerate research on scaling test-time compute, RL rollout, and model-hardware co-design for next-generation systems

Experience with large-scale, high-concurrent production serving
Experience with GPU inference engines (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, Triton, TensorRT-LLM)
Strong background in system optimizations: batching, caching, load balancing, parallelism
Low-level inference optimizations: GPU kernels, code generation
Algorithmic inference optimizations: quantization, speculative decoding, distillation, low-precision numerics
Experience with testing, benchmarking, and reliability of inference services
Experience designing and implementing CI/CD infrastructure for inference

Overview i3 is seeking Software Engineers to join tour team in Huntsville, Alabama. You will help design, develop, integrate, test, and sustain mission‑critical command and control (C2) software used by our warfighters and customers around the world. In this role, you will support Agile Software Teams, working closely with systems and test engineers to build robust, secure, and scalable software solutions that address complex logical and mathematical challenges in support of Global C2 missions. This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy hands‑on development, solving complex technical problems, and collaborating in a highly integrated, Agile environment. Responsibilities * Design, develop, document, test, and debug applications and software systems that implement logical and mathematical solutions that are aligned with program objectives. * Participate in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Scrum teams to develop and maintain software products across multiple software baselines for the IBCS program. * Work in a fast-paced environment with high expectations, diverse assignments, and collaborative team settings across all levels of the organization. * Perform software development and upgrades in multiple programming languages/versions while minimizing changes to the operational behavior of tactical software. * Support documentation creation and updates using Markdown and other collaboration tools. * Support testing activities including unit and functional testing, code coverage analysis, and static code analysis; contribute to continuous improvement of test effectiveness and automation. * Other duties as assigned. Qualifications Education, Experience and Required skills: * This role can be filled at mulitple levels

Associate Software Engineer- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 1 year of relevant experience
Software Engineer- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 2 years of relevant experience, Master's degree in STEM field and 0 years of relevant experience
Strong object-oriented software development experience with Java and C++ * Proficiency in Linux-based development and runtime environments. * Experience with scripting languages and tools including Bash and Python. * Experience with modern configuration management and source control tools (Git / GitLab). * Experience with Agile SAFe and Atlassian Agile tools including Jira and Confluence. * Active Secret Clearance and the ability to maintain a clearance required. * Must be a U.S. Citizen. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including Cameo or similar tools. * Experience with DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines to build, integrate, test and deliver software. * Experience supporting real-time or distributed systems using RTI/DDS publish/subscribe middleware. * Engagement: Experience with US Army Systems including PATRIOT, LTAMDS, SENTINEL A3/A4, IFF devices, and M_SHORAD. * Experience with Engagement Planning and Execution, PAC2/PAC3, and AIM9x, and Indirect Fires. * Track Management: Experience with track management including sensors, composite track, IFF devices, and Combat Identification. * CompTIA Security+ Physical Demands: * The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

jobs.title: Junior Frontend Engineer & Technology Support | Dermstore
jobs.description:
About THG

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.  
Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.  
From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.   
With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?  
Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.
By combining our portfolio of owned brands with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.
THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

Why be a Junior Frontend Engineer & Technology Support at THG Beauty?

Dermstore is the premier destination for professional-grade skincare and clinical beauty, curated by experts and trusted by enthusiasts. Since its founding by a dermatologist, Dermstore has been a pioneer in the digital beauty space, offering a highly curated selection of the world’s most efficacious brands across skincare, hair care, and cosmetics. As a leader in prestige beauty e-commerce, we bridge the gap between clinical expertise and a premium shopping experience.
This is a unique hybrid opportunity for someone who is early in their front-end engineering career and has hands-on IT and desktop support experience. You’ll contribute to modern headless ecommerce applications using JavaScript and work closely with senior engineers while also providing onsite technology support to employees at our New York office.
This role offers the opportunity to grow your frontend engineering career while using your existing IT support experience to make an immediate impact.

As Junior Frontend Engineer & Technology Support , you’ll:   

Frontend Engineering

Build and maintain frontend applications using JavaScript/ES6+ and frameworks such as React, Vue, or similar.
Contribute to fast, scalable, secure, and accessible headless ecommerce experiences.
Work with senior engineers to understand system architecture, APIs, data structures, and how different systems communicate.
Contribute to frontend performance, accessibility, security, and observability.
Write clean, maintainable code and follow development standards and best practices.
Participate in code reviews and pair programming.
Work with UX, CRO, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver new features and improvements.
Develop your knowledge of headless ecommerce, SSG, APIs, and GraphQL.
Help create intuitive, inclusive user experiences.
Stay curious about new technologies, share ideas, and continue developing your technical skills.

Technology & IT Support

Provide hands-on onsite technology support to employees.
Troubleshoot laptops, desktops, applications, and operating systems.
Support Dell/Windows and macOS environments.
Support Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, and SharePoint.
Assist with device enrollment, configuration, replacements, onboarding, and offboarding.
Provide support for Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and Okta
Troubleshoot authentication issues and escalate more complex issues
Provide basic Wi-Fi and network troubleshooting.
Support meeting rooms, AV, video conferencing, and workplace technology.
Assist employees with workplace technologies, including corporate printing.
Maintain technical documentation and asset records.
Provide excellent employee onboarding/offboarding support for tech
Work closely with global Technology teams, including colleagues in the UK.

What skills and experience do I need for this role?

3-4 years of experience in desktop support, end-user IT, service desk, or onsite technology support.
Strong hands-on troubleshooting experience across laptops, desktops, applications, and peripherals.
Experience supporting Dell/Windows and macOS.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365.
Experience or exposure to Entra ID and Intune.
Experience supporting Okta or a similar authentication platform.
Basic networking knowledge, including Wi-Fi and TCP/IP.
Experience with meeting rooms, AV, video conferencing, device management, and onboarding/offboarding.
Strong communication and customer service skills.

Frontend Experience

Some experience building frontend applications through professional experience, internships, university, bootcamp, personal projects, or open-source contributions.
Good working knowledge of JavaScript, including vanilla JavaScript and ES6+.
Experience with or exposure to React, Vue, or a similar frontend framework.
Understanding of HTML, CSS, APIs, and modern web development.
Understanding of core programming concepts, including events, error handling, inheritance, and asynchronous programming.
Awareness of web accessibility and WCAG principles.
Interest in headless ecommerce, SSG, GraphQL, frontend performance, and modern web technologies.

About You

You enjoy both building technology and helping people solve technology problems.
You’re comfortable working with senior engineers, asking questions, learning new technologies, and sharing ideas. You have strong attention to detail and enjoy working collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams.
You’re also comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change and you may need to move between frontend development and hands-on employee support.

What’s in it for me?

Salary: $90,000 to $100,000 based on experience
Hybrid Work Model - 3 days office/2 days home
Medical, Dental, Vision plans

401K matched up to 5%
Generous PTO (Paid Time Off)
Short and long-term disability
Exclusive employee discounts off THG Brands

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

AgCountry Farm Credit Services (AgCountry), Farm Credit Services of America (FCSAmerica) and Frontier Farm Credit are financial cooperatives that operate under shared management across eight states. While each association is owned by its local farmers and ranchers, they collaborate by pooling resources, expertise, and talent to provide affordable credit, crop insurance, and financial services.

Our associations are united by a common mission and commitment to serving rural America and supporting each other, which drives the success of the farmers, ranchers, and agribusiness we serve. We take pride in being a great place to work, and this enthusiasm is reflected in the relationships our team members foster with one another and with our customers.

Job Summary *Hybrid-Incumbent must work three days per week in the Omaha, Ne office. 

We are looking for an Application Developer to join our Retail Lending developer team. In this role, you will be part of a full-stack, custom development team in a fast-paced, agile environment where agile development is embraced, and innovation is encouraged. You will participate in ideation and brainstorming sessions to devise creative and disruptive solutions, applications, APIs and data solutions to drive toward implementation of those solutions. You will be building solutions that support our customers and our teammates who serve them. Ultimately, your work will impact our mission to become Agriculture’s most valued financial partner.

Collaborate with others to address customer and business problems by reviewing objectives, gathering facts, analyzing data, and proposing alternative solutions.
Stories / Requirements: Collaborate with product teammates to analyze and comprehend the intended purpose and functionality of the system. Examine existing stories and utilize them as a foundation for discussions. Additionally, consider expanding upon or proposing new narratives based on the insights gained during this process.

Experience in creating multi-tier and web-based applications utilizing Visual Studio and related Microsoft .NET or similar technologies (e.g., C#, Web API, Entity Framework, .NET Core).

jobs.title: Mid-Level Full-Stack AI Solutions Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About AlarisPro

AlarisPro is the aviation industry’s only aviation-minded, cloud-based UAS fleet management platform. It replaces spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one powerful system that unifies safety, compliance, and operational intelligence through centralized tracking of flights, maintenance, parts, and aircraft configuration.

Now we are building the future of Preventive Maintenance Artificial Intelligence. AlarisPro is evolving from a data provider into an AI solutions integrator—turning trusted operational data into intelligence, recommendations, and better decisions for UAS operators.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on, growing engineer who can strengthen the platform we operate today while helping build the intelligent products of tomorrow. This is not a narrow database, front-end, or AI role. Working with experienced technical and product leaders, you will contribute across the current Microsoft-based application stack, modern cloud services, APIs, user experiences, and emerging AI capabilities.

You will be successful if you enjoy modernizing real production systems, learn the aviation domain, use AI coding tools fluently, and work with product and design partners to move from raw information to trusted decisions.

This is a hybrid position based in Southern Maryland. Applicants must currently reside in the United States and be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Company-paid relocation assistance is available for qualified candidates. Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience, qualifications, and technical expertise.

What You Will Build?

·    Evolve the current platform.
Develop, optimize, secure, and maintain AlarisPro’s MSSQL, ASP.NET/.NET, IIS, API, and React capabilities.
·     Create the modern AI stack.
Contribute to cloud-native services, AI-enabled workflows, retrieval and reasoning capabilities, model integrations, evaluation approaches, and production-ready data pipelines.
·     Applications that turn information into decisions.
Build experiences that surface risks, identify patterns, recommend actions, and support preventive maintenance and operational decision-making.
·     Connect the ecosystem.
Design secure, documented REST APIs and integrations that allow internal services, customers, partners, and AI agents to work with AlarisPro data and capabilities.
·     Build usable front ends.
Create responsive, accessible interfaces that make complex safety, compliance, maintenance, and fleet intelligence understandable and actionable.
·     Use AI-assisted engineering responsibly.
Apply AI tools (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate discovery, prototyping, refactoring, testing, documentation, and delivery—with human review and production engineering discipline.

Core Responsibilities:

Production Platform & Data

·   
 Develop and optimize T-SQL stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, schemas, indexes, and execution plans.
·    Monitor reliability and performance; troubleshoot deadlocks, blocking, long-running queries, resource utilization, and application/database issues.
·    Maintain data integrity, security, availability, backup/recovery practices, and compliance controls.
·    Develop, debug, refactor, review, deploy, and support ASP.NET/.NET applications, React Native, and IIS-hosted services.
AI, Cloud & Integration

·    
Prototype and deploy AI capabilities that use AlarisPro’s trusted operational data to improve maintenance, safety, compliance, and fleet decisions.
·    Build and consume secure REST APIs using appropriate authentication patterns, including JWT, OAuth 2.0, API keys, and related controls.
·    Contribute to cloud architecture, deployment automation, observability, CI/CD, testing, and scalable service design, with an emphasis on AWS environments.
·    Help evaluate new models, frameworks, and coding agents; document findings, technical decisions, and measurable product outcomes.
Product, Design & Collaboration

·   
 Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, risks, and decisions—not simply requested features.
·    Use Design Thinking and product management methods to frame problems, prototype quickly, test assumptions, prioritize value, and iterate from evidence.
·    Bridge aviation operational requirements, product objectives, user experience, and technical constraints to develop effective, practical software solutions.
·    Contribute to roadmaps, requirements, acceptance criteria, code reviews, technical documentation, testing, and release readiness.

What We Are Looking For:

Required Experience

·   
 Hands-on development with C# or VB.NET and ASP.NET Web Forms, MVC, .NET Core, or a comparable .NET application environment.
·    Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with cloud-hosted applications, databases, or services.
·    Front-end development experience; HTML, JavaScript, CSS, React or comparable modern frameworks are strongly valued.
·    Practical experience using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools.
·    Working knowledge of Git, testing, secure development, code review, deployment, and production troubleshooting.
·    Ability to contribute across the stack, communicate clearly, ask good questions, reliably estimate tasks assigned, document work, and deliver reliably and on time in a fast-moving environment.
Preferred Experience
·    3+ years of professional software or data-platform engineering experience, including meaningful hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL.
·    AWS architecture, application/API hosting, WebSocket’s, managed databases, and cloud observability.
·    SQL Agent automation, Microsoft SQL database administration, IIS configuration, high availability, and performance engineering.
·    Applied AI/ML, LLM integrations, retrieval-augmented generation, automated integration testing, model evaluation, or MLOps/LLMOps.
·    Product discovery, Design Thinking, user research, prototyping, backlog prioritization, or product management practices.
·    Experience in aviation, UAS/drone operations, fleet operations of any type, preventive maintenance, safety, regulatory compliance, or other high-reliability domains are a plus.

Our Approach to AI-Assisted Development

We value speed, curiosity, and strong tool fluency. We also expect engineering judgment. AI-generated code must be understood, reviewed, tested, secured, documented, and operated like any other production code. The goal is not to generate more code; it is to deliver better outcomes faster.

Success in This Role

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality software solutions that improve the AlarisPro platform and provide meaningful value to our customers. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
·       Ownership and Accountability:
Take responsibility for assigned projects and deliver reliable, well-tested solutions on schedule with minimal oversight.
·        Productivity and Execution:
Consistently make measurable progress, manage priorities effectively, and deliver results in a fast-paced development environment.
·        Problem-Solving:
Independently analyze complex challenges, identify practical solutions, and exercise sound technical judgment.
·        User-Centered Design:
Apply Design Thinking principles to translate aviation operational requirements and customer needs into intuitive, efficient software solutions.
·        Software Quality:
Develop maintainable, scalable, and secure code while minimizing defects, technical debt, and unnecessary complexity.
·        Collaboration and Communication:
Work effectively with leadership, product stakeholders, and fellow engineers while proactively communicating progress, challenges, and solutions.
·        Continuous Improvement:
Demonstrate initiative in improving existing functionality, development processes, and overall user experience.
·        Business and Mission Awareness:
Understand how software development decisions affect customer operations, aviation safety, regulatory compliance, and AlarisPro's business objectives.

Why Join AlarisPro?

Join AlarisPro at an exciting stage of growth and innovation, where you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future of unmanned systems. You'll help shape the continued evolution of a proven, industry-leading platform at the intersection of aviation safety, cloud technology, and applied AI. Leveraging extensive real-world operational data, you'll contribute to the development of next-generation capabilities in predictive maintenance, reliability analytics, and intelligent decision support that improve aviation safety and operational efficiency.

Just as important, you can connect your work to the bigger picture. You’ll be working with stakeholders across the firm, so you’ll need to understand what the business needs, explain technical trade-offs in plain terms, and show how your work makes a difference.

You’ll get full remote flexibility, hands-on experience with a modern data platform, and a real part in the AI and data initiatives shaping how the firm operates.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (MLOps & Data)
jobs.description:
About Surgeon Decision Intelligence (SDI)

SDI is a healthcare AI startup building surgical decision-support tools for spine surgery. Founded by
practicing spine surgeons and academic faculty, we combine deep clinical expertise with modern
machine learning to improve surgical planning and patient outcomes. Our platform spans medical
imaging pipelines, clinical outcomes data, and ML models that operate on both.

The role

We have working models: code that takes in an MRI series and produces measurements surgeons care
about. We need an engineer to turn them into production systems that are tested, versioned, deployed
and monitored, with every output traceable to the model, code and data that produced it. This is an
MLOps-focused role: reproducibility, versioning, deployment and monitoring of our models are the core
of the job.

An implementation partner is currently standing up our core platform: Databricks, MLflow, our
databases and model serving. You'll work alongside them during the build, take ownership when they
hand it over, and be the person who gets our models onto it and keeps them running. You'll also help
grow and connect the data our research depends on.

This is a hands-on engineering role on a small team. You'll work closely with our Principal AI/ML Engineer
on how models are built, tracked, released and served.

What you'll work on in your first year

Take our models from prototype to production.
Refactor MVP model code, starting with our MRI

imaging pipeline, into tested, typed, reproducible Python packages. Find out what's slow and make it
fast.
Make every result reproducible and traceable.
Register models in MLflow with pinned code,

environment and data versions. Build batch and online inference on Databricks so that every stored
output records the model that produced it. Define how a new model is validated, promoted and
rolled back, and write those procedures down.
Build the path from research code to production.
Set up project templates, CI, code review

and a clear path from "my model works" to "my model is registered and deployable" for everyone on
the team who writes model code.
Grow and connect our research data.
Our core research datasets already exist. You'll help shape

how they need to grow and change as we do, and connect our data sources (imaging, annotations,
scanner and protocol metadata, clinical outcomes) so researchers can find, query and use them.
That includes designing schemas, versioning the datasets our models are trained and evaluated on,
and writing loaders that handle the edge cases real-world data throws at you.
Own the platform.
Once our partner hands it over, you'll run it day to day: CI/CD, access, cost and

upgrades. You'll also set up monitoring for the services and for data and model drift, so we find out
about problems before our users do.

What we're looking for

2+ years of professional software engineering, mostly in Python, writing tested code that runs in

production.
You've taken at least one ML system from prototype to production yourself and kept it running

afterward, so you know what breaks.
A working understanding of how models are trained and evaluated, enough to reproduce a training

run: seeds, nondeterministic GPU operations, data splits, preprocessing versions. Experience with
PyTorch.
Hands-on MLOps: experiment tracking or a model registry (MLflow or similar), deploying model

inference, and CI/CD.
Data engineering: you've built pipelines that produce datasets other people train on. Relational

database design in PostgreSQL or similar: schemas, migrations, constraints, and knowing when not
to normalize.
You've reviewed other people's code and helped less experienced developers write better software

without slowing them down.
You've worked at a startup or on a small team where you owned work end to end.
You can take a loosely defined problem, ask the right questions, and come back with a working

solution without needing step-by-step direction.

Nice to have

Databricks (strongly preferred): Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Spark, Model Serving, Workflows.
Medical imaging experience: DICOM, MRI or CT pipelines, de-identification.
Longitudinal clinical or outcomes data, including follow-up and censored time-to-event data.
Regulated healthcare software: HIPAA and handling patient data, FDA software as a medical device,

design controls.
Azure (blob storage, Entra ID) or another major cloud.
Building and deploying APIs (FastAPI or similar).
Storing and compressing vectors: pgvector, quantization, dimensionality reduction.
Speeding up numerical Python code (NumPy, PyTorch, GPUs).
Side projects you've built and shipped on your own.

What this role is not

Not primarily a research or modeling role.
Your main job is making our models reproducible and

reliable in production, and building the data they're trained on. You'll need to understand our
models, and because we're a small team you may contribute to research from time to time, but it
won't be the core of the role.
Not building a platform from scratch, or tuning one component of a large system.
Our core

infrastructure is being stood up now. Your job is to own it and put our work on it, across the stack.

Location: Remote to start, transitioning to in person in New York City

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Platform Engineer

Role Purpose

Lead the design, build, and operation of a secure, scalable migration platform to move object data from OBSv2 to AWS S3.
The role focuses on reliable execution, automation, governance, monitoring, and production support for large-scale enterprise data migration.

Key Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end migration workflow from OBSv2 source buckets to AWS S3 destination buckets.
Build and operate AWS-based orchestration using Step Functions, Lambda, Fargate, AWS Batch, DynamoDB, SQS, and rclone.
Support both manifest-based and dynamic migration approaches, including batching, sharding, task sizing, and retry handling.
Implement governance for bandwidth allocation, queue management, prioritisation, throttling, and job tracking.
Build observability through CloudWatch dashboards, logs, metrics, alerts, health checks, and progress reporting.
Support secure multi-account deployment, IAM controls, privacy safeguards, testing, performance tuning, and production cutover.

Expected Deliverables
Production-ready migration orchestration platform supporting both manifest and no-manifest paths.
Hub-side governance for bandwidth control, queue processing, throttling, and completion reporting.
Reusable rclone-based migration runtime with progress reporting and dynamic throttle support.
DynamoDB-backed job, task, queue, bandwidth, and summary state management.
CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, logs, runbooks, deployment automation, and operational documentation.

Preferred Experience
Experience with Dell ECS, OBSv2, or other S3-compatible enterprise object storage platforms.
Experience delivering enterprise-scale migrations in regulated, production environments.
Experience with hub-and-spoke operating models across multiple AWS accounts.
Ability to produce clear technical documentation and leadership-ready reporting.

Mandatory Technical Skills
1. AWS Serverless

Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, API Gateway, SSM Parameter Store, and Secrets Manager.

2. AWS Compute and Containers

Strong working knowledge of ECS Fargate, AWS Batch, container task definitions, sidecar patterns, resource sizing, and runtime environment configuration.

3. AWS Storage

Deep understanding of Amazon S3, S3 Intelligent-Tiering, S3-compatible APIs, object metadata, prefix structures, large object transfers, and lifecycle considerations.

4. Object Storage Migration

Experience migrating large object datasets from on-premises or S3-compatible platforms such as Dell ECS/OBSv2 to AWS S3.

5. rclone

Hands-on experience configuring and operating rclone for high-volume transfers, including transfers, checkers, retries, checksum validation, no-traverse behaviour, stats, logs, and bandwidth limiting.

6. Python Development

Strong Python skills for Lambda and Fargate services, including boto3, JSON processing, exception handling, logging, dataclasses, streaming files, and API integration.

7. DynamoDB

Ability to design and operate DynamoDB tables, keys, indexes, scans, updates, batch writes, Decimal handling, and state-management patterns.

8. Networking

Understanding of AWS Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPCs, private subnets, routing, S3 Gateway Endpoints, NAT Gateway scoping, and high-throughput network design.

9. IAM and Security

Strong knowledge of IAM roles, cross-account access, STS assume-role, API keys, Secrets Manager, least-privilege design, and secure operational access.

10. Observability

Experience with CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards, structured logging, operational telemetry, and migration progress reporting.

11. CI/CD and Deployment

Experience with GitLab repositories, CI/CD pipelines, environment-specific configuration, infrastructure deployment, and safe teardown procedures.

Know-How Skills and Domain Understanding
Understand large-scale object storage migration patterns, including manifests, prefix-based partitioning, batching, and validation.
Balance migration performance across data volume, object count, compute resources, network capacity, and rclone concurrency.
Design fair bandwidth allocation, throttling, queue handling, retry, and escalation models for production migrations.
Apply strong operational discipline across monitoring, runbooks, restart procedures, completion checks, and stakeholder reporting.
Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture notes, input contracts, implementation details, and support procedures.
