jobs.title: IT Site Reliability Engineer — API Management Platforms
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Role

The Enterprise Platforms team within our Data & Agentic Platform Solutions organization is responsible for deploying, operating, and continuously improving the platforms that power TI's digital integration, automation and DevOps capabilities. As an IT Site Reliability Engineer within the Enterprise Platforms team, you will serve as the primary technical platform owner for TI's Apigee Edge private cloud environment — the backbone of TI's API management and integration strategy — while also providing platform SRE support across a broader portfolio of automation and DevOps tooling used throughout the enterprise.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure administration, DevOps engineering, and platform reliability. You will be expected to bring deep technical expertise in API management operations while also developing familiarity with adjacent platforms such as CI/CD pipelines, artifact repositories, source control systems, automation orchestration tools, and integration middleware. You will work closely with application development teams, security, network, and infrastructure teams to ensure all supported platforms are stable, performant, secure, and scalable.

Key Responsibilities

Apigee Platform Ownership (Primary Focus)

Primary Technical Owner: Serve as the go-to subject matter expert (SME) for TI's Apigee Edge private cloud platform, owning the full platform lifecycle from installation and configuration through ongoing operations, upgrades, and eventual roadmap evolution.
Platform Administration: Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain Apigee Edge private cloud components (Management Server, Router, Message Processor, Cassandra, ZooKeeper, Qpid, Postgres) across dev/test and production environments.
Monitoring & Intervention: Own and improve system monitoring solution to ensure early detection of issues and implementation of self-healing solutions where appropriate.
Incident Management: Serve as the primary escalation point for all Apigee-related incidents; lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and drive post-incident reviews (PIRs) to prevent recurrence.
API Proxy Lifecycle Support: Partner with development teams on API proxy deployment pipelines, policy troubleshooting, and runtime performance optimization within the Apigee environment.
Security & Compliance: Apply and enforce security hardening standards on the Apigee platform; manage TLS/SSL certificates, OAuth configurations, and role-based access controls (RBAC); ensure alignment with TI IT security policies and audit requirements.
Capacity Planning & Performance Tuning: Monitor platform resource utilization (CPU, memory, disk, JVM heap); conduct capacity planning and performance tuning across all Apigee Edge components and underlying infrastructure.
Backup & Disaster Recovery: Own and maintain backup, restore, and disaster recovery procedures for all Apigee Edge components and associated data stores (Cassandra, PostgreSQL, ZooKeeper).
Vendor Engagement: Manage the technical relationship with Google/Apigee support for escalated issues, product defects, version roadmaps, and advisory services.
Platform Roadmap Input: Provide technical guidance and recommendations on Apigee platform strategy, including future-state considerations such as migration paths to Apigee Hybrid hosted solution.

Broader Automation & DevOps Platform SRE Support (Secondary Focus)

Multi-Platform SRE: Provide site reliability engineering support for other automation and DevOps platforms within the ITS DevOps Platforms portfolio — which may include CI/CD tools, artifact management, source control, integration middleware, and automation orchestration platforms.
Operational Consistency: Apply consistent SRE principles across all supported platforms — defining SLOs/SLIs, building observability dashboards, maintaining runbooks, and driving reliability improvements.
Cross-Platform Incident Support: Respond to and triage incidents across the broader platform portfolio; coordinate with platform-specific SMEs and infrastructure teams to restore services rapidly.
Automation & Tooling Development: Develop and maintain automation scripts and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tooling (Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform, or similar) to streamline operations, deployments, and configuration management across all supported platforms.
Documentation & Knowledge Management: Create and maintain thorough technical documentation including architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, change records, and knowledge base articles for all platforms under support.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with networking, server infrastructure, application development, and security teams to support integrations, troubleshoot complex issues, and deliver platform enhancements across the automation portfolio.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
3+ years of hands-on experience with API management on Apigee or similar API Management platform

Preferred Qualifications

Strong proficiency with Linux/Unix system administration (RHEL, Rocky, or similar)
Proficiency in at least one scripting/automation language: Python, Bash, or PowerShell
Familiarity with REST API concepts, API lifecycle management, and API security patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys, JWT)
Experience with monitoring and observability tools, including one or more of the following: Elastic (ELK Stack — Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent
Understanding of networking concepts: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, TLS/SSL, firewalls, and proxies
Demonstrated experience supporting or administering at least one other DevOps or automation platform beyond Apigee (CI/CD, artifact management, source control, or similar)
Ability to provide on-call support for critical platform incidents outside normal work schedule
Apigee Certified API Engineer or equivalent certification
Experience with Apigee Edge components: Management Server, Router, Message Processor, Cassandra, ZooKeeper, Qpid, and PostgreSQL
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools: Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet
Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline tools: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar
Experience managing artifact repositories such as JFrog Artifactory or Sonatype Nexus
Experience with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and hybrid cloud architectures
Exposure to API mediation patterns, microservices architecture, and event-driven integration
Experience working in ITIL-based environments (Change Management, Incident Management, Problem Management)
Prior experience in a semiconductor, manufacturing, or large enterprise IT environment

About Us

Why TI?

The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us.
Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture .
At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings .

About Texas Instruments

Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI.com .

Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, disability, genetic information, national origin, gender, gender identity and expression, age, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.

About The Team

jobs.title: Quality Engineer (SDET)
jobs.description:
About Prudentia Sciences

Prudentia Sciences is an AI-powered technology platform transforming how biopharma, biotech, and life sciences investors approach portfolio management, due diligence, and value/risk simulation. Our platform accelerates investment in breakthrough therapies by:

Empowering biopharma to accelerate drug pipelines, maximize ROI, and achieve clinical and commercial success for greater patient impact
Enabling strategic positioning of asset value during portfolio planning and dealmaking
Equipping investors with data-driven insights to optimize capital allocation in drug asset transactions

Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Signal Fire, Iaso Ventures, and Virtue, we're on a mission to unlock the full potential of pharmaceutical R&D by empowering decision-makers with real-time, data-driven insights.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring our first dedicated QA Engineer: a hands-on engineer who writes code, builds quality into our platform from the ground up, and cares as much about performance and reliability as about correctness.

This is a rare opportunity to join a high-impact technology company in a major growth stage, where you’ll partner closely with engineering, product, and ML teams to safeguard the trust our pharma and biopharma customers place in our platform. Our platform is quickly seeing exceptional demand in its sector, and is backed by top-tier life science investors who have an informed perspective on where AI can have a profound impact in the industry.

What You’ll Do

Test Automation: Design, build, and maintain automated test suites across UI, API, and data pipelines, with most coverage at the API and data layers, so the team can ship fast and with confidence as the platform scales.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI coding tools (like Claude Code) daily to build and maintain tests, and know when to question their output. You understand why the code works, not just that it runs, and you keep sensitive data out of AI tools.
Quality Gates in CI/CD: Own the automated quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), deciding what blocks a release and what doesn’t. Be ruthless about eliminating flaky or long-running tests.
API & Contract Testing: Test at the API layer by default, and catch breaking changes between services before they reach production.
Performance & Reliability Testing: Own load, performance, and reliability testing so the platform meets the availability and responsiveness expectations of deal teams working with large volumes of sensitive, time-sensitive data.
Bug Tracking & Triage: Identify, document, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps, work with engineers to prioritize fixes, and make clear go/no-go release calls.
Data & Output Validation: Validate the accuracy and consistency of ML-driven outputs (risk analyses, valuations, scientific assessments) as they move from the orchestration layer into user-facing views.
Security & Compliance Awareness: Help verify secure handling of sensitive scientific and deal data, including keeping each customer’s data separate, in line with best practices for healthcare and life sciences data.
Collaboration & Process: Work cross-functionally with engineers, product leads, and domain experts to translate scientific and business requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria.
Continuous Improvement: Champion a quality-first culture: advocate for testability in design reviews, improve test coverage over time, and stay current on modern QA tooling and practices.

Who You Are

Core Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
QA Experience: Proven experience testing modern web applications and designing and building automated test suites, ideally as the person who owned them.
Test Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., pytest, REST-assured, pactflow).
CI/CD Integration: Experience owning automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), including setting up quality gates and managing flaky tests.
AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily work, with a habit of verifying what they produce.
Performance Testing: Experience designing load or performance tests and finding real bottlenecks.
Technical Fluency: Comfort reading code and working directly with engineers to understand system architecture, APIs, and data flows well enough to design meaningful tests.
Data-Driven Applications: Experience testing applications with complex, data-driven workflows.
Bug Tracking & Communication: Skilled at writing clear, reproducible bug reports and explaining quality risks and release readiness to the team.
Security & Compliance Awareness: Familiarity with best practices for secure data handling and testing in regulated or sensitive-data environments (especially valuable in healthcare, life sciences, or enterprise environments).
Collaboration & Product Mindset: Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to work closely with engineers, product managers, and scientific domain experts to deliver a high-quality user experience.

What We Offer

Impact: Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster
Ownership: Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader
Growth: Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase
Compensation: Competitive salary and equity
Team: Collaborative, mission-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma

Location

We are prioritizing candidates who can be flexibly hybrid twice per week (Tues/Thurs) from our Boston, NYC, or San Francisco office. If we find truly exceptional talent, we may consider fully remote in the United States.

Compensation Range: $120K - $145K

About Partner Forces

We partner with government agencies and industry to strengthen national security and critical infrastructure through expertise in strategy, program management, stakeholder engagement, technology implementation, preparedness, and business transformation.

At Partner Forces, we're more than consultants—we're trusted advisors. We work alongside our clients to solve meaningful problems, deliver actionable solutions, and make a lasting impact. As a growing firm, every employee has the opportunity to contribute not only to our clients' success, but also to the future of Partner Forces. Our culture is grounded in six core values: Integrity, Excellence, Positivity, Candor, Determination, and Teamwork.

These values shape how we work with our clients, support one another, and grow together. We believe that when our people thrive, our clients do too, which is why we invest in our employees' well-being, professional development, and long-term success.

What We Are Looking For

Partner Forces is looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to support a federal cybersecurity client at the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex data problems, connecting systems, and finding smarter ways to automate processes. In this role, you'll help bring together data from different sources, build and improve data pipelines, and develop automated solutions that make data more accessible, reliable, and useful. The ideal candidate is a strong technical problem solver who thinks automation-first, is comfortable working with messy or disconnected datasets, and enjoys figuring out how to make systems work better together.

At Partner Forces, we value curious, collaborative people who are willing to roll up their sleeves, ask good questions, and find practical solutions that support the mission.

What You'll Do

Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that integrate information from multiple systems and sources.
Develop automated processes to collect, transform, organize, and move data efficiently.
Integrate structured and unstructured datasets to improve data accessibility and usability.
Use SQL, Python, and other tools to clean, transform, and manage data.
Identify opportunities to replace manual processes with scalable, automated solutions.
Troubleshoot data integration challenges and improve data quality, consistency, and reliability.
Support data platforms, databases, and cloud-based environments.
Help organize and document data so teams can understand where it comes from and how it can be used.
Collaborate with technical teams and mission stakeholders to understand needs and develop practical solutions.
Support data that enables cybersecurity operations, analytics, reporting, and other mission capabilities.

Qualifications

Must be a U.S. Citizen with an active Top Secret security clearance.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 3–7 years of experience in data engineering, data integration, automation, or a related technical field.
Hands-on experience building data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with databases and multiple data sources.
Experience using Python or similar scripting languages to automate data processes.
Experience integrating, transforming, and managing complex datasets.
Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Candidates must be local to the DMV area and available to work onsite 2–3 days per week. This is a required in-person commitment.

Nice to Have

Experience with metadata management, data catalogs, or data governance.
Experience supporting federal cybersecurity or DHS missions.
Experience with APIs, workflow automation, or modern data integration tools.
Familiarity with data warehousing, data lakes, or modern data platforms.

Next Steps

If your application looks like a match, someone from our People Operations team will reach out to schedule a phone screening. During this conversation, we will determine if the current or future position aligns with your experience and skills. If things go well, from there you'll meet with members from the project team, including the hiring manager and teammates, and possibly be asked to submit a writing assessment to showcase your practical knowledge. If we find you are a match, you’ll get a call offering you the role. While we wish we could hire every great candidate who comes our way, the reality is that we can't. If you are not selected, we will be sure to connect with you and let you know so you can move on with your search. We will also keep your resume for future needs.

Salary Range & Compensation Philosophy

The anticipated salary range for this position is $110,000 - 165,000. At Partner Forces, we recognize that every candidate brings a unique combination of skills, experiences, and qualifications. Compensation decisions consider several factors, including years of relevant experience, specialized expertise, clearance level, and the requirements of the role. We also believe compensation is a starting point, not a finish line. We're committed to recognizing contributions, rewarding strong performance, and creating opportunities for continued growth as our employees develop their skills and careers at Partner Forces.

jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point, while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach audiences that are deeply engaged.

Our Team

The Ads Platform Engineering teams build advertising systems and integrations that powers the delivery of ads using our world class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads - unique mix of client and server side ad insertions, state of the art content delivery system, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving, members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

Our team is new and yet faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Open Roles

Role

We are hiring for multiple roles across our Ads Platform teams. As you progress through the interview process, you will be assessed for the following roles:

The Ads Inventory Management & Forecasting team builds state-of-art realtime inventory forecasting solution leveraging ML models and high performance ad server simulations. The team also builds systems that enable publisher inventory management solutions, which supports various monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split and yield optimization.
The Core Ads Serving team powers real-time ad decisioning, delivering relevant, high-quality ads while balancing revenue goals and advertiser outcomes. They build complex ML models for low-latency environments and manage core systems that enhance campaign performance through budgeting, pacing algorithms, and dynamic allocation across direct and programmatic. Additionally, the team develops models for goal-based delivery optimization, such as CPC, CPV, and CPCV.
The Ads Programmatic team builds interfaces with selected SSPs and DSPs to integrate with Advertisers' primary buying mechanisms to unlock spend.
The Ads Member Experience team is responsible for building and serving the different ad formats available on the platform. The team owns the integration between the different Netflix clients (TV, mobile app, web) and the ads serving infrastructure. One of its primary goals is to optimize how different ad formats are integrated with the Netflix member experience.
The Ads Identity & Audiences team is revolutionizing ad experiences by utilizing advanced machine learning models for identity resolution and precise behavioral and contextual audience targeting. We create foundational systems that deliver relevant and engaging ads to Netflix members, all while upholding their privacy. Our continuous refinement of models generates a flywheel effect, enhancing member experiences and driving optimal advertiser outcomes at scale.

Skills & Experience We’re Seeking

Proficiency in Java, C++, Python, or Scala with a solid understanding of multi-threading and memory management
Experience in building end-to-end ML model deployment and inference infra for low-latency real-time ad systems.
Experience in handling data at extremely large volumes with big data tools like Spark.
Yield Optimization, scoring, and bid ranking models, and Dynamic Allocation of direct/programmatic guaranteed and non-guaranteed inventory
Modeling and Building Cost Per Click, Cost Per View, and Cost Per Video Complete modeling and optimization
Productionized predictive models to forecast the effectiveness of advertising campaigns, including metrics like impressions, reach, clicks, conversions, and ROI.
Building Scalable Simulation solution to model different inventory scenarios, including demand fluctuations, pricing strategies, and inventory allocation.
General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape, with a focus on publisher side challenges like optimizing fill rates and maximizing revenue in the context of inventory management.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders from science team, product, engineering, operations, design, consumer research, etc., to productionize and deploy models at scale

Nice To Haves

Experience in productionizing ML models and deploying models at scale.
Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.
Familiar with publisher-side ad tech systems including ad servers, bidders, yield optimizers, and their demand-side counterparts (SSPs/DSPs)
Good understanding of Lucene index and had experience building Lucene index with large volume of data.
Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.
Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

In this role, the FAE will report to the Senior Director of Sales and serve as an integral part of the sales and marketing team, working closely with sales, PLM, Product Development, and key customers and to encourage and support adoption of Lumentum’s Cloud Modules and components into Datacenters and GPU Clusters.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

The Manufacturing Automation Engineer is responsible for identifying, developing, and implementing automation solutions across Port Alpha's shipyard production processes — plate cutting and profiling, panel and sub-assembly fabrication, robotic welding, block assembly, blast and paint, outfitting, material handling, and test — to improve throughput, quality, repeatability, safety, and cost efficiency. This role serves as the primary technical owner for automation projects from concept through production launch, partnering closely with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain teams.

The role sits within Shipyard Optimization (Robotics & Autonomous Build) and works hand in hand with Saronic's central automation and software teams so that Port Alpha's automation architecture, controls standards, and MES integration stay aligned with the company-wide approach while fitting the realities of large-structure steel shipbuilding.

The ideal candidate combines strong manufacturing process knowledge with automation expertise and plays a critical role in designing products and processes that are optimized for scalable automated production. Following implementation and production stabilization, ownership transitions to Port Alpha Manufacturing Engineering for sustaining support and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Automation Strategy & Process Development

Identify manufacturing operations and workflows suitable for automation based on safety, quality, throughput, ergonomic, and cost considerations.
Develop automation roadmaps and business cases to support production scaling objectives, feeding the Port Alpha Production Systems Roadmap.
Evaluate and recommend automation technologies including robotics, machine vision, PLC-controlled systems, automated assembly and welding equipment, material handling systems, and test automation.
Lead feasibility studies, cycle time analysis, and ROI assessments for proposed automation initiatives.

Cross-Functional Product & Process Design

Partner with Design Engineering during product development to ensure vessels and their structures are designed for manufacturability and automation (DFMA/DFA).
Provide design feedback on tolerances, joining methods, part presentation, fixturing, assembly sequence, and inspection requirements to enable robust automated manufacturing processes.
Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering and Shipyard Optimization to define scalable production architectures and standardized automation strategies that fit the facility layout and flow.

Automation Project Ownership

Own automation projects from concept development through equipment commissioning and production launch.
Define equipment specifications, statement of work (SOW), acceptance criteria, and validation plans for integrators and vendors.
Manage automation suppliers and system integrators throughout design, build, FAT, SAT, installation, and startup activities.
Coordinate equipment integration with facility infrastructure, MES systems, quality systems, and production controls.
Develop and execute process validation plans, capability studies, and production readiness reviews.

Production Launch & Handoff

Support pilot builds, process debugging, and ramp-to-rate activities during production launch.
Establish documentation packages including work instructions, PM requirements, spare parts lists, control plans, and troubleshooting guides.
Train Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, and Asset Reliability & Facility Operations teams on system functionality and maintenance requirements.
Transition ownership of stable production systems to Manufacturing Engineering for sustaining support and continuous improvement activities.

Continuous Improvement & Technical Leadership

Drive improvements in OEE, yield, uptime, cycle time, and labor efficiency through automation initiatives.
Standardize automation design practices, controls architecture, and equipment specifications across production lines and with Saronic's other manufacturing sites.
Support root cause investigations and corrective actions related to automated systems during launch phases.
Stay current with emerging manufacturing automation technologies and industry best practices, including shipbuilding-specific automation.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or related field.
5+ years of experience in manufacturing automation, process engineering, or production equipment development.
Experience implementing automated manufacturing systems in high-volume, heavy fabrication, or advanced manufacturing environments.
Strong understanding of industrial automation systems including robotics, PLCs, HMIs, sensors, pneumatics, servo systems, and machine vision.
Experience with manufacturing process development, PFMEA, validation methodologies, and production launch activities.
Ability to interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and process flow documentation.
Experience managing external automation vendors and integrators.
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred

Experience with robotic welding, automated panel lines, plate cutting and profiling, or other large-structure automation in shipbuilding or heavy fabrication.
Experience with automated assembly, test automation, or robotic material handling systems.
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and statistical process control methodologies.
Experience with controls programming, robot programming, or industrial networking.
Knowledge of MES integration, traceability systems, and smart factory/Industry 4.0 concepts.
Experience in shipbuilding, aerospace, automotive, robotics, electronics, or advanced manufacturing industries.
PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or automation-related certifications are a plus.

Key Competencies

Automation system architecture
Design for automation (DFA/DFM)
Production process optimization
Equipment commissioning and validation
Cross-functional technical leadership
Manufacturing scale-up and launch execution
Vendor and project management
Root cause analysis and problem solving

Physical Demands

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Occasional standing and walking within the office
Manual dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment
Visual acuity to read screens, documents, and reports
Occasional reaching, bending, or stooping to access file drawers, cabinets, or office supplies
Lifting and carrying items up to 20 pounds occasionally (e.g., office supplies, packages)

Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses

401(k) plan with company match

Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

Discounted pet insurance options including 24/7 Telehealth helpline

You will drive system-level design decisions that enable Alluxio to scale to thousands of nodes and exabytes of data, while maintaining performance, reliability, and simplicity for users.

In this role, you will operate as a technical architect and hands-on engineering leader, partnering closely with engineering teams and product management to translate complex requirements into scalable distributed system designs.

What You Will Be Able To Build and Owner：

Lead the end-to-end architecture and design of large-scale distributed systems powering the Alluxio platform.
Drive technical strategy and architectural direction across multiple teams and components.
Design systems that support high scalability, fault tolerance, performance optimization, and data durability.
Provide hands-on development and deep technical guidance in critical areas of the system.
Lead complex system design reviews and mentor senior engineers on distributed systems design.
Identify and resolve system-level performance bottlenecks and reliability challenges.
Collaborate with product management and engineering leadership to translate product goals into technical solutions.
Influence the broader technical ecosystem through open-source contributions and architectural thought leadership.

Who We Are Looking For:

Master or BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience of 2+ years in a technical leadership or architect role, driving system-level design and guiding engineering teams.
Strong hands-on software development experience in one or more general-purpose programming languages, including but not limited to Java, C/C++, or Go.
Deep architecting expertise in at least two of the following areas:
Distributed and parallel systems
Distributed storage systems
Architecting large-scale software systems
Demonstrated ability to design and implement high-quality, stable, and scalable end-to-end system architectures in production environments.
Strong analytical thinking and complex problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills and ability to influence technical direction across teams.

We Would Especially Appreciate If You Have:

PhD in Computer Science, Distributed Systems, or related fields.
Deep understanding of consensus algorithms, storage engines, or large-scale data systems.
Experience building or operating cloud-native infrastructure platforms.
Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source distributed systems projects.
Track record of designing systems that operate at massive scale (thousands of nodes or higher).
Passion for building high-performance infrastructure software.
Contributions to Alluxio open-source community.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Base Salary Range:
$230,000 – $330,000 / year （The final base salary offer within this range is determined by various factors, including candidate experience, technical qualifications, and operational needs. ）

Compensation & Benefits:
The posted range reflects the base salary range for this role . In addition to base pay, full-time positions at Alluxio are eligible for performance-based annual bonuses, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package (including health, 401k, and paid time off) .

About The Role

Design, implement, test, review, and release maintainable software. Explain technical tradeoffs and document interfaces and operational behavior.

Strong software engineering skills and experience building production systems.

Relevant depth in infrastructure, AI systems, or frameworks and developer tools.

Reliable delivery of useful shared capabilities.
Improvements to quality, performance, reliability, or developer experience.

Full-time, in-office in San Francisco. Base salary: $130,000–$175,000 annually. Equity: 0.1%.

jobs.title: Data Engineer II, AWS DC Global Network Delivery
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Global Network Delivery Services keeps the cloud running. We own the delivery and operation of all AWS global infrastructure — every data center, every server, every cable that gives hundreds of millions of customers uninterrupted access to the services they depend on. We tackle some of the hardest supply chain and infrastructure problems on the planet, with thousands of variables in play, and we're looking for exceptional people to help solve them.

You'll join a diverse, cross-functional team — Product, BI, network engineers, planners, builders, and operations leaders worldwide — collaborating across AWS to deliver the highest standards of safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost. You'll work in an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We're seeking a talented Data Engineer who thrives with a startup mentality — someone who moves fast, thinks big, and partners directly with business and senior leaders to turn ambiguous problems into clear, data-backed recommendations.

What makes this role exciting? You won't just move data from point A to point B — you'll build context through your pipelines. You'll own the context-driven source-of-truth tables that track the infrastructure delivery process across its full lifecycle — from intake through deployment to decommission — fueling analytics, LLMs, and business decisions. You'll manage the infrastructure behind those pipelines, keeping it lightweight, auditable, and highly available. And you'll partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, and Software teams to design pipelines that let business teams answer their own questions — without waiting in a queue.

The ideal candidate is passionate about understanding the business and making an impact with data. You ask sharp questions, design thoughtful data models, and build relevant pipelines with low tech debt. You know great data engineering isn't about shipping pipeline after pipeline — it's about data quality, governance, and knowing your sources well enough to make the right trade-offs. You'll build well-documented, context-rich datasets and self-service tools (new or reused) that put data directly in the hands of the people who need it most — applying data mining, data modeling, and AI to evaluate business health and drive measurable improvement..

Key job responsibilities

Know why you're building, not just what. Ask sharp questions first, understand your data and its significance, reuse before you rebuild, and set clear data contracts so data is always traceable to its source — and correct.
Own the design, development, and operation of scalable, production-grade, context-driven data pipelines — including the infrastructure behind them — keeping them lightweight, cost-efficient, auditable, and highly available to power metrics, reporting, analytics, and ML/LLM use cases.
Build context-rich "source of truth" datasets and reusable, dimensional data models that track the infrastructure delivery lifecycle (intake → deployment → decommission), serving as a trusted, intuitive-to-query foundation for downstream consumers while keeping tech debt in check.
Design data models and ETL/ELT workflows to ingest, transform, and integrate data from diverse sources using AWS services (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, EMR, Athena, Lambda) and internal Amazon data platform tools.
Define and champion data quality/ engineering and governance best practices — validation, monitoring/alerting, testing, design standards, documentation, and governance — to keep pipelines accurate, trustworthy, and well-maintained.
Partner with Software, Product, and other Data Engineering teams to source and model the right business entities, so any team can answer their own questions without waiting in a queue.
Troubleshoot operational and data-quality issues with root-cause analysis and durable fixes; audit existing pipelines, jobs, and queries, and recommend improvements to upstream sources for greater accuracy, simplicity, and scalability

About The Team

We are the PAX Data and Analytics team — a small, high-conviction group of BI Engineers and Data Engineers embedded in one of the world's largest and fastest-growing data center organizations. We were established less than a year ago with a clear mandate: **turn operational complexity into decision-ready clarity.**

We don't build data pipelines and dashboards . We build *context* — the kind that lets leaders act with confidence and operators spot problems before they become incidents. Our work spans the full data lifecycle: sourcing and integrating raw operational signals, engineering relevant and reliable pipelines, and surfacing insights through self-service tools that hundreds of people rely on daily.

Every pipeline we ship, every standard we define, and every contract we establish becomes the foundation for what comes next

We are young, we are scrappy, and we are building something that will outlast us. If you want to lay foundations that an entire organization will stand on — you're in the right place.

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of data engineering experience
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
Experience with SQL
Experience working on and delivering end to end projects independently

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
Knowledge of batch and streaming data architectures like Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Storm, Beam

Define and champion data quality/ engineering and governance best practices — validation, monitoring/alerting, testing, design standards, documentation, and governance — to keep pipelines accurate, trustworthy, and well-maintained.
Partner with Software, Product, and other Data Engineering teams to source and model the right business entities, so any team can answer their own questions without waiting in a queue.
Troubleshoot operational and data-quality issues with root-cause analysis and durable fixes; audit existing pipelines, jobs, and queries, and recommend improvements to upstream sources for greater accuracy, simplicity, and scalability

About The Team

We are the PAX Data and Analytics team — a small, high-conviction group of BI Engineers and Data Engineers embedded in one of the world's largest and fastest-growing data center organizations. We were established less than a year ago with a clear mandate: **turn operational complexity into decision-ready clarity.**

We don't build data pipelines and dashboards . We build *context* — the kind that lets leaders act with confidence and operators spot problems before they become incidents. Our work spans the full data lifecycle: sourcing and integrating raw operational signals, engineering relevant and reliable pipelines, and surfacing insights through self-service tools that hundreds of people rely on daily.

Every pipeline we ship, every standard we define, and every contract we establish becomes the foundation for what comes next

We are young, we are scrappy, and we are building something that will outlast us. If you want to lay foundations that an entire organization will stand on — you're in the right place.

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of data engineering experience
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
Experience with SQL
Experience working on and delivering end to end projects independently

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
Knowledge of batch and streaming data architectures like Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Storm, Beam

jobs.description:
Company Description

The transition from Bosch to Radionix is now complete — providing a future-focused trajectory for our Radionix and Bosch product portfolios and exclusive benefits for our valued partners.

The Radionix name holds a special place in the hearts of our associates, dealers, distributors, and customers alike. The new Radionix vision — Mission control for your security — encapsulates our focus on empowering users with an intrusion system that seamlessly integrates every layer of security, from our intrusion system products to our G Series panels to our reimagined Remote Security Manger app.

Fairport, NY is the headquarters for the Radionix sales & marketing organization in the United States and serves as the primary site for research and development, engineering, quality, and product management for intrusion detection systems, including state-of-the-art sensors, control panels, software, communications and more.

Job Description

Radionix is seeking an Entry-Level DevOps Engineer
at our facility located at 130 Perinton Parkway in Fairport, NY
. In this role, you will join our engineering team to help build, maintain, and support the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, automation, monitoring, and operational tooling used to deliver software for intrusion alarm systems, connected security devices, cloud services, and customer-facing applications.

This position is ideal for a motivated early-career engineer who wants to grow across cloud infrastructure, DevOps automation, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, monitoring, security, and modern software delivery practices. You will work alongside experienced engineers in a structured product development environment and contribute to reliable, scalable, and secure cloud platforms that support real-time security and life-safety applications.

Individuals in this role will participate in cloud infrastructure deployment, pipeline automation, environment support, troubleshooting, release activities, and operational improvements while learning the architecture, tools, and practices used across Radionix security platforms.

Primary Responsibilities

Assist with the development, maintenance, and support of cloud infrastructure used by Radionix software platforms, cloud services, web applications, APIs, and customer-facing portals.
Support infrastructure as code practices using Azure Bicep, with future opportunities to work with Terraform.
Help build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, with future opportunities to support GitHub Actions.
Assist with deployment automation for cloud services, microservices, APIs, databases, web applications, and supporting infrastructure.
Support Azure cloud environments while helping design DevOps practices that remain portable, maintainable, and cloud-agnostic where appropriate.
Work with senior engineers to understand cloud architecture, environment configuration, networking, security, monitoring, deployment patterns, and operational best practices.
Participate in a structured product development and release process, including environment provisioning, build validation, deployment support, verification, and production release activities.
Help monitor system health, application availability, infrastructure performance, logs, alerts, and operational dashboards.
Assist with troubleshooting deployment issues, build failures, infrastructure problems, configuration errors, and service availability incidents.
Collaborate with software engineers, test engineers, cloud engineers, architects, product owners, project managers, and support teams.
Help maintain secure DevOps practices, including secrets management, access control, certificate handling, secure configuration, and environment separation.
Support containerized application deployment patterns using tools such as Docker and cloud-native hosting platforms.
Assist with documentation of infrastructure, pipelines, deployment procedures, operational runbooks, and environment configurations.
Participate in code reviews, pipeline reviews, infrastructure reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions.
Use modern development and operations tools, including source control, issue tracking, build systems, deployment tools, monitoring platforms, and AI-assisted development tools where appropriate.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
Academic, internship, co-op, project, or entry-level experience with software development, cloud infrastructure, IT systems, automation, or DevOps practices.
Foundational understanding of cloud computing concepts such as compute, storage, networking, identity, security, monitoring, and deployment.
Basic experience with scripting, automation, or programming using tools such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, C#, JavaScript, or YAML-based pipeline configuration.
Basic understanding of source control concepts using Git or similar tools.
Exposure to CI/CD concepts, build pipelines, release pipelines, automated testing, or deployment automation.
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as IP addressing, TCP/IP, DNS, certificates, firewalls, load balancers, and client/server communication.
Interest in cloud infrastructure, DevOps automation, cybersecurity, IoT device platforms, and highly available cloud services.
Ability to analyze problems, troubleshoot technical issues, and work collaboratively with other engineers.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Willingness to learn new technologies, tools, platforms, and operational processes.

Preferred Qualifications

Internship, co-op, academic project, or personal project experience using Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bicep, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, or similar technologies.
Exposure to infrastructure as code concepts, including reusable templates, parameterized deployments, environment configuration, and repeatable provisioning.
Familiarity with Azure services such as App Services, Container Apps, Virtual Machines, Key Vault, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, or Azure Functions.
Experience with pipeline configuration using YAML.
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts using Docker, Kubernetes, or other cloud-native platforms.
Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts such as identity and access management, least privilege, secrets management, TLS, certificates, encryption, and secure deployment practices.
Exposure to monitoring, logging, alerting, observability, or incident response practices.
Familiarity with Agile Scrum development practices.
Interest in intrusion security systems, building automation, connected devices, real-time systems, or life-safety technology.
Experience using AI-assisted tools for scripting, infrastructure automation, troubleshooting, documentation, or test generation.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver who is curious, collaborative, and eager to grow into a well-rounded DevOps engineer. This person should be comfortable learning from senior engineers, asking thoughtful questions, improving automation, supporting reliable deployments, and helping teams deliver software safely and consistently.

This role offers the opportunity to build experience across several important technology areas, including Azure cloud services, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps automation, containerized workloads, cloud networking, monitoring, cybersecurity, and cloud-agnostic deployment practices
.

Additional Information

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $80,000-$87,000 annually. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc.

In addition to base salary, full-time employees are eligible to participate in Keenfinity Group's (US) Health and Welfare Benefit Plans—including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance—as well as the company’s 401(k) plan, subject to the terms and conditions of the respective plan documents. Full-time employees are eligible to participate in Keenfinity Group’s paid time off and sick leave programs in accordance with applicable policies.

Reasonable accommodations may be made, to the extent they do not pose an undue hardship, to enable qualified individuals with covered disabilities to perform essential functions.

jobs.description:
Our Company

BrightSpring Health Services

Overview

BrightSpring Health Services is a Louisville‑headquartered leader in complementary home‑ and community‑based health services for complex populations, with integrated clinical and pharmacy solutions across care settings. Following its combination with PharMerica, BrightSpring operates a diversified care and pharmacy platform—serving patients and provider partners nationwide—which makes intelligent automation a pivotal enabler of clinical, operational, corporate, and pharmacy outcomes at scale.

We’re seeking an Intelligent Automation Engineer
with strong hands-on expertise in UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Copilot Studio, and Agentic AI
. This role will design scalable solutions, drive delivery from concept through production, conduct code reviews, support production deployments, and collaborate with business, technology, security, data, and operations teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Solution Design & Engineering

Design secure, scalable, and maintainable intelligent automation solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, business requirements, and operational standards.
Translate business needs into solution designs, technical specifications, process flows, reusable components, and implementation plans.
Evaluate automation opportunities and recommend the appropriate combination of UiPath, Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Copilot Studio, APIs, and Agentic AI.

Delivery & Architecture

Develop and configure enterprise automations using UiPath, including Studio, Orchestrator, queues, assets, reusable libraries, Document Understanding, and attended and unattended automation patterns.
Build business solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, and Copilot Studio, integrating Microsoft 365, Azure, enterprise applications, databases, and APIs.
Apply Agentic AI patterns, including tool use, task orchestration, human-in-the-loop controls, prompt design, grounding, evaluation, and guardrails.
Drive assigned solutions through design, development, testing, user acceptance, release readiness, and successful production deployment.
Create resilient solutions with structured logging, exception handling, retry logic, credential security, auditability, monitoring, and operational support documentation.

Quality, Governance & Production Readiness

Conduct peer code reviews and design reviews to ensure quality, security, maintainability, performance, and adherence to development standards.
Prepare and execute production deployments in accordance with change management, access governance, testing, rollback, and release-control requirements.
Monitor production solutions, troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

Collaboration & Delivery

Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, developers, infrastructure, security, data, and support teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
Communicate technical options, dependencies, risks, and delivery status clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Contribute to estimation, sprint planning, documentation, knowledge transfer, production support, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting enterprise automation solutions.
Advanced proficiency with UiPath, including Studio, Orchestrator, queues, assets, libraries, integrations, and production operations.
Strong experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps.
Experience creating actionable dashboards, operational reporting, and analytics solutions with Power BI.
Hands-on experience building copilots, conversational workflows, or enterprise assistants with Copilot Studio.

We're a high-ownership engineering team inside TikTok USDS JV shipping a flagship B2B AI product at the frontier of large-model inference and creative automation. If you want your engineering decisions to be the reason an industry-leading brand team trusts a new AI platform with their content production, this is the seat.

About the Team
We are the engineering incubator for TikTok USDS JV's newest enterprise AI products. Our remit spans the full lifecycle — from the first localizable prototype to a scaled, multi-region, enterprise-grade service. The team has shipped products that have grown from a handful of design partners to global enterprise rollouts, and the pipeline keeps growing.

We operate with a strong 0→1 mindset: ambiguity is the default, ownership is non-negotiable, and the patterns that the next decade of enterprise AI will be measured against are being prototyped on our team right now.

Responsibilities:
- End-to-end product engineering. Take ideas from prototype to production. One week you might be building the foundational services that power the product; the next, the user-facing surface or operator tooling; the week after, the instrumentation and feedback loops that tell you whether it worked.
- Enterprise features with real customer impact. Ship the capabilities enterprise customers evaluate, contract against, and renew on — features that have to meet a real-world quality bar, not a demo bar.
- Pair with ML on the frontier. Work side by side with our ML and inference teams to turn frontier model capability into something enterprise customers can rely on — predictable, isolated, audit-ready, and built for the kind of scale only a frontier AI product sees.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with industry experience.
- 3+ years as a software engineer, with proven contributions to team-based, production systems — ideally in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary environment.
- Solid programming skills in C/C++ and/or Python, with a strong grasp of data structures and algorithms.
- Comfort moving across the stack — backend services, user-facing surfaces, instrumentation and tooling — and the engineering rigor to know which trade-offs matter at which layer.
- Strong sense of ownership and a bias for action: you finish what you start, and you ship.

Preferred Qualifications:
- End-to-end product engineering experience; B2B or enterprise platform experience;
- Hands-on or adjacent experience with ML systems, GPU serving, or other compute-intensive AI workloads; distributed systems, concurrent programming, and Microservices.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. jobs.title: Software Engineer (ICB 3)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Description - Intro

Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is looking for a Software Engineer with a talent for developing software and contributing to a culture dedicated to quality, security, and a smooth user experience. This role focuses on our non-mainframe applications, with opportunities to expand your experience into mainframe software.

This role is in the Mainframe DevOps value stream, as a software engineer for one of our flagship products, Gen (formerly known as COOL:Gen or CA Gen). Gen is a low-code, model-driven development environment for enterprise applications. Gen enables global enterprises to generate and deploy applications in a single, integrated development environment for multiple platforms.

Broadcom has earned scores of global Workplace Excellence awards in the last few years - and there's a reason for that. It’s our aim to encourage global collaboration and innovation while supporting and developing our talented workforce. Broadcom empowers its employees to drive success for both the business and themselves. We value a lean and flat organization, with team members who work in-office, for a more collaborative culture that focuses on execution and delivering value.

#BroadcomSoftware

The Opportunity

As a Software Engineer (ICB 3), you will focus on the development, quality, and security of Gen. This is a hands-on technical role: you will write code, contribute to code reviews, and help maintain technical standards and testing strategies. Working independently and collaboratively, you will address problems of diverse scope and partner with cross-functional team members and customers. While your primary focus will be on our distributed (non-mainframe) applications, you will also have the chance to engage with our mainframe software, offering a unique opportunity to broaden your technical expertise across the enterprise stack.

Work Location - ON SITE:

5465 Legacy Dr, Plano, TX 75024

Who You Are

You are a self-motivated team player who likes diving into complex, legacy environments to modernize them in response to evolving industry standards and customer needs. You collaborate easily with others, with an Agile mindset that makes communicating, responding to change, and continuous improvement a natural way of working for you. Your professional curiosity keeps you well informed of the latest technologies, and deepens your knowledge of legacy systems that are the foundation of global enterprise.

What You’ll Do

Research, develop, and implement high-quality, secure software solutions to maintain and enhance Gen's core product capabilities for non-mainframe applications.
Troubleshoot and fix customer cases that have been escalated to engineering.
Contribute to technical design to ensure robust security standards, while retaining a simple user experience.
Provide subject matter expertise by authoring technical blogs, webinars, and documentation on best practices.
Assist more junior staff members and collaborate with enterprise customers, helping them address complex requirements and supporting best practices in Gen modernization and security.
Design and implement automation for testing, build pipelines, and deployment processes to enhance product quality and delivery efficiency.

What You Need

Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development.
Bachelors or Masters in Engineering or equivalent degree.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand complex component relationships.
Growth mindset with a commitment to continuous personal and professional development.
Strong problem analysis and debugging skills.
Deep expertise and hands-on coding experience with Java, C#, C, and/or C++.
Experience in Windows, Unix, and Linux operating systems.
Expertise in relational databases.
Knowledge and related experience in one or more of the following: Cloud Native Architectures, Containers, .NET, TCP/IP, Tuxedo, WebSphere, Liberty, WebLogic, JBoss (WildFly), InstallAnywhere, Eclipse.
Experience with designing and using web APIs like gRPC, REST, etc.
Proficiency and hands-on experience in designing and implementing test automation, build pipelines, and CI/CD processes.
Experience leveraging AI development tools to enhance software development productivity, code quality, and debugging workflows.

Additional Skills That Will Benefit Your Efforts

Experience working with language servers or compilers.
Understanding of complex microservices, databases, and Client-Server communication.
Demonstrated experience implementing cybersecurity principles (e.g., cryptography, secure coding practices, access controls) and using industry-standard products like passkeys and TLS.
Experience in object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and Component Based Development (CBD).
Experience with Source Code Management tools, such as GitHub.
Knowledge and related product expertise in any of the following: Python, Typescript, Docker, Kubernetes, Spring Boot, Jakarta, Oracle, Db2, MS SQL Server, ODBC, JDBC, ADO.NET, COM, Windows MFC, Jenkins, Ansible.
Experience with mainframe technologies.
Experience developing with or maintaining Gen.

Compensation And Benefits

jobs.description:
Scion Staffing has been engaged to conduct a search for a Senior Data Platform Engineer for our partner, an established healthcare services organization modernizing its technology and data capabilities. This is a direct hire, on onsite position located in Addison, Texas.

Position Overview

The Senior Data Platform Engineer will build, operate, and secure a modern Snowflake data platform using a medallion architecture. Working closely with the Data Architect, this hands-on engineer will develop ingestion pipelines, dbt transformations, dimensional models, and governance controls that turn sensitive operational data into trusted business insights. This high-ownership opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys managing the full data lifecycle and helping shape a growing data environment.

Perks

Employee benefits package, with complete details to be provided during the interview process
High-impact opportunity to help build and shape a modern enterprise data platform
Broad ownership across Snowflake, dbt, data modeling, governance, security, and pipeline development
Collaborative environment with opportunities to mentor teammates and expand modern data-stack capabilities

Responsibilities

Onboard data from SQL Server databases and SaaS applications through REST APIs, ODBC, SFTP, file feeds, native connectors, incremental-loading methods, and CDC patterns.
Build, maintain, and monitor pipelines across the bronze, silver, and gold layers using Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Azure Data Factory, and modern orchestration tools.
Develop dimensional data models, including fact and dimension tables, appropriate grain, conformed dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions, while translating business requirements into maintainable transformations.
Manage the Snowflake environment, including warehouses, roles, resource monitors, platform performance, cost management, reliability, scheduling, dependencies, and failure resolution.
Protect PHI, PII, and other sensitive data by implementing RBAC, least-privilege access, masking, row-access policies, audit logging, lineage, and governance controls.
Establish data-quality tests, validation checks, source-to-warehouse reconciliation, and consistent business definitions while serving as a hands-on technical resource to other engineers.

Qualifications

Minimum of 5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role.
Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience designing dimensional data models, including fact tables, dimension tables, grain, conformed dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.
Production experience with dbt, medallion architecture, modern ELT patterns, and a cloud data warehouse; Snowflake experience is strongly preferred.
Experience building ingestion pipelines from both SQL databases and SaaS or API-based sources using REST APIs, ODBC, SFTP, file feeds, native connectors, incremental loading, or CDC.
Proficiency with Python and experience with orchestration or integration technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, or Snowflake Openflow.
Experience implementing access and security controls for sensitive or regulated data, including RBAC, data masking, row-level access, audit logging, or comparable protections.
Demonstrated ability to independently own a production data platform within a small team, including pipeline reliability, monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, security, performance, and cost management; healthcare, revenue cycle management, HIPAA/PHI, NetSuite, Paycom, Power BI, or SnowPro experience is preferred.

Compensation And Benefits

This position offers competitive compensation salary range of $135-145k/yr (DOE) and an employee benefits package. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, technical expertise, certifications, and other job-related qualifications.

We're looking for an experienced, forward-thinking engineer to strengthen our Platform Engineering capabilities across AWS and Windows environments, with a focus on authentication, certificate services and encryption. In this role, you'll design and automate the identity and cryptographic services that our Infrastructure and Application stack depends on, from certificate lifecycle automation at enterprise scale through to directory, authentication and key management. You'll work closely with diverse technology teams to streamline delivery, embed security best practices, and champion infrastructure-as-code. Design, implement, and manage scalable and resilient infrastructure on AWS.
Design and automate the certificate lifecycle at enterprise scale, covering issuance, validation, renewal, revocation and deployment to target workloads.

Implement and enforce security best practices across the infrastructure and deployment processes.
Collaborate closely with development teams to understand their needs and provide Platform Engineering expertise.
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and application deployment issues.
Implement and manage monitoring, logging and alerting to ensure system visibility and proactive issue detection.
Clearly and concisely contribute to the development and documentation of Platform standards and best practices.
Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
7+ years of experience in a Platform Engineering, DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) role.
Extensive hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), including ACM, KMS, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager, IAM, EventBridge, Lambda and S3.
Experience designing and operating multi-account AWS environments, including cross-account IAM, resource policies and KMS key policies.
Strong Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate lifecycle experience, including certificate authority operation, certificate formats, chain assembly, renewal automation and revocation.

Strong Active Directory experience, including replication, FSMO roles, trust relationships and AD-integrated DNS.
Strong understanding of Windows authentication protocols, specifically Kerberos and NTLM, including service principal names, delegation, supported encryption types and service account models.
Practical experience with encryption at rest and in transit, and with key management services.
Solid understanding of Windows Server administration and integration with cloud environments.
Proven experience with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools, specifically Terraform (OpenTofu) and AWS CDK.
Strong experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD.
Deep understanding of security best practices and their implementation in cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., NewRelic, CloudWatch, Cloud Logging, Prometheus).
Strong scripting skills, with PowerShell at an advanced level, plus Python or Bash.
Experience with configuration management tools, such as Chef, AWS SSM, or Ansible.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Experience with certificate automation protocols and tooling (e.g., ACME, cert-manager or equivalent).
Experience operating a private certificate authority.
Experience with multi-tenant platforms and namespace isolation.
Experience hardening Active Directory against credential attacks.
