jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
Overview

At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget.

Our Science & Technology directorates include National Security, Integrated Discovery Sciences, and Energy and Environment. In addition, we have an Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory, a Department of Energy, Office of Science user facility housed on the PNNL campus.

The National Security Directorate (NSD) drives science-based, mission-focused solutions to take on complex, real-world threats to our nation and the world.

The AI and Data Analytics Division, part of NSD, combines profound domain expertise and creative integration of advanced hardware and software to deliver computational solutions that address complex data and analytic challenges. Working in multidisciplinary teams, we connect foundational research to engineering to operations, providing the tools to innovate quickly and field results faster. Our strengths are integrated across the data analytics lifecycle, from data acquisition and management to analysis and decision support.

Responsibilities

We are seeking a motivated Software Engineer to join our dynamic team at PNNL and contribute to cutting-edge projects that shape the future of critical technology supporting national security and intelligence. In this role, you'll collaborate with experienced engineers to design, build, and optimize scalable systems for processing multi-modal intelligence data at a remarkable scale and speed. This hands-on position offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills in AI/ML engineering, data orchestration, and system architecture while delivering impactful solutions in a fast-paced environment where agility and reliability are key to success.

As a Software Engineer on PNNL's Software Engineering and Architectures (SEA) team, you'll have the chance to shape mission-critical AI systems, help build enterprise-scale data platforms, and gain hands-on experience with some of the nation's most sophisticated intelligence and security applications. You'll receive mentorship from senior engineers, collaborate with research scientists, and see your code deployed in production systems that directly support national security missions.

What You'll Build & Learn

AI Systems Development – Contribute to agentic AI implementations, work with LLM integrations, learn MLOps best practices on real-world applications
Intelligence Platform Development – Build components for multi-INT fusion systems, develop GEOINT processing tools, contribute to threat analysis platforms
Data Engineering – Develop data pipelines, build analytics workflows, contribute to cloud-native data architectures
Professional Growth – Receive mentorship from senior engineers, participate in code reviews, learn enterprise software development practices

Technical Skills (We'll Help You Grow)

Programming Foundation – Solid Python skills, experience with one additional language (Go, Rust, C++, C#/.Net, or similar)
Platform Experience – Foundational cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP), familiarity with Linux environments
Development Practices – Understanding of version control (Git), exposure to CI/CD, basic Agile/Scrum experience
Data & Databases – Experience with SQL and understanding of data processing concepts
AI-Assisted Development – Experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar to explore code, accelerate development, write tests, and debug effectively, with sound judgment around code quality, security, and validation.
Eagerness to Learn – Interest in AI/ML technologies, geospatial systems, large-scale data processing

National Interest Project Examples

Detect and prevent smuggling of drugs and contraband at ports of entry [Link]
Develop large data pipelines to thwart funding for terrorists, nuclear proliferators, drug cartels, and rogue leaders [Link]
Applying big data solutions to national security problems [Link]
Applying image classification for nuclear forensics analysis [Link]
Develop capabilities for scalable geospatial analytics [Link]

This position is based in Richland, WA or Seattle, WA and requires an onsite presence Monday through Thursday, with Friday as required by business needs.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

PhD -OR-
MS/MA -OR-
BS/BA and 2 years of software engineering experience
Hands-on professional experience using Python to build, test, and deliver software for customers or end users

Preferred Qualifications

Degree in computer science, software engineering, or related field
Experience in working on a team that developed and deployed petabyte size large-scale and high-performance ETL pipelines and analytics
Experience taking a project from idea or requirements through implementation, testing, and delivery to a customer, end user, or other stakeholder.
Demonstrated proficiency in Python and least one other language (Go, Rust, C++, C#/.Net, or similar)
Experience collaborating with a team of software engineers to design, build, and deliver complex software applications
Strong understanding of software engineering and data management best practices
Experience in cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP) and implementation
Possession of professional certifications in cloud technologies or database certifications
Familiarity with machine learning algorithms with hands-on experience in machine learning pipeline development
Experience delivering software solutions for agencies such as the Department of Energy, Department of Homeland Security, Department of Defense, or National Nuclear Security Administration
Possession of an active Federal Q Clearance

Hazardous Working Conditions/Environment

Not applicable.

Additional Information

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance.

A security clearance background investigation includes review of your employment, education, financial, and criminal history, as well as interviews with you and your personal references, neighbors, and co-workers to determine trustworthiness, reliability, and loyalty to the United States. The investigation also examines your foreign connections, drug and alcohol use, foreign influence, and overall conduct.

Requirements

U.S. Citizenship
Background Investigation: Applicants selected will be subject to a Federal background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified matter in accordance with 10 CFR 710, Appendix B.
Drug Testing: All Security Clearance positions are Testing Designated Positions, which means that the applicant selected for hire is subject to pre-employment drug testing, and post-employment random drug testing. In addition, applicants must be able to demonstrate non-use of illegal drugs, including marijuana, for the 12 consecutive months preceding completion of the requisite Questionnaire for National Security Positions (QNSP).

Note: Applicants will be considered ineligible for security clearance processing by the U.S. Department of Energy if non-use of illegal drugs, including marijuana, for 12 months cannot be demonstrated.

Testing Designated Position

This position is a Testing Designated Position (TDP). The candidate selected for this position will be subject to pre-employment and random drug testing for illegal drugs, including marijuana, consistent with the Controlled Substances Act and the PNNL Workplace Substance Abuse Program.

About PNNL

Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is a world-class research institution powered by a highly educated, diverse workforce committed to the values of Integrity, Creativity, Collaboration, Impact, and Courage. Every year, scores of dynamic, driven people come to PNNL to work with renowned researchers on meaningful science, innovations and outcomes for the U.S. Department of Energy and other sponsors; here is your chance to be one of them!

At PNNL, you will find an exciting research environment and excellent benefits including health insurance, and flexible work schedules. PNNL is located in eastern Washington State—the dry side of Washington known for its stellar outdoor recreation and affordable cost of living. The Lab’s campus is only a 45-minute flight (or ~3 hour drive) from Seattle or Portland, and is serviced by the convenient PSC airport, connected to 8 major hubs.

Commitment to Excellence and Equal Employment Opportunity

Our laboratory is committed to fostering a work environment where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect while solving critical challenges in fundamental sciences, national security, and energy resiliency. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

PNNL considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), protected veteran status, and any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local laws.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures and in employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at careers@pnnl.gov.

Drug Free Workplace

PNNL is committed to a drug-free workplace supported by Workplace Substance Abuse Program (WSAP) and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs.

If you are offered employment at PNNL, you must pass a drug test prior to commencing employment. PNNL complies with federal law regarding illegal drug use. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you test positive for any illegal controlled substance, including marijuana, your offer of employment will be withdrawn.

Security, Credentialing, And Eligibility Requirements

As a national laboratory, PNNL is responsible for adhering to the Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which require new employees to obtain and maintain a HSPD-12 Personal Identify Verification (PIV) Credential. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete the applicable tier of federal background investigation post hire and receive a favorable federal adjudication. The tier of federal background investigation will be determined by job duties and national security or public trust responsibilities associated with the job. All tiers of investigation include a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last 1 to 7 years (depending on the applicable tier of investigation). Illegal drug activities include marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

For Foreign National Candidates

If you have not resided in the U.S. for three consecutive years, you are not eligible for the PIV credential and instead will need to obtain a favorable Local Site Specific Only (LSSO) Federal risk determination to maintain employment. Once you meet the three-year residency requirement thereafter, you will be required to obtain a PIV credential to maintain employment. The tier of federal background investigation required to obtain the PIV credential will be determined by job duties at the time you become eligible for the PIV credential.

Mandatory Requirements

jobs.title: Software Test & Automation Engineer  II
jobs.description:
Quantum Space is redefining mobility and maneuverability in space. Our high-mobility spacecraft platforms support national security, civil, and commercial missions with unmatched flexibility and propulsion capability. We build fast and iterate quickly.

Who We’re Looking For

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Software Test & Automation Engineer II
to develop and maintain automated testing solutions that ensure the reliability, functionality, and performance of our next-generation spacecraft flight software. In this role, you will contribute to software integration, verification, and regression testing by developing automated test frameworks, requirements-based test cases, and test scripts that validate mission-critical spacecraft functions.

You will work closely with flight software, systems engineering, and integration and test teams to support software testing across software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and flight-representative environments. This position is ideal for an engineer with strong programming and test automation skills who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex technical challenges, and is passionate about building reliable software for next-generation space missions.

Where You’ll Make an Impact

Develop and maintain automated integration, verification, and regression testing capabilities for spacecraft flight software.
Design, implement, and execute requirements-based test cases and automated test scripts to validate flight software functionality and performance.
Develop and enhance automated test frameworks using Python, C/C++, or equivalent programming languages.
Verify spacecraft command and telemetry processing, mode management, fault management, and other critical flight software functions.
Support software testing in software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and flight-representative environments.
Collaborate with flight software developers, systems engineers, and integration and test teams to identify defects, troubleshoot issues, and support root-cause analysis.
Develop and maintain automated regression test suites to ensure software changes do not impact existing functionality.
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve software quality, testing efficiency, and development workflows.
Analyze test results, document defects, and generate verification reports to support software readiness and requirements compliance.
Support the development and maintenance of software test environments, simulation tools, and test infrastructure.
Participate in technical reviews and contribute to improvements in software verification processes, automation tools, and configuration management practices.

What It Takes

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.
2+ years of experience in software development, software testing, test automation, or a related engineering discipline.
Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, or equivalent languages.
Experience developing automated test scripts, test frameworks, or software verification tools.
Experience testing embedded systems, real-time software, or complex software applications.
Understanding of software integration, verification, validation, and regression testing methodologies.
Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD processes, and software configuration management practices.
Experience with software debugging, troubleshooting, and defect tracking.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment.

Nice-to-Have Experience

Experience with spacecraft flight software, satellite systems, avionics, or other mission-critical embedded software.
Familiarity with spacecraft flight software architectures, command and telemetry processing, mode management, and fault detection and recovery.
Hands-on experience with software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing environments.
Experience developing automated test frameworks using Python, pytest, or similar testing tools.
Experience working with real-time operating systems (RTOS), embedded Linux, or similar environments.
Familiarity with spacecraft simulation tools, ground support equipment, or flight-representative test environments.
Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or GitHub Actions.
Experience with Git, JIRA, or similar software development and configuration management tools.
Understanding of requirements traceability, test coverage analysis, and software verification and validation (V&V) processes.
Experience supporting spacecraft integration and testing, software qualification, or mission readiness activities.

What You’ll Get

Ownership – Develop and maintain automated testing solutions that directly contribute to the reliability and performance of mission-critical spacecraft flight software.
Innovation – Support transformative aerospace and defense programs enabling next-generation space mobility and operations.
Impact – Help ensure spacecraft flight software meets critical performance, reliability, and mission readiness requirements through automated verification and testing.
Growth – Join a collaborative engineering team working across flight software, systems engineering, and spacecraft integration and testing in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
Compensation – Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, generous leave, FSA, 401(k) matching, and equity sharing.

Location:
Rockville, MD

Base Salary:
$100,000-140,000

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Quantum Space's total compensation package.

Additional Requirements

To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including ITAR, applicants must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual per 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Apply now. Join us in building the next generation of spacecraft.

Spectator Sports, Software Development, and Information Services

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Data Engineer II will collaborate with faculty, operational staff, business users, and other stakeholders to develop, manage, and optimize datasets, reports, data pipelines, and systems supporting programs and projects at the HII, with a particular emphasis on the Florida Parkinson’s Disease Registry. As a member of the Data Engineering team, this role will support the full data lifecycle, including data integration, curation, quality assurance, reporting, and data sharing. The Data Engineer II will apply professional expertise to manage and integrate data from diverse sources, develop and operationalize data solutions, and support program and project deliverables. This position will help ensure data integrity, standardization, security, and compliance with applicable data governance requirements, while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, automation, and reuse of data processes and solutions.

Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain complex data processes, programs, and pipelines to integrate, transform, cleanse, and consolidate data from diverse sources for reporting, analytics, and operational use.
Create and maintain SAS, SQL, and related data processing programs to extract, subset, transform, summarize, and validate data from large and complex databases and institutional systems.
Design and implement data models, data structures, and integration processes that support reliable analytics, reporting, and data sharing. Assist with new data acquisition, exploration, standardization, and integration.
Develop, review, enhance, publish, and schedule reports, dashboards, and analytical outputs to monitor data acquisition, data quality, project/program status, and other key performance measures.
Design and maintain processes that promote data integrity, completeness, accuracy, and consistency across datasets, reports, dashboards, and other data products.
Work directly with faculty, operational staff, business users, and other stakeholders to understand objectives, analyze functional and data requirements, and translate those needs into technical designs, prototypes, data models, reports, and analytical solutions.
Collaborate with external institutions and agencies to support project execution, data exchange, integration, and resource sharing activities.
Apply best practices in the development, implementation, documentation, and maintenance of data programs, pipelines, systems, and analytical solutions while adhering to institutional data governance, security, privacy, and data management requirements.
Maintain the integrity, reliability, and reproducibility of analysis datasets, data models, documentation, programming code, and other technical deliverables. Document systems, processes, and workflows comprehensively and contribute to the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures.
Identify and implement opportunities to improve data processing, integration, reporting, automation, standardization, and reuse.
Collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders to coordinate activities and support timely completion of project and program deliverables. Proactively communicate progress, timelines, accomplishments, risks, and issues to management, including proposed mitigation strategies when challenges arise.
Develop and maintain domain expertise in complex enterprise applications, institutional data systems, data processing technologies, and business intelligence tools to support current and evolving data management and analytical needs.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS or other field involving software and analytical training and two years of relevant work experience. OR a Bachelor's degree with no specific required field and three years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
Master’s degree and one year of relevant work experience,

OR a combination of six years of relevant work experience and validated training. Preparation for a relevant IT certification, validated through certification requirements and documentation of completion, is considered to be related training.

Additional Information for Applicants: This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship

Degree Equivalency Clause: Four years of direct experience for a bachelor’s degree.

Senate Bill 1310- The Florida Senate (https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2023/1310) is conditional upon meeting all employment eligibility requirements in the U.S.

A public employer may include a postsecondary degree as a baseline requirement only as an alternative to the number of years of direct experience required, not to exceed:
(a) Two years of direct experience for an associate degree;
(b) Four years of direct experience for a bachelor’s degree;

(d) Seven years of direct experience for a professional degree; or
(e) Nine years of direct experience for a doctoral degree
Related work experience may not substitute for any required licensure, certification, or registration required for the position of employment as established by the public employer and indicated in the advertised description of the position of employment.

Job Title: Embedded Software Engineer

Job Description

This role focuses on designing and developing embedded software for weapon control systems within a broader Battle Management System portfolio. You will work on multiple projects, ranging from coding on embedded microcontrollers to building simulators with interactive graphical user interfaces. The position includes supporting the installation and assessment of embedded systems both locally and at external locations. You will collaborate closely with a team of approximately 15 engineers on a large, complex program, contributing to mission-critical capabilities.

Responsibilities

Design, code, and engineer embedded software solutions for weapon control systems across multiple Battle Management System projects.
Develop software for embedded microcontrollers, ensuring reliable and efficient operation in real-time environments.
Create simulators and interactive graphical user interfaces to support system development, testing, and demonstration.
Debug and troubleshoot low-level hardwaresoftware interfaces using tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
Diagnose and resolve network-related issues, including network configuration, connectivity, and data transmission problems.
Write test cases and perform unit testing to validate hardwaresoftware integration and overall system functionality.
Support installation, integration, and assessment of embedded systems at local and external test and operational sites.
Work effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly changing range and field environment with a strong focus on fielding a reliable product.
Support tasking across multiple concurrent projects, managing priorities and collaborating with cross-functional team members.
Use version control systems and modern development tools to maintain code quality, traceability, and configuration control.

Essential Skills

Minimum of three (3) years of experience demonstrating the ability to concept, prototype, design, code, and engineer embedded software solutions.
Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited college or university in computer engineering or electrical engineering, or equivalent direct hands-on experience with a weapon system application.
Proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages: C#, Java, or C++.
Knowledge of hardware architectures, microcontrollers, and communication protocols relevant to embedded systems.
Knowledge of graphical user interface (GUI) development, including design and implementation.
Knowledge of the TCP/IP protocol suite, including network stack integration and socket programming.
Proficiency with widely used version control systems, such as Git.
Experience using debugging and troubleshooting tools for embedded systems and low-level hardwaresoftware interfaces.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and support multiple projects simultaneously.
Eligibility to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Knowledge and experience with weapon system integration.
Knowledge, experience, and understanding of military standards such as MIL-STD-1553.
Experience integrating embedded systems with GPS, sensors, safety interlock circuitry, and other mission-critical subsystems.
Experience with Linux-based environments for development or deployment of embedded solutions.
Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) for embedded applications.
Experience with modern development platforms and collaboration tools, including Git-based repositories and continuous integration systems.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to diagnose complex issues involving hardware, software, and networks.
Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a multidisciplinary engineering team.

Work Environment

This position is fully onsite, five days a week, at a base in Dahlgren, VA. You will work within a secure facility as part of a team of approximately 15 engineers on a large, prime weapon system program. The environment is fast paced and field oriented, with frequent interaction between software, hardware, and test personnel. You will use tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, embedded development environments, version control systems, and network analysis utilities. Work involves both laboratory and range or field settings, with a strong focus on delivering reliable, deployable products in support of mission-critical operations.

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Help Build the Future of Caterpillar –

At Caterpillar, technology always has a purpose, which is to solve our customers’ toughest challenges. Through Cat Technology, we are solving problems by building the intelligence layer that connects machines, data, and people to make jobsites safer, more productive, and more sustainable. By combining deep domain expertise in physical systems with software, connectivity, autonomy, and AI, we deliver solutions that work in the real world—on real jobsites, at global scale.

You’ll build and deploy against one of the most unique data foundations—over 1.6 million connected assets generating real-world data daily. These data and platform capabilities are enabling the development of AI models, edge computing architectures, and software systems that scale across fleets, products, and industries. The result will be a new generation of machines that continuously learn, improve, and deliver performance at scale.

Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites

Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.

Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.

If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.

Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.

We are seeking an AI Automation Engineer to develop annotation automation solutions used to create training data for robotics, autonomy, computer vision, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems with a scrum team.

This role combines software engineering, machine learning, and data engineering to build automated annotation and captioning capabilities for real-world heavy equipment and construction environments. You will help deploy and extend technologies such as NVIDIA Cosmos Curator and Cosmos Reason while also developing Caterpillar-specific AI models that enable automated labeling, automated captioning, and AI-driven quality assurance.

This is a hands-on technical role focused on turning complex AI and data challenges into scalable production solutions.

Develop and deploy automated labeling and captioning solutions for perception and VLA datasets.
Train, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models to support auto-labeling, auto-captioning, and annotation quality automation.
Build data pipelines and workflows that move datasets through automated labeling, human review, quality validation, and dataset publication.
Implement and extend platforms such as NVIDIA Cosmos Curator, Cosmos Reason, and other emerging AI automation technologies.
Develop solutions that integrate Caterpillar data systems with external annotation providers and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Ensure reliability, scalability, observability, and operational excellence across annotation automation services.

What Makes This Role Unique

Most AI automation solutions are not trained to understand heavy equipment, jobsites, sensor data, or machine operations.

In this role, you'll help develop the AI capabilities needed to label and describe Caterpillar-specific data at scale. You'll work on challenges involving computer vision, multimodal AI, robotics, autonomy, and Vision-Language-Action systems while helping create the data foundation that powers the future of intelligent machines.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field.
Experience developing production-grade software solutions using Python, modern software engineering practices and containerization platforms (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience designing and implementing distributed systems, APIs, and data processing pipelines.
Experience training, fine-tuning, or deploying machine learning models.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work across multiple technical disciplines.
Experience generating and managing camera and LiDAR sensor datasets for perception or machine learning applications, including data collection pipeline design and ground truth generation.
Experience in data annotation and quality assurance for autonomous systems or computer vision projects, with demonstrated ability to define annotation guidelines, identify labeling defects, and drive measurable improvements in dataset accuracy.
Experience using annotation and dataset management tools such as Labelbox, Supervisely, RoboFlow or similar toolchains.
Experience using machine learning frameworks and training tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, Weights & Biases, MLflow or similar frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with computer vision, robotics, autonomy, Physical AI, or multimodal AI systems.
Experience with AI-assisted annotation, auto-labeling, or machine learning data pipelines.
Experience training or fine-tuning foundation models, vision models, or multimodal models.
Experience with NVIDIA Cosmos Curator, Cosmos Reason, or similar AI automation platforms.
Experience with Vision-Language-Action (VLA) datasets and workflows.
Experience with sensor data such as cameras, LiDAR, radar, or autonomous machine datasets.

Experience building human-in-the-loop AI workflows and quality automation systems.

You'll work on some of the most challenging applications of AI in the physical world, helping build systems that transform vast amounts of machine and sensor data into the intelligence that powers autonomous and AI-enabled equipment. Seek opportunities to expand technical knowledge and capabilities.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

About Us

Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.

Overview:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Build, run, and own ETL pipelines on EMR (Spark) orchestrated in Airflow — including their monitoring, alerting, and recovery.
Write SQL and Python for data ingestion, transformation, and the datasets that analysts and dashboards depend on.
Own data quality for what you build — run the checks before you ship and add new ones where they're missing; confirm the results are correct, not only that the job completed.
Build and extend the data models for your area: fact and dimension tables following the team's layering conventions.
Keep your jobs efficient — watch runtime and cost, and raise slow or expensive jobs rather than living with them.
Use and extend the team's shared patterns and templates, and turn work you find yourself repeating into something automated or reusable.
Work with analysts and business stakeholders to turn requests into datasets that actually get used.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

2–4 years of hands-on data development in a production environment — pipelines that run on a schedule with real downstream consumers, that you were responsible for including when they broke.
Strong SQL: window functions, complex multi-table joins, incremental loads, and the ability to work out why a query is slow.
Python for production ETL and tooling (PySpark, pandas, boto3) — code that runs on a schedule, not only notebooks.
Hands-on experience with Spark on a cloud platform: AWS EMR, Databricks, Glue, or equivalent.
Production experience with a scheduler, Airflow preferred: DAG design, dependencies, retries, and reruns that are safe to repeat.
Working understanding of dimensional modeling: fact and dimension tables, star schema, and warehouse layering.
Comfortable working on AWS (S3 with Parquet / ORC), Linux, and Git — and comfortable picking up new tools as the platform evolves.
Effective use of AI to solve data problems — using it to move faster on SQL, debugging, and unfamiliar schemas, with the judgment to catch output that looks right but isn't.

jobs.description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About The Role

jobs.title: EGSE/Avionics Test Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Quantum Space is redefining mobility and maneuverability in space. Our high-mobility spacecraft platforms support national security, civil, and commercial missions with unmatched flexibility and propulsion capability. We build fast and iterate quickly.

Who We’re Looking For

We are seeking a technically driven EGSE/ Avionics Test Software Engineer to develop automated test software, Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) software, and hardware/software integration test infrastructure for spacecraft avionics supporting Ranger missions.

In this role, you will develop reusable test applications, instrument interfaces, and automated test sequencing capabilities used to verify spacecraft avionics hardware and software. You will work closely with avionics, flight software, electrical, systems, and test engineers to build reliable test infrastructure, troubleshoot complex hardware/software interactions, and ensure test results are accurate, repeatable, and defensible.

This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of software and hardware, solving difficult integration problems, and building robust test systems that directly contribute to flight readiness and mission success.

Where You’ll Make an Impact

Develop automated test software and EGSE software supporting spacecraft avionics development and verification
Design and develop reusable test applications, instrument interfaces, device drivers, test sequencing capabilities, and data acquisition tools
Develop software to control laboratory instrumentation and communicate with embedded avionics hardware
Build maintainable and extensible test frameworks that separate hardware interfaces, test logic, configuration, and data handling
Develop requirements-based verification tests, including positive and negative testing, boundary conditions, failure scenarios, and fault injection
Support hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and hardware/software integration testing of spacecraft avionics
Develop automated functional and performance tests for flight computers and other avionics hardware
Troubleshoot complex hardware, firmware, software, communication interface, and test equipment issues using systematic root-cause analysis
Verify and validate automated test software and test equipment to ensure accurate and reliable results
Implement test logging and data collection practices that provide traceability and reproducibility across hardware and software configurations
Collaborate with avionics, flight software, systems, electrical, and test teams to develop verification approaches and resolve integration issues
Participate in code reviews and contribute to software development, configuration management, and continuous integration practices
Operate within a fast-paced development environment focused on rapid execution, technical excellence, and mission success

What It Takes

Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline
Experience developing automated test software using LabVIEW, Python, C/C++, or equivalent programming environments
Experience developing software that controls laboratory instrumentation and communicates with embedded hardware
Experience developing reusable and maintainable automated test applications, frameworks, or test infrastructure
Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing complex hardware/software integration issues
Understanding of software verification principles, including requirements-based testing, boundary conditions, negative testing, and fault injection
Experience verifying that automated test software and test equipment are operating correctly and producing reliable results
Familiarity with software configuration management and version control tools such as Git
Strong software debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Nice-to-Have Experience

Experience developing automated test systems or EGSE for spacecraft, aerospace, defense, or other complex embedded systems
Experience developing test frameworks with modular device drivers, reusable interfaces, automated test sequencing, logging, assertions, and configuration management
Experience communicating with hardware over interfaces such as Ethernet, TCP/UDP, RS-422/485, SpaceWire, SPI, I2C, or similar protocols
Experience testing asynchronous hardware and developing software that accounts for timing, synchronization, timeouts, and communication errors
Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and simulation environments
Experience developing automated power-on, functional, or acceptance testing for flight computers or other avionics hardware
Experience with automated fault injection and verification of fault detection, isolation, and recovery behavior
Experience using laboratory instrumentation, protocol analyzers, data acquisition systems, or similar test equipment
Experience developing unit tests, simulated instrument interfaces, or other methods for validating automated test software
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, automated testing, code reviews, and software configuration management
Understanding of embedded firmware and flight software architectures
Experience working with spacecraft avionics or flight hardware
Experience supporting fast-paced aerospace, defense, or commercial space programs

What You’ll Get

Ownership – Take responsibility for automated test software and infrastructure that directly supports the development and verification of mission-critical spacecraft avionics
Innovation – Build robust test frameworks and automation capabilities that accelerate spacecraft development and improve verification efficiency
Impact – Help ensure spacecraft avionics and flight systems perform reliably through rigorous, repeatable, and defensible testing
Growth – Work across avionics, flight software, electrical, systems, and test engineering while expanding your expertise in spacecraft hardware/software integration
Compensation – Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, generous leave, HSA, 401(k) matching, and equity participation

Location:
Rockville, MD or Hawthorne, CA

Base Salary:
$110,000 to $160,000

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Quantum Space's total compensation package.

Additional Requirements

To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including ITAR, applicants must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual per 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

jobs.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 9 Nov 2026

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Senior Software Engineer (C++/Python) will be a key player in our Affera Mapping and Ablation System Software Team, working on cutting-edge technology in the electrophysiology field. This role is pivotal in designing and developing intuitive, user-friendly interfaces that enhance the usability and functionality of our advanced medical devices.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience designing, developing, and testing real-time high-performance visualization software applications. They will take ownership of critical software features, collaborating closely with other engineering teams to bring these features to life.

We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.

The Affera Mapping and Ablation System is an innovative medical technology designed to treat patients with cardiac arrhythmias. The system involves advanced mapping techniques to create detailed images of the heart's electrical activity, helping physicians identify abnormal areas causing arrhythmias. Once identified, the Affera Ablation System delivers targeted energy to disrupt these abnormal signals, restoring normal heart rhythm.

Primary Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, real-time visualization applications in a collaborative team environment
Take ownership of key software features, driving their development from concept through to production
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including hardware, QA, and DevOps, to ensure seamless integration and high-quality software delivery
Design, implement, and maintain network and serial communication interfaces between desktop applications and connected hardware, supporting reliable exchange of commands, device status, and real-time telemetry
Integrate asynchronous device communication with the UI and application data layers, maintaining responsiveness through appropriate buffering, thread synchronization, timeout handling, connection monitoring, and recovery from communication failures
Optimize software performance, ensuring low latency, high reliability, and scalability in a regulated environment
Implement and maintain robust software testing strategies, including unit, integration, and automated testing of communication interfaces under normal and fault conditions, such as delayed or malformed messages, connection loss, and reconnection
Document software designs, coding practices, and development workflows to maintain high levels of clarity and consistency within the team
Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies within the team
Attend and participate in pre-clinical in-vivo system evaluations.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience OR Master’s degree with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience OR PhD with 0 years relevant experience
Expertise working in Python/ C++ environments, ideally with ROS or device-level comms

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing Ethernet/TCP/IP communication interfaces using socket programming, including connection management, message serialization, and secure communication with certificate-based authentication
Experience implementing serial device interfaces, such as RS-232 or USB-to-serial, including baud rate and port configuration, message framing, checksum validation, flow control, and timeout handling
Ability to troubleshoot network and serial communication issues using packet captures, serial logs, and device simulators, with an understanding of asynchronous I/O and thread-safe integration with desktop UI applications
Experience in desktop UI development (e.g. Qt/QML, PyQt, Open GL , WPF, or similar)
Experience building real-time or data-rich interfaces for technical or clinical applications
Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The Digital Enterprise Technology – Legal, Risk & Compliance (LRC) Application Development team is looking for a sharp, curious Full Stack Software Engineer who loves building great software and building it fast with modern AI tooling. This role is first and foremost about engineering excellence: strong fundamentals, clean architecture, and the ability to ship end-to-end features across the stack.

We're looking for someone who treats AI coding assistants as a core part of the craft, not a side skill — using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex daily to move faster, explore designs, and raise code quality.

You'll work across the full stack — frontend, backend, APIs, data, and integrations — with Salesforce as the primary building platform. Salesforce experience is a plus, not a must-have — we'll get you ramped quickly if you bring strong core engineering skills.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Design, build, and ship full-stack features end-to-end — UI, APIs, business logic, data models, and integrations — with a strong bias for clean, maintainable, well-tested code.

Use AI-assisted development tools — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar — throughout the SDLC: scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and code review, while maintaining engineering rigor over AI-generated output.

Where the work runs on Salesforce, develop using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, and the platform's security model — with support to ramp up if you're new to the platform.
Explore and build agentic and AI-powered features (e.g., Agentforce, workflow automation, AI agents) that bring real automation and intelligence into business processes, with appropriate governance and human-in-the-loop checks.
Own features through the full lifecycle: solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Contribute to CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies; and raise the bar on engineering practices across the team.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
4+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience — strong fundamentals across frontend, backend, APIs, and data.

Hands-on, daily experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar — able to write precise prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and performance.
Solid grounding in software design patterns, SDLC, Agile methodologies, Git, and CI/CD practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently design and deliver scalable technical solutions.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Even Better If...

Experience developing on the Salesforce platform (Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce Flows, platform security model) — a strong plus.
Exposure to Agentforce, Data Cloud, Einstein AI, or other AI-agent/workflow-orchestration platforms.
Experience with enterprise integration tools (MuleSoft, Platform Events, Named Credentials) or event-driven architectures.
Salesforce Platform Developer I/II certification, or equivalent industry certifications.

Experience shipping a production AI-powered feature (e.g., agentic workflows, RAG, LLM-backed UI) — one of the strongest signals we look for.

A true engineer at heart: someone who can reason about architecture, write clean code, and diagnose hard bugs — with or without AI in the loop.
Genuinely AI-native: you reach for Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex by default, and use them to build fluency across the stack, not just in your specialty.
Curious and adaptable — comfortable picking up new platforms (including Salesforce, Mulesoft) quickly when the work calls for it.

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. jobs.description:

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.

As a Software Engineer – UI/UX (Qt/QML) You will own significant features and workflows in the Prism Mapping application UI — the surfaces clinicians use during procedures and case review. A typical week mixes deep Qt/QML and C++/Python implementation, partnership with UX designers translating Figma designs into responsive production interfaces, integration work with the visualization, signals, and infrastructure teams, and the kind of debugging that happens when application state, real-time data, and human interaction all collide. You'll make architecture decisions about UI state, data binding, and interaction patterns; mentor newer UI engineers; and set the standard for what a high-quality, clinically-safe interface looks like in our product.

About The Affera Prism Mapping System

The Affera Prism Mapping System is an advanced electrophysiology mapping platform used by physicians to diagnose and guide the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias. It captures and processes signals from inside the beating heart, builds detailed real-time three-dimensional maps of cardiac anatomy and electrical activity, and presents that information to clinicians and mapping specialists during live procedures. Engineers on this team build the software that makes that possible — from the runtime and data pipelines that move signals in milliseconds, to the algorithms that turn raw signals into clinically meaningful information, to the visualization and UI surfaces clinicians rely on in the lab.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Delivery
jobs.description:
About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We've raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.

As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we're positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

About The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer, Agent Delivery to deploy production AI agents inside some of the world's largest supply chain companies.

You'll work directly with customer operators, engineers, and executives to understand how critical workflows actually run. Then you'll design integrations, debug production systems, and ship AI-powered workflows into environments that are often undocumented, fragmented, and business-critical.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer operations. You'll own deployments from initial discovery through production launch, spending time with customers both remotely and onsite, solving complex operational problems and turning those solutions into reusable product capabilities.

Success in this role is measured by outcomes: can you get systems live, make them reliable, and solve problems in environments you don't fully control? Every deployment teaches us something new about how supply chain companies operate. The patterns you uncover become product features, and what you solve for one customer often becomes a capability we ship across the platform.

The impact you will have

Lead high-impact customer deployments from problem definition through production, designing, prototyping, building, and deploying AI agents and workflows that change how work gets done and run reliably at scale.
Embed in customer workflows and build relationships from ICs and operators up to executives, turning messy business requirements into clear technical solutions that solve the underlying problem, not just the first request.
Make design decisions across agent behavior, application logic, data, evals, security, and reliability, and set the patterns for how Pallet agents are deployed in production.
Connect Pallet agents to the systems, APIs, and data customers already rely on, working directly with their engineering and ops teams to get around technical constraints.
Stay accountable after launch by debugging failures, evaluating and improving agent quality, and working with Engineering and Product to clear anything blocking a successful deployment.
Turn what you learn in the field into reusable agents, integrations, evals, and frameworks, and bring recurring needs and product gaps back to Product and Engineering to shape the core platform.

Who You Are

1+ years of experience building and owning production systems in high-growth startups or similarly demanding environments.
Strong experience working with APIs, integrations, authentication systems, and event-driven architectures.
Proven ability to debug complex systems in production.
Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where documentation is incomplete, and requirements evolve quickly.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working directly with customers is a strong plus

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
GM Performance Power Units - Concord, NC

Data Engineer - Onsite

Job Summary

Build and operate reliable data pipelines for power unit test and performance activities, using AWS as the primary cloud environment. Make engineering data accessible, traceable and ready for analysis, while retaining the context needed to interpret results correctly.

Work with Test, Performance, Controls and IT teams to turn files, measurements and test events into supported data products. Collaborate with the business and manufacturing data role to connect test results with approved engine, build and component information in Microsoft Fabric.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain ingestion pipelines for agreed dyno, test rig, instrumentation and performance sources. Support batch, file and streaming patterns where requirements justify them.
Preserve source files and relevant timestamps, units, calibration references, run identifiers and acquisition context. Implement validation and make missing or disputed context visible.
Develop documented datasets and processing pipelines using Python and SQL. Implement duplicate prevention, late-data handling, checkpoints and controlled replay.
Link test runs to approved engine, build and serialize component identities. Work with system owners to resolve mismatches and maintain traceable mappings.
Prepare and publish agreed test and performance summaries from the AWS environment for use by the business and manufacturing data platform. Work with the business & manufacturing data engineer to establish controlled data exchanges, including the reference data needed to link test results to engines, builds and components.
Monitor data freshness, pipeline failures, processing performance and cloud consumption. Tune storage, retention and compute against agreed engineering and cost requirements.
Use source control, peer review, automated checks and controlled deployment. Maintain separate development and production configurations and protect credentials.
Document pipelines, dependencies and recovery procedures. Train a nominated deputy and contribute to an agreed support and incident response model.

Required Qualifications

Practical experience building and supporting production data pipelines on AWS, including S3 and appropriate processing, orchestration and monitoring services.
Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience handling large files, time-series data or other complex engineering datasets.
Understanding of incremental processing, idempotency, schema changes, data quality controls and recovery from partial failure.
Experience with Git, code review, testing and repeatable deployments. Ability to work with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices.
Understanding of cloud access controls, service identities, encryption and secure connectivity, working with infrastructure and security specialists.
Ability to diagnose failures, explain cost drivers and document a service so another engineer can maintain it.
Ability to translate engineering requirements into clear data contracts and acceptance tests, and communicate effectively with technical and business colleagues.
Relevant qualification or equivalent practical experience. Candidates should demonstrate delivered outcomes rather than a specific certification alone.

Preferred Qualifications

Automotive, motorsport, aerospace, manufacturing or another test-intensive engineering environment.
Dyno or rig data, signal alignment, timestamp synchronization, calibration context, telemetry formats and engineering metadata.
Parquet or Delta Lake, distributed processing, and AWS services such as Glue, Athena, EMR, Kinesis or equivalent tools selected for the workload.
Cross-cloud data exchange, Microsoft Fabric or Power BI integration, and linking test results to PLM, ERP or lifing records.
Databricks on AWS where justified by the processing requirements. Databricks experience is beneficial rather than a prerequisite.

Why Join Us

Ready to be part of a team that pushes boundaries both on and off the track? At GM Performance Power Units, we are developing a new era of performance for the Formula 1 grid. Joining us means entering a startup racing environment backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, giving you the rare opportunity to help build a world-class program from day one. We believe in rewarding innovation and powering potential. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a competitive and comprehensive package designed to support your performance, well-being, and future, helping you thrive at every level.

That Includes Access To

Bonus scheme
Private healthcare
401(k) plan including company match
Employer-paid life insurance and disability coverage
32 days annual leave (including holidays)
Free financial advisor access
Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
Subsidized on-site dining
On-site gym
Discounted GM vehicle purchase/lease program
Free on-site EV charging for personal GM vehicles

It’s all part of our commitment to creating a workplace that’s as high-performing and forward-thinking as the people who make it succeed.

Join Us And Help Power What’s Next.

You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability and performance of a next-generation Formula 1 power unit. Our culture rewards precision, innovation, and the relentless pursuit of performance.

jobs.description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

HPE is seeking a Cloud Software Engineer
to work in our San Jose, California office on a hybrid schedule.

The Cloud Software Engineer
will build from the ground up to meet the needs of mission-critical applications, and is always looking for innovative approaches to deliver end-to-end technical solutions to solve customer problems.

The Cloud Software Engineer
will bring technical thinking to break down complex data and to engineer new ideas and methods for solving, prototyping, designing, and implementing cloud-based solutions.

The Cloud Software Engineer
will collaborate with project managers and development partners to ensure effective and efficient delivery, deployment, operation, monitoring, and support of Cloud engagements.

The Cloud Software Engineer
provides business value expertise to drive the development of innovative service offerings that enrich HPE's Cloud Services portfolio across multiple systems, platforms, and applications.

Location:
Hybrid schedule in our San Jose, CA. office.

Responsibilities

Analyses the feature specifications and determines the required coding, testing, and integration activities.
Designs and develops moderate to complex cloud application modules per feature specifications adhering to security policies.
Identifies debugs and creates solutions for issues with code and integration into application architecture.
Develops and executes comprehensive test plans for features adhering to performance, scale, usability, and security requirements.
Deploy cloud-based systems and applications code using continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate cloud applications' management, scaling, and deployment.
Contributes towards innovation and integration of new technologies into projects.
Analyzes science, engineering, business, and other data processing problems to develop and implement solutions to complex application problems, system administration issues, or network concerns.

Education And Experience Required

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or closely related quantitative discipline. Master’s desirable.
4 + years of experience in cloud development.

Knowledge And Skills

Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Golang, or JavaScript.
Good understanding of distributed systems, event-driven programming paradigms, and designing for scale and performance.
Experience with cloud-native applications, developer tools, managed services, and next-generation databases.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary The Software Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting the applications that power our business operations. Our company delivers HIPAA-regulated SaaS solutions for healthcare communication, supported by internal ERP and production systems. This role encompasses client-facing applications, internal business systems, and the integrations that connect them.
Our current technology stack includes .NET, MongoDB, SQL Server, RabbitMQ, a modern JavaScript front end, cloud infrastructure, and Odoo. Prior experience with every component is not required. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong depth in at least one technology stack, the ability to learn new tools quickly, and a systems-oriented mindset — understanding how components work together rather than focusing narrowly on individual tasks. We evaluate candidates based on demonstrated ability and problem-solving skill, not memorized knowledge.
Essential Functions / Key Accountabilities •        Develop and maintain features and services that are secure, well-tested, and operationally maintainable.
•        Participate in design discussions and own technical decisions within your domain, including data models, API contracts, and failure-handling strategies, with appropriate documentation.
•        Translate loosely defined requirements into working solutions through rapid iteration — delivering functional prototypes early and refining them based on feedback.
•        Leverage LLM tools in daily workflows and contribute to AI feature development, including retrieval, structured extraction, and agent-based workflows.
•        Develop and maintain integrations between the ERP, order and production data, and client-facing applications.
•        Provide operational support for owned systems, including CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, on-call rotation participation, and incident response.
•        Conduct and receive constructive code reviews, and share knowledge across the team.
•        Collaborate with product managers, project managers, and operations staff to clarify business requirements prior to development.
Other Responsibilities •        Maintain the level of accountability that HIPAA-regulated, security-sensitive systems require.
•        Respond to after-hours emergencies as directed.
•        Adhere to all company policies.
•        Assist other technology teams as needed.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities •         Systems Design:
Ability to reason about distributed system architecture, including API contracts, messaging and queuing, data modeling, caching, retry logic, and dependency failure handling. Demonstrated experience contributing to these decisions on production systems and articulating the tradeoffs involved.
•         AI & LLMs:
Working knowledge of large language model fundamentals, including context windows, embeddings and vector search, retrieval, tool calling, and model limitations such as hallucination. Experience building against at least one model API. Proficiency with LLM-assisted coding tools, combined with rigorous review of all generated code prior to release.
•         Cloud Infrastructure:
Familiarity with core cloud concepts — compute, managed databases, queues, networking, IAM, secrets management, and logging — with hands-on experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP. Working knowledge of containers and CI/CD pipelines.
•         Security:
Strong security fundamentals, including input validation, authentication versus authorization, secrets handling, encryption, and the OWASP Top 10, with careful handling of sensitive data. HIPAA-specific training will be provided.
•         ERP & Manufacturing:
Understanding of ERP systems and their core data structures, including customers, products, orders, inventory, purchasing, fulfillment, and the general ledger. Odoo experience preferred. Familiarity with manufacturing operations (BOMs, work orders, scheduling, WIP) is a plus.
•         Engineering Depth:
Proficiency in at least one backend language (C#, Java, Go, TypeScript, or Python) and a modern front-end framework, with experience in both relational and document databases. Demonstrated ability to learn new technology stacks on the job.
•         Professional Approach:
Proactive problem-solving orientation, early and constructive communication when facing obstacles, transparency about tradeoffs, and willingness to adjust course based on new information.
Education & Experience •        Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
•        Minimum of 4 years of professional experience developing, deploying, and supporting production software.
•        Demonstrated experience taking meaningful ownership of applications, systems, integrations, or software development projects.
•        Experience developing SaaS applications serving active customers strongly preferred.
•        Background in healthcare technology, healthcare communications, diagnostics, financial services, or another regulated industry preferred.
•        Experience with ERP, manufacturing, production, fulfillment, or operations-driven systems highly desirable.
•        Experience integrating multiple applications, databases, APIs, and operational systems strongly preferred.
•        Experience incorporating AI/LLM technologies into software applications or development workflows is a plus.
Working Conditions •        Office environment. This is a full-time, on-site position at Previon's corporate offices in Yorba Linda, California; remote employment is not available for this role.
•        The position may occasionally require after-hours availability to address critical production issues, deployments, or system emergencies.

Our team is inspired by the needs of these patients, and the surgeons and healthcare providers who treat them. We embrace a culture of exceptional response by partnering with researchers and educators to transform clinical insights into tangible solutions. Our solutions improve the techniques and outcomes of surgery so patients can resume their lives as quickly as possible.

Position Summary

The Full Stack Software Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining both frontend and backend software for our Robotics products. This role spans modern web applications built with TypeScript and Svelte, as well as high-performance C++ backend services, rendering systems, and algorithm integration. The platform includes web-based user interfaces, Qt-based desktop applications, and service-oriented components communicating through technologies such as gRPC and Protocol Buffers.

This individual will serve as a technical contributor, driving architecture, design decisions, and implementation across the full technology stack. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in modern frontend development, backend systems, UI/UX design, and scalable application architecture. Experience working with 3D visualization, rendering pipelines, and regulated software environments is highly desirable

The position is hands-on and requires the ability to independently lead complex initiatives while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams including algorithm, systems, quality, and product development teams.

Essential Functions

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack software solutions from concept through production deployment.
Develop prototypes, proofs of concept, and production-quality applications.
Lead architectural design and technical implementation across frontend and backend systems.
Build modern web applications using component-based architectures and responsive design principles.
Develop reusable UI components and design systems that promote consistency and maintainability.
Build performant, scalable backend services and application infrastructure using modern C++.
Integrate algorithms into production software in collaboration with dedicated algorithm teams.
Develop and maintain rendering and visualization capabilities, including 3D graphics subsystems where applicable.

Represents the company in a professional manner and upholds the highest standards of ethical business practices and socially responsible conduct in all interactions with other employees, customers, suppliers, and other third parties

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of professional software development experience, including both frontend and backend technologies.
Expert proficiency in modern C++ (C++17 or later).
Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as Svelte, React, Vue, or similar.
Experience developing desktop applications using Qt
Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and scalable application development.

Experience leading architecture reviews, technical roadmaps, and engineering best practices.
