We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Sr. Front-End/Full Stack Developer

What does a successful Sr. Front-End/Fullstack Engineer do at Clover?

In this role, you will be a lead UI/UX-minded engineer responsible for driving the client-side evolution and expansion of our platform. While you have the full-stack capability to navigate backend APIs, your primary strength and passion lie in building exceptional web experiences, modern user interfaces, and modular frontend architectures. As part of the Loyalty Program team, you will own the user experience on the Clover Dashboard
, translating complex data into sleek, responsive web applications used by over 700k merchants worldwide. Working alongside a strong team of dedicated backend engineers, you will bridge the gap between design, product, and services—owning web client features end-to-end, evaluating modern frontend technologies, and ensuring sub-second UI responsiveness at scale.

What You Will Do

Architect, design, and develop high-performance, modular web-based frontend applications using React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript, backed by supporting Java/Spring Boot microservices.
Own the client-side architecture of the Clover Dashboard, establishing frontend best practices, state management standards, and component libraries.
Partner with Product, UX, and core Backend Engineers to translate product requirements into intuitive, reliable web workflows and clean, extensible software.
Design, consume, and optimize RESTful APIs and GraphQL/event-driven endpoints built for web clients, mobile dashboards, and 3rd-party app integrations.
Promote effective use of AI‑powered engineering tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated test generation, code review, and UI performance profiling) to accelerate delivery and quality.
Own client services and features from design through deployment, automated UI testing, and production monitoring.
Participate in design and code reviews, advocating for modular code, responsive design, accessibility, and clean frontend architecture.
Coach and mentor team members to improve their technical frontend capabilities, web performance optimization, and UI testing strategies.
Participate in regular release management and cross-functional agile rituals across distributed teams.

What You Will Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of software development experience, with a proven focus on Frontend / Web Engineering.
Expertise in React and TypeScript, including deep knowledge of modern client-side state management, build tooling (Webpack/Vite), and Web Performance Optimization.

Hands-on experience with modern CSS frameworks, component design systems, and responsive web design for complex dashboard interfaces.
Experience using and championing AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, automated test suites) to accelerate UI delivery.
Practical knowledge of RESTful API design, HTTP/browser protocols, web security (OAuth2, CORS), and working with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).

What Would Be Great To Have

Experience with Micro-frontend architectures (e.g., Webpack Module Federation).
Familiarity with secondary languages/tools: Python, Node.js, GraphQL, or Docker/Kubernetes containerized workflows.
Previous background in Fintech, e-commerce, POS platforms, or merchant analytics tools.
Experience re-architecting client-side monoliths into decoupled, high-availability web applications.

This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.
This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Backend/Full-stack
jobs.description:
Instrumental builds the manufacturing acceleration platform behind the world's most complex electronics. We capture digital exhaust and engineering context from assembly lines — images, test logs, BOM data, performance, repair cycles — and our AI engines identify insights that are difficult or impossible for human engineers to find. We accelerate the companies building the AI era by improving manufacturing yield, throughput, and ramp. NVIDIA, Meta, L3Harris, and their manufacturing partners rely on Instrumental to accelerate new product introduction and production.

We're entering one of the most important periods in our company's history. Over the next year, we'll be rebuilding our platform layer for a scale it wasn't originally built for — and the engineer who joins now will shape that architecture as much as anyone.

We're looking for a Backend/Platform engineer who owns hard, ambiguous systems problems end-to-end, and who does it in a way that makes the rest of engineering want to build on what you ship. This isn't a role where you inherit an architecture and maintain it. You'll partner directly with engineering leadership and teams across product, AI, and edge systems — not just to keep the platform running, but to raise the bar on how we build.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the systems that matter most. Take full lifecycle ownership of core platform services — design, build, deploy, operate — especially the ones where the obvious architecture doesn't hold up, and you have to design a better one.
Make the rest of engineering better at shipping. You'll push back when a design won't scale, an approach trades short-term speed for long-term pain, or a "good enough" isn't. You earn the standing to do this by being right, consistently, and by being someone teams want in the room.
Move fast without creating friction. You'll make architectural calls, iterate in real time, and adjust course mid-build — all while keeping other teams, and the systems they depend on, aligned and stable. No surprises, no silent breakage.
Build the platform as you go. Better tooling, smarter use of AI-assisted development, sharper observability and incident response — you'll leave the platform meaningfully stronger than you found it, and you'll do it in a way that earns trust rather than working around people.

This role probably isn't the right fit if...

You want a well-defined system to maintain, rather than one to build and rebuild as the business scales.
When something breaks or doesn't scale, you wait for direction instead of diagnosing and fixing it yourself.
You've mostly worked in codebases where the hard architectural decisions were already made — this job is proactive, not maintenance.
You measure success by "it shipped" rather than "it shipped, it holds up, and the team trusts how we got there."
You've built a reputation for moving fast at the cost of the people around you — trust and speed both matter here, not one traded for the other.

Requirements

5+ years as a software engineer, with real ownership of production systems at a startup — you've designed and shipped systems end to end, not just contributed to systems someone else architected.
Fluency in Python or Go, with strong data modeling and system design instincts.
Experience building SaaS or multi-tenant systems, and the product judgment that comes with it.
A track record of solving hard, ambiguous engineering problems — untangling messy domains, making design decisions with incomplete information, and owning the outcome — not just building well-scoped features.
Fluent in AI-assisted development as a default way of working, and able to bring others along on it.
Evidence that other engineers and leaders trusted your judgment and wanted you on their hardest problems — examples that speak to this are a plus.

We’re a growing team that works collaboratively, supports each other, and is energized by having an impact. We value passion and the ability to learn — you’re encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn’t match the job description precisely!

The following is a representative annual base salary range for this position within the Bay Area: $170,000-$221,000. In addition, job level and salary opportunities are evaluated during our interview process — we review each applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, this individual will help deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions while contributing to application reliability, software quality, and engineering efficiency. Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable software applications based on business requirements and technical specifications.

jobs.description:
Description

Financial systems must keep working, even as the technology behind them changes.

As an IT Application Developer with the Department of Social and Health Services (DSHS), you'll update financial applications to support Washington's One Washington initiative and the transition to Workday. These systems support accounting, budgeting, and financial operations that help DSHS serve Washington residents.

You won't be expected to learn these systems alone.

You'll work alongside senior developers to understand requirements, design solutions, write code, and test changes. Your week will include Agile development cycles, troubleshooting, peer reviews, and collaboration with business and technical teams.

We encourage you to apply if
you enjoy solving technical problems, can explain your design decisions, and welcome feedback. You understand that reliable software depends on both sound code and a clear understanding of business needs.

Your first 90 days
are about learning the applications, development tools, and business processes. You'll review existing code, work with senior developers, and begin contributing changes.

Within your first year, success means you can develop, test, and implement changes that support the One Washington transition.

The opportunity comes with a defined timeline.

There are two one-year project positions, with possible extensions dependent on additional funding. You'll work Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with at least two days each week at Office Building 2 during your first three months. No additional travel is expected. The Olympia area offers access to South Puget Sound, parks, and trails, although wet winters and commuting conditions are worth considering.

Still reading? Here's what you'll do.

Some Of What You'll Do

Develop and maintain financial applications and data interfaces.
Analyze requirements and design technical solutions.
Write, test, debug, and review application code.
Update systems and integrations for One Washington and Workday.
Troubleshoot production issues and application failures.
Participate in Agile development cycles and peer reviews.
Collaborate with senior developers and business teams.
Document system changes, designs, and test procedures.
Follow development, security, and quality standards.

Meet one of these pathways:

Seven years of recent professional software development and maintenance experience; or
An associate degree in computer science or a closely related field and five years of professional software development and maintenance experience; or
A bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a closely related field and three years of professional software development and maintenance experience.

Qualifying experience includes analyzing, designing, implementing, programming, or maintaining software applications.

You must also have experience or training in some of these technologies: Java, C#, .NET, Microsoft SQL Server, Transact-SQL, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, SQL Server, or Transact-SQL.
Knowledge of SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) or Integration Services (SSIS).
Experience with TFS, Azure DevOps, or Agile/Scrum.
Experience with application integration and production troubleshooting.
Ability to explain technical decisions and collaborate during reviews.

Submit

Your resume.
Your cover letter.
Three professional references.

Include details about the applications you've developed, technologies used, and your contributions.

Email recruiter Kris George at kris.george@dshs.wa.gov and reference job number 08822.

Design, develop, implement, and maintain secure, scalable, full-stack software applications supporting mission-critical enterprise systems, with a focus on Secure Development Operations (SecDevOps) principles.
Develop and maintain software applications using compiled and interpreted programming languages while ensuring compliance with secure coding standards and enterprise security requirements.
Design, develop, and optimize relational and NoSQL database solutions to support application functionality, performance, data integrity, and security.
Establish, implement, and enforce secure coding standards, including code quality, Zero Trust security principles, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), and secure dependency management.

Apply software engineering and security principles across diverse programming languages, operating systems, development frameworks, and hosting environments.
Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, security tools, and development methodologies to address evolving mission requirements and improve software engineering capabilities.
Support security assessments, accreditation activities, and compliance reviews by maintaining software security documentation, SBOM records, vulnerability reports, and evidence of implemented security controls.
Develop and maintain secure software development procedures, technical documentation, coding standards, and best practices to support consistent implementation across the enterprise.
Promote a culture of security awareness, accountability, and continuous compliance by establishing repeatable processes and encouraging sustained adoption of secure software development standards.

Expertise with artifact management toolsets (Nexus, Artifactory, NuGet, etc) and SAST/DAST code quality platforms (SonarQube, Aikido, CodeQL, or similar) and Git-oriented supporting capabilities (such as pre-commit hooks and branch management rules)

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Growth
jobs.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About The Role

Growth Engineering at Suno owns the path from "someone hears about Suno" to "someone who creates music, comes back, and subscribes." That includes onboarding, paywalls and pricing, credits and billing, lifecycle messaging, logged-out surfaces and SEO, and the attribution and experimentation systems underneath all of it. Millions of people hit these surfaces every day.

You'll work on a team of web, iOS, and Android engineers. The team runs on experiments: you'll form a hypothesis, ship the test, read the result, and either scale it or retire it. Most projects have a small lean team on them.

We're a small team inside a company that is still moving fast. You'll have a say in what gets prioritized, and work directly with PMs, designers, data scientists, and marketers to deliver results for Suno.

Check out our Suno version of the job here: https://suno.com/s/fgke9OYJlf54RMKs

What You’ll Do

Own user growth or revenue projects end-to-end: from identifying opportunities through shipping and measuring results.
Partner closely with product, marketing, and design to translate their goals into a prioritized plan, ship fast, and measure impact with data.
Build and iterate across the full stack: frontend, backend, and data analysis.
Design and run experiments, working with product and data science on instrumentation, measurement, and result interpretation.
Create scalable and performant infrastructure that support growth campaigns and initiatives.

What You’ll Need

5+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
Experience shipping full-stack web features to production.
History of owning outcomes rather than tickets: projects where you chose what to build, shipped it, and can say what happened to the metric afterward.
Comfort with data: asking critical questions about data, running queries on it, isolating signal from noise, and reading out results
A bias toward shipping fast without sacrificing code quality or user experience, and the judgment to decide when to optimize for what.
Genuine interest in music, and in the people making it with Suno.

Nice to have

Experience in at least one of our core areas: consumer growth and experimentation, subscriptions and monetization, or marketing engineering (SEO/AEO, CRO, CMS, attribution, lifecycle/CRM).
Cross-platform experience shipping features on web and mobile.

Additional Notes:
Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Location:
This is an onsite role in our Chelsea, NYC office.

Perks & Benefits For Full-Time Employees

Company Equity Package
401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)
Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)
11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time
16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave
Creative Education Stipend
Generous Commuter Allowance
In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
MANTECH
seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Platform Engineer
to join our team in Chantilly, VA
.

The Platform Engineer will support mission-critical data operations by designing, building, and optimizing large-scale data ingest and processing solutions in a Big Data environment. In this role, you will enable reliable, performant Elastic clusters and data pipelines that support analytic and operational needs across the full data lifecycle. You will own the Elasticsearch cluster lifecycle, build and maintain GitLab and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, support enterprise RHEL hardware, and lead innovative efforts to integrate next-generation technologies.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Designing, implementing, and optimizing large-scale data ingest and processing systems in a Big Data environment
Installing, configuring, upgrading, and maintaining on-premises Elasticsearch clusters, including routine cluster health checks, shard allocation, index maintenance, and custom dashboard development for performance tuning and capacity planning
Designing, writing, and maintaining SaltStack states, pillars, and orchestration workflows to automate server provisioning, configuration compliance, and patch management across on-premises RHEL servers
Building and maintaining end-to-end CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI and Jenkins that integrate automated builds, artifact publishing, and system deployments
Developing automation scripts in Bash, PowerShell, and Python for ad-hoc operational tasks, bulk provisioning, and monitoring plug-in development
Leading the integration of third-party software, prototyping emerging technologies through Proof-of-Concept initiatives, and establishing migration paths that minimize operational impact
Producing high-quality run-books, SOPs, architectural diagrams, and technical documentation in Confluence and Markdown while collaborating across engineering teams, vendors, and stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications

High School Diploma/GED with 4+ years of progressively responsible experience in platform engineering, data engineering, software development, or systems administration
2+ years of hands-on experience administering and patching RHEL/CentOS Linux servers in production, including server provisioning, configuration compliance, and hardware troubleshooting
2+ years of proven experience writing and maintaining SaltStack states, pillars, and orchestration workflows (or comparable IaC tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet)
Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, upgrading, and troubleshooting Elasticsearch clusters, including Kibana, Beats, and Elastic Stack security features
Experience building and maintaining end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar automation tools to publish artifacts and drive automated deployments
Strong scripting experience and proficiency in Bash, Python, or PowerShell for workflow automation, bulk provisioning, and monitoring plug-in development
Experience integrating third-party software into existing infrastructure and producing comprehensive technical documentation, run-books, and SOPs in Confluence or Markdown

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced experience with large-scale Elasticsearch deployments, cluster health optimization, and multi-node scaling
Advanced proficiency in Configuration Management and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) utilizing SaltStack, Ansible, or Puppet
Practical knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes
Proven experience supporting mission-critical data operations and platform engineering initiatives within secure government environments

Clearance Requirements

An active TS/SCI with Polygraph is required for this position.

Physical Requirements

Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

Costco IT is responsible for the technical future of Costco Wholesale
, the third largest retailer in the world with wholesale operations in fourteen countries. Despite our size and explosive international expansion, we continue to provide a family, employee centric atmosphere in which our employees thrive and succeed.

This is an environment unlike anything in the high-tech world
and the secret of Costco’s success is its culture. The value Costco puts on its employees is well documented in articles from a variety of publishers including Bloomberg and Forbes. . Costco IT is a dynamic, fast-paced environment, working through exciting transformation efforts. We are building the next generation retail environment where you will be surrounded by dedicated and highly professional employees.

Software Engineers perform development work across the technology stack (both front-end/back-end expertise). They are versatile in how they can add value, demonstrating the ability to manage the completion of projects that involve databases, backend services, or the development of front-end applications. If you want to be a part of one of the worldwide BEST companies “to work for”,
simply apply and let your career be reimagined.

ROLE

Develops the conceptual systems architecture design and the supporting technologies needed to enable new and/or enhanced functionality within a given product/application, applying principles that promote availability, reusability, interoperability, and security into the design framework.

Required

5+ years’ experience analyzing, designing and implementing integration solutions. Candidates with development experience using general software development and integration technologies will be trained as necessary to use specific integration technologies.
3+ years’ experience coding with XML, JSON, or SQL.
Detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills and ability to analyze potential future issues.
IBM App Connect Enterprise (aka ACE, fka IBM Integration Bus) and IBM MQ in support of multiple business projects.
Proven ability to develop software solutions with supporting documentation.
Ability to learn and maintain knowledge of multiple application areas.
Ability to build lasting trusted partnerships across various functional areas and technical disciplines.
Self-motivated, responsible, conscientious, and detail-oriented.
Proven ability to set and follow priorities and timelines.
Ability to work on multiple simultaneous timelines.
Familiar with standard code management practices and tools.
Ability to support off-hours work as required, including weekends, holidays, and 24/7 on call responsibilities on a rotational basis.
International travel may be required.

Recommended

Familiarity with ReST APIs concepts, including OAuth2.
Familiarity with Google PubSub.
Knowledge of multiple operating systems, especially i5/OS (System i / iSeries / AS/400), AIX, Linux, and Windows.
Experience with various programming and scripting languages (Java, C#, Bash/Korn).
Experience with working within the Agile framework.

Resume

jobs.title: EDA Tools & Design Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is seeking an EDA Tools & Design Automation Engineer to join the Mixed Signal Design Automation team. In this role, you will own the deployment, configuration, reliability, and ongoing evolution of the EDA tool environment used by our mixed-signal design teams. You will develop and maintain AI-enabled design-automation tooling; build automation using Python and EDA-specific scripting languages; partner with CAD on tool and PDK configuration; and help define and support scalable EDA flows that enable faster, more reliable mixed-signal design iteration.

This role is remote,
based out of any location in North America
.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

You have 5+ years of experience supporting, configuring, or automating semiconductor EDA tools in an analog, mixed-signal, custom-design, CAD, or methodology environment.
You’re a strong Python engineer with experience in Tcl and/or Cadence SKILL, Linux-based EDA environments, and GUI or batch-flow integrations.
You apply software best practices—including version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and maintainable design—and have experience with AI-assisted development tools.
You’re analytical and collaborative, able to troubleshoot complex issues and work effectively with CAD, PDK, infrastructure, layout, and design teams. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience is welcome.

What We Need

Own the deployment, configuration, reliability, and evolution of the EDA environment for Tenstorrent’s mixed-signal design teams.
Develop, test, release, and support AI-enabled automation and workflows, primarily in Python, with Tcl or Cadence SKILL integrations as needed.
Partner with Design Automation and CAD to build workflows, configure tools and PDKs, qualify supported versions, and maintain reproducible environments.
Help standardize automation conventions, interfaces, and data formats, and resolve tool, configuration, PDK, and workflow issues. Experience with Cadence and Synopsys custom flows, OpenAccess, verification, extraction, simulation, or Slurm/HPC is a plus.

What You Will Learn

How mixed-signal design teams use EDA tools and automation across the design lifecycle.
How to evolve AI-enabled workflows that support faster, more reliable design iteration.
How tool and PDK configurations, qualification, and reproducible environments enable scalable design flows.
How to balance standardization with flexibility across open-source, in-house, and commercial tools while collaborating across engineering teams.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

Halvik Corp
delivers a wide range of services to 13 executive agencies and 15 independent agencies. Halvik is a highly successful WOB business with more than 50 prime contracts and 500+ professionals delivering Digital Services, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Cyber Security and Cutting-Edge Technology across the US Government. Be a part of something special!

Position Overview

Halvik is seeking a Test Automation Engineer to support the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) Office of the Chief Digital & Information Officer (OCDIO) Digital Factory capacity task order. Operating under DOT's IT Modernization Initiative (ITIM-2025-007) and the 2025–2029 "Path to 1DOT IT" strategy, the program delivers modernized, secure, and resilient applications through a Software Factory, Capacity-as-a-Service (CaaS) model. Halvik provides Agile Scrum teams for Development, Modernization, and Enhancement (DME) work across cloud, on-premises, and SaaS platforms hosted within the USDOT IT security boundary.

As a member of Halvik's DME Scrum teams, the Test Automation Engineer designs, builds, and maintains automated test suites that are embedded in the CI/CD pipeline and run with every build and release. The program's Mandatory Iteration-Level Testing & Validation Framework makes testing a required delivery control and calls for a progressive shift from manual to automated execution. This role drives that shift. It contributes directly to the end-client's objectives by catching defects early, protecting existing functionality through automated regression, keeping defect rates within contract thresholds, and producing the objective test evidence needed for the Definition of Done, release readiness, and Authority to Operate (ATO) packages.

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Execution: Lead the development of a test automation strategy and reusable framework for each assigned product, prioritizing automation of smoke, regression, end-to-end, and high-risk scenarios, and progressively converting manual test cases to automated execution in line with the program's Automation Transition Requirement.
Operational Oversight: Manage daily execution, maintenance, and triage of automated test suites. Monitor results, isolate flaky tests, investigate failures, and log defects with clear reproduction steps and severity in the Government-furnished Jira instance.
Collaboration: Coordinate with developers, the Senior Business Analyst / QA Analyst, the Cloud Engineer / DevSecOps / CI-CD, the Solutions Architect, and the Scrum Master to turn user stories and acceptance criteria into automated tests, build testability into features, and deliver tested increments every sprint.
Technical Performance: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps) so that tests run on every build, deployment, and promotion, and make results available for sprint demos, release readiness reviews, and ATO evidence packages.
Government-Furnished Tools: Configure and operate OCDIO's automated testing tool (currently ClicTest) and any other Government-furnished testing tools, adapting quickly when tools change or new ones are provided.
Test Coverage Across Categories: Build and maintain automated coverage across the required testing categories, including smoke testing in every environment (with post-deployment validation in Production), end-to-end workflows across UI, APIs, and data layers, persona and role-based permissions, regression, and integration/API contract testing.
Performance, Security, and Accessibility Testing: Support automated performance and load validation under realistic transaction volumes, security checks aligned to the OWASP Top 10 and authentication/authorization rules, and automated Section 508 (WCAG 2.0 A/AA) accessibility scans.
Evidence and Definition of Done: Ensure objective test evidence (executed scripts, logs, automated output, and pass/fail results) is attached to the corresponding Jira ticket before any item is marked "Done," and document the rationale for any testing category that does not apply to a given change.
Quality Metrics: Track and report automation coverage, pass rates, and defect trends, and help keep the defect rate below the program's five percent Maximum Allowable Defect Rate (MADR) while supporting any corrective action planning.
Data and Release Validation: Develop automated scripts to validate data migrations (record counts, transformations, field-level mappings) and to verify deployment and rollback procedures before production promotion.

jobs.title: Sr Data Engineer
jobs.description:
The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.

We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

Protective is looking for Data Engineers to design, build, and operate production data pipelines on Voyager, our Databricks lakehouse on Azure. You will own the end-to-end flow of data through a medallion architecture — ingesting source data into the Bronze layer, applying cleansing, validation, and conformance in Silver, and publishing trusted, consumption-ready data products in Gold.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, analytics, and platform operations. You will write production-grade Python and SQL, enforce data contracts, and help Protective treat data as a product with named owners and real consumers. You will be embedded on a delivery pod that owns its data products end to end, rather than servicing tickets from a queue.

On Voyager, the medallion layers are named Raw, Prep, and Prod. They map directly to Bronze, Silver, and Gold and are used interchangeably in this description.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain production data pipelines on Databricks using Python, SQL, Apache Spark, and Delta Lake
Build Bronze-layer ingestion that reliably captures data from APIs, relational databases, flat files, cloud storage, and SaaS platforms — using dlt (dltHub) and Databricks-native ingestion where each fits — including incremental loading, pagination, watermarking, state management, and replay after failure
Develop Silver-layer transformations in dbt and Python over Delta Lake that cleanse, standardize, type, deduplicate, validate, conform, and enrich data so that it is reusable across domains. A meaningful share of this role is making messy source data trustworthy
Create Gold-layer data products: dimensional models, slowly changing dimensions, fact and bridge tables, aggregates, and serving tables aligned to how consumers actually query
Produce and maintain the curated datasets ML engineering trains and serves models from — feature and training tables that are versioned and reproducible, not one-off extracts
Author and maintain data contracts using the Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS) — schema with real semantics, named owner, known consumers, quality rules, and freshness expectations — and assess backward compatibility before every change
Implement data quality as code: uniqueness and not-null on keys at minimum, plus referential, accepted-value, freshness, and custom business-rule tests, surfaced to producers and consumers rather than buried in logs
Orchestrate ingestion and transformation as assets in Dagster, deployed to Dagster Cloud, and operate what you build across development, branch, and production deployments — schedules and sensors, asset dependencies, backfills, and run observability
Apply governance through Unity Catalog — catalogs, schemas, external locations, grants, row- and column-level security, and lineage — and handle credentials through Azure Key Vault rather than in code
Implement incremental and merge-based processing with Delta Lake (MERGE, schema evolution, time travel, OPTIMIZE) and tune Spark jobs, table layouts, and compute for performance and cost
Troubleshoot production failures, data-quality issues, source-system changes, and late-arriving or duplicate data — including backfills and recovery — and take part in the pod’s on-call rotation for the pipelines it owns, with root-cause analysis that closes the gap rather than reopening the ticket
Build and maintain CI/CD for data assets in Azure DevOps — automated tests and CI checks on dlt, dbt, and Dagster changes, promotion from development through branch deployments to production, and releases that are repeatable and auditable
Instrument what you own for observability: freshness, volume, quality, latency, and cost, with alerting tied to the SLAs and SLOs your contract commits to instead of depending on someone noticing
Work inside the platform’s control expectations — least-privilege access, secrets in Azure Key Vault, change management through pull request and pipeline, and audit evidence that falls out of the deployment path rather than being reconstructed later
Participate in code review and document architecture, runbooks, and data products so others can discover, trust, and reuse them
Work with data architects, analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into maintainable data solutions

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered
3+ years building and supporting production data pipelines in a cloud data platform environment
Strong hands-on Python and SQL. Both are used daily and neither substitutes for the other
Hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable Spark-based lakehouse, including Delta Lake tables, MERGE, and incremental load patterns
Practical understanding of medallion / multi-layer lakehouse design, and the judgment to say what belongs in Bronze versus Silver versus Gold
Experience ingesting data from APIs, relational databases, files, or SaaS applications, including the incremental and state-management problems that come with it
Working knowledge of dimensional modeling — grain, keys, facts and dimensions, slowly changing dimensions — and of ELT design patterns and data quality practice
Experience with orchestration and scheduling using Dagster, Databricks Workflows, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or similar
Git-based source control, pull request review, automated testing, and CI/CD as normal practice — Azure DevOps or comparable
Experience troubleshooting production data failures, performance bottlenecks, and source-system changes
Experience with pipeline monitoring and alerting, and a working understanding of what a freshness or quality SLA means once real consumers depend on it
Ability to explain technical designs and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical partners

Preferred Qualifications

Databricks certification (Data Engineer Associate or Professional) or equivalent demonstrated depth
Unity Catalog experience: catalogs, schemas, volumes, external locations, storage credentials, permissions, and lineage
dbt on Databricks, or another transformation framework used alongside Spark
Python-based modeling frameworks over Delta Lake, and experience implementing Type 2 history, surrogate keys, and merge strategies in code
Experience with a declarative Python ingestion framework such as dlt (dltHub), Airbyte, Meltano, or Fivetran
Dagster experience specifically, including assets, asset checks, sensors, schedules, and branch deployments

In addition to offering comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, we support emotional wellbeing through mental health benefits and an employee assistance program. Work/life balance is important and Protective offers a variety of paid time away benefits ( e.g. , paid time off, paid parental leave, short-term disability, and a cultural observance day). jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

About The Internship

Stripe's Applied ML, Data Science, Risk, and Payments organizations are excited to offer Master's machine learning engineering internships for the summer of 2027. This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to critical projects that directly enhance Stripe's suite of products, focusing on areas such as foundation models used for dozens of tasks e.g. fraud detection, enhanced support, and predicting user behavior.

As an intern, you'll tackle challenging problems at the intersection of finance, technology, and data. You'll have the chance to work on creative projects like the Stripe Assistant and the Stripe Foundation Model, which leverage machine learning to revolutionize how businesses interact with financial services and data.

Responsibilities

Develop and deploy large-scale machine learning systems that drive significant business value across various domains.
Engage in the end-to-end process of designing, training, improving, and launching machine learning models.
Write production-scale ML models that will be deployed to help Stripe enable economic infrastructure access for a diverse range of businesses globally.
Collaborate across teams to incorporate feedback and proactively seek solutions to challenges.
Rapidly learn new technologies and approaches, demonstrating a strong ability to ask insightful questions and communicate the status of your work effectively.

Who you are

Minimum Requirements

A deep understanding of computer science, obtained through the pursuit of a Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related field, with the expectation of graduating in winter 2027 or spring/summer 2028.
Practical experience with programming and machine learning, evidenced by projects, classwork, or research. Familiarity with languages such as Python, Scala, Spark and libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
Expertise in areas of machine learning such as supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, ML operations, and possibly experience in Large Language Models or Reinforcement Learning.
Demonstrated ability to work on collaborative projects, with experience in receiving and applying feedback from various stakeholders.
A proactive approach to learning unfamiliar systems and a demonstrated ability to understand complex systems independently.
Intent to return to the degree-program after the completion of the internship/co-op.

Preferred Qualifications

You Might Also Have:

Two years of university education or equivalent experience, with in-depth knowledge in specific domains of machine learning.
Published and presented peer-reviewed articles in top-tier venues.
Experience in writing high-quality pull requests, maintaining good test coverage, and completing projects with minimal defects.
Familiarity with navigating new codebases and managing work across different programming languages.
Excellent written communication skills to clearly articulate your work to both team members and wider Stripe audiences.

Application requirements

Please Submit The Following With Your Application

A detailed resume or LinkedIn profile showcasing your work history.
Examples of relevant work and your approach to learning, such as GitHub repositories, StackOverflow contributions, or other project portfolios.

Join us for an unforgettable summer internship and help shape the future of global commerce. At Stripe, you won't just be working on theoretical projects; you'll make a tangible impact on the world's economic infrastructure.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

Code that saves lives.

As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.

Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).

More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. jobs.description:
Overview

Join a team where innovation meets mission. Our AI, cloud, cyber, and modernization solutions save agencies thousands of hours, safeguard national security, and strengthen health and humanitarian missions worldwide. With 1,700+ team members, 1,500+ AI/data experts, and 100+ prime contracts, we deliver at scale and with purpose.
We've been recognized as a Top Workplace by the Washington Post for six straight years and named to the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies 13 of the past 14 years. Credence is a welcoming home for those looking to grow and contribute to positive change. We encourage all employees to expand beyond their boundaries, dive into important world-changing Federal challenges.
Position Summary

Credence has an immediate need for an  AI Software Engineer 
to join our growing AI and Automation practice. You will be a technical anchor in our AI and Automation practice. You'll apply foundational AI skills to build and deploy data-driven solutions. Under mentorship from senior AI leaders, you'll drive agentic AI development lifecycles and collaborate across engineering, data, and stakeholder teams to deliver high-impact, cloud-native AI capabilities that advance federal missions.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below

Generative AI & LLM Usage

Contribute to projects using generative AI and LLMs, helping to prototype, customize, and refine AI powered capabilities
Agentic AI System Development

Support end-to-end AI development: model selection, agent creation, tool calling, response synthesis, and ambient background agents
AI Software Engineer

Maintain strong software engineering principles while leveraging the latest advancements in AI code generation to accelerate your workflows
Collaborative Engineering

Work alongside data engineers, software engineers, and data scientists to develop operational agent AI systems
Cloud Enablement

Help automate model deployment workflows using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and container orchestration tools
Production Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor AI systems post-deployment, perform performance tuning, and apply best practices for reliability and scalability
Technical Rigor & Documentation

Write clean, well-documented code following industry and federal guidelines; support reproducible development
Professional Growth

Stay current on AI/ML trends and tools and actively learn from senior team members through mentorship and technical design reviews

Requirements

What You Bring

Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field
3-7 years
 of hands-on experience delivering AI/ML solutions
Experience in generative AI, working with LLMs, and adding tool calls (MCP)
Experience with agentic frameworks such as Agent2Agent Protocol, Mastra, Strands, AgentCore, and/or Gemini Agent Platform
Deep understanding of AI APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock
Typescript proficiency and familiarity with key libraries and frameworks (Nx, NextJS, Mastra, Vercel AI SDK, Playwright, Jest, Vite)
Python proficiency and familiarity with libraries and frameworks (uv, Pydantic, FastAPI, CrewAI, LangChain, LangGraph, Unstructured)
Experience deploying applications using cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and container tools (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI)
Experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity)
Strong communication skills and client-oriented mindset
U.S. Citizenship with eligibility for DoD Secret clearance

Preferred

Curious and experimental about the latest innovations in AI with an orientation toward the relentless pursuit of delivering mission impact
Exposure to adjacent skillsets such as data engineering, data science, UI/UX, cloud engineering, and platform engineering to understand the entire software ecosystem
Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, Open Tofu, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation to deploy cloud native applications
Knowledge of federal cybersecurity, RMF, FedRAMP, or regulatory frameworks

Why This Role Matters

Real-World Impact
 — Your work will support defense and health agencies where AI solutions directly contribute to national security and public well-being
Growth-Oriented Environment
 — Learn from technical leaders, innovate within Agentic AI, and mentor those around you in AI best practices
Culture of Empowerment
 — You'll be part of a team that values innovation, trust, collaboration, and mission success

Salary Range:
 $120,000 - $150,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience, education, certifications, skills, and overall qualifications.

Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)

jobs.title: CST Application Engineer - Physical Systems
jobs.description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

Cadence Design Systems is looking for recent bachelor’s graduates in Engineering to join the Physical System Design and Analysis (PSDA) Customer Service team through a cohort-based early career program. Positions are available in San Jose, CA or Livonia, MI.

As an integral member of the PSDA Customer Service team, you will work with industry-leading computer-aided engineering (CAE) tools used to simulate and analyze complex physical systems. You will collaborate with technical experts and customer-facing teams in a dynamic environment focused on helping customers solve challenging engineering problems. Through hands-on assignments, you will build practical experience in simulation workflows, application engineering, technical support, and professional services while developing the communication and problem-solving skills needed for a successful customer service career.

What opportunity is offered?

This full-time, entry-level position begins with a one-year, cohort-based development program for recent engineering graduates from across North America and consists of two six month rotations. The program combines structured learning, hands-on projects, mentoring, and rotational experiences across key Customer Service functions (technical sales, customer support, training, and services). Participants will learn from application engineers, technical support and professional services who use Cadence CAE simulation tools, coding and scripting, and the practical use of artificial intelligence to improve engineering and customer workflows.

After successfully completing the cohort program, participants will transition into a full-time role within a PSDA Customer Service group that uses Cadence CAE tools for simulation and analysis. Placement will be based on the participant’s skills and interests, business needs, and available opportunities across application engineering, technical support, and professional services.

This cohort-based program will offer experience in the following areas:

Fundamentals of computer-aided engineering, physics-based simulation, and engineering analysis
Hands-on use of Cadence CAE tools and workflows for physical system design and analysis
Coding and scripting using languages such as Python to automate simulation, data processing, and reporting tasks
Application engineering, including solution development, demonstrations, technical enablement, and customer collaboration
Technical support, including problem diagnosis, troubleshooting, and effective customer communication
Professional services, including project delivery, simulation best practices, and creation of customer-ready engineering outputs
Practical applications of artificial intelligence in engineering analysis, workflow automation, knowledge management, and customer service
Networking, mentoring, and participation in Cadence’s recent-graduate community

Cadence is a market leader in AI and digital twins, pioneering the application of computational software to accelerate innovation in the engineering design of silicon to systems. Our design solutions, based on Cadence’s Intelligent System Design strategy, are essential for the world’s leading semiconductor and systems companies to build their next-generation products from chips to full electromechanical systems that serve a wide range of markets, including hyperscale computing, mobile communications, automotive, aerospace, industrial, life sciences and robotics.

The Cadence Physical Systems Intelligence portfolio unites leading CAE technologies from BETA CAE Software, Fidelity CFD Software and MSC Software such as structural analysis, CFD, multibody dynamics, and pre- and post-processing to simulate complete systems earlier, faster, and with greater accuracy and confidence.

At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

Where is this position located?

San Jose, CA or Livonia, MI

The annual salary range for San Jose, CA is $ 78,400 to $145,600. You may also be eligible to receive incentive compensation: bonus, equity, and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the salary range is a guideline and compensation may vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies and work location. Our benefits programs include: paid vacation and paid holidays, 401(k) plan with employer match, employee stock purchase plan, a variety of medical, dental and vision plan options, and more.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Azure AI / Machine Learning Engineer

Department: Information Technology
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Hybrid preferred, Remote available
Reports To: Director of HSI

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Azure AI / Machine Learning Engineer to design, develop, optimize, and deploy artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions within our Microsoft Azure environment.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in machine learning principles, including regression modeling, statistical analysis, and predictive analytics. This individual should understand how to develop, evaluate, and refine regression models to improve predictive accuracy, reduce errors, and enhance overall machine learning performance.

This role will be responsible for leveraging Azure Machine Learning and related technologies to develop scalable, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions. The successful candidate will collaborate with technical and business teams to identify opportunities, improve model performance, integrate AI capabilities into existing systems, and translate complex data into actionable business insights.

This position will take primary responsibility for machine learning modeling, supporting infrastructure, and solution development, working closely with a software engineer and a team of chemists. The engineer will help bridge scientific research and production-ready technology, translating analytical requirements into reliable, scalable solutions.

We are looking for a hands-on problem solver who combines technical expertise, analytical thinking, and a practical approach to applying AI and machine learning to real-world challenges.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Machine Learning Development

Design, develop, train, and deploy machine learning models using Microsoft Azure.
Apply regression modeling, statistical methods, and other machine learning techniques to improve predictive performance and model reliability.
Evaluate model accuracy, identify performance gaps, and implement improvements through feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and validation.
Develop solutions for analyzing complex datasets, including high-dimensional and imaging-related data.
Research and evaluate emerging AI and machine learning technologies for potential business applications.
Take ownership of machine learning modeling, supporting infrastructure, and solution development, collaborating closely with a software engineer and a team of chemists.

Azure AI & ML Platform

Develop and manage machine learning workflows using Azure Machine Learning.
Build and maintain scalable pipelines for data preparation, model training, testing, and deployment.
Leverage Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, and Microsoft Foundry where appropriate.
Integrate AI and machine learning capabilities with existing enterprise applications, databases, and business systems.
Optimize Azure resources for performance, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.

Model Deployment & Optimization

Implement MLOps best practices for model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Establish repeatable processes for testing, validating, and deploying models into production.
Monitor deployed models for accuracy, performance degradation, and data drift.
Collaborate with IT and development teams to maintain secure and reliable AI environments.

Required Qualifications

Experience developing, training, or deploying machine learning solutions.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, particularly Azure Machine Learning or comparable cloud-based ML platforms.
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Understanding of regression modeling, statistical analysis, predictive analytics, and model evaluation techniques.
Experience with data preparation, feature engineering, model validation, and performance optimization.
Familiarity with cloud-based architectures, APIs, and enterprise system integrations.
Understanding of software development practices, version control, and CI/CD concepts.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively and collaborate across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Azure AI Search, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, or Azure Functions.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, or generative AI applications.
Knowledge of large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and vector databases.
Experience implementing MLOps pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation.
Experience developing AI solutions from proof of concept through production deployment.
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer, Azure Data Scientist, or related certifications.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Preferred Skills (Not Required)

The following skills are beneficial but are not required for consideration:
Applied machine learning and predictive modeling.
Python development and statistical analysis.
Regression modeling and model optimization.
Azure Machine Learning (Azure ML).
Scientific computing and high-dimensional data analysis.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $120,000–$160,000 annually
Final compensation will be determined based on experience, technical expertise, and qualifications.
We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including:
Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
– Comprehensive healthcare coverage options.
401(k) Retirement Plan
– Company-sponsored retirement savings plan with a 3% employer match.
Paid Vacation
– Paid time off to support work-life balance.
Paid Holidays
– Company-observed paid holidays.
Health Savings Account (HSA)
– Access to tax-advantaged healthcare savings for eligible employees.
Bonus Compensation
– Opportunity for additional performance-based compensation.
Disability & Life Insurance
– Insurance coverage to provide financial protection.
Professional Development
– Annual allowance of $2,000–$3,000 for continued education, Microsoft certifications, ML conferences, technical training, or specialized scientific computing courses.
Company-Provided Equipment
– Necessary technology and equipment to support job responsibilities.

Work Arrangement: Hybrid preferred, with remote opportunities available.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:
Improve predictive model performance through effective modeling, evaluation, and optimization techniques.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Kubernetes Platform Engineer - Hybrid 1-2 Days per week
Duration: 1 year
Location: Phildelphia

About the Engagement
A large enterprise is migrating a mission-critical, in-house Perl-based warehouse and manufacturing operations platform from on-premises VMware infrastructure to AWS. The application runs across manufacturing facilities globally, orchestrates physical hardware (barcode scanners, laser cutters, label printers), and relies on a complex set of dependencies including Kafka, MySQL hub-spoke replication, RabbitMQ, message queuing systems, and terabyte-scale shared file mounts.

The migration strategy follows a Rehost (Lift-and-Shift) with Kubernetes Modernization approach. The first phase moves the QA cluster from on-premises into AWS, followed by production migrations to support international facilities. The role requires close collaboration with the Cloud Infrastructure team (VPC/networking), the application team, and the DBA team managing MySQL replication.

This is an embedded engineer role — the successful candidate will work directly alongside the application and infrastructure teams throughout the migration, participating in planning, execution, cutover, and post-migration stabilization, and delivering structured knowledge transfer and team upskilling.

Key Responsibilities
Kubernetes & Application Migration
· Assist the technical migration of the Kubernetes cluster from on-premises infrastructure into AWS EKS
· Modernize and rewrite existing Helm charts to align with current Kubernetes standards and AWS EKS deployment patterns
· Validate and implement container orchestration strategy including pod scaling, resource limits, and health checks
· Establish GitOps workflows and CI/CD pipelines for Kubernetes deployment automation
· Maintain connectivity to on-prem hardware (barcode scanners, laser cutters, label printers) via hybrid networking during and post-migration

Database Migration & Replication
· Coordinate with the DBA team to plan and execute migration of the MySQL hub-spoke replication topology (hub + read replica per facility) to AWS RDS.
· Validate binary log replication strategy across hub and spoke databases
· Test and document read replica promotion procedures and DR runbooks in the AWS environment
· Preserve existing AWS DMS BI reporting replication connectivity during migration
· Ensure continued connectivity to downstream dependencies: Kafka clusters, RabbitMQ, message queuing systems, and MSSQL databases

Networking & Security
· Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure team to validate VPC architecture, Transit Gateway, VPC peering, and security group rules across multiple AWS regions
· Validate and implement TLS/certificate management.
· Configure DNS routing and record management during cutover windows
· Execute and validate network preflight connectivity tests across all identified application dependencies prior to each cutover
· Design and document security group inbound/outbound rules based on port dependency analysis
Required Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and application migration, with demonstrated AWS hands-on experience
· Strong Kubernetes expertise: cluster operations, Helm chart authoring and migration, namespace management, pod lifecycle, and troubleshooting
· Hands-on experience with AWS EKS provisioning, configuration, and managed add-on management
· Proficiency in AWS networking: VPC design, subnets, Security Groups, Transit Gateway, Route Tables, VPC Peering, and PrivateLink
· Working knowledge of MySQL replication topologies (primary/replica, binary log replication) and RDS/Aurora MySQL migration
· DNS management and TLS/certificate lifecycle experience (cert-manager, ACM, or equivalent)
· Infrastructure as Code proficiency: Terraform or AWS CloudFormation
· Experience designing and executing migration cutover plans with defined rollback criteria
· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to translate technical findings into clear direction for application teams

Preferred Qualifications
· Familiarity with Kafka connectivity and configuration within Kubernetes environments
· RabbitMQ deployment and connectivity in containerized workloads
· Experience with API integration and message queue dependency mapping in migrations
· CI/CD pipeline configuration for Kubernetes deployments (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or Flux)
· Experience with managed Kubernetes platforms
· AWS CloudWatch implementation: custom metrics, alarms, log groups, and dashboards
· Familiarity with AWS DMS (Database Migration Service) for ongoing replication scenarios
· AWS certifications: Solutions Architect – Professional, or DevOps Engineer – Professional
· Experience with Perl-based applications or understanding of asynchronous job processing patterns
Working Knowledge (Nice to Have)
· Manufacturing, warehouse, or fulfillment center operational systems domain context
· Hybrid on-prem/cloud connectivity for physical hardware (scanners, printers, laser cutters)
· AWS Cost Optimization: Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, right-sizing
· AWS Backup policies and cross-region replication configuration
· APM tooling: Datadog, New Relic, or Dynatrace in AWS environments

About Us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What You’ll Do

Own frontend across product and marketing surfaces: You will work across both our core product interface and customer-facing web pages, ensuring a cohesive, polished user experience across all touch points. This includes building features in the web app and also collaborating on our website to keep branding and user experience consistent and high-quality.
Build content infrastructure that unblocks the team: You'll develop our CMS (we use Sanity) to give content and marketing teams self-serve tooling, structured content models, and preview/staging workflows, so routine changes don't depend on engineering. You'll design content schemas and editing experiences that let non-engineers move quickly and confidently.
Champion growth: You'll partner with marketing, sales, and operations to implement analytics and enable experimentation, turning business goals into shipped, instrumented features so we always know what's actually working.
Make localization first-class: You'll support localization and internationalization — multilingual content, translation workflows, and the infrastructure behind them, so non-English experiences are genuinely first-class rather than afterthoughts.
Treat performance as a feature: You'll own Core Web Vitals, media and asset optimization, and the diagnosis of the subtle issues: layout shift, lazy-loading, video quality, render timing. You care about speed, and you measure it.
Hold a high bar for accessibility: You'll champion semantic markup, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and WCAG-minded component design, ensuring the site is usable by everyone who visits it.

What You'll Bring

Marketing and growth fluency: You've worked on marketing or growth-facing web before, and you understand the business context — funnels, conversion, SEO, analytics, and A/B testing—not just the code. We care about this more than years of experience or exact seniority.
Strong frontend fundamentals: You're fluent in modern JavaScript and TypeScript and React (or a similar framework), with a real sense for UI/UX craft and an instinct for getting the small details right.
A genuine commitment to performance and accessibility: You care about both deeply and can point to specific, concrete things you've done to improve them in production.
Comfort with structured content: You've worked with a headless CMS and structured content models before. Sanity experience is a plus.
Strong cross-functional collaboration: You work well with non-engineers — designers, content writers, and marketers — and can translate their goals into technical work, and technical tradeoffs back into terms they can act on.

Even better...

Localization and i18n experience: You've worked with internationalization systems and translation tooling before.
Analytics and experimentation depth: You're familiar with web analytics and experimentation platforms and know how to use them to drive decisions.
Third-party integration experience: You've integrated services like video hosting or error monitoring into a content workflow.

Our values

Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.
Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.
Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.
Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.
Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What We Offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

Flexible (unlimited) paid time off
Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family
Life insurance and disability benefits
Retirement plan dependent on country of employment
Parental leave
Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized
Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most
Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team.
