Develop, maintain, and enhance engineering configurators, design automation tools, and digital engineering applications used across the transformer components portfolio.
Create and maintain product rules, calculations, configuration logic, engineering databases, templates, and automated workflows.
Collaborate with product experts to capture engineering knowledge and translate design requirements into scalable and maintainable digital solutions.
Improve engineering productivity through automation, standardization, digitalization, and process improvement initiatives.
Support the integration of engineering tools with CAD, PLM, ERP, and other enterprise systems.
Validate and test engineering applications to ensure accuracy, reliability, and alignment with product requirements.
Develop technical documentation, training materials, and user guides for engineering systems and processes.
Provide technical support and training to engineering teams utilizing design tools and configurators.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities by deploying new products and engineering knowledge into configuration and automation systems.
Contribute to Design to Value (DtV) initiatives through product standardization, process optimization, and cost-reduction projects.
Drive continuous improvement of engineering processes, data quality, and design governance practices.
Stay current with emerging technologies in design automation, engineering software development, AI-enabled engineering tools, and digital engineering methodologies.
Support the development of long-term digital engineering roadmaps and best practices.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Experience developing, supporting, or enhancing engineering software tools, configurators, automation systems, or technical applications.
Experience working with CAD, PLM, ERP, product data management, or engineering configuration platforms.
Working knowledge of programming or scripting languages such as Python, C#, VBA, SQL, JavaScript, or similar technologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate engineering requirements into practical digital solutions.

Strong communication and documentation skills.
Self-driven, collaborative, and results-oriented work style.

Preferred: experience with Creo, Windchill, SAP, or similar engineering platforms.
Preferred: experience supporting industrial products, power equipment, transformer components, or manufacturing environments.
Preferred: experience with Design to Value (DtV), Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, DFM/DFA, or continuous improvement methodologies.
Preferred: experience with database development, systems integration, reporting tools, or engineering data governance.

Location: San Diego, CA

Our client is developing a universal, plug-and-play compute and vision platform for vehicles. Its mission is to bring advanced driver-assistance and connected-vehicle technology to the 1.5 billion cars already on the road—making them safer, smarter, and software-defined.

The company is moving from initial units toward mass production and needs a hands-on engineer to help design and build the systems that make that possible.

Our client is hiring its first Embedded Software Engineer to design, build, and own the embedded software architecture that powers its hardware platform—from drivers and middleware through CI/CD, OTA, and vehicle validation.

This is a greenfield, build-from-scratch role

This is not a role for someone looking to maintain an existing codebase—you'll be creating the core systems from the ground up.

Design, build, and stand up CI/CD pipelines for embedded software builds, testing, artifact management, and releases—from scratch
Architect integration environments for embedded software, HIL systems, test benches, vehicles, and data logging
Build automated deployment systems across HIL, bench, production, and vehicle environments
Engineer system compatibility across multiple vehicle makes, models, ECUs, and CAN bus architectures
Design and build regression test frameworks for firmware, CAN interfaces, ADAS functions, and system releases
Build test harnesses, simulators, and automated validation frameworks from the ground up
Develop production flashing systems and processes to ensure every shipped device meets requirements
Engineer OTA update mechanisms for reliability, safety, rollback, and recovery
Lead root-cause analysis and architect long-term fixes for complex hardware/software defects
Define and build the quality metrics, release criteria, and system-level test plans this platform will run on
Partner with engineering and manufacturing to design quality into the product from the ground up
Use field performance data to drive new software, hardware, and process designs

What We're Looking For:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience developing embedded systems, platform software, or system integration solutions (not purely support/maintenance/QA)
Strong hands-on experience building software for Linux-based embedded systems
Experience developing, integrating, and debugging on Yocto-based Embedded Linux, Ubuntu, or Debian
Driver-level development experience with UART, SPI, I2C, timers, LEDs, IMUs, or similar I/O peripherals

Hands-on experience with CAN bus and tools such as CANalyzer, SavvyCAN, or SocketCAN
Strong hardware/software integration and debugging skills
Experience building bootloaders, flashing tools, firmware deployment, and OTA systems

Comfort building systems and tools from zero in a fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have:

AI model integration and optimization on real-time embedded devices
Experience validating cameras, radar, IMUs, or other vehicle sensors
Experience building HIL systems, test rigs, or vehicle simulators

Experience with Git, Git LFS, Docker, and release-management tools
Knowledge of cloud microservices and connected-device architectures

The chance to architect and build a platform from the ground up as it moves from prototype to mass production
Collaborative, mission-driven team based in San Diego

jobs.description:
COMPANY SUMMARY

At Impyrian, our commitment to excellence, client-centric approach, and deep industry expertise set us apart. We strive to be a trusted partner for organizations seeking to embrace digital transformation, bolster cybersecurity, streamline operations, leverage advanced audio-visual technologies, drive successful engineering and construction projects, and harness the power of AI and robotics to stay ahead in today's dynamic business landscape.

Impyrian knows the most important factor in our success is the excellence of our personnel—if we take care of our people, our people take care of our clients. This philosophy helps ensure a work-life balance, competitive compensation and benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Impyrian is seeking a Junior-Level Full Stack Developer to support the development, enhancement, and maintenance of enterprise applications. The role develops and supports Java-based applications using modern frameworks, relational databases, and automated testing tools in an Agile environment, collaborating with developers, technical leads, business analysts, and stakeholders.

Project Scope

The Enterprise Reference Data Service is the authoritative source of truth for geographical, regulatory, and operational reference data across U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP). The team is building and maintaining a centralized, auditable platform using Java/Spring Boot microservices, bitemporal PostgreSQL data models, Liquibase migrations, Apache Kafka event streaming, and accessible USWDS-compliant Angular interfaces.

Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Java and Spring Boot.

Build and optimize data access layers, entity mappings, and database interactions using Spring Data JPA and PostgreSQL.

Implement bitemporal data models supporting historical auditing, point-in-time retrieval, and preservation of historical records.

Develop asynchronous event publishers using Apache Kafka and Apache Avro schemas for reliable downstream message delivery.

Develop responsive, accessible single-page applications using Angular and TypeScript.

Analyze requirements with technical and functional stakeholders and translate business needs into technical solutions.

Maintain automated test suites using JUnit 5, Vitest, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks.

Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and documented code in accordance with software development best practices.

Troubleshoot defects, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

Participate in peer code reviews and improve application architecture, code quality, and development practices.

Use Google Gemini and AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate feature development, code reviews, refactoring, and test generation.

Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

Track development activities, defects, and user stories in Jira or similar tools.

Support releases, deployments, enhancements, and production maintenance.

Conduct live feature demonstrations and architectural walkthroughs covering APIs, the web portal, and Kafka event feeds for internal stakeholders, program leaders, and prospective downstream consumers.

Share technical guidance and knowledge with less experienced team members, as appropriate.

Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Required Qualifications

Education and Work Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, plus at least 3 years of relevant professional experience.

At least 3 years of experience developing and/or supporting Java applications.

Strong experience with Java frameworks, including Spring and Spring Boot.

Experience working in an Agile software development environment.

Experience using Jira or a similar issue-tracking and Agile development tool.

Experience developing applications integrated with relational databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL.

Experience writing and maintaining automated unit tests using JUnit or a comparable framework.

Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), object-oriented programming, and modern software development practices.

Skills and Competencies:

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to collaborate with developers, technical leads, business analysts, and other stakeholders.

Ability to write maintainable code, participate in code reviews, and support application releases and production maintenance.

Corporate Values Alignment:

Passionate - Demonstrates enthusiasm for the work, the company and client's mission, and the impact it has on others through dedication, team motivation, continuous learning, and ownership.

Selfless - Puts the needs of others, the team, and the company first through knowledge sharing, teamwork, inclusivity, and humility.

Impactful - Strives to make a meaningful and measurable difference for the company, clients, and community, with a focus on results and continuous improvement.

Prolonged use of a computer and keyboard, including typing and using a mouse.

Frequent use of manual dexterity for computer-based work and detailed tasks.

Ability to walk or stand occasionally to attend meetings or move around the office.

Ability to maintain focus and attention to detail throughout the workday.

Develop and maintain full-stack web applications that support mission operations and analytic workflows
Apply dataflow expertise to improve development processes and streamline mission workflows

Experience with AI-assisted development

Your New Career

jobs.title: Software Engineer I, AI
jobs.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The AI Software Engineer designs, develops, and maintains AI-enabled applications with an emphasis on integrating large language models into business workflows. This role partners with business and technology stakeholders to understand requirements, implement well-tested solutions, and support deployed AI services in production. Responsibilities include contributing to codebases, documentation, and operational support processes while following secure engineering practices and established development standards. The position supports experimentation and evaluation of AI tools and frameworks under guidance from senior engineers and helps improve user experiences through automation and AI-assisted capabilities aligned with firm objectives.

Job Duties

Develops AI-driven applications and integration points
Researches and evaluates AI technologies for potential implementation
Designs and maintains documentation for AI systems and processes
Collaborates with business units to clarify AI solution requirements
Coordinates technical efforts related to AI systems issues and optimizations
Builds and maintains a variety of internally developed and third-party integrated systems documentation
Implement AI features, including large language model integrations, prompts, and retrieval workflows under guidance
Proactively monitors and supports existing applications and automations
Integrates AI functionalities into existing systems to enhance user experience for defined use cases and scoped deliverables
Supports AI Engineering & IT professionals on responsibilities and provides guidance regarding effective resolution of issues with oversight from team leads
Escalates critical issues to management and implements strategies for timely resolution based on runbooks and established escalation paths
Coordinates and organizes efforts and follow-up from items stemming out of team meetings for assigned action items
Provides Level IV support on specific applications as needed
Participates in code reviews as a reviewer and author; remediates findings to ensure quality and security in AI applications
Monitors and supports existing AI applications and automations by reviewing alerts/dashboards and performing routine checks
Other duties as required

Supervisory Responsibilities

N/A

Education

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

High School diploma or GED, required
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information Systems, preferred

Experience

Two (2) or more years of experience in application development, required
One (1) or more years of experience with cloud technologies, preferred
Experience with artificial intelligence / machine learning, preferred
Experience integrating large language models into IT systems, preferred
Experience troubleshooting application issues using logs, monitoring tools, and debugging techniques, preferred
Experience with Microsoft development stack (.Net, C#, Azure), preferred

License/Certifications

Microsoft developer certifications, preferred
AI or machine learning certifications (Microsoft AI-900, AI-102) certifications, preferred

Software

Development Experience with one or more of the following, required:

Front-end Development (React, AngularJS, .NET MVC, or similar)
Backend Development (C#, NodeJS)
Database Server Experience (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL or similar)
SQL Development Experience (Queries, Functions, Stored Procedures)
NoSQL Experience (Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, or similar)
Cloud Technologies (Azure)
Business Intelligence (ADF, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS, Power BI, or similar business intelligence technologies)
Mobile Development Experience (Xamarin, Swift, Objective-C, or similar)
CI/CD Pipeline experience (i.e., GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, Gitlab Runners, etc.)
Experience with databases/SQL
Experience with the following products, preferred:
Microsoft Visual Studio / VS Code
Microsoft Azure DevOps or GitHub
Microsoft SQL Server and/or Azure SQL
Microsoft Entity Framework

Language

N/A

Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong verbal and written communication skills
Excellent interpersonal and customer relationship skills
Capacity to work in a deadline-driven environment while handling multiple complex projects/tasks simultaneously with a focus on details
Capable of successfully multi-tasking while working independently or within a group environment
Ability to rely on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals
Capable of working well under pressure while dealing with unexpected problems in a professional manner
Capacity to communicate and interact with all levels of employees and management
Ability to interact and build relationships and consensus among people
Advanced knowledge of concepts, practices and procedures within the software development industry
Strong information technology architecture and design skills
Capacity to consistently produce clean code and adhere to appropriate documentation standards

Individual salaries that are offered to a candidate are determined after consideration of numerous factors including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and geography.

National Range: $85,000 - $100,000

Maryland Range: $85,000 - $100,000

NYC/Long Island/Westchester Range: $85,000 - $100,000

About Us

At BDO, how we show up matters. We build strong relationships by supporting one another, our clients, and our communities with care, curiosity, and a commitment to helping one another grow and succeed. Here, you’ll find meaningful work, leaders invested in your success, and opportunities to build a career around what matters most to you.

Our purpose is to be the people our clients count on to grow with confidence and achieve what matters most. Our values guide how we bring that purpose to life each day. Together, they shape how we work with one another, serve our clients, and create meaningful impact.

BDO provides assurance, tax, and advisory services to clients across the U.S. and around the world. No matter your role, you’ll be part of a team helping clients navigate complexity and move forward with clarity.

As technology continues to shape how we work, BDO values the ability to apply generative and agentic AI solutions to develop work products, improve workflows and identify potential risks. Across our firm, we emphasize professional judgment in validating AI-generated outputs for accuracy, quality, and compliance.

We are proud to be an ESOP company, offering participants a stake in the firm’s success through beneficial ownership and a unique opportunity to enhance their financial well-being. As a qualified retirement plan, the ESOP is a meaningful addition to our comprehensive compensation and Total Rewards benefits* offerings. It also reinforces an ownership mindset that strengthens our connection to one another, our clients, and the future we’re building together.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer II - Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
Job Description

About Enterprise Architecture:

Enterprise Architecture Is An Organization Within The Chief Technology Office At American Express And It Is a Key Enabler Of The Company’s Technology Strategy. The Four Pillars Of Enterprise Architecture Include

Architecture as Code: this pillar owns and operates foundational technologies that are leveraged by engineering teams across the enterprise.
Architecture as Design: this pillar includes the solution and technical design for transformation programs and business critical projects which need architectural guidance and support.
Governance: this pillar is responsible for defining technical standards, and developing innovative tools that automate controls to ensure compliance.
Colleague Enablement: this pillar is focused on colleague development, recognition, training, and enterprise outreach.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deliver scalable, high-quality software solutions across the full stack, leveraging Java and Python for enterprise-grade platforms and services
Lead the architecture and implementation of distributed systems, ensuring performance, reliability, and maintainability
Own end-to-end delivery of features—from design and development to deployment, monitoring, and support in production environments
Act as a senior member of an Agile team, driving best practices in coding standards, testing, documentation, and continuous delivery
Mentor and guide junior engineers, providing technical leadership through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing
Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
Build and evolve RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems, ensuring strong service contracts and backward compatibility
Champion engineering excellence by improving CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and developer productivity
Proactively identify system bottlenecks, debug complex issues, and drive root-cause analysis with long-term fixes
Design systems for scalability, resilience, and observability, including monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies
Contribute to cloud-native adoption, including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, and auto-scaling architectures
Influence technical direction and challenge the status quo by proposing innovative, pragmatic solutions
Take ownership and accountability for delivering high-impact outcomes aligned with team and organizational goals

Qualifications

6+ years of professional software development experience with strong expertise in Java and working knowledge of Python for backend or data-driven applications
Deep experience with Java ecosystems and frameworks such as Spring, Spring Boot, or equivalent
Proven experience in full-stack development, including backend services and modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or similar)
Strong experience building RESTful APIs, microservices architectures, and service-to-service integrations
Solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance optimization
Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and/or NoSQL databases (Cassandra, DynamoDB, MongoDB)
Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)
Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS
Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native development patterns
Hands-on experience in test data generation and unit test development and execution
Preferred: Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and Generative AI technologies, including LLMs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Experience with API design standards, OpenAPI/Swagger, versioning, and contract-driven development
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)
Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern software development lifecycle practices
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (advanced degree is a plus)

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

Competitive base salaries
Bonus incentives
6% Company Match on retirement savings plan
Free financial coaching and financial well-being support
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits
Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
20+ weeks paid parental leave for all parents, regardless of gender, offered for pregnancy, adoption or surrogacy
Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
Career development and training opportunities

For a full list of Team Amex benefits, visit our Colleague Benefits Site .

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. American Express will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. For positions covered by federal and/or state banking regulations, American Express will comply with such regulations as it relates to the consideration of applicants with criminal convictions.

We back our colleagues with the support they need to thrive, professionally and personally. That's why we have Amex Flex, our enterprise working model that provides greater flexibility to colleagues while ensuring we preserve the important aspects of our unique in-person culture. Depending on role and business needs, colleagues will either work onsite, in a hybrid model (combination of in-office and virtual days) or fully virtually.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build digital health products that improve millions of lives.

As an Associate Software Engineer
, you'll help create modern digital health experiences that support patients and healthcare providers around the world. You'll join a collaborative engineering team building cloud-native applications and services that power customer-facing healthcare products and platforms. Working alongside engineers, product managers, designers, and cross-functional partners, you'll turn real-world problems into software that is reliable, secure, scalable, and meaningful.

This is an opportunity for someone who is curious, adaptable, and excited by the future of software engineering. We are looking for engineers who want to understand the problem behind the code, take ownership of outcomes, and explore how AI is transforming the way software is designed, built, tested, and operated. If you're eager to learn, enjoy experimenting with new ideas, and want your work to have a direct impact on customers, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Design, build, test, deploy, and operate reliable, secure, and scalable cloud-native applications and services.
Contribute to features from idea through production, helping solve real customer problems and measuring outcomes after release.
Use AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to support development, testing, debugging, documentation, code review, and learning.
Experiment with emerging AI-enabled engineering workflows and share learnings with teammates.
Develop clean, maintainable software and APIs using modern engineering practices.
Build applications with performance, security, privacy, reliability, and scalability in mind.
Participate in technical design and architecture discussions while learning from experienced engineers.
Collaborate with Product, UX, Quality, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver practical customer-focused solutions.
Use data, telemetry, and customer feedback to improve products and software experiences.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, simplify systems, and improve developer productivity.
Participate in code reviews, automated testing, deployments, production support, and incident learning activities.
Continuously learn new technologies and contribute ideas that improve how the team works.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of software development experience.
Strong programming fundamentals and experience with at least one modern programming language.
Understanding of APIs, testing, version control, debugging, and core software engineering principles.
Ability to collaborate effectively, communicate technical ideas, and learn from feedback.
Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new technologies.
Ownership mindset with a genuine interest in understanding customer and business problems.
Interest in AI-assisted software engineering and how emerging tools can improve software development.

Nice to Have

Experience with AWS or another cloud platform.
Familiarity with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Swift, or similar languages.
Experience using AI coding tools or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar technologies.
Exposure to APIs, automated testing, CI/CD, or modern software delivery practices.
Interest in AI, automation, and emerging technologies.

What Sets You Apart

Product Curiosity: You want to understand the customer problem and business outcome, not just the technical requirements.
Growth Mindset: You actively seek feedback, embrace new ideas, and continually look for opportunities to learn.
Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes and follow through on commitments from start to finish.
Experimentation: You enjoy testing new approaches, learning from results, and sharing insights with others.
Adaptability: You stay open to changing technologies, evolving ways of working, and new challenges.
Collaboration: You build strong relationships, contribute positively to team discussions, and support those around you.

Why Join Resmed

At Resmed, our mission is to improve lives through better health technology. You'll be part of a team developing products that help people live healthier, higher-quality lives while working at the intersection of healthcare, cloud technology, and AI.

You'll join an environment that values curiosity, learning, and innovation. We encourage engineers to explore emerging technologies, challenge assumptions, and find better ways to solve problems. You'll have the opportunity to work on meaningful products, collaborate with talented colleagues, and contribute to technology that makes a real difference for customers around the world.

If you don't meet every requirement listed above but believe you could be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. We know that talent, potential, and perspective come in many forms, and we'd love to hear your story.

We are shaping the future at Resmed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package: comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance. Employees receive Flexible Time Off (FTO), 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating days and are eligible for 14 weeks of primary caregiver or two weeks of secondary caregiver leave when welcoming new family members.

Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills.

At Resmed, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this position is: $90,000 - $113,000 USD.

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

Description
Java Developer Contractor

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Java Developer Contractor to support the design, development, and maintenance of web applications, backend services, and cloud-based solutions. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working across the Java/Spring ecosystem, building REST APIs, integrating with AWS services, and contributing to modern CI/CD-driven development workflows.
The right candidate will be hands-on, pragmatic, and comfortable working independently while collaborating with technical and business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (MERN)
jobs.description:
As part of the Reailize and B-Yond group, you’ll be joining a team that is redefining how technology powers businesses worldwide. We combine global expertise in AI, automation, and network transformation with a culture that values innovation, creativity, and impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to work on groundbreaking projects, grow your skills, and be part of a group that’s shaping the future of technology.

About The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our DevOps team to primarily design, develop and test applications for internal software systems. You will work with the customer’s industry leading automation and technology Subject Matter Experts for the 5G core network to automate deployment and upgrades of 5G Core Network Functions. You will be working with state-of-the-art technology in containerized applications, Azure, CI/CD, workflow engines and software. These systems automate the process of capturing customer’s mobility services design, and network design to aid in the planning, design, deployment, configuration, and management of the network functions that are part of each service definition.

This opportunity requires onsite presence twice a week out of any of these locations

:

Texas: Austin, Dallas, Plano
New Jersey: Middletown, Bedminster
Georgia: Lenox/Atlanta, Alpharetta
Washington: Bothell, Redmond

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js)
Build and maintain scalable, secure, high-performance RESTful APIs and backend services.
Develop responsive, reusable UI components in React, emphasizing usability and maintainability.
Design and optimize MongoDB data models, indexes, and queries to support application performance and scalability.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.
Ensure high-quality deliverables through testing, code reviews, performance tuning, and security best practices.
Integrate and maintain third-party APIs and internal services.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the stack (frontend, backend, database, CI/CD).
Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
Participate in Agile ceremonies (planning, standups, retrospectives) and deliver iteratively.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience building production web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js)
Strong JavaScript fundamentals (ES6+), including writing clean, modern, maintainable code.
Solid experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs using Node.js + Express.js.
Strong React skills including hooks, component architecture, and practical state management patterns.
Working knowledge of TypeScript (able to read/write TS in a React/Node codebase).
Experience integrating backend services with MongoDB (schemas, query optimization, indexing).
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, including Azure DevOps (ADO) YAML pipelines for React/Node services.
Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills; able to quickly read and improve existing code.
Strong understanding of authentication/authorization (e.g., JWT, OAuth/OIDC) and secure API patterns.
Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows (PRs, reviews, branching strategies).
Familiarity with cloud fundamentals—especially Azure concepts relevant to deploying and operating web services.
Ability to work effectively in an Agile, cross-functional environment with strong ownership and communication.

Nice To Have

Experience with Next.js or other React frameworks.
Experience with one or more React state libraries (Redux, Zustand, etc.)
Experience with Docker and container-based workflows.
Deeper experience with DevOps tooling beyond pipelines (infra-as-code, monitoring/observability, release automation).
Experience with workflow/BPM engines (e.g., Camunda (BPMN)) or similar orchestration platforms (including Pronghorn).
Experience with alternative clouds (AWS/GCP) in addition to Azure.

Don’t meet every requirement?

Studies show that many qualified candidates, especially women and underrepresented groups may hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If you meet around 50% of the requirements and are excited about this role, we strongly encourage you to apply. We value potential, learning ability, and diverse perspectives as much as direct experience.

Interview Integrity

During the interview process, we're evaluating your individual problem-solving skills, creativity, and approach to challenges. While AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor are part of your daily toolkit once you join B-Yond, all interviews, assessments, and take-home assignments must be completed independently.

You may not use AI tools, third-party services, coaching platforms, or content-farming services during any part of the interview process unless we explicitly permit it. We will clearly communicate when AI tools are allowed for specific assessments.

Any indication of third-party assistance or AI-generated responses will result in immediate disqualification.

Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The AI Software Engineer designs, develops, and maintains AI-enabled applications with an emphasis on integrating large language models into business workflows. This role partners with business and technology stakeholders to understand requirements, implement well-tested solutions, and support deployed AI services in production. Responsibilities include contributing to codebases, documentation, and operational support processes while following secure engineering practices and established development standards. The position supports experimentation and evaluation of AI tools and frameworks under guidance from senior engineers and helps improve user experiences through automation and AI-assisted capabilities aligned with firm objectives.

Job Duties

Develops AI-driven applications and integration points
Researches and evaluates AI technologies for potential implementation
Designs and maintains documentation for AI systems and processes
Collaborates with business units to clarify AI solution requirements
Coordinates technical efforts related to AI systems issues and optimizations
Builds and maintains a variety of internally developed and third-party integrated systems documentation
Implement AI features, including large language model integrations, prompts, and retrieval workflows under guidance
Proactively monitors and supports existing applications and automations
Integrates AI functionalities into existing systems to enhance user experience for defined use cases and scoped deliverables
Supports AI Engineering & IT professionals on responsibilities and provides guidance regarding effective resolution of issues with oversight from team leads
Escalates critical issues to management and implements strategies for timely resolution based on runbooks and established escalation paths
Coordinates and organizes efforts and follow-up from items stemming out of team meetings for assigned action items
Provides Level IV support on specific applications as needed
Participates in code reviews as a reviewer and author; remediates findings to ensure quality and security in AI applications
Monitors and supports existing AI applications and automations by reviewing alerts/dashboards and performing routine checks
Other duties as required

N/A

Education

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

High School diploma or GED, required
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information Systems, preferred

Two (2) or more years of experience in application development, required
One (1) or more years of experience with cloud technologies, preferred
Experience with artificial intelligence / machine learning, preferred
Experience integrating large language models into IT systems, preferred
Experience troubleshooting application issues using logs, monitoring tools, and debugging techniques, preferred
Experience with Microsoft development stack (.Net, C#, Azure), preferred

License/Certifications

Microsoft developer certifications, preferred
AI or machine learning certifications (Microsoft AI-900, AI-102) certifications, preferred

Software

Development Experience with one or more of the following, required:

Front-end Development (React, AngularJS, .NET MVC, or similar)
Backend Development (C#, NodeJS)
Database Server Experience (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL or similar)
SQL Development Experience (Queries, Functions, Stored Procedures)
NoSQL Experience (Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, or similar)
Cloud Technologies (Azure)
Business Intelligence (ADF, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS, Power BI, or similar business intelligence technologies)
Mobile Development Experience (Xamarin, Swift, Objective-C, or similar)
CI/CD Pipeline experience (i.e., GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, Gitlab Runners, etc.)
Experience with databases/SQL
Experience with the following products, preferred:
Microsoft Visual Studio / VS Code
Microsoft Azure DevOps or GitHub
Microsoft SQL Server and/or Azure SQL
Microsoft Entity Framework

Language

N/A

Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong verbal and written communication skills
Excellent interpersonal and customer relationship skills
Capacity to work in a deadline-driven environment while handling multiple complex projects/tasks simultaneously with a focus on details
Capable of successfully multi-tasking while working independently or within a group environment
Ability to rely on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals
Capable of working well under pressure while dealing with unexpected problems in a professional manner
Capacity to communicate and interact with all levels of employees and management
Ability to interact and build relationships and consensus among people
Advanced knowledge of concepts, practices and procedures within the software development industry
Strong information technology architecture and design skills
Capacity to consistently produce clean code and adhere to appropriate documentation standards

Individual salaries that are offered to a candidate are determined after consideration of numerous factors including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and geography.

We build strong relationships by supporting one another, our clients, and our communities with care, curiosity, and a commitment to helping one another grow and succeed. Here, you’ll find meaningful work, leaders invested in your success, and opportunities to build a career around what matters most to you.

Our purpose is to be the people our clients count on to grow with confidence and achieve what matters most. Our values guide how we bring that purpose to life each day. Together, they shape how we work with one another, serve our clients, and create meaningful impact.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Digital Health Technology team powers digital experiences and engagement to enhance the lives of millions of people every day through connected care. We build, deliver and manage a portfolio of data management platforms and mobile offerings in support of our core businesses. We thrive on simple and elegant architecture and agility. You’ll be immersed in a dynamic high-growth environment and empowered to excel, take informed risks, and drive ingenuity across the enterprise.

This is a remote
position, however, the candidate must live in San Diego, CA or surrounding areas.

Our mission is to empower ResMed's developer community with an opinionated, yet empathetic developer experience that avoids surprise, is a joy to use, and abstracts the complexities of modern development to accelerate the pace of ResMed’s next generation Healthcare Informatics platform.

As a Software Engineer, you must possess world class technical skills and a strong sense of empathy for your fellow developers. You will work closely with other talented engineers, architects and stakeholders to architect, implement, and deliver on our roadmap.

Responsibilities And Accountabilities

You have a developer first mentality with a deep empathy for the challenges of modern software development.
You have experience with full lifecycle of product development from inception to happy customers.
You are comfortable presenting your ideas to your peers, team members and management.
You will drive our inner sourcing/open sourcing strategy and help drive ResMed’s developer community in that direction.
You will build our cloud native mindset and drive our architecture towards it.
You will build and maintain observability and reliability of our services.
You will participate in a 24/7, follow the sun on call model for production incident management including weekends and holidays.
You will drive and implement improvements in developer tools and automation.
You will research, design, implement, test, and document your solutions to the technical problems as assigned.
You will collaborate across the enterprise to drive consensus and understanding.

Qualifications And Experience

BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Information Technology or equivalent experience.
2+ years of professional software development experience.
Experience with public cloud (AWS) and cloud computing concepts.
Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals and experience with at-least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Typescript, React etc.
Understanding of test practices regardless of language or tools.
Basic knowledge of source control, pull requests and automated quality gates using tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket etc.
Passion for learning and problem solving.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts and practices is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications
:

Experience building services using cloud native technologies including Kubernetes, Docker, serverless, etc. is a plus
Production experience building and operating Kubernetes clusters in public cloud is a plus.
Experience monitoring infrastructure with monitoring and logging tools such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK etc.
Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, experience with on-call rotation and incident management.

We are shaping the future at ResMed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package: comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance.

Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills.

Subject to the absolute discretion of the company, this role may be eligible for an annual cash bonus payment based on company, business unit, and/or individual performance.

At ResMed, it is not
typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this position is:

Pay Range

107,000.00 - 134,000.00 - 161,000.00 USD Annual

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. Based onsite at our global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Software Engineer will join the Production Automation team where you will work with a supportive, international team of software developers with diverse engineering backgrounds. We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. **What You Will Be Doing:**

As a software engineer specializing in backend development, you'll work in a dedicated team to enhance the infrastructure and products that underpin NVIDIA's AI platforms. Your work will be essential in enabling innovative AI research, focusing on:

* Developing solutions at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and high-performance computing, supplying to the advancement of AI technologies.
* Designing, developing, and optimizing (micro-)services orchestrated by Kubernetes to provide large-scale AI training workflows on AI training supercomputers located at major CSPs, with resiliency and efficiency.

* Crafting a submission abstraction that enables model engineers and training platforms/frameworks to seamlessly submit long-running training jobs while hiding the complexity of handling infrastructure failures, running job lifecycles with auto-restarts on failure, ensuring full efficiency, and promptly advising users.
* Crafting these services to be modular, enabling them to be coordinated with and deployed onto on-premises AI clusters that apply NVIDIA Hardware and Cloud services.

**What We Need To See:**

* A Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development, preferably with Python, Go, C/C++, or similar high-performance languages.
* Consistent track record of building and scaling large-scale distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, as well as container technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, and HPC/AI platforms such as Slurm.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Real world experience in DL frameworks, orchestrators like PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, and Ray
* Experience in developing a framework plugin architecture that allows the framework to be integrated with the cluster scheduler visibly to the users
* Strong understanding of NVIDIA GPUs, network technologies, and their failure patterns.
* Experience with AI models and AI based tools.
* Provide references to your code contributions.

NVIDIA leads the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. NVIDIA is looking for exceptional people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence!

BLN24 is seeking a Junior Software Developer to support NOAA's modernization of mission-critical weather and data dissemination systems. Working as part of an Agile development team and with mentorship from senior engineers, the developer will help review legacy weather applications, which typically ingest, route, and deliver weather products, and convert them into secure, event-driven, cloud-native applications on AWS in support of the National Weather Service. Experience with Git and familiarity with agile development practices.

Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform through work, coursework, personal projects, or certification.

U.S. Citizenship and eligibility for Public Trust clearance.

   Front-end experience with JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3, and a modern framework (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js). 

Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda, S3, SQS, ECS, EC2, or RDS. 

AWS certification (e.g., Cloud Practitioner or Developer – Associate). 

Familiarity with Python web and data frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, SQLAlchemy).

Experience with integration testing and CI/CD pipelines. 

Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).

Experience reading and modernizing legacy code (e.g., Java, C/C++, or C#/.NET). 

Experience with application security practices such as vulnerability remediation and secrets management. 

Experience with logging and observability tools and practices. 

Familiarity with federal government environments. 

Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) responsibly, within security and data-handling policies.

SPA’s Operations Research and C5ISR Analysis (ORCA) Group develops and employs simulation system products in support of operations, experimentation, and the acquisition analysis process. Responsibilities

The hired candidate has the responsibility of working collaboratively on projects involving SPA and industry modeling and simulation (M&S) tools, most specifically the SPA Naval Simulation System (SPA NSS™) tool. One primary focus will be the new SPA MesaVision™ initiative. This initiative has the goal of using the core strengths of the best M&S tools together to produce the best analysis. The hired candidate will be required to assist senior developers with algorithm development, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.

Qualifications

About The Position

The County of Riverside’s District Attorney’s Office is seeking to fill a Software Engineer II to support the District Attorney Office in Riverside.

The Software Engineering team within the Riverside County District Attorney’s office has designed and built a sophisticated software platform entirely in-house to support the complex operations of a modern DA legal environment. The system spans multiple modules, including case management, transaction processing, reporting, data management, and real-time integrations with external agencies, all tailored to meet evolving business and compliance needs. As a Software Engineer II, incumbents will play a key role in shaping and scaling this critical platform. Incumbents will work alongside a sharp, collaborative team with strong technical backgrounds in computer science and engineering; people who care deeply about code quality, system architecture, and long-term impact. This is a unique chance to work on meaningful, large-scale projects with the autonomy to innovate and the support of smart peers within a stable public sector environment. If you are looking for challenging work that truly matters, submit an application today!

Applicants who are currently enrolled in their third or fourth year of college, majoring in computer science or computer engineering, are highly desired. Competitive candidates will have demonstrated experience in at least one of the following programming languages or frameworks: C#, C++, Angular, Java, JavaScript, and React.js.

The Software Engineer II is distinguished from the Software Engineer I in that the latter is the entry-level classification in the series. This class is further distinguished from the Senior Software Engineer in that the latter requires incumbent to lead the team responsible for developing and implementing complex algorithms, data structures, and data models. Advancement to the next level is obtained by competitive selection through an open recruitment.

The District Attorney of Riverside County , as the public prosecutor acting on behalf of the People, vigorously enforces the law, pursues the truth, protects those victimized by crime, exonerates the innocent, and safeguards the rights of all to ensure that justice is done on behalf of our community. The office’s staff of over 700 is comprised of prosecuting attorneys, sworn investigators, victim-witness advocates, paralegals, investigative technicians, forensic analysts, and a wide range of information technology and supporting staff all committed to excellence and integrity in public service. The principles, methods, and techniques in software engineering in web front end and backend development; data structures; algorithm analysis; computer organization and architecture; compiler (front-end parser); relational databases; operating systems; backend development in an object-oriented language; automata and formal languages or computational theory; systems configurations, library publishing packages, NuGet packages and repositories; networking or distributed computing; source control and NuGet packages.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Reconciliation & Reporting
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, the projects you own will have direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

You will help build and operate the systems that ingest and integrate global card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, and reconcile them against internal payment data to power settlement, dispute, cost, tax, and regulatory reporting. You will own well-scoped projects within this platform end-to-end, with guidance from more experienced engineers. Our vision is to make reconciliation and reporting accurate, automated, and near real-time.

You Will

Own small, well-bounded projects end-to-end with guidance available: clarify requirements, design, build, test, ship, and follow up.
Build and maintain features within the ingestion and reconciliation pipelines that match card-network and partner reports against internal transaction data.
Contribute to tooling that provides end-to-end traceability of money throughout the system.
Develop features for reporting and reconciliation products that are accurate, reliable, timely, scalable, and user-friendly for both internal finance teams and external merchants.
Produce standardized journals and summaries that feed downstream accounting, audit, and analysis.
Contribute to our large-scale tax and regulatory reporting systems, including US IRS information returns (the 1099 family, issued at the scale of tens of millions of forms annually to merchants and customers) and international regimes such as EU-wide CESOP and country-specific reporting for Australia, Ireland, and Spain.
Support broader regulatory and compliance obligations (AML, KYC, and similar), with careful handling of sensitive and PII data, including TIN validation and secure form generation and filing.
Validate your work before calling it done, using code review, tests, small experiments, or usage signals, including for AI-assisted changes.
Take agency in debugging and escalating production issues across services, giving the team clear context on what changed, when it changed, how it changed, and what risk remains.
Collaborate with engineers, product managers, data analysts, and finance, tax, and compliance partners, contributing to technical design and product decisions that shape feature outcomes.
Review peers' work, apply their feedback to your own, and document learnings, including AI workflows the team can reuse.
Opportunistically improve the systems you touch when it fits your project scope, replacing manual and redundant work with automation, and route larger issues to the right owner.

You Have

3+ years of professional software or data engineering experience.
A Bachelor's degree in a technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar) or equivalent technical experience.
Experience building or maintaining batch- or event-driven data pipelines, with exposure to workflow-orchestration technologies (e.g., Airflow, Temporal, Spark, or equivalent) and a working understanding of distributed systems.
Proficiency in at least one major programming language (e.g., Java, Python, Go) and solid SQL.
Experience delivering well-scoped projects or features end-to-end (design, build, test, ship, operate), with guidance from more experienced engineers.
Strong communication skills: you surface concerns alongside a concrete proposal, and you give teammates clear context when debugging and escalating.
Care for engineering quality, including maintainable and testable code, code review, CI/CD, and observability, appropriate for a complex, high-stakes financial environment.
Proficiency in using AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle, with the judgment to recognize where they accelerate work and where output needs additional validation.

Nice to Have

Exposure to financial, tax, regulatory, or payments reporting and reconciliation products.
Familiarity with the payments ecosystem (merchants, acquirers, card networks, and issuers/processors), including authorization, clearing, and settlement, card-network settlement file formats, or ISO-8583.
Understanding of accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, and financial reconciliation processes.
Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake) or distributed data systems and tools such as Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, Kafka, and Hadoop.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Interest in financial products and markets.

jobs.title: Analysis Software Engineer II - Chemical Insights Research Institute
jobs.description:
Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity for an Analysis Software Engineer II
at UL Research Institutes, based in our Morrisville, North Carolina office.

The Analysis Software Engineer II designs, develops, and maintains high-quality software applications and data pipelines in support of Underwriters Laboratories Research Institutes’ (ULRI) Chemical Insights mission to provide unbiased research on chemicals and their risks to people’s health.

The Analysis Software Engineer II is a key contributor on project teams to define specifications for complex software programming applications and modifies existing applications. The role requires strong proficiency in data science tools and web technologies for building durable data pipelines and full-stack software applications. The role requires a collaborative mindset, and the ability to turn complex scientific requirements into scalable, high-quality software solutions.

UL Research Institutes

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Chemical Insights teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice.

Chemical Insights Research Institute (CIRI)

The Chemical Insights Research Institute (CIRI) contributes to the protection of public health and well-being by conducting scientific research. Our research and initiatives let people around the world know what chemicals are in the air we breathe and how they affect human health and the planet. We share our research and knowledge through information and application tools with leaders in the scientific, business, and policy communities to raise awareness of human health risks stemming from emerging technologies. To learn more, visit: chemicalinsights.org/.

What You’ll Learn And Achieve

As the Analysis Software Engineer II, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL as you:

Design, build, and maintain Python-based data pipelines for ingesting, cleaning, transforming, and validating scientific data, as well as web-based applications and REST APIs for scientific data curation and evaluation.
Collaborate with scientific technical experts, UX/UI designers, software engineers, and other developers to deliver features that meet user needs and research goals.
Integrate applications with databases, APIs, laboratory information systems, high-performance computing (HPC) systems, and external scientific data sources.
Design and implement programmatic REST APIs for seamless integration between services.
Write unit and integration tests for reliable, durable software applications.
Assist internal scientists and engineers in using data pipelines and applications; maintain effective documentation of these systems for internal users.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in software engineering.
Plan and prioritize project activities, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery.
Communicate project status, risks, and technical challenges to stakeholders and senior management.
Mentor colleagues in software engineering best practices.

Perform code reviews and provide constructive feedback on findings, both verbal and in writing.

Perform other duties as directed.

What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes:
We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do.

People: Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require.
Interesting work: Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good.
Grow and achieve: We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs.
Values. Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive.
Total Rewards: All employees at UL Research Institutes are eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days.

What Makes You a Great Fit

While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes :

Advanced technical knowledge of software development, version control, and agile development practices.
Proficiency with Python data-science stack (e.g., Polars, Pandas, Numpy, Scipy) and web-application frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI), cloud services (AWS or Azure), and relational databases (PostgreSQL).
Familiarity with JavaScript (e.g., React, Vue, Plotly), R, Java, Go, and containerization (Docker), and orchestration tools for production deployment is preferred but not required.
Strong project management, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong management, initiative, and influence skills to create alignment with multiple stakeholders and deliver results in a scientific research organization.
Positive and collaborative attitude and interpersonal skills to work effectively with leaders and colleagues across the organization.
Must be a self-starter and possess excellent leadership qualities.

Professional Education And Experience Requirements For The Role Include

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, computer programming, or a related field and minimum of 4 years of professional full stack development experience; or
Master’s degree in computer science, information technology, computer programming, or a related field and minimum of 2 years of professional full stack development experience.
Prior experience in developing online applications in a scientific research environment.

About UL Research Institutes And UL Standards & Engagement

UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement are nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well-being.

To learn more, visit our websites UL.org and ULSE.org.

jobs.title: System Software Engineer - GPU Power and Performance Management
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is redefining accelerated computing and powering the next era of artificial intelligence. Our data-center platforms bring together GPUs, CPUs, networking, systems, and software to solve some of the world’s most exciting computing problems. We are looking for a System Software Engineer to join NVIDIA’s GPU Performance and Power Management Software team. You will help design, develop, and debug production software for performance states (P-states) and Power Management Controllers. Your work will also support dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) and power-management technologies for next-generation data-center GPUs.

You will work at the intersection of hardware architecture, embedded firmware, device drivers, operating systems, and AI workloads. In this role, you will contribute across the product lifecycle, including design, pre-silicon development, validation, silicon bring-up, and production support. This is a great opportunity to build expertise in GPU power and performance software while contributing to products that deliver leading performance, energy efficiency, and reliability.

What You’ll Be Doing

Design, build, implement, and debug GPU power- and performance-management software, with emphasis on P-state management and DVFS.
Develop control policies and software mechanisms that optimize GPU performance, power, thermals, and energy efficiency under demanding data-center workloads.
Support features through full product lifecycle: requirements, architecture, implementation, pre-silicon validation, silicon bring-up, productization, and production support.
Collaborate with GPU architects and hardware designers to define and implement hardware-software interfaces for next-generation processors.
Analyze interactions among workloads, clocks, voltages, power limits, thermals, telemetry, and system-level policies.
Investigate, triage, and resolve power, performance, stability, and reliability issues spanning firmware, drivers, hardware, and platform software.
Help execute validation strategies and automation for functional correctness, transition latency, performance-per-watt, and robustness across operating conditions.
Write clear technical documentation, interface definitions, for features.
Partner with distributed teams across architecture, ASIC, firmware, driver, validation, platform, and data-center systems.

What We Need To See

BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
2+ years of relevant industry experience, or strong coursework, internship, co-op, or project experience in system software.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Ads Tooling
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The ads system at TikTok operates on a massive scale and serves millions of advertisers, clients and influencers across the world. The quality of the ads system depends heavily on the underlying infrastructure that handles massive data. The USDS Ads team empowers TikTok's global monetization by efficiently delivering ads and content on TikTok.

Tooling is what makes changing that system fast — and safe. Ads correctness cannot be asserted by comparing an expected string to an actual one: ranking outputs are probabilistic, behavior is driven as much by configuration as by code, and a silent regression in a prediction pipeline costs revenue long before it triggers an alert. Off-the-shelf test frameworks don't cover this, so we build our own. You will build the platforms and tooling that let every engineer on the team validate their changes — automated validation across ads pipelines, and continuous system-health monitoring that protects business metrics. Just as importantly, you'll go looking for the manual, repetitive, and error-prone workflows our engineers live with today, and replace them with automation.

You'll join a team that invests in your growth — with mentorship from senior engineers, ownership of real surfaces from early on, and a clear path toward technical leadership.

Responsibilities:
- Build and own the internal tooling and platforms that power ads system validation — test frameworks, environment and data provisioning, assertion libraries, and self-service harnesses that let engineers validate changes without hand-rolling infrastructure each time.
- Identify inefficient engineering workflows and automate them away. Audit how the team actually works today — manual verification steps, repeated debugging rituals, slow feedback loops, high-toil release procedures — quantify the cost, and build the tooling that eliminates it.
- Build quality infrastructure for ads systems, including training/serving consistency checks, prediction-service invariant and fallback validation.
- Build automated system-health monitoring that surfaces regressions in business and quality metrics, routes findings to the owning engineer with enough context to act, and shortens time-to-detection.
- Integrate tooling into CI/CD as release gates, so validation runs by default rather than by remembering to run it.
- Treat internal engineers as your users — measure adoption, gather feedback, and iterate on developer experience rather than shipping tools and walking away.
- Bring in new ideas and tooling, including applying LLM and agent-based approaches to test generation, failure triage, and coverage analysis.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or above, major in computer science or related technical disciplines.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, developer tooling, quality engineering, or test infrastructure for complex and scalable distributed systems.
- Track record of building tooling or frameworks used by other engineers — not only authoring tests within an existing framework.
- Hands-on authorship of CI/CD pipelines including release-gating logic.
- Demonstrated instinct for spotting repetitive or manual engineering work and replacing it with automation, with measurable results.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in the Ads domain — auction mechanics, bidding, ranking, attribution, or billing.
- Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering-efficiency tooling, or test infrastructure adopted across a team or org.
- Experience testing or validating large-scale ranking and machine learning infrastructure, including model evaluation, A/B experiment correctness, or online/offline consistency.
- Applied LLM/agent tooling for engineering workflows, including structured-output schema design.
