Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. This is a high-ownership engineering role for someone who thinks in systems. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining DelRicht's data platform, cloud infrastructure, integration architecture, and AI-powered applications — working across every layer from source systems to operational tools.

Our environment is built on Google Cloud Platform and the broader Google ecosystem. The ideal candidate is deeply comfortable in that stack and brings hands-on experience building AI-augmented workflows using tools such as Vertex AI, Gemini API, Document AI, and LLM-based tooling including Claude and Claude Code.

Experience with Fivetran or comparable managed integration platforms

Role Summary
We are hiring a Software Engineer to build the automation that lets a small team deliver fraud and AML solutions to many clients at once.
You will build internal tooling the Solutions team uses every day — Claude Code plugins, skills and MCP servers in our internal plugin marketplace — and integrate them with our AI Sandbox, the Vera platform, and the APIs behind them. You will also work directly on client onboarding: standing up tenants from solution templates, parsing third-party data and responses, wiring up integrations, and validating end to end that the right alerts actually fire.
This is a production software engineering role. What we are really hiring for is the instinct to turn something one client needed into something every client gets. Machine learning experience is not required, and neither is a fraud or AML background — both are learnable, and we would rather have an engineer who ships.
This role is open at both junior and senior levels.

Primary responsibilities
Build Automation Tooling: Design and ship the plugins, skills and MCP servers the Solutions team runs — tenant creation, configuration copying, onboarding flows, on-call helpers — in Python and shell.
Make It Reusable: Turn one-off solutions into tooling that works for every client. This is the core of the job, not an afterthought.
Integrate with the Platform: Connect tooling to the AI Sandbox, Vera and internal platform APIs, and keep it working across sandbox, preprod and production tenants.
Support Client Onboarding: Work hands-on on live onboardings — tenant setup from templates, schema and response parsing, third-party integrations over SFTP and API, and end-to-end validation that the right alerts fire.
Serve Your Users: What you build is used by core engineering, product, delivery, customer support and technical account management. Understanding what each of them needs, and keeping them informed, is part of the work.
Own Your Projects: Scope, sequence and deliver your own work, and say clearly where it stands.

Requirements
Qualifications
Experience: At least 1 year of full-time professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems. Internships are not counted toward this minimum. We are open on level — we care more about what you have built than how long you have been building.
Education: BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering. MS preferred. We also consider other STEM degrees alongside a record of shipped production software.
Shipped Software: Demonstrated experience delivering working software end to end — not prototypes or notebooks.
Coding Proficiency: Strong, production-grade Python — the primary language for this team's automation and tooling. Java is expected for senior candidates and preferred for junior ones: our core platform is built in Java, and you will work across both over time. Comfort with shell, and with reading unfamiliar codebases, matters as much as either language.
Cloud and Containers: Experience with AWS and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
Built for Others: Evidence of building something other people then used — an internal tool, a library, a plugin, a template, a service another team depends on.
Collaboration and Ownership: Able to work across team boundaries, take end-to-end ownership, and operate where the path is not already defined.

Preferred qualifications
Java, if you are applying at a junior level — our core platform is built in it.
TypeScript — solution features often land in our front end.
LLM-powered agent workflows — LangChain/LangGraph, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling or RAG — for production or internal platforms.

Experience deploying or maintaining machine learning models in production.
Analytical databases and large-scale data exploration (ClickHouse or other columnar stores).

Domain knowledge in fraud or risk — a plus, never a requirement.

Total Compensation: Includes Base + Performance Bonus + Equity Options.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Discretionary Time Off Policy (DTO) and paid holidays.
Opportunities for R&D exploration and professional development.

We Are

The beginning of a new Data & AI decade that will reshape work and society has begun. Accenture is stepping boldly into this future with a clear strategy and purpose: to help clients optimize and reinvent their business with data & AI — backed by a $3B investment and commitment to our people to do industry-defining work.

You Are

As a Data Engineering, Management & Governance professional, you will play a pivotal role in building data solutions for ingestion, transformation, and structuring data, utilizing both vendor and open-source tools for building, migrating, and deploying data pipelines.

Position Responsibilities

Apply data engineering principles to create reusable workflows for data ingestion, quality assurance, transformation, and optimization.
Design, Build and test scalable data pipelines using extract, transform, and load tools, including validating outputs against source totals (e.g., financial balances, transaction counts).
Document requirements and technical design documents.
Deploy solutions to production environments using CICD dev ops and cloud architecture principles.
Migrate data from legacy data warehouses using cloud architecture principles
Automate the flow of data for consumption.
Build business processes that enable data governance (e.g., stewardship of financial, customer, or product master data).
Design and advise on data quality rules and set up effective data compliance policies.

Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience on Cloud and Big Data technologies such as serverless data processing, Spark/SparkSQL, batch and streaming services, event-driven data pipelines, cloud databases, and programming languages such as Python, SQL, and Node.js
Minimum 3 years of experience in following:

Cloud data storage, data management and data services

Data supply chain including streaming pipelines to help address the challenges of acquiring data, evaluating its value, distilling & analyzing.
Examine data from multiple sources, and share insights which provide competitive advantage

Devops and CI/CD processes

Scheduling and orchestration

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Ability to lead and effectively facilitate design sessions with business customers and the BI team to derive data requirements and data design information

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Our Public Cloud engineering teams are responsible for innovating and maintaining a large scale distributed systems engineering platform that ships hundreds of features to production for tens of millions of users across all industries every day. Our users count on our platform to be highly reliable, lightning fast, supremely secure, and to preserve all of their customizations and integrations every time we ship. You will need deep experience with concurrency, large scale systems, proficiency with solving real-world data management challenges, a strong understanding of how to craft solutions that are highly available, and a proven ability to design, develop, and optimize the core back-end systems.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Deliver cloud infrastructure automation tools, frameworks, workflows, and validation platforms on our public cloud platforms
Designing, developing, debugging, and operating resilient distributed systems that run across thousands of compute nodes in multiple data centers
Using and contributing to open source technology
Developing Infrastructure-as-Code
Writing microservices on containerization frameworks such as Kubernetes, Docker, Mesos
Resolving complex technical issues and drive innovations that improve system availability, resilience, and performance
Balancing live-site management, feature delivery, and retirement of technical debt
Participate in the team's on-call rotation to address complex problems in real-time and keep services operational and highly available

You're Our Person If You Have

Minimum of 3 years of backend software development experience (Python) working with Cloud Architecture
In-depth, hands-on experience with Linux Systems Administration and Troubleshooting, servers, and Cloud architecture. Good knowledge of Linux internals.
Proven professional work experience with Python. In-depth understanding of OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and concurrency.
Public cloud engineering on GCP, AWS, and or Azure platforms. Cloud provisioning, infrastructure, and migration at cloud scale.
Use of AI assisted development tools to automate DNS and infrastructure management.
Solid understanding of configuring, deploying, managing, and maintaining large cloud-hosted systems.
Experience with container and orchestration systems like Kubernetes, Docker, etc.
Experience with infrastructure automation tools like Splunk, Puppet, Spinnaker, Terraform, git, etc.
Strong understanding of fundamental network technologies like DNS, Load Balancing, SSL, TCP/IP, SQL, HTTP, Switches, Routers.
CI/CD experience with tools like Jenkins, and Travis CI.
Implementation experience of large infrastructure projects.
A continuous learner, a critical thinker, and a team player with excellent communication skills.
Embrace a culture and work environment that promotes diversity and inclusion.
Configuration management with open-source tools, ideally Puppet, Chef, Salt, or Ansible.
Experience maintaining monitoring platforms like Grafana.
Experience with Agile development methodology and Test Driven Development

Even Better If You Have

Experience using AWS Route 53.
Working in high-availability, 24x7x365 large-scale multi-datacenter environment
Highly skilled in packet analysis, network analysis tools, troubleshooting, and analytical fault diagnosis.
Security hardening of network infrastructure, such as DNSSEC

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Security
jobs.description:
Flexcompute is a cutting-edge technology startup that specializes in ultra-fast simulation technology. Our products are utilized by companies in designing and optimizing technology products, with applications ranging from designing airplanes and cars to wind turbines and quantum computing chips. Our customer base includes both household names and startups in emerging industries. Our company was founded by world-renowned leaders in simulation technology from Stanford University and MIT. Backed by top VC firms, we are poised to disrupt the billion-dollar engineering simulation industry with our fast-growing trajectory.

We are seeking a hands-on software engineer to work on security projects across our web application, AWS, and on-premises high-performance computing environment. This is a crucial role in supporting the company’s growth into regulated industries.

What You Will Do

Build and integrate technical security features and controls into our web application and internal administration platforms
Implement and maintain AWS security controls, including IAM, encryption, backups, logging, monitoring, and alerting
Securely orchestrate customer jobs and data across cloud and HPC environments
Build and respond to alerts from security logs covering both cloud and on-premises hardware
Deploy and manage vulnerability scanning tooling; collaborate with developers to triage and remediate findings
Fix and validate remediations of penetration test findings
Harden and secure on-premises HPC infrastructure
Maintain and improve compliance tooling integrations, identify gaps, and drive remediation efforts

Requirements

Strong hands-on engineering experience in at least one of:

Backend software engineering
DevOps / Infrastructure engineering
Security engineering, with a focus on building than maintenance

Experience securing cloud environments, ideally AWS

Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform)

Experience deploying or working with CI/CD pipelines

Working knowledge of application and infrastructure security fundamentals

Must be a US Citizen or Green Card Holder

What We're Looking For

We are looking for backend software engineers, devops engineers, or security engineers, as long as you are hands on and are interested in security. You will join a team of infrastructure engineers in an engineering-first company which is at the frontiers of HPC-based simulations. This is a role primarily focused on writing code.

Ideally you have experience in one or more of: building NIST 800-171 or NIST 800-53, compliance automation platforms, infrastructure-as-code, AWS security, developing CI/CD pipelines

Friendly, thoughtful, and intelligent coworkers.

SET THE COURSE

This position helps bring Tommy Bahama’s island-lifestyle brand to life online, contributing to intuitive and inspiring digital experiences that deepen customer engagement and drive B2C eCommerce growth. Working closely with and learning from the Lead Front End Web Developer and senior team members, this role builds foundational front-end skills while supporting Creative, Marketing, and Development in delivering an online shopping journey that reflects the quality customers expect from the brand.

What You’ll Build

Product pages that make it easy to fall for the next hero print. Search and navigation that get customers to what they want, fast. Seasonal launches and campaigns that land flawlessly on day one. Checkout flows that stay out of the customer’s way. These are the moments you’ll build, refine, and own.

WHY JOIN US

You’ll join a small, tight-knit development team where your ideas are heard and your code ships fast. We build with modern tools — Angular, TypeScript, and AI-assisted development — on a brand with real momentum and a customer base that notices the details. You’ll get hands-on mentorship from experienced developers, exposure to real production work from day one, and a clear path to grow your skills and take on more ownership over time.

BE THE ISLAND GUIDE

Key Responsibilities

You’ll help turn creative vision into a shopping experience customers love — writing code for features big and small, with support and feedback from senior developers along the way.

Develop front‑end features using the Angular framework, TypeScript/NgRx, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, translating creative designs into clean, working code for a B2C eCommerce platform, with guidance and code review from senior developers.
Integrate and consume SAP REST OCC APIs to support dynamic application functionality.
Build and maintain integrations with third‑party platforms including Adobe Dynamic Media, Google Maps, Bazaarvoice, Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Manager, Klaviyo, and others.
Support CMS‑driven site content and develop new CMS components, templates, and features.
Deliver a polished, pixel-perfect experience across every browser, platform, and viewport our customers use.
Develop and maintain responsive, mobile‑first website experiences optimized for phones, tablets, and desktops.
Implement SEO‑focused development practices for eCommerce, including SSR, structured data, canonical URLs, sitemaps, and an understanding of AEO/GEO considerations.
Execute time‑sensitive website updates such as promotional events, product launches, and seasonal campaigns.
Assist with gathering requirements and communicating with non‑technical stakeholders, with support from senior developers on more complex or ambiguous requests.
Troubleshoot and resolve straightforward usability, performance, and functional issues, escalating more complex problems to senior developers.
Team up with Creative to bring bold designs to life — building, implementing, and testing pages, interactive components, and UI enhancements customers will actually notice.
Stay curious about emerging web technologies and practices, and bring new ideas to the team for discussion.
Build and test UI components for WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance, including semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, and screen reader compatibility.
Write and maintain automated unit and end-to-end tests (e.g., Jasmine/Karma, Cypress) to ensure code quality and prevent regressions.
Implement and maintain analytics and tag management integrations (e.g., Adobe Analytics/GA4, Adobe Launch/Google Tag Manager) to support site tracking and reporting.
Manage day-to-day tasks with guidance from the Lead Front End Web Developer and project management, prioritizing work as directed.
Actively participate in code reviews — both giving and receiving feedback — to build technical skills and absorb team coding standards and best practices.

Essentials For Life In Paradise

1–3 years of hands‑on web development experience
Core Technical Skills: Foundational knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; exposure to Angular and TypeScript (through coursework, projects, or professional experience)
Preferred Technical Skills: NgRx, REST APIs, SCSS, Git, JSON, familiarity with a CMS platform such as Adobe Experience Manager, and interest in using AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT)
Accessibility, Testing & Analytics: Willingness to learn and apply WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines, automated testing frameworks (e.g., Jasmine/Karma, Cypress), and analytics/tag management tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, GA4, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager); prior exposure is a plus
Exposure to designing, developing, or testing B2C eCommerce or other consumer-facing websites (preferred, not required)
Familiarity with CMS platforms or components is a plus
Ability to collaborate effectively with external vendors and internal business stakeholders
Eagerness to learn, take feedback well, and grow into greater ownership of tasks and technical challenges over time
Working knowledge of relational databases (plus)
Experience with SAP Commerce Cloud Composable Framework (plus)
Familiarity with IDEs such as Eclipse or Visual Studio Code

Rate Range: $93,000.00 to $115,000.00 Annually

Multiple factors will vary the applicable rate of pay for this role, including an individual’s experience, knowledge, and skillset, as well as work location and available budget.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Clinically AI

Clinically AI is a rapidly scaling healthcare AI company transforming how behavioral health and healthcare organizations manage clinical documentation, compliance workflows, chart auditing, and operational efficiency through artificial intelligence.

Our platform helps clinicians, compliance teams, administrators, and healthcare organizations reduce administrative burden, improve documentation quality, strengthen audit readiness, and operate more efficiently. We operate at the intersection of AI, healthcare operations, workflow design, and real-world clinical execution, where adoption, trust, usability, and measurable outcomes matter.

The Opportunity

This opportunity places you at the center of a rapidly scaling engineering organization tackling some of the most ambitious challenges in healthcare technology.

We are seeking a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and scale the full technology ecosystem behind our platform — React front-ends, Node services, mobile apps, browser extensions, and high-performance AI systems — with state-of-the-art developer-focused AI tools that dramatically increase your velocity and technical reach.

This is a critical role for someone who can ship across the full stack, partner directly with clinicians and administrators to see firsthand how their work improves care, and take on ownership quickly as the team scales. You will work closely with product, design, AI/ML, and customer-facing teams to translate real clinician needs into high-impact solutions.

This is not a narrowly-scoped, single-stack engineering role. You should be comfortable moving across front-end, back-end, mobile, and AI-driven systems, leveraging modern AI developer tools to move fast, and operating with real autonomy in a fast-growing, high-velocity environment.

We believe successful engineers here are defined not by narrow specialization, but by ownership, technical judgment, and the real-world impact of what they ship — whether that's leading a single feature or, over time, owning an entire product area. Whether your path leads toward principal engineering, staff IC, or future team leadership, you'll have the autonomy, resources, and AI-enabled leverage to get there faster.

What You'll Own

Ship across the stack.
Architect, develop, and ship new features across our full technology ecosystem — React front-ends, Node services, mobile apps (iOS/Android), browser extensions, and AI-driven infrastructure — owning major components from design through deployment with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
Partner cross-functionally.
Collaborate directly with product, design, AI/ML, and customer-facing teams to translate real clinician needs into high-impact solutions.
Accelerate with AI.
Leverage advanced developer-focused AI tools to speed up development, improve code quality, and strengthen system reliability.
Drive innovation.
Contribute to internal hackathons, rapid prototyping, and stay ahead of industry trends to identify technologies and opportunities that set the standard.
Shape technical strategy.
Lead technical decisions, contribute to architectural strategy, and help define engineering patterns as we grow the platform.
Mentor and elevate the team.
Mentor other engineers, raise the bar on best practices, and help build a strong, supportive engineering culture.
Own end-to-end.
Drive end-to-end ownership of key product areas and help build and scale new teams as the company grows.

What We're Looking For

Full-Stack Range.

The Role at a Glance

The Agentic Platform Engineer builds the shared cloud platform and engineering foundations that enable AIDA teams to deliver secure, scalable AI agents and agentic applications. This role focuses on the runtime, tooling, and guardrails that agents depend on: model access, tool and context integration, orchestration frameworks, evaluation, observability, and DevSecOps on AWS.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and maintain shared platform services that support agent runtimes, LLM gateways, model routing, prompt/context management, and tool integration.
Standardize agentic delivery patterns including tool/function calling, MCP-style tool servers, retrieval pipelines, memory and state management, and multi-agent orchestration.
Implement guardrails for agent safety: input/output filtering, prompt injection defenses, human-in-the-loop approval paths, sandboxed execution, and least-privilege agent identities.
Improve developer productivity through CI/CD, environment templates, agent scaffolding, SDKs, and platform automation.
Build observability and evaluation for agentic systems: tracing, token and cost telemetry, latency, quality/eval harnesses, and regression testing of prompts and agent behavior.
Manage cost-aware model consumption, rate limits, caching, and secure secrets/access patterns across environments.

Experience with API infrastructure, containers, deployment pipelines, and operational tooling.

Experience supporting production systems, data platforms, and AI/ML workloads.

Hi ,

Hope You are doing great !!

We are currently hiring for the following opportunity that may align with your expertise: please let me know if you are interested or open to the job market so you can reply over the same email or you can directly reach me at mohan@hireontech.com / 214 7719902.

Role/Skills:
Data Engineer, GCP, HL7, HIN Transaction

Work Site:
Nashville, Tennessee( Hybrid Role - 3 Days Onsite)

Detailed Job Description :

As a Consulting Data Engineer, you will architect, build, and optimize the next generation of our real-time healthcare data platforms and event-driven architectures. You will play a foundational role in moving our clinical, operational, and financial data away from legacy batch processing toward high-throughput, near-zero-latency streaming pipelines.
In this role, you will champion modern data engineering practices, design highly scalable cloud-native pipelines, and mentor a growing team of engineers. You will bridge the gap between complex electronic health records (EHR) and data consumer-enabling data scientists, software engineers, and clinical analysts to securely access, stream, and query compliant data at scale to improve patient outcomes and operational efficiency.
Core Responsibilities

Architect Real-Time Pipelines: Design, implement, and monitor high-throughput, fault-tolerant streaming pipelines that ingest and process millions of concurrent healthcare data events (e.g., live telemetry, HL7 feeds, ADT messages).
Scale Google Cloud Infrastructure: Build and maintain scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud data infrastructure using Google Cloud healthcare-native tools and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Enforce Healthcare Compliance & Security: Uphold strict data security protocols (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC2) by building robust data lakehouse architectures that enforce PHI/PII masking, role-based access control (RBAC), and encryption at rest and in transit.
Enable Self-Service Data & Interoperability: Build out streaming data ecosystems that support modern healthcare interoperability, managing real-time data catalogs and schema registries.
Promote Code Excellence: Write modular, highly reusable, and performance-tested code; lead code reviews and establish standardized CI/CD automated deployment workflows.
Optimize Data Reliability: Set and champion strict SLAs for clinical data delivery, establish automated data-quality testing, and implement proactive system monitoring and alerting.
Collaborate & Mentor: Work closely with Data Architects, Clinical Product Managers, and AI/ML teams to translate healthcare requirements into technical blueprints while mentoring mid-level engineers.

Required Qualifications

Experience & Education

13+ years of experience in dedicated data engineering, data architecture, or distributed systems software engineering roles.
4+ years of experience specifically within the healthcare domain (payer, provider, digital health, or health tech).
Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer (or equivalent proven expert-level architecture experience on GCP).

True Streaming Focus

Advanced Event-Driven Architecture: Mastery of high-volume streaming technologies including Apache Kafka and Google Cloud Pub/Sub for decoupled, real-time message routing.
Stream Processing: Deep hands-on experience with Apache Flink or Google Cloud Dataflow (Apache Beam) for real-time streaming, complex event processing (CEP), windowing, and streaming data transformations.

Healthcare-Specific Tech Stack

Interoperability Standards: Deep expertise working with FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) JSON structures, HL7 v2/v3 messaging, and DICOM imaging standard streams.
GCP Healthcare Tools: Hands-on experience implementing and scaling the Google Cloud Healthcare API (specifically FHIR stores and HL7v2 stores).
EHR Integration: Experience integrating streaming pipelines with major EHR systems (such as Epic, Cerner, or Meditech).

Cloud Ecosystem & Modern Tooling

Google Cloud Ecosystem: Technical mastery of BigQuery (including partitioning, clustering, and streaming inserts), Cloud Storage, Dataproc, and Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow).
Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java, with a strong focus on writing optimized code for distributed computing platforms (like Spark or Beam).
Modern Data Stack & Modeling: Mastery of modern analytics engineering frameworks (such as dbt), dimensional data modeling, and lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).
DevOps & Automation: Robust experience building automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and managing infrastructure using Terraform.

Candidate will support advanced technology radar programs by validating user-facing and backend software that interfaces with high-performance sensor and data processing systems. These applications are tightly coupled with real-time data pipelines and hardware systems, requiring a strong understanding of system behavior, performance testing, and automated data flow validation.

Proficiency in testing software built in modern C++ or writing test scripts to interface with C++ binaries.
Strong experience with Python or other scripting languages for test automation development.
Experience with Linux-based environments, including shell scripting and system monitoring.
Experience testing performance-sensitive, distributed, or systems-oriented applications.
Familiarity with tracking and test management tools (e.g., Jira or equivalent bug-tracking systems).
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
US Citizenship is required and ability to obtain and maintain and DoD Secret clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidate with additional skills in the following is preferred:

Experience setting up test automation within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker).
Experience with messaging frameworks (e.g., ZeroMQ or similar) for simulating and testing distributed systems.
Exposure to radar, RF, or sensor systems and hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) testing frameworks.
Experience testing frontend web applications built with Angular TS, Flask, or SCSS.

HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital, Inc. is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (Ticker: HASI). For more information, please visit hasi.com.

Position Summary

The Platform Engineer is a member of the Data Platform Engineering team, which builds, operates, secures, and evolves HASI's enterprise data technology stack. The team owns the technology platforms that power the business — including Snowflake, Airflow, SQL Server, Power BI Service, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, Power Automate, Jupyter Hub, Business Objects, Kyriba, Sigma/Thoughtworks, and the broader data warehouse and metadata/catalog tooling ecosystem — not the business data or business logic that runs on top of them.

This role manages and enhances the platforms that data engineering relies on day to day, with primary focus on Snowflake, Airflow, and Microsoft Fabric. The Platform Engineer evaluates new and emerging technologies in the market, builds standard operating procedures (SOPs) for platform usage, and partners closely with the Data Engineering team to establish repeatable processes and code controls that make pipelines, models, and integrations reusable across projects.

Key Responsibilities

Manage, maintain, and continuously enhance the data engineering platform stack, with particular focus on Snowflake, Airflow, and Microsoft Fabric
Evaluate new and emerging technologies in the market and recommend platform additions, replacements, or upgrades that improve capability, cost, or performance
Author and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for platform usage, onboarding, and administration across the data platform toolset
Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and implement new processes, coding standards, and code controls that promote reusability and consistency across pipelines and integrations
Configure, administer, and tune Snowflake environments, including warehouses, roles, resource monitors, and access controls, to balance performance and cost.
Build, monitor, and maintain Airflow orchestration environments, including DAG deployment standards, environment configuration, and job reliability
Support and administer Microsoft Fabric workloads, ensuring proper configuration, capacity management, and integration with existing platforms
Own platform automation and CI/CD pipelines used to deploy and promote platform changes across development, QA, and production environments
Contribute to metadata and catalog tooling to improve data discoverability, lineage, and governance across the platform
Monitor platform availability, performance, and cost, and proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact users
Support upgrades and lifecycle management of platform components, including patching, version upgrades, and deprecations
Collaborate with security teams to implement and maintain platform security controls, access management, and compliance requirements
Document platform architecture, configurations, and standards to support operational maturity and knowledge sharing across the team

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field
3+ years of professional experience in platform engineering, data engineering, or data infrastructure roles
Hands-on experience administering and optimizing Snowflake, including warehouse sizing, cost management, security, and performance tuning
Experience building, deploying, and operating Apache Airflow environments and orchestrating production data pipelines
Experience with Microsoft Fabric or comparable modern data platform/lakehouse technologies
Familiarity with CI/CD tooling and practices for platform and infrastructure automation
Working knowledge of SQL Server, data warehouse infrastructure, and cloud-based data storage and compute environments

jobs.title: Software Engineer I, Marketplace Makers
jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the Role?

Etsy is looking for a Software Engineer I to join the Marketplace Makers team. Marketplace Makers are the sellers who create the best buyer experiences on Etsy, and our team builds the programs and tools that recognize and grow them. We work across experiences such as the Star Seller program as well as seller tooling in Shop Manager.

As a Software Engineer I, you will build and ship full-stack web features in PHP and React/TypeScript, learn how Etsy's platform works end to end, and grow your craft with support from a team that pairs, reviews, and teaches. This is an early-career role: we are looking for someone with a solid programming foundation who is eager to learn how production software is built at scale.

This is a full time role reporting to the Engineering Manager of Marketplace Makers.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

We are a multi-functional product team distributed across the US and Mexico. The team is composed of software engineers, a product manager, a product designer, a researcher, an analyst, and a copywriter.
We work on problems that directly affect millions of sellers: how they earn and keep Star Seller status, and how we motivate the practices, like fast responses and on-time shipping, that create great buyer experiences.
We ship in small increments behind feature flags, run A/B experiments to validate changes, and use data to decide what to build next.
At Etsy, we believe that code is craft and that small, empowered, self-motivated teams can do big things. We take advantage of our continuous deployment system and cultivate a blameless culture based on trust and a commitment to learning. Learn more on our engineering blog: Code as Craft.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Build and maintain well-scoped product features across our PHP backend and React/TypeScript frontend, with guidance from senior engineers.
Translate designs and product requirements into production-ready code, and write tests that keep it working.
Participate in code review, both giving and receiving feedback.
Help instrument and analyze A/B experiments on seller-facing features such as the Star Seller dashboard and seller inbox.
Investigate bugs and support issues, and communicate clearly about what you find and how you fixed it.
Collaborate with product, design, research, and analytics partners in planning, standups, and retrospectives.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

A foundation in software engineering, from a degree in computer science or a related field, a bootcamp, or equivalent self-directed experience.
Some experience building web applications, through internships, co-ops, personal projects, or professional work, in languages such as PHP, Python, Ruby, Java, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
Curiosity about how things work and the persistence to debug until you understand the root cause.
Comfort asking questions, taking feedback, and learning in the open.
An interest in solving user problems and in writing code that is readable and maintainable.
Clear written and spoken communication with both technical and non-technical teammates.

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

Geo-1: 120,000.00 - 162,000.00 USD Annual
Geo-2: 108,000.00 - 146,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview or hiring process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs. While Etsy supports visa sponsorship, sponsorship opportunities may be limited to certain roles and skills.

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree.

jobs.title: Electrical Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
SIEMAG TECBERG Inc. is part of a global engineering group that delivers specialized mechanical and electrical solutions for industrial applications. The company focuses on advanced hoisting, material handling, and automation technologies that support safe, efficient, and reliable operations. Team members collaborate across disciplines to design, implement, and maintain high-performance systems for a wide range of customers. SIEMAG TECBERG Inc. offers opportunities to work with modern automation and control technologies while contributing to complex, technically challenging projects.
Role Description
The Electrical Automation Engineer is a full-time, on-site position based in Newburgh, IN. This role is responsible for designing, programming, and commissioning automation and control systems for industrial equipment and processes. Daily tasks include developing electrical schematics, configuring PLCs and HMIs, integrating sensors and drives, and ensuring proper functionality and safety of automated systems. The engineer will diagnose and resolve control and electrical issues, optimize process performance, and provide technical support during installation, testing, and maintenance. Collaboration with mechanical engineers, project managers, and external partners is expected, along with preparing documentation, reports, and user instructions for installed systems.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Electrical Engineering skills, including familiarity with industrial power distribution, control circuits, and relevant standards.
Candidates should possess Automation and Process Control skills, such as PLC and HMI programming, drive and motion control configuration, and system integration.
Candidates should possess Troubleshooting skills, including systematic fault diagnosis, root cause analysis, and resolution of electrical and control issues.
Candidates should possess Robotics-related skills, including understanding of robotic interfaces, programming basics, and integration into automated production or handling systems.
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with industrial communication protocols (e.g., Ethernet/IP, Profibus, Modbus) and safety systems is highly beneficial.
Ability to read and create electrical schematics and technical documentation. AutoCad Electrical and/or EPlan experience is a plus.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work safely on-site and collaborate in multidisciplinary teams.

jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (TS/SCI)

Location: Norfolk / Virginia Beach, VA (on-site, 20 to 30% travel)

Salary: $180,000 to $220,000 base depending on level, plus competitive equity

Our client builds software and hardware that help people on the front lines deter and de-escalate conflict with America's adversaries. Their tools support maritime vigilance, counter misinformation and collect non-traditional intelligence, across all U.S. service branches, multiple combatant commands, partner nations and the intelligence community. They have been profitable since 2021.

The team is mission-driven and believes in public service, and they put serious effort into improving the technology the government uses.

The Role

Our client is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to be the technical owner for mission-critical national security software deployments. You will sit between engineering and the customer, turning operator requirements into production-grade software deployed directly into government environments. This is hands-on, high-stakes engineering work that shapes U.S. defense outcomes.

What you'll own

Deploying and sustaining production software inside government and DoD IT environments, end to end from requirements through fielding
Acting as the primary technical contact for mission owners, operators and intel analysts, turning ambiguous field requirements into shipped software
Scoping and building low-cost pilots with government mission teams (pre-sales) and running full technical deployments after contract close (post-sales)
Writing hands-on backend code (Python preferred) across customer use cases, including large-scale text, multimedia and geospatial data
Navigating government IT ecosystems (RMF, IdAM, SIEM, CDSs) and working with product, design and platform engineering teams

What We're Looking For

Active TS clearance with SCI eligibility (candidates eligible and willing to obtain clearance may be considered if technically exceptional)
4 to 6 years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture or forward deployed roles within government or DoD environments
Full-stack engineering experience with strong backend fundamentals, Python preferred (assessed through a backend coding and algorithms interview)
Proven experience deploying software inside government or DoD IT environments (RMF, IdAM, SIEM, CDSs)
Ability to own a project end to end in a field-facing or customer-embedded context with minimal oversight
Willingness to travel 20 to 30% to customer and classified operational sites

Tech stack

Python, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS S3, DoD RMF, Government IT systems (IdAM, SIEM, CDS)

jobs.title: Software Engineer 2
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Software Engineer 2 contributes to the technology platforms that support the secure exchange of healthcare transactions between providers, payers, and business partners. This role helps deliver reliable, scalable, and efficient solutions while supporting the organization's modernization journey from legacy applications to cloud-native technologies. The ideal candidate enjoys solving technical challenges, demonstrates ongoing technical development through coursework, projects, internships, or hands-on experience, and contributes to the delivery and support of business-critical applications and services.

The Software Engineer 2 develops, enhances, and supports applications, integrations, and platform capabilities that enable healthcare transaction processing and business operations. Working closely with engineers, architects, product teams, and operations partners, this role contributes to both cloud modernization initiatives and ongoing enhancements of existing platforms.

This position provides hands-on experience across software development, system integration, automation, operational support, and cloud technologies. The engineer is expected to independently investigate technical challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and apply sound engineering practices to deliver secure, maintainable, and reliable solutions.

This position follows a hybrid work arrangement in Louisville, KY or Nashville, TN, with an expectation of 1-2 days per week onsite.

Use Your Skills To Make An Impact

Solution Development & Delivery

Develop, test, enhance, and support application, integration, batch, and API solutions across modern and legacy platforms.
Partner with engineers, architects, and product teams to deliver enhancements and modernization initiatives.
Troubleshoot application, processing, and integration issues and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.

Modernization & Engineering Excellence

Contribute to cloud modernization efforts, platform simplification initiatives, and reduction of technical debt.
Develop or enhance automation and tooling that improve operational efficiency and solution reliability.
Continuously learn and apply new technologies, engineering practices, and development approaches.

Collaboration & Operational Support

Collaborate with technology and business partners to deliver secure and reliable solutions.
Support production stability through monitoring, testing, troubleshooting, and incident resolution activities.
Participate in code reviews, knowledge sharing, and team discussions to strengthen engineering practices.

Required Qualifications

This is an entry-level opportunity
open to candidates with relevant software development knowledge and hands-on experience gained through internships, coursework, projects, technical training, or other practical learning experiences. Professional work experience is not required.

Associate's degree in Computer Science
Foundational software development knowledge gained through education, internships, projects, or professional experience.
Hands-on use of .NET/C# and SQL through coursework, internships, projects, technical training, or professional work.
Evaluating technical challenges, investigating root causes, and recommending solutions.
Demonstrated application of new technologies, tools, and processes through coursework, projects, internships, or other hands-on experiences.
Communicates technical information effectively and collaborates with team members and business partners to support solution delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, or similar programming technologies through coursework, projects, internships, technical training, or other hands-on learning opportunities.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, APIs, system integrations, or enterprise applications.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, or DevOps practices.
Exposure to healthcare technology, EDI transactions, or regulated environments.
Interest in cloud-native technologies, automation, and modern software engineering practices.

jobs.description:
About Us:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Ideal Background:

This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree.

Project Overview:

As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go.
Evaluate and refine AI-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance AI-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks.
Build agents and automated verification tools in Python that can verify the quality of code and identify error patterns.
Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them.
Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task.

Required Skills:

Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more)
Strong expertise in Python with deep knowledge of frameworks, tooling, and best practices for building production-grade software.
Experience building full-stack applications and deploying scalable software using modern languages and tools.
Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment.
Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales.

Engagement Details:

Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week
Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave)
Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit)
Location: Candidates must be based in the United States

Evaluation Process:

The application process takes 15–30 minutes.
Completion of an AI video interview is required.

jobs.description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world's leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

About the Role:

We're looking for a high-taste engineer with a strong eye for quality — someone who's worked hands-on with preference data and rubric creation, and knows what separates a good example from a great one. You communicate clearly and can synthesize complex technical work the way a strong MAI dev would: concise, structured, and easy for others to act on. You're comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and default to shipping over deliberating.

Design, refine, and iterate on rubrics and evaluation criteria for preference data
Review and label data with a high bar for quality, catching subtle issues others might miss
Build and maintain pipelines/infra that support data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows
Synthesize findings from data work into clear write-ups, updates, or recommendations for the team
Collaborate closely with researchers/engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes

Required Skills:

Proficiency in Python (especially building/maintaining pipelines and infra) or Typescript (experience contributing to or navigating large codebases like VSCode a plus)
Hands-on experience with preference data collection and/or rubric creation
Strong written and verbal communication — able to distill technical work into clear, actionable summaries
Demonstrated high-taste judgment — able to articulate why something is good, not just that it is.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

Work in a fully remote environment.
Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

**Location:** Remote, US
  
**Employment:** Full-time

### **Overview**

We are working with an AI-driven company developing healthcare software that automates clinical documentation through real-time transcription, AI note generation, and EHR integration, supporting practices nationwide. The small, versatile engineering team works across all platform layers on a multi-product system.

### **Role Highlights**

Seeking an experienced engineer to boost product delivery, strengthen platform stability, and drive platform consolidation. The role involves developing features, resolving issues, reducing technical debt, and improving infrastructure with a focus on AI integration.

### **Responsibilities**

* Deliver end-to-end features across products swiftly.
* Own outcomes impacting customers and business, handling incidents and bugs.
* Collaborate with product and customer teams on scope and requirements.
* Identify and address technical debt and infrastructure gaps.
* Lead complex, multi-sprint initiatives with ambiguity.
* Improve team standards: code quality, deployment, testing, and AI workflows.

### **Candidate Profile**

* Skilled in working across systems and layers with deep expertise.
* Capable of making subsystem decisions, troubleshooting, and documenting trade-offs.
* Comfortable with unfamiliar systems and quick experiments.
* Uses AI daily for coding, design, and analysis; judicious in AI application.
* Mentors peers through reviews and sharing knowledge.
* Proactive, positive, and solution-oriented.

### **Qualifications**

**Must-Haves**

* Daily AI tool usage and team AI adoption experience
* 5+ years’ software development
* Strong TypeScript and React skills
* Experience with Node.js & Express
* Familiar with cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
* Docker/containerization experience
* Cross-system working experience
* Independent problem-solving in small teams

**Nice-to-Haves**

* WebSockets or real-time communication
* Speech-to-text, NLP, or AI/ML experience
* Healthcare or regulated industry familiarity

### **Tech Stack**

* TypeScript (full stack)
* React, Vite, Tailwind CSS
* Node.js, Express, WebSockets
* Azure, GitHub Actions

### **Why Join?**

* Make a meaningful impact in healthcare workflows
* Quick pathway from idea to product
* Tackle real-time audio, AI, and platform unification challenges
* AI-embedded engineering culture

### **Benefits**

* Competitive salary
* Health, dental, vision
* 401(k)
* Remote-first environment
* AI tools subscription support

jobs.description:
Datadog & Observability Consultant | Site Reliability EngineerOverview

* Job Title: Datadog & Observability Consultant (Site Reliability Engineer)
* Location: Remote (U.S.) – East Coast hours
* Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week minimum
* Salary Range: $70-$85/hour (based on experience)
* Total Compensation Package: Hourly contract compensation
* Employment: 14-month contract, with strong potential for extension
* Required Experience: Hands-on Datadog and observability experience (ideally 10+ years in IT, 3+ years with Datadog)

About This Opportunity

A Fortune 500 insurance company needs a Datadog expert to give its DevOps team clear visibility across code pipelines, applications, databases, and environments (production, failover, UAT, and QA). You'll build the dashboards, monitors, and log pipelines that help the team spot and diagnose issues before users notice. This is a hands-on, independent role on a small, highly technical DevOps team.

Responsibilities

* Set up tracking, metrics, and evaluation guardrails for AI models and automated workflows
* Design custom dashboards, composite monitors, and anomaly alerts (e.g., Watchdog)
* Build and replicate structured log pipelines, indexing rules, and metric aggregations for new projects and infrastructure
* Monitor code pipelines and system performance across multiple environments
* Quickly identify and diagnose production issues using observability practices
* Flag issues early and keep the DevOps lead informed

Required Qualifications

* **Must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship**
* Prior hands-on experience with Datadog in an enterprise environment
* Strong grasp of observability: logging, metrics, monitoring, and alerting
* Background as a Site Reliability Engineer or in a similar role
* Self-starter who works independently and takes ownership of their work
* Able to work East Coast business hours

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience monitoring AI/ML models or automated workflows
* Scripting experience (e.g., Python)
* Experience in large, regulated organizations (insurance, financial services)

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer, 2027 New Grad
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

At Brain Co., new-grad engineers contribute to real production systems and see their work deployed at global scale.

About The Role

As an AI Platform Engineer at Brain Co., you’ll help build the backend services and shared capabilities behind our AI products. You’ll solve technical problems, develop reliable software, and collaborate with Product and ML teams to bring AI applications to enterprise and government customers.

This full-time, entry-level role is designed for candidates completing a bachelor’s degree in Spring 2027. You’ll turn cutting-edge AI into systems that important institutions can depend on, taking ownership of clearly scoped projects involving APIs, distributed services, and developer tooling. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, with support through code reviews, design discussions, and ongoing collaboration.

What You’ll Work On

Design and build backend services and data pipelines that power Brain Co.’s AI products. Own scoped projects across implementation, testing, and maintenance, with guidance from experienced engineers.
Build tools that accelerate AI product development, including ML experiment tracking, artifact management, and automated training and evaluation pipelines.
Help build reliable systems for enterprise and government customers, with attention to testing and handling common failure cases.
Design modular, reusable components and clean APIs (REST, gRPC). Use profiling to improve application latency and throughput.
Partner with engineering, Product, and ML teams to build shared platform capabilities that remove bottlenecks and reduce the time it takes to ship new AI products.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You…

Expect to complete a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field in Spring 2027.
Have solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and databases, with familiarity with API design and testing.
Are comfortable writing and debugging code in at least one language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Rust, Java, or C++.
Have built a backend service, API, data-intensive application, or developer tool through an internship, research, coursework, or a personal project.
Are curious about how systems work under the hood and eager to learn distributed-systems concepts such as consistency, failure handling, retries, and idempotency.
Care about building intuitive, well-documented, and maintainable APIs and shared tools for internal ML and product teams.
Enjoy breaking down open-ended problems into clear technical designs, reasoning from first principles, and communicating your ideas.
Take ownership of your work, care about its quality over time, and actively seek feedback and guidance when needed.

Job Details & Benefits

Eligibility: Completing a bachelor’s degree in Spring 2027.
Competitive full-time compensation and benefits
Support and feedback from experienced platform engineers
Opportunity to work on real production systems used globally
Meaningful ownership from day one, with room to grow alongside the team
Daily lunches (if onsite)

Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For

The Software Engineer, I analyzes, designs, develops, and maintains software solutions for the organization’s products and systems. Collaborates on system integrations of software and hardware to ensure optimal performance and program consistency. Develops, validates, and tests structures, user documentation, and software functionality. Work is reviewed for accuracy and adherence to established processes and guidelines.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Collaborates with team members to establish requirements for less complex design projects
Completes all phases of software engineering design projects, including coding, debugging, testing, and deployment
Conducts analysis of processes and systems, delivering results to key stakeholders
Analyzes and interprets results, recommending potential solutions for software and system improvements
Contributes to the development and testing of software solutions for various products, ensuring they meet quality and performance standards
Creates and maintains documentation for projects, including code, design specifications, and test results
Stays up to date with the latest technologies and software engineering methodologies, applying them to projects as needed
Reviews and evaluates changes or upgrades to existing designs or test processes
Exercises sound judgment in selecting appropriate methods and techniques for problem solving and solution delivery

This position requires hybrid (3 days/week in office) work in the Lincolnshire, IL office.

Required Qualifications

Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. Advanced Degree in relevant field is also acceptable
Relevant experience in software development or a related field
Equivalency: Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree
Experience with MS SQL Server, Appium and PyTest

Key Skills And Competencies

Successful completion of a Zebra Technologies Internship
Quantitative, analytical, and problem solving skills
Familiarity with programming languages, operating systems, algorithms and software development frameworks
Basic understanding of software development life cycles (e.g., Agile, Scrum)
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Position Specific Information

Travel Requirements: Up to 15%

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability and protected veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Pay Range

$68,400.00 - $102,600.00 Annual

Incentive Compensation

In addition to base pay, Zebra offers this role the opportunity to earn a performance-based annual cash incentive, at a target equal to 5% of base pay, in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan.

Zebra Total Rewards

Zebra Total Rewards includes more than just pay and is structured to meet the needs of our changing global business and evolving talent. We are committed to providing our employees with a benefits program that is comprehensive and competitive – including healthcare, wellness, inclusion networks, and continued learning and development offerings. We offer community service days, in addition to the traditional insurances, compensation, parental leave, employee assistance program and paid time off offerings depending on the country where you work.

In most other roles, the Zebra annual cash incentive program links Company and individual performance together. Some roles may also be eligible for long-term incentive equity awards.

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.

Responsibilities

Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential

The Claims-Engineering team within Enterprise Technology is building the future-state delivery system for one of the largest Claims applications at State Farm. Working in the Engineering department on a DevOps and Infrastructure team, you'll work directly with engineering and business partners to make decisions and drive pace. Your work is the automation that gets application code into the right place, in the right shape, and running the right way. As a member of the Claims-Engineering team you'll be challenged and empowered to grow professionally.

If you're curious about infrastructure, this role puts a lot of it in front of you quickly. The system spans CI/CD pipelines, deployment configuration managed as code and the tooling that generates it, container images and manifests, and the observability and secrets tooling around them, all running on the enterprise's Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift on AWS (ROSA) platforms. We’re just getting started on a new platform that you’ll help us build out while working closely with the teams that own the application build process, the application framework, and the underlying infrastructure. We're hiring for aptitude as much as current depth. If you're early in your infrastructure career and want to learn, this team has the scope and the senior engineers to get you there.

Area of Focus:

Build the CI/CD pipelines that deploy containerized Java applications across environments
Write and maintain Kubernetes and OpenShift manifests and deployment configuration
Work on infrastructure as code and on the in-house deployment tooling written in Go, Python, and Bash
Help move deployment configuration toward a GitOps model
Build and patch container base images and application images
Diagnose and fix deployment and environment problems, picking up production support responsibilities as you go
Write runbooks, decision records, and team documentation
Apply skills, tools, security processes, applications, environments, and programming languages to complete assignments with guidance and direction from experienced engineers
Maintain and develop understanding of software engineering topics including version control, CI/CD, containers, and compute environments including Linux and Public Cloud
Leverage inner source best practices to encourage code discoverability and collaboration across the enterprise

Qualifications

We Are Seeking Candidates With:

Containers and Kubernetes: images, pods, services, and deployment configuration (OpenShift or ROSA a strong plus)
CI/CD pipeline experience
Linux fundamentals
Scripting and automation in Python, Bash, or Go
Git and version control workflow
Comfortable reading Java application code and application server logs

Additional Skills:

A real willingness to learn. We're investing in this role, and we care more about where you're headed than about the length of your résumé.
ArgoCD or other GitOps tooling
Infrastructure as code (Terraform)
Observability tooling (Dynatrace, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana)
Secrets management
AWS fundamentals
Curious. Willing to dig into unfamiliar code and infrastructure, ask questions, and follow a problem all the way down
Collaborative. Works well with cross-functional teams and senior engineers, and says clearly where things stand
Takes ownership of work from development through production
Writes things down. Contributes to runbooks, decision records, and documented processes
Takes code review feedback well and wants to learn from the senior engineers around you

Work Locations
: Bloomington, IL-Corporate, Dunwoody, GA-Park Center Hub, Richardson, TX-CityLine Hub or Tempe, AZ-Marina Heights Hub locations.

Hybrid Work Arrangement:
A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in-office time each month, beginning in late 2027.

SPONSORSHIP
: Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H-1B visa) for this opportunity.

Our Benefits

Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week!

Potential starting salary range: $80,600 - $149,000
Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience
High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience

Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary

At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!

Get Paid! On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus.
Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more!
Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring.
Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union!
Take a Little “You” Time! You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you!
Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund.
Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary.

,
locations
, and the
hiring process
of joining the State Farm team!
