Skillable is a 100% remote and virtual tech company that’s modernizing the world of training. Come share your professional magic with highly talented, driven and fun colleagues who believe in the power of “skilling.” Experience what a team focused on doing the right thing feels like!

Our talented people are what makes us friendly and have fun! We work together to create amazing solutions and experiences for our customers and their clients. We utilize our employees’ personal strengths to help grow our company and ensure our team is living their best, authentic life. We share our appreciation for our team members regularly during all-hands, a workplace appreciation tool, regular shoutouts in our Teams channels, social media, amongst more. Our remote-first work environment blends work and life without the added pressure of commuting or feeling guilty about leaving early to visit the dentist.

Come work with us and learn what teamwork and integrity blended with an emphasis on well-being and balance can do for your career and lifestyle!

We're an AI-first engineering team, and we treat that as a discipline, not a shortcut. Every engineer here works with agentic coding tools — Claude Code and GitHub CoPilot are key drivers in our daily work, which changes the shape of the job:

* You'll spend more of your time on design, decomposition and review, and less on typing. Agents handle much of the implementation; you own the architecture, the verification and everything that ships.
* We invest in the system that makes AI effective: project context, custom agents and skills, MCP integrations and multi-agent code review. Improving that system is engineering work here, and it's part of the role.
* Judgment matters more, not less. Knowing when to hand work to an agent — and when not to — is a skill we hire for and grow.
* Skillable's whole business is proving skills by doing. We hold our own work to the same standard: AI-assisted or not, it isn't done until it's verified.

The **Software Engineer** is responsible for owning features within the designated team - designing, building, and maintaining both server-side logic and infrastructure as well as client-side logic and interfaces that are key to our custom labs and related applications. Develop and optimize APIs, databases, UIs, design systems, and libraries written in either C# or JavaScript/TypeScript. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the product and technology roadmap is consistently delivered.

**What You Will Do:**

* Own complex software features within your team’s domain, leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering rigor.
* Guide and direct AI agents through feature development, serving as the primary architect, reviewer, and decision-maker to frame the problem, set constraints and make the calls that ensure solutions are aligned with business requirements and technical standards.
* Utilize AI tools to generate high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code, project context management, reusable skills, agent workflows, prompt frameworks and automated quality checks,
* Drive comprehensive automated testing and verification practices for every feature before release, ensuring unit tests and validation scenarios are tied back to the requirements.
* Own the quality of all delivered software by rigorously reviewing AI-generated output, challenging assumptions, finding the gaps, and validating that solution fully resolves the problem.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with AI-assisted development, ensuring generated solutions meet expectations for security, maintainability, correctness, and long-term sustainability.
* Create and maintain documentation of features, design decisions, configurations, and other key technical areas of the application.
* Actively collaborate with other developers, QA engineers, designers, and product experts in a cross-functional scrum team.
* Assist with scope and estimation for proposed features, leading to accurate cost and timeline estimates.
* Handles ambiguity within a feature: fills reasonable gaps in requirements, identifies open questions early, and proposes answers rather than only raising problems
* Adhere to quality development patterns and practices, ensuring the team adheres to these standards.
* Communicates status clearly and asks for help without hesitation.
* Adhere to standards and best practices for non-functional requirements such as system performance, usability, reliability, adaptability, security, legal and other operational aspects.
* Participate in team on-call rotation during evenings, weekends, or holidays for emergency support or special events.
* Consistently review work to ensure quality, avoid errors and maintain high standards.
* Support and promote the company values through positive interactions with both internal and external stakeholders on a regular basis.
* Other strategic business initiatives or special cross-functional project involvement as required.

**What You Bring to the Role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field (computer software, computer science, software development, etc.) or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of professional experience as a software developer in an agile product team.
* 3+ years working with .NET Framework and C# required, AND Typescript or JavaScript required.
* Hands on experience delegating real implementation work to AI agents and reviewing and verifying what comes back for delegated engineering, not autocomplete.
* Proven experience regularly use of modern AI tools/agent tools including GitHub CoPilot and Claude Code or similar as a standard practice in building software that is not experimental.
* Strong fundamentals in system design, debugging and code review so AI raises the bar for, supporting existing coding skills.
* Evidence of building scaffolding around AI tools: custom agents, MCP servers, eval harnesses or enablement that made AI work more efficien

At NHD, we are building a leading product that defines the new market category of Contractor Management. We digitalize the entire engineer to pay process with our cutting-edge data-driven & AI technologies. Are you passionate about building backend systems in Go, automating infrastructure, and keeping production healthy and observable? Read on!

### **About You:**

* When something is blocking the team, your instinct is to build the smallest thing that answers the question rather than debate it — a spike, a script, a quick prototype.
* You share real opinions in design discussions — on tradeoffs, complexity, and risk — because you believe teams make better decisions when people actually weigh in.
* You take code review seriously in both directions: you ask until you understand before approving, and you welcome the same rigor on your own work.
* You stay engaged past the merge — on cleanup, follow-up bugs, and alerts that trace back to what you shipped — because you care about the full lifecycle, not just the delivery moment.

* Operate what you build: instrument it, respond to alerts, and close the loop on issues that surface after release.

* Pick up improvements you notice along the way — tech debt, alerting gaps, missing tests — without waiting to be asked.

Key job responsibilities

Design, develop, and optimize highly reliable flight software for Star Tracker flight systems, spanning low-level device drivers and real-time control loops to high-level autonomous behaviors, fault management, and AI/ML-driven decision-making that target Linux environments
Architect and implement fault-tolerant, redundant software systems that keep systems operational with continuous uptime across a constellation of satellites, including health monitoring and autonomous recovery without ground intervention
Build and maintain robust test, validation, and simulation infrastructure, from hardware-in-the-loop testbeds and software-in-the-loop virtualizations to automated regression suites
Own the full lifecycle of embedded software delivery - from requirements decomposition and architecture design through implementation, code review, integration, deployment, and long-term maintenance of software running on satellites in orbit
Collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams spanning hardware, systems, communications, manufacturing and operations engineers to design, integrate, test, and deploy high-speed optical communication systems that push the boundaries of space-based networking
Develop and refine autonomous operational behaviors that enable satellites to independently recover and adapt to changing conditions, and respond to anomalies
Drive continuous improvement of deployment and over-the-air (OTA) update processes, ensuring new capabilities and fixes can be safely and reliably delivered to hundreds of satellites on orbit with minimal operational risk

A day in the life

As a Senior Software Engineer on the OISL Star Tracker team, you won't just write code - you'll see it in action. Your software will control and monitor critical sensor hardware operating on hundreds of real satellites in orbit, and you'll be there for every stage of the journey: from early design and on-the-ground verification to watching your code operate in-orbit and see the stars.

About The Team

You will join a multi-disciplinary team of top-notch engineers whose work spans an unusually wide aperture: embedded flight software running on satellites in orbit, cloud-based systems powering mission and network operations, automation frameworks that keep a growing constellation healthy, and AI-driven capabilities that make our devices smarter with every orbit. We collaborate closely with optical, electrical, firmware, manufacturing, and operations teams — and with partner organizations including Mission Operations — to deliver one of the most advanced optical communication systems ever built.

We are looking for a senior software engineer who combines deep technical and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right things done quickly and effectively, and someone who thrives at the intersection of hardware and software, space and ground, autonomy and operations.

5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
Experience in embedded development in C/C++

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
Experience developing in a linux embedded environment

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101042

Autodesk is looking for a Software Engineer to help develop a new Electron and Chromium-based desktop platform for Autodesk web applications. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will build and maintain components of the Electron application, work with Chromium configuration and desktop operating-system integrations, troubleshoot application and runtime issues, and contribute to making the platform secure, reliable, and reusable. You will work alongside senior engineers while developing deeper expertise in Electron, Chromium, Node.js, Windows, and desktop platform engineering.

Responsibilities

Electron application development - approximately 40%: Develop and maintain features in the Electron main process, preload layer, renderer integration, and supporting Node.js components
Chromium runtime and platform integration - approximately 20%: Work with supported Chromium and Electron configuration, command-line options, and build settings to enable capabilities required by the desktop platform
Windows and native integration - approximately 20%: Implement desktop capabilities such as application lifecycle behavior, operating-system integration, hardware and system-information access, application protocols, and other native functionality
Reliability, security, and troubleshooting - approximately 20%: Investigate application crashes, runtime problems, memory issues, security concerns, installation problems, and interactions between the web application and desktop environment
Implement well-defined features and technical tasks from design through testing and code review
Develop secure communication between web content and privileged desktop functionality using well-defined application interfaces
Write unit and integration tests for the components you develop and contribute to the team's automated quality practices
Work with senior engineers to apply Electron security best practices, including process isolation, restricted native APIs, secure inter-process communication, and controlled navigation
Contribute to integrations with identity, crash reporting, telemetry, software distribution, and other desktop platform services.
Help evaluate and adopt new Electron and Chromium versions and resolve compatibility issues when they arise
Use profiling, logging, Chromium developer tools, and operating-system diagnostic tools to investigate technical problems
Participate in design discussions, code reviews, sprint planning, technical investigations, and team retrospectives
Work collaboratively with quality, build/release, product, and other engineering teams to deliver production-ready functionality
Document technical implementations and lessons learned so knowledge can be shared across the team

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
1+ years of professional software engineering experience
Experience developing software using JavaScript or TypeScript
Familiarity with Node.js and modern web application technologies
Understanding of software engineering fundamentals including source control, testing, debugging, and code review
Ability to troubleshoot typical software problems using logs, debuggers, and development tools
Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and apply guidance from more experienced engineers
Strong collaboration and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Electron or another desktop application framework
Familiarity with Chromium architecture, configuration, or developer tooling
Experience developing Windows desktop software
Experience with native Node.js modules or interoperability between JavaScript and native operating-system APIs
Familiarity with C++ or another systems programming language
Experience with Windows APIs, processes, registry, application lifecycle, or desktop security concepts
Familiarity with desktop application packaging, installers, and code signing
Experience diagnosing performance, memory, or application-startup problems
Familiarity with continuous integration and automated software delivery

The Ideal Candidate

You are curious about how software works below the web application layer and want to develop deeper expertise in desktop and runtime engineering.

You enjoy debugging problems, learning new systems, and understanding how technologies such as Electron, Chromium, Node.js, and Windows interact. You can independently complete well-defined engineering tasks, ask for help when a problem moves beyond your experience, and use feedback from senior engineers to improve your solutions.

You value clean code, automated testing, secure engineering practices, and collaborative problem solving.

We are building a new desktop platform that enables Autodesk's web-based products to deliver richer, higher-performance experiences on Windows. Forma is the first product adopting the platform, with the longer-term goal of creating reusable desktop capabilities for additional Autodesk products.

You will join a new cross-functional platform team working across Electron, Chromium, Windows desktop integration, software delivery, security, and enterprise deployment. You will collaborate with experienced engineers in Sheffield and with engineering teams across Autodesk.

This is a hybrid working position based out of Autodesk's Sheffield office.

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Field Deployment and Support
jobs.description:
About Destro AI

Destro AI is building the intelligence layer for robotics — the system that coordinates robots, humans, and workflows across complex real-world operations. Founded by former leaders from HAI Robotics, Dexterity, and Matic, Destro is built on a simple thesis: robotics has solved movement, but not decision-making. Destro is backed by investors who have previously invested in and built companies like Brex, Figma, Notion, and Instacart.

Destro's MothershipOS is a shared brain across all robots, unlocking complex factory and warehouse workflows. Unlike traditional systems that rely on local intelligence on each robot, Destro brings global intelligence across the entire operation. Destro recently closed its Seed round at one of the highest valuations for a robotics company at this stage, and is already deploying in production with large enterprise operators.

About The Role

We're hiring a Robotics Forward Deployed Engineer, to own the software that runs MothershipOS in live customer warehouses. This role is responsible for writing and maintaining production code, not solely for troubleshooting it, and will serve as the engineering presence on-site when systems need to be brought up, stabilized, or restored to full function.

Schedule Expectations

This is a field deployment role, not a standard office-hours position. Warehouse operations run multiple shifts, and go-lives, incidents, and integrations are not confined to business hours.
Regular work outside standard business hours should be expected, including nights and weekends. Go-lives are frequently scheduled during off-hours or weekend downtime windows to avoid disrupting customer operations.
This role may be paged for production issues, including robot faults, network outages, and server failures, outside normal hours, and is expected to respond promptly, either remotely or on-site.
Extensive travel to customer sites is required, at times on short notice.
Candidates seeking a fixed 9-to-5, Monday-through-Friday schedule are unlikely to find this role a fit.

What You'll Do

Software
Write, test, and maintain the software services that run MothershipOS at customer sites, including deployment tooling and diagnostic utilities.
Design and build internal tools that make field deployments faster and more repeatable.
Translate field learnings into production-hardening fixes and improvements in the core codebase.
Maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks so issues can be diagnosed consistently across sites.

Field Deployment
Deploy and validate Destro's software stack in live warehouses, working directly with customer operations, IT, and engineering teams.
Own production issues end-to-end during launch and stabilization, including off-hours incidents.
Improve uptime, throughput, and reliability of deployed systems through both code and infrastructure changes.

Systems and Infrastructure
Build and maintain containerized services (Docker Compose) running on Destro-managed servers and edge devices.
Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP) for image management, versioning, and deployment tooling.
Configure and troubleshoot networking, including VLANs, DHCP, internal DNS, and certificate-based service security.
Debug across the full stack: robot state faults, sensor issues, API failures, container networking, database queries, and monitoring dashboards.

Who You Are

2 to 6 years of experience in systems engineering, robotics software, backend engineering, infrastructure, or field engineering, with genuine software development experience rather than field support alone.
Comfortable being paged off-hours and traveling on short notice.
Able to operate independently in ambiguous, high-pressure environments without a fully specified solution.
Calm under pressure, direct with customers, and demonstrates strong ownership.

Technical Skills

Required
Strong Python or C++, with the ability to write maintainable, production-grade code.
Hands-on Docker/Docker Compose experience, including building, deploying, debugging, and versioning images.
Linux/server administration: command line, logs, processes, systemd, firewalls.
Networking fundamentals: DHCP, DNS, VLANs, static IP reservations, TLS/certificates.
Experience with APIs and communication protocols (REST, WebSockets, MQTT).
Proficiency with Git and standard software development workflows.

Strongly Preferred
Experience with AMRs, warehouse automation, or fleet management.
Cloud deployment experience, ideally GCP.
Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, or time-series databases.
WMS/WES/ERP integration experience.

Nice to Have
Experience with robot task allocation, scheduling, or routing.
Experience with wearables, scanners, or other warehouse hardware.

Job Description:

We are GDIT. The people supporting and securing some of the most complex government, defense,

and intelligence projects across the country. We ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work has meaning and impact on the world around us, but also on us, and that’s important.

GDIT is your place. You make it your own by embracing autonomy, seizing opportunity, and being rusted to deliver your best every day.

We think. We act. We deliver. There is no challenge we can’t turn into opportunity. And our work depends on a Data Engineer joining our team to support customer activities.

The Data Engineer builds and sustains the data foundation of the POTFF Enterprise Data and Analytics function. The Data Engineer acquires, integrates, and prepares data from the Government-designated Human Performance System of Record (e.g., HPDMS) and other Government-approved sources; designs, implements, and maintains scalable, reproducible data pipelines and curated, analysis-ready datasets on the Government-furnished technology stack; and enforces the data quality, lineage, and governance controls that make downstream analysis defensible. The Data Engineer provides data engineering expertise for the enterprise data science team and works in direct support of the Data Scientists, Senior Data Scientists, and Data Science Advisor.

HOW A DATA ENGINEER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

Design, implement, and maintain scalable extract-transform-load and extract-load-transform (ETL/ELT) pipelines on the Government-furnished technology stack (e.g., SQL Server, Databricks, and Apache Spark (PySpark)) for batch and scheduled processing and data transformation.
Fuse disparate structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources from across the POTFF enterprise, including the Government-designated Human Performance System of Record (e.g., HPDMS), assessment and wearable data, and other Government-approved systems, into curated, analysis-ready datasets.
Implement rigorous data quality controls, validation rules, lineage documentation, and performance tuning to ensure reliable, reproducible, and secure pipelines; monitor scheduled and orchestrated workloads and resolve failures.
Develop and maintain data models, data dictionaries, metadata, and transformation logic under version control, and document data sources, assumptions, and processing steps to ensure transparency and operational continuity.
Prepare and curate text and other unstructured data to support Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) use cases executed by the data science team within Government-approved tools.
Support the integration of curated data products into Government-furnished visualization and low-code tools and the deployment of analytic products into operational workflows, including basic machine-learning operations (MLOps) practices where directed by the Government.
Apply Government data governance, security, and privacy requirements, including DoW Impact Level 5 (IL5), HIPAA, and Privacy Act protocols, to all data handling, and implement data access controls as directed by the Government.
Collaborate with Government personnel, clinicians, program staff, and the data science team to identify new data sources, improve the quality of data entered into Government systems, and translate analytical requirements into data requirements.
Provide data engineering expertise and technical guidance to Data Scientists and Senior Data Scientists.

EDUCATION:

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or computing discipline, including but not limited to computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, information systems, data science, data engineering, mathematics, statistics, or geospatial science or geoinformatics, with documented coursework or professional application in programming, databases, and quantitative analysis. A candidate without the degree qualifies with the experience stated under Required Minimum Experience/Skills.
Minimum of three (3) years of professional experience in data engineering, database development, or data pipeline development. Without the bachelor’s degree, a minimum of five (5) years of such experience.
Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and in Python or a comparable language used for data engineering, demonstrated through professional work experience.
Demonstrated experience building and operating data pipelines, including ETL/ELT design, data modeling, data quality checks, reproducible pipeline design, and version control (Git).
Ability to communicate clearly with analysts and non-technical stakeholders and to document technical work for continuity.

PREFFERED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with Palantir Foundry (including ontology development) or a comparable data-integration platform.
Experience with distributed processing frameworks such as Databricks and Apache Spark (PySpark).
Familiarity with Power BI semantic modeling and with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps and Power Automate).
with deploying analytics or machine-learning models into applications and with MLOps concepts.
Experience working in a DoW-authorized cloud environment.
Experience with human performance, health, clinical, or biomedical data.

LOCATION:
Various CONUS SITES

Secret or Top-Secret Clearance, or the ability to obtain clearance.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

The Imaging team builds and fields state-of-the-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it.

About The Role

We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join the Imaging team. This is not a product development role, and it isn't a traditional cloud-SRE role either. You are the frontline for keeping fielded imaging systems alive: the person field personnel and customer-support escalations turn to when a deployed system isn't behaving. You'll be the second SRE on a small, high-trust team, working directly with our lead, with real room to shape how Imaging reliability and support operate as we scale.

The work is varied and often ambiguous. You might spend a morning triaging a networking failure on a system being stood up at a remote site, an afternoon walking a field operator through a sensor calibration over the phone, and the back half of a week hardening a runbook so the next person never has to solve that problem live again. When a fielded system misbehaves, the root cause could be anywhere in the stack--and you're the one who narrows it down.

If you get energy from diagnosing live systems under pressure, being the reason a deployment stays up, and turning recurring fire-drills into durable fixes, this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

Own fielded system reliability.
You are responsible for the health and uptime of deployed imaging systems. When issues arise--whether the root cause is in the network, the calibration, an upgrade, or the sensor hardware itself--you triage, diagnose, and drive resolution.

Run point on escalations
. You'll be first and second line of response for issues coming through our support channels and Anduril's customer-support pipeline (Tier 0 to Mission Success / Product Operations to SRE), acting as the deep-expertise backstop the rest of the funnel escalates to.

Turn fires into runbooks.
Recurring issues shouldn't be solved live twice. You'll build and maintain runbooks, diagnostics, and self-service tooling that reduce repeat problems and shrink the support load over time.

Hold the boundary with engineering.
You own everything short of a code fix. When an issue turns out to be a genuine software defect, you'll cleanly reproduce it, document it, and hand it off to the Mission Software Engineers--protecting their focus by keeping frontline support where it belongs.

Feed reliability back into the product.
You'll turn what you learn in the field into signals that make our systems more supportable--better observability, safer upgrades, more graceful failure.

Travel expected approximately 20% of the time for field support and deployment windows.

What We're Looking For

Required

3+ years in SRE, DevOps, field/systems engineering, or production support of deployed hardware/software systems--with real ownership after systems ship, not just standing them up
Strong Linux fundamentals, including comfort troubleshooting real networking issues (IP, routing, VPNs, connectivity in constrained or field environments)
Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve issues across system boundaries (networking, services, hardware interaction) without always having full visibility into every component
Comfortable owning a structured on-call rotation, including scheduled after-hours and weekend coverage
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to run a remote troubleshooting session with a non-technical operator and document what happened
Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance

Preferred

Experience supporting fielded or deployed systems, not just development environments
Experience with fielded hardware or sensor systems (EO/IR, optical, or similar), including familiarity with sensor calibration
Scripting for diagnostics and automation (Python, Bash, or similar)
Familiarity with Nix or NixOS--uncommon, but valuable on our stack
Familiarity with systemd service management and observability practices on Linux
Familiarity with incident tooling (PagerDuty or equivalent)

What Makes Someone Successful Here

The people who thrive in this role share a few traits that don't always show up on a resume:

They close loops. When they pick up a problem they own it until it's resolved, not until it's someone else's problem.

They stay calm under pressure. A system down in the field with an operator waiting is a high-stress moment. They work the problem methodically instead of reacting.

They communicate proactively. They don't wait to be asked for a status update. They document what they find, share what they learn, and keep the people who need to know informed.

They're comfortable with ambiguity at the stack boundary. When a device behaves unexpectedly in the field, the root cause could be anywhere. They have a methodology for narrowing it down systematically rather than guessing or waiting for someone else to have the answer.

They know where the line is. They own frontline support fully, and they know when an issue is a true code-level defect that belongs with engineering--handing it off cleanly rather than either sitting on it or tossing it over the wall half-formed.

$124,000—$164,000 USD

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

TOGA Technology is looking for a Full Stack Developer to help build and grow our platform of business applications. This is a full stack role for someone who wants real ownership of features, not just tickets, and who is excited to help shape how a growing platform gets built.

This role requires genuine comfort working alongside AI coding tools. Producing code is no longer the hard part: knowing when AI generated code is subtly wrong, and having the discipline to verify rather than assume, is what separates a strong developer from a risky one. We are looking for someone who pairs real technical skill with intellectual humility, comfortable saying, “I don’t know, let me check,” yet confident enough to push back when something doesn’t look right. You will take real ownership of features, and over time, whole applications, with meaningful autonomy.

jobs.description:
About Onyx.

Onyx is building the market for people who enjoy being right. Our consumer platform lets people take positions on what happens next across sports, prediction markets, crypto, financial markets, politics, culture, and real-world events.

More than one million users have already found Onyx. Now, we’re bringing that same energy into regulated financial markets through Onyx Predictions, a CFTC-registered introducing broker and NFA member.

In June 2026, we raised a $20 million Series A led by Payward, the parent company of Kraken, valuing Onyx at $220 million less than one year after emerging from beta. Our team comes from Jane Street, DraftKings, Robinhood, xAI, SIG, HRT, and Harvard.

We’re building Onyx in New York with a small team, serious momentum, and no interest in moving slowly. The product is live. The market is growing. The category is still ours to define.

The Role.

We’re hiring a Full-Stack Software Engineer to build the systems and consumer experiences at the center of Onyx.

Our stack is primarily TypeScript, React, React Native, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS. You’ll work across it, building customer-facing trading experiences, backend financial infrastructure, real-time systems, and the services that keep everything moving.

This is not a role where you’ll spend months working on one narrowly defined component. You’ll own projects from the initial idea through production, work directly with product, design, trading, and operations, and make technical decisions that shape both the platform and its architecture.

Your work will be visible. Your responsibilities will expand quickly. You’ll ship directly to users and own what happens next.

What You’ll Own

Build and ship full-stack product features using TypeScript, React, and Node.js.
Develop customer-facing trading experiences across web and mobile.
Build backend services supporting markets, orders, execution, positions, balances, and settlement.
Design reliable APIs, real-time systems, and scalable PostgreSQL workflows.
Build and maintain production infrastructure in AWS.
Integrate with exchanges, liquidity providers, payment systems, and financial partners.
Improve system performance, observability, reliability, and fault tolerance.
Partner with product, design, trading, and operations from concept through launch.
Make consequential technical decisions and own the outcomes.

You’ll Do Well Here If You

Have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Are highly proficient in TypeScript, React, and Node.js.
Have built and maintained production applications across the stack.
Understand relational databases, transactions, concurrency, and data consistency.
Have production experience with PostgreSQL and AWS.
Are comfortable building real-time, concurrent, or event-driven systems.
Can move between frontend, backend, and infrastructure based on product needs.
Independently lead technical projects from planning through production.
Move quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality, reliability, and customer experience.

Even Better If You Have

Experience with React Native or Expo.
Built products in trading, crypto, payments, prediction markets, or consumer fintech.
Worked with WebSockets, live data feeds, streaming systems, or event-driven architecture.
Experience with order management, execution, market data, settlement, or broker connectivity.
Helped scale a consumer application through rapid growth.

Location:

This role is based in our NoHo, Manhattan office, with core in-office days Tuesday through Thursday.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Onyx is unable to provide employment sponsorship for this position.

Compensation And Benefits

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $150,000–$200,000, depending on experience, impact, and scope, plus a target bonus and equity.

Benefits Include

Fully covered medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Meaningful equity ownership.
Commuter benefits.

Why Onyx?

Onyx is for people with conviction.

We hire talented people, give them meaningful ownership, and expect them to use it. Our teams stay small, the work stays visible, and the distance between an idea and production stays short.

Onyx moves quickly because our markets move quickly. Titles matter less than judgment, initiative, and the quality of what you ship. Good ideas can come from anywhere, but the person willing to make the call is expected to follow it through.

We value people who are ambitious without ego, intellectually honest, comfortable with uncertainty, and energized by hard problems. We debate openly, decide quickly, and take responsibility for the result.

Come build what’s next with us.

jobs.description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

Job Description

Ensora Health builds software that helps therapists and clinicians run successful practices, and we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape how we build it. You’ll bring deep PHP and object-oriented expertise, plus fresh ideas for using AI to change how our team designs, writes, tests, and ships code.

This isn’t a maintain-the-status-quo role. We want someone who looks at how we work with PHP today, says “here’s a better way,” and then proves it. You’ll lead technical projects, work directly with leadership to define requirements, and raise the bar for the engineers around you.

What You’ll Do

Lead the design, build, and deployment of features and services using object-oriented principles and modern PHP practices.
Challenge our current PHP patterns, tooling, and workflows, and champion improvements that make our code faster to ship, easier to maintain, and more secure.
Explore and prototype new ways to use AI in our development lifecycle, such as AI-assisted code generation, refactoring, test creation, code review, and root-cause analysis. Then turn what works into repeatable team practices.
Evaluate AI-assisted tools and set guidelines for using them responsibly, with human review, strong testing, and security standards.
Work with leadership and product partners to define software requirements and translate business needs into sound technical plans.
Take the lead on operational and technical projects, from scoping and estimation through delivery.
Shape architecture decisions, designing reusable, testable components that scale.
Diagnose and resolve complex bugs and performance issues, using logs, metrics, and traces to find root causes.
Drive automated testing, including unit and integration tests, and improve coverage across the codebase.
Lead by example in code reviews, give constructive feedback, and mentor engineers at every level.
Apply secure coding practices and address common web and application security risks before they become problems.
Keep technical documentation clear and current, using AI tools to help.
Share what you learn through demos, lunch-and-learns, and written guides, so the whole team benefits.

Required

What you bring

6+ years of professional software development experience in an object-oriented language, with deep PHP expertise.
Strong command of OOP principles, design patterns, and clean code practices.
A track record of improving how a team builds software, not only what it builds.
Hands-on experience using AI tools for coding, debugging, testing, or documentation, and sound judgment about when to trust their output and when not to.
Experience working in a Linux-based development environment.
Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS3.
Solid experience with relational databases and SQL/MySQL.
Working knowledge of system architecture, debugging strategies, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
A demonstrated commitment to code quality, testing, and maintainable design.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical partners.

Nice to have

Experience building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into PHP applications.
Experience creating repeatable AI workflows for your team, such as shared prompts, test generation, or automated review.
Experience with Docker or containerized environments.
Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms.
Experience in healthcare or other regulated software environments.

Additional Information

While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer / Automation Architect
Location:
Fairport / Rochester, NY (Must reside within 20 miles of Fairport, NY)
Engagement Type:
Independent Contractor
Pay Rate:
$40–$65 per hour
Work Arrangement:
Contract with occasional in-person meetings
Engagement Duration:
Initial paid technical audit, with potential for ongoing support

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer / Automation Architect to take ownership of an existing, fully developed business automation and outreach platform.
This is not a greenfield development project
. The platform is already built, and the primary responsibility is to evaluate its existing architecture, identify technical and performance issues, improve system reliability, optimize automated data collection and API integrations, and
troubleshoot cold-email deliverability.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical expert who can independently take over a complex codebase developed by others, diagnose problems, implement practical solutions, and provide ongoing technical oversight and maintenance.

Key Responsibilities

Codebase & Architecture Audit:
Review the existing application, assess its architecture, identify technical debt, and recommend improvements.
Performance Optimization:
Diagnose bottlenecks, troubleshoot system failures, and improve application performance, stability, and reliability.
Full-Stack Engineering:
Maintain and improve existing Python, React, and Next.js applications.
Automation & Data Pipelines:
Audit and optimize web scraping, browser automation, automated data collection, and data processing workflows.
API Integrations:
Troubleshoot and improve integrations with Apollo, Apify, Instantly, OpenAI, and other third-party services.
Database Management:
Evaluate and optimize Supabase/PostgreSQL databases, queries, data integrity, and pipeline performance.
Email Deliverability:
Investigate low email delivery volumes, spam placement, inbox rotation, and cold-email infrastructure issues.
Email Authentication & Reputation:
Diagnose SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configurations, domain reputation, and other factors affecting deliverability.
Cloud Infrastructure:
Maintain and troubleshoot deployments and infrastructure across DigitalOcean, Vercel, and GitHub-based workflows.
Ongoing Technical Support:
Implement corrective actions, document findings, monitor system performance, and provide ongoing maintenance as needed.

Required Qualifications

Strong experience in full-stack software development using Python, React, and Next.js
.
Hands-on experience with web scraping, Playwright, and browser automation.
Experience designing, troubleshooting, and maintaining API integrations and automated data pipelines.
Working knowledge of Supabase, PostgreSQL, database optimization, and data management.
Experience with cloud deployment and development tools, including DigitalOcean, Vercel, and GitHub.
Practical experience diagnosing cold-email deliverability issues and improving inbox placement.
Understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain reputation, inbox rotation, and email authentication.
Proven ability to take over, audit, troubleshoot, and maintain software systems originally developed by other engineers.
Ability to work independently, identify root causes, and implement solutions without extensive supervision.

Immediate Priorities

During the initial engagement, the contractor will be expected to:

jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/29/2026

Meet the Team

Our team is part of the Cisco AI and Automation portfolio, responsible for the "Circuit" platform—the central AI engine that powers productivity and process automation for all of Cisco. We are a rapidly expanding, high-impact group dedicated to building the vehicle for AI-driven business transformation. We operate at the intersection of applied research and production, ensuring our technology is not only cutting-edge but also optimized for performance, reliability, and functional quality for our 80,000+ monthly users.

As an Automation QA Engineer, you are the guardian of that functional quality—owning the automated testing ecosystem that keeps Circuit reliable, scalable, and production-ready across every release. This is a hybrid position.

Your Impact

As an Automation QA Engineer
, you will drive the transformation of our regression testing ecosystem, moving beyond manual processes to build AI-driven, fully automated test suites for both new and legacy features. You will design and own end-to-end (E2E), API, and performance test automation that ensures the Circuit platform continues to meet Cisco's high standards for functional quality and performance.

You will build and maintain scalable test frameworks, integrate them into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality feedback, and leverage AI-assisted coding tools (such as Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code) to generate and maintain tests—while rigorously validating that AI-generated artifacts are stable, correct, and compliant with security standards. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to automate functional quality and reduce technical debt directly ensures Circuit remains a reliable vehicle for process automation across Cisco.

Responsibilities

Automated Regression & E2E Testing:
Architect, build, and maintain comprehensive automated regression and end-to-end test suites for the entire Circuit platform using Playwright
(TypeScript/JavaScript), Python/Pytest
, and Selenium, replacing manual QA with scalable automation.

API Testing:
Design and automate REST
and GraphQL
API test suites covering functional correctness, contract validation, error handling, and performance—including validation of AI/model-serving endpoints under concurrent load.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Platform
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril’s Lattice software platform integrates together many sensors into a single cohesive view of the world, providing needed context for our users. Anduril’s Frontier AI team builds edge-compatible, generative AI systems into the Lattice software platform to provide features and products that improve autonomy and reduce cognitive burden on the warfighter. Specific applications include but are not limited to automating mission planning, battle-space understanding, voice-control of assets, and enabling higher-levels of autonomy.

About The Job

Frontier AI is looking for a backend software engineer to own and evolve our internal LLM agent framework. This role sits at the intersection of backend infrastructure, applied AI, agent architecture, model post-training, and evaluation tooling. You will build the platform that enables teams across Anduril to develop, evaluate, and deploy reliable LLM agents in mission-critical environments.

What You’ll Do

Own Anduril’s internal LLM agent framework, including core abstractions, runtime architecture, developer experience, integrations, and reliability.
Support multiple business lines building LLM agents by providing new framework capabilities, implementation guidance, architectural reviews, and best-practice patterns.
Partner with machine learning teams to make model post-training workflows easy to integrate, ranging from supervised fine-tuning to offline RL, online RL, and environment-driven agent improvement.
Design tooling that supports modern agent patterns, including structured tool calling, filesystem-using agents, memory and retrieval, planning loops, subagents, agent graphs, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Work with partner teams to define comprehensive evaluation suites that measure task success, tool-call correctness, trajectory quality, robustness, regressions, and deployment readiness.
Stay current on emerging agent architecture and evaluation trends, and make pragmatic decisions about which techniques should or should not be adopted internally.

Required Qualifications

Strong backend engineering experience building production-quality platforms, frameworks, APIs, or infrastructure used by other engineers.
Deep expertise in LLM agent framework design, including the tradeoffs between different orchestration patterns such as linear agents, graph-based agents, multi-agent systems, planner/executor loops, and tool-heavy agents.
Experience designing agent evaluation paradigms, including trajectory evaluations, LLM-as-judge workflows, task-success metrics, tool-call correctness checks, rubric-based qualitative grading, adversarial scenario testing, regression eval suites, and human-in-the-loop review.
Familiarity with model post-training workflows such as SFT, preference tuning, reinforcement learning, and environment-based agent training.
Strong judgment around reliability, observability, debugging, and safety for LLM applications deployed in high-stakes settings.
Ability to work directly with partner teams, understand ambiguous product needs, and turn them into reusable platform capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with agent frameworks like Langchain Deepagents, Claude SDK, etc.
Experience building evaluation platforms, simulation environments, benchmark suites, or agent test harnesses.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, distributed systems, workflow orchestration, or ML infrastructure.
Familiarity with defense, robotics, command-and-control systems, autonomy, or operational planning domains.

US Salary Range

$220,000—$292,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

jobs.description:
About Us

GMI Cloud is a fast-growing, AI-native infrastructure company delivering high-performance GPU compute, inference services, and infrastructure for AI agents. Following 8x ARR growth, GMI Cloud continues to scale rapidly across the U.S. and APAC. As a Reference Platform NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) and a validated leading NCP across both markets, we power production AI for leading AI-native companies including Fireworks AI, Cartesia, Reflection, and OpenRouter. From large-scale compute to optimized inference and agentic workloads, GMI Cloud gives AI teams the infrastructure they need to build, deploy, and scale on one unified cloud. One cloud for compute, inference, and agents.

Role Overview

We are seeking a talented and highly skilled Infrastructure Backend Engineering Development Engineer to design, build, and maintain the scalable infrastructure that supports GMI AI/ML initiatives. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cloud computing, distributed systems, and DevOps practices to enable efficient AI infrastructure operations.

Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain AI/MLinfrastructure optimized for large-scale training and inference.
Develop automation pipelines for GPU/CPU resource provisioning and workload scheduling using DevOps best practices and methodologies.
Develop observability and telemetry solutions to pro-actively monitor hardware performance, utilization, and health to ensure cluster reliability and efficiency.
Optimize infrastructure for high-throughput data transfer and low-latency communication.

Collaborate with relevant engineering teams to configure and troubleshoot GPU clusters and hardware resources.
Document infrastructure architecture, deployment procedures, automation workflow, and operational best practices.
Stay current with the latest GPU technology developments, infrastructure engineering and integrate new hardware/software solutions as appropriate.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Golang, Python, Bash) with strong coding practices and system design skills.
Extensive experience with infrastructure orchestration platforms, especially OpenStack and Kubernetes.

Strong proficiency in automation, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines using Ansible, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar.
Proven experience implementing telemetry and observability
solutions (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir
and related technologies).
Knowledge of networking, security, and performance tuning in GPU clusters.
Hands-on experience in deploying GPU clusters and managing GPU workloads.
Experience with secret management using HashiCorp Vault.
Experience with distributed and high performance storage systems (e.g. Vastdata, Weka, DDN, Ceph)
Strong system thinking and abstraction skills, capable of designing complex distributed systems from an end-to-end perspective.
Strong understanding of DevOps principles, automation, and cloud-native architectures.

Meeting every qualification is not required—if you’re excited about this role, we’d love to hear from you. We believe diverse perspectives and experiences strengthen our team.

We are seeking a Data Analytics Engineer to design, build, and maintain modern data solutions that support analytics, operational reporting, and enterprise decision-making. This role will focus on developing governed, reusable data assets, strengthening data quality, reducing technical debt, and implementing scalable data engineering practices within cloud-based analytics platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Data Quality Engineering
Design and implement reusable data quality validation frameworks to ensure completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with business rules.
Embed automated quality controls into data pipelines and monitoring processes.
Identify, investigate, and resolve data quality issues that impact reporting and analytics.
Establish data quality metrics, monitoring standards, and remediation processes.
Promote best practices that improve trust and reliability across enterprise data assets.

Data Engineering & Pipeline Development
Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines using Databricks, Python, SQL, APIs, and cloud-native technologies.
Build and maintain reliable data ingestion, transformation, and delivery processes.
Support medallion architecture patterns and modern data engineering methodologies.
Ensure secure, efficient, and cost-effective movement of data across systems and platforms.
Continuously improve pipeline performance, scalability, and operational reliability.

Data Modeling & Analytics Enablement
Design and maintain dimensional data models including star schemas and enterprise data warehouse structures.
Develop trusted, reusable datasets that support analytics, reporting, and operational business processes.
Translate business requirements into scalable data models and governed reporting assets.
Standardize definitions, metrics, and business rules to improve consistency across analytics solutions.
Optimize data structures to improve reporting performance and ease of consumption.

Technical Debt Reduction & Platform Improvement
Assess existing solutions and identify opportunities to simplify, modernize, and standardize data architectures.
Reduce technical debt through improved engineering patterns, automation, and platform optimization.
Refactor legacy pipelines and workflows to improve maintainability and supportability.
Implement engineering standards that improve reliability and scalability.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the data ecosystem.

Data Lifecycle Management & Governance
Design and implement governed data retention, archival, and purge processes.
Ensure compliance with data governance, security, audit, and retention requirements.
Maintain data lineage, metadata, and documentation supporting enterprise governance practices.
Collaborate with stakeholders to establish standards for data ownership and stewardship.
Support regulatory and operational compliance initiatives through effective data management practices.

Data Integration & Platform Support
Integrate data from APIs, enterprise applications, third-party platforms, and other source systems.
Develop and maintain scalable data exchange and integration solutions.
Support production operations, issue resolution, and ongoing platform maintenance.
Monitor platform health and proactively address performance or reliability concerns.
Collaborate with engineering teams to support enterprise-scale data operations.

Document data quality rules, validation processes, and operating standards.
Develop support handoff materials that enable long-term sustainment and operational excellence.
Ensure solutions are well-documented and audit-ready.
Promote knowledge sharing across engineering and analytics teams.

Stakeholder Collaboration
Partner with business stakeholders, analysts, data engineers, and third-party teams to understand requirements and priorities.
Translate business rules into governed technical solutions.
Communicate risks, dependencies, and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Participate in project planning, solution design, and delivery activities.
Support analytics initiatives through consultation, data analysis, and engineering expertise.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Software Development, or related technical roles.
4+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting production data solutions.
Strong experience working with Databricks or Snowflake, with Databricks preferred.
Proven experience building scalable data pipelines and enterprise data assets.

Technical Skills
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
Strong experience with Databricks and modern cloud-based data platforms.
Data pipeline development and optimization.
Data quality framework implementation and monitoring.
ETL/ELT architecture and development.
Dimensional modeling and star schema design.
Data warehousing and enterprise data management.
API integration and data exchange solutions.
Data governance, lineage, retention, and audit processes.
Production support and operational monitoring.
Large-scale database management and query optimization.

Experience working with large and complex enterprise data environments.

Who We Are

The Center for Geospatial Solutions (CGS) is a self-sustaining nonprofit enterprise. Founded to help bridge the gap between policy and practice, our mission is to enable people and the planet to meet the pace of change by expanding access to new technologies that power more sustainable and equitable outcomes.

We are a fully remote team of award-winning professionals with decades of applied expertise and end-to-end GIS capabilities. By embracing whole-system thinking and state-of-the-art technology, we enable partners across public, private, and nonprofit sectors to tackle complex, real-world challenges—like housing affordability, ecosystem conservation, water management, and sustainable infrastructure—with greater clarity.

Our work liberates and connects key information, creates nuanced pictures of complex situations, and makes data easier to use, understand, and act on. We use tools like satellite data and artificial intelligence to deliver insights for impact.

At CGS, we believe that technology can be a tool for positive change. We are dedicated to building a diverse team that represents the communities and systems we live and work in. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity, and lived experiences, and know a more inclusive team makes us a stronger organization.

About The Lincoln Institute

CGS was established in 2020 at the Lincoln Institute of Land Policy, which seeks to improve quality of life through effective use, taxation, and stewardship of land. A nonprofit private operating foundation whose origins date to 1946, the Lincoln Institute researches and recommends creative approaches to land as a solution to economic, social, and environmental challenges. Through education, training, publications, and events, the Lincoln Institute integrates theory and practice to inform public policy decisions worldwide and has office locations in Cambridge, Massachusetts; Washington, DC; Phoenix, Arizona; and Beijing, China.

Position Overview

The Software Developer 1 position reports to the Associate Director for Technology for the Internet of Water. You will provide scripting, software development, and development-to-operations (DevOps) services. This is a backend/hybrid development role focused on building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers our water data systems.

We expect the Software Developer to have strong foundations in software design and an eagerness to learn and solve challenging problems. You will work across a diverse technology landscape that includes conventional relational databases, Esri and open-source geospatial platforms, cloud-optimized data stores, and increasingly, knowledge graph and semantic web technologies. You will conceptualize, design, build, and deploy new and innovative products and applications for our infrastructure to facilitate the wide offerings, capabilities, and feedback loops for water data management. We have high standards for code quality, all forms of testing, and intelligent architecture. Experience with JavaScript, Python, APIs, Linux, relational databases, Docker, and public cloud providers is desired.

This is a fixed-term full-time position at 37.5 hours/week reporting to the Associate Director, Data Engineering in Washington D.C., Cambridge, MA, Phoenix, AZ; or remotely. Occasional domestic and international travel up to 10% may be required. We expect the Software Developer to have strong foundations in software design and an eagerness to learn and solve challenging problems.

What You'll Do

Software Development

Develop and modify internal and external-facing software as part of engineering teams that may include internal team staff and external collaborators and/or contractors.
Focus on developing backend software components and services that interact with upstream and downstream components (including front-end user interfaces and back-end data management and transformation processes and APIs).
Develop reusable tools, libraries, and frameworks for data integration, analysis, and visualization that can be applied across multiple projects and initiatives.
Produce high-quality code and software for data management, publication, aggregation, and visualization with appropriate documentation.
Ensure reproducibility, accessibility, and sustainability of Center-developed software and data systems.
Participate in all aspects of the application development life cycle, including specifications, prototypes, development, quality assurance, deployment, and operations and maintenance.
Design, develop, and maintain efficient data pipelines that extract data from various data sources, transform it into a unified data model, and push it to a destination data store through strong collaboration with water, land, and housing domain experts to understand data sources and requirements.
Develop end-to-end systems for data harmonization, geocoding, and integration of large, heterogeneous datasets from diverse sources.
Implement data validation and cleansing processes to ensure high data quality and integrity.
Identify and integrate new technologies and tools to improve data processing and storage.
Work closely with water domain experts to translate domain-specific needs into technical requirements.
Create and maintain documentation for data pipelines, including data models, ETL processes, and data flow diagrams.

DevOps and Infrastructure

Assume principal responsibility for CI/CD of web services as well as software and data releases.
Support research, development, and operations by troubleshooting and resolving issues that arise.
Take technical responsibility for systems and be on the lookout for opportunities for new systems, improvement of existing systems, and work with the team to keep systems scaling and performing optimally.

Collaboration and Growth

Participate in team code reviews, present your work for feedback, and provide constructive feedback to others.
Clearly communicate technical capabilities, limitations, issues, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, including stakeholders, partners, and domain experts.
Work collegially and successfully in interdisciplinary teams with colleagues from various topical backgrounds and different skill levels and communication levels.

The Role

We are seeking a Software Engineer I, Full Stack to join our product development team working on Incydr, our Insider Risk Management product.

In this role, you will work as a full stack engineer with an emphasis on the front end of the Incydr web application, building features that help security teams protect corporate data and reduce insider risk. You will implement user interfaces in React and TypeScript, while also contributing to the backend services and APIs — built primarily in Kotlin and Java and hosted on AWS — that power those experiences. You will consume and help design APIs, maintain a consistent, high-quality user experience, and collaborate with User Experience, Product Management, Information Experience, and other development teams to provide features that bring value to our customers and help them secure their collaboration culture.

AI-First Engineering at Mimecast

Mimecast is an AI-first engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations.

We're looking for engineers who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.

What You’ll Do

Implement full stack code for assigned projects — from front-end interfaces to backend services and APIs — starting with well-scoped pieces and growing toward owning small features end to end, with an eye toward supportability, testability, and a consistent user experience.
Write unit, integration, and system tests across the frontend and backend of your team's code.
Test, debug, and troubleshoot across the Incydr web stack, from the UI down to backend services.
Partner with teammates to ship end-to-end features spanning UI and services.
Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and help manage deployment of services owned by the team.
Assist with production issues and escalated customer questions for the web application and services owned by the team.
Participate in the team’s on-call rotation to support production services and respond to incidents as needed.
Document code and review code and design docs from others.
Demo progress on team deliverables.
Participate in story mapping and authoring sessions.
Contribute to process improvement efforts within engineering.
Participate in design discussions and code reviews, asking questions, contributing, and accepting feedback.
Learn about new things and share that with your team and others.
Collaborate with teammates throughout the product development organization including product owners, UI/UX designers, QA analysts, technical writers, and customer champions.

What You’ll Bring

We're looking for engineers with established fundamentals and the aptitude to grow — we care as much about your ability to learn as your current skill set, and strong candidates will have experience across many of these areas without necessarily checking every box.

1-2 years of professional software engineering experience, with a full stack background and an emphasis on frontend development.
Experience with React and TypeScript fundamentals including components, props, hooks, etc.
Experience with modern HTML and CSS techniques.
Experience translating designs/mockups into functional, responsive user interfaces.
Experience with frontend testing frameworks (e.g. Cypress, Playwright, or similar).
Familiarity with REST APIs and integrating client-side applications with backend services; experience building or maintaining those APIs is a plus.
Exposure to backend languages such as Kotlin or Java, and to data repository technologies (e.g. PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch), is a plus.
Experience with object-oriented development, microservices, or multi-tier systems is a plus.
Familiarity with continuous integration and deployment concepts.
Experience with agile/lean development processes.
Comfortable taking ownership of deliverables as part of a team.
Comfortable working in a collaborative environment, both offering and asking for help when it's needed.
Comfortable working with non-technical staff.
Passion for building interfaces and systems that work well for users.
Able to communicate technical ideas to peers in written and verbal form.
Experience with design systems and web performance is a plus.

What We Bring

Join our Incydr Product Development team to accelerate your career journey, working with cutting-edge technologies and contributing to projects that have real customer impact. You will be immersed in a dynamic environment that recognizes and celebrates your achievements.

Mimecast offers formal and ‘on the job’ learning opportunities, maintains a comprehensive benefits package that helps our employees and their family members to sustain a healthy lifestyle, and importantly - working in cross functional teams to build your knowledge!

Our Hybrid Model: We provide you with the flexibility to live balanced, healthy lives through our hybrid working model that champions both collaborative teamwork and individual flexibility. Employees are expected to come to the office at least two days per week, because working together in person:

Fosters a culture of collaboration, communication, performance and learning.
Drives innovation and creativity within and between teams.
Introduces employees to priorities outside of their immediate realm.
Ensures important interpersonal relationships and connections with one another and our community!

The base salary range for this position is $100,000-$150,000 plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly.

Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
