SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**SOFTWARE ENGINEER, BACKEND (PYTHON/C++)**

As a Software Engineer on the test infrastructure team, you will design, develop, and maintain SpaceX's in-house testing ecosystem that powers software and hardware test and validation across all flight systems. You will build and evolve the core test infrastructure framework and supporting applications used for production testing, integration testing, and high-fidelity simulations. The team is focused on building out SpaceXAI, improving SpaceX's engineering capacity and capability through AI tooling.

This is a high-impact role where you will work across engineering groups to create reliable, scalable, and performant testing tools that accelerate vehicle production and flight software. Our testing software is critical to mission success for all vehicle programs at SpaceX. SpaceX is looking for smart, motivated software engineers who enjoy taking on complex challenges, work well in dynamic environments, and care about software best practices.

Help us build world-class software that is critical to SpaceX's mission to Mars.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop and maintain the core test infrastructure framework and applications used across SpaceX
* Improve reliability, performance, and safety of test software and infrastructure
* Work closely with flight software engineers and users across the company to develop new features and improve user experiences
* Own all aspects of software engineering and product development for test infrastructure
* Deep dive into users' problems to find and create efficient solutions

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree
* 1+ years of experience with C/C++
* 1+ years of experience with Python

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience developing telemetry-based software
* Expertise in designing software systems
* Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework
* Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring
* Understanding of agentic workflows and utilizing AI to improve developer experience
* Expertise in profiling and improving application performance
* Experience with build systems (Make and Bazel preferred) and package management tools (pip, npm)
* Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Ansible and Puppet for managing them
* Production experience with Docker, Containerd, LXC, and/or Kubernetes
* Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* You may be asked to work extended hours/weekends dependent on launch cadence
* This role requires you to be onsite. Remote and/or hybrid work will not be considered

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

Pay Range:  
Software Engineer/Level I: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00/per year

Software Engineer/Level II: $145,000.00 - $175,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation & will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**

* To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX's Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com*.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Discovery
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
------------------

Anduril Cyber is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of capabilities to enable offensive cyber missions. Cyber is a new business line at Anduril, and relies upon our fleet of autonomous vehicles, the Lattice operating system, mesh networks, and other hardware products to engage in cyber operations at the edge. We design and build novel solutions to deploy cyber capabilities in unconventional or difficult to reach environments.  
  
The new **Lattice for Cyber** team will build the core capabilities, experiences, and primitives that allow our Cyber products to operate reliably at scale. This is a founding team working from an unusually blank sheet of paper.

**ABOUT THE JOB**
-----------------

As a Software Engineer in Lattice for Cyber, you will build the core capabilities, experiences, and primitives that our offensive Cyber programs rely on. You will solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way. Your efforts will ensure that Anduril products seamlessly work together to achieve a variety of critical outcomes. Clean interfaces, real documentation, and working examples are the product, not chores that come after it.  
  
Above all, Anduril engineers on this team are driven by a "Whatever It Takes" mindset — executing in an expedient, scalable, and pragmatic way while keeping the mission top-of-mind and making sound engineering decisions to deliver successful outcomes on-time and with high quality. Not only will you build the software, you'll have the opportunity to work with the customer's to deploy it.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Build highly-available and scalable services, data models, and APIs that power our offensive cyber products such as command and control frameworks, autonomous cyber behavior trees, SIGINT analysis tools, and data exfiltration pipelines.
* Integrate best-of-breed Cyber tools and products into Lattice via custom SDKs or white-glove integrations.
* Work directly with program teams and customers as they build real missions on your products.
* Contribute to technical leadership, design clarity, and long-term maintainability across a growing software stack.
* Design distributed software systems that work reliably between the far edge and the enterprise across degraded, intermittent, and contested networks.
* Incorporate AI/LLM-enabled workflow features where they improve analyst or operator effectiveness without compromising system reliability.
* Build SDKs and integrations to allow best-of-breed vendors to incorporate their software and tools into our Lattice Cyber platform.
* Contribute back to the Lattice software platform core, allowing your products to provide value across the entire company.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production software.
* Strong software engineering experience in one or more of C, C++, Python, Go, Rust, or modern TypeScript/React application development.
* Ability to debug across the full stack, including logs, networking, interfaces, configuration, and hardware/software boundaries.
* Practical experience with Linux and containerized deployment.
* Comfort collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams and translating ambiguous requirements into clean software interfaces.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical reviews and architecture discussions.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Washington, DC or the Orange County, CA metro areas.
* Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time support program teams and customer events.
* **US security clearance eligible**

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Hands-on offensive or defensive cyber background.
* Exposure to AI/LLM integration patterns, inference workflows, tool orchestration, or model-assisted application features.
* Front end experience in TypeScript and React. This is a backend leaning role, but we generally work across the stack.
* Track record of technical leadership, productization work, or direct customer interface in complex engineering environments.
* Prior work delivering into air-gapped or otherwise constrained deployment environments.
* An active U.S. Security clearance.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer, Test Infrastructure (SITL/HITL)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About The Team**
------------------

The Sentry Tower Software team develops robotic systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. We live in a world where security officers are increasingly overwhelmed by sensor data feeds. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture.

**About the Job**
-----------------

Sentry Towers are robotic systems: motors, cameras, radars, radios, and sensor boards, running on NVIDIA Jetson compute in the field. Verifying that a system like this works means accounting for physical actuation, real sensor data, and hardware that fails in ways no unit test anticipates. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own our simulation and hardware test infrastructure and make automated, whole-system testing the default for everything we ship. A regression that escapes here does not surface on a developer's laptop. It surfaces on a tower at a site someone has to fly to, guarding a perimeter that does not pause while we debug.

You will work across both halves of the problem. Our software-in-the-loop environments are declaratively defined multi-node virtual towers, complete with a simulated ground control station, synthetic sensor feeds, and a game-engine-driven world, which lets us run whole-system scenarios in CI with no hardware attached. Our hardware-in-the-loop side drives real Jetson-based towers through a board test server: provisioning them over the network, flashing firmware, installing full system images, and reporting results back through our CI pipeline on a nightly and weekend cadence.

Both foundations are in place and working, so you are inheriting infrastructure rather than starting from nothing. What does not exist yet is most of what sits on top: the functional test suites, the scenario library, and the diagnostic tooling that turn a booting tower into a verified one are yours to design. Firmware integration, compute platform bring-up, and both our Air Defense and Counter-Intrusion business lines depend on this capability, and what you build becomes the standard they test against.

Test infrastructure is a job where the wins are invisible and the failures are loud. You will spend real time on work nobody asks for by name: chasing intermittent failures to root cause instead of retrying them, waiting on hardware that is scarce and shared, and rebuilding coverage when a compute generation changes underneath you. The measure of the role is bugs that never reach a tower, which means much of your best work leaves no trace anyone thanks you for.

Our Product: https://www.anduril.com/sentry

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Own and grow our SITL environments: add product variants and scenarios, keep the simulated sensor and video pipelines faithful enough to be trustworthy, and keep whole-system test runtimes short enough to fit inside a normal development cycle.
* Build out functional coverage on the HITL bench across the behavior that matters: motion control and trajectory execution, camera and sensor bring-up, firmware update paths, network failover, and clean recovery from power loss and unexpected reboots.
* Own the CI integration end to end: scheduling, dependency chaining between test stages, artifact and log capture, result reporting, and the flake triage that keeps a hardware pipeline trusted instead of ignored.
* Grow the test platform continuously as the product line does. New compute generations, new payloads, and new product variants each need coverage, and keeping the framework ahead of the roadmap is the enduring core of this role.
* Make failures diagnosable without touching the rig. Invest in log capture, serial console capture, and test artifacts so an engineer can root-cause from the CI output alone.
* Partner with hardware and manufacturing engineers to stand up the physical HITL benches, specifying the fixtures, switching, power control, and instrumentation needed to exercise towers unattended. This is a substantial upfront build with periodic expansion as new hardware arrives.
* Partner with firmware, platform, and business line teams so they can add their own tests against your framework, and support them as their first users.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* 4+ years of professional software engineering, with meaningful time spent building test infrastructure, CI systems, or simulation for systems that involve real hardware.
* Proficiency in Python for test authoring and automation, plus working ability in Rust or C++ to read and debug the services under test.
* Demonstrated experience automating tests against physical hardware: device provisioning, remote power and reset control, serial consoles, network booting, or instrumented benches.
* Strong CI/CD engineering skills, including pipelines with expensive stages, hardware resource contention, and scheduled rather than per-commit execution.
* Experience with declarative configuration and reproducible builds. Nix or NixOS is what we use and what we most want to see; adjacent depth in Bazel, Buildroot, Yocto, or infrastructure-as-code to

On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. * **Building the future of Disney’s media business:** DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
* **Reach & Scale:** The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more.

**Lifecycle Messaging**

jobs.description:
**Meet the Moment with Alteryx**

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

**Meet the Moment with Alteryx**

At Alteryx, we're building technology that helps organizations connect to, manage, and work with their data securely and efficiently. As data, automation, and AI continue to evolve, our cloud platform plays an important role in helping customers solve complex problems and make better decisions.

We're looking for engineers who enjoy meaningful technical challenges, value collaboration, and want to build technology that makes a real difference.

  

**Position Overview**

We're looking for a **Software Engineer** to join our Data Plane Transport team within Cloud Platform Engineering. Our team builds and operates foundational services that enable secure, reliable communication between Alteryx Cloud, data planes, and customer environments. Our work includes Data Bridge, which enables customers to securely access private data sources, along with shared platform services for connectivity, networking, registration, and

orchestration across distributed cloud environments.

  

This is a hands-on, backend-focused engineering role, primarily developing services and APIs in Go, with some opportunities to contribute to frontend applications using TypeScript and React.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, contribute to technical decisions, and take ownership of features and improvements from development through production.

  

This is a remote-friendly role.

Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and distributed systems, primarily using Go.

Build and improve secure connectivity solutions involving service registration,

orchestration, routing, and proxy/relay-based communication.

Own well-defined features and enhancements through implementation, testing,

deployment, and production support.

Develop and maintain cloud-native services running in AWS and GCP, with a focus on reliability, security, and scalability.

Contribute to frontend applications and platform management experiences using TypeScript and React when needed.

Investigate and troubleshoot issues across application code, cloud infrastructure, and networking components.

Improve automated testing, monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational tooling. Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and code reviews while collaborating with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and other engineering teams.

Participate in an on-call rotation after onboarding, helping maintain production reliability and address recurring issues.

  

**Required Qualification** s

2+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent relevant experience.

Experience building backend services and REST APIs using Go or a comparable backend language, with the ability to become productive in Go.

Strong software engineering fundamentals, including debugging, automated testing, and writing clean, maintainable code.

Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, and service-to-service communication.

Understanding of networking fundamentals, including HTTP/TLS, TCP/IP, DNS, and client-server communication.

Experience developing or deploying applications in cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or similar platforms.

  

Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software

development practices.

Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to independently deliver

scoped work while collaborating with a team.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience with TypeScript, React, or similar frontend technologies.

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, or other cloud-native tooling.

Familiarity with cloud networking, private connectivity, proxies, gateways, or secure tunneling.

Exposure to event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Redis, or Pub/Sub.

Familiarity with observability tools such as Datadog, metrics, logging, and distributed tracing.

Understanding of security concepts such as authentication, certificates, secrets management, and encryption.

Experience troubleshooting production services, participating in on-call rotations, or improving system reliability.

jobs.title: Layout Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly skilled R&D Engineer with extensive hands-on experience in RFIC, MMIC, RF module, or analog/mixed-signal layout, combined with an interest in advancing layout automation and design productivity.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in developing and optimizing complex high-frequency IC layouts, with practical understanding of RF layout considerations such as device placement, matching, routing, shielding, isolation, passive structures, parasitic effects, and electromagnetic interactions.

This role is primarily focused on RFIC/MMIC layout and physical design, while also providing opportunities to contribute to layout automation through Python, parameterized layout generation, and collaboration with software and automation engineers.

Responsibilities:

* Develop physical layouts for RF, microwave, and analog integrated circuits.
* Work closely with circuit designers to translate schematics into high-quality, manufacturable layouts.
* Apply RF/analog layout techniques including device matching, symmetry, shielding, grounding, isolation, and parasitic optimization.
* Layout active devices and passive structures such as transistors, resistors, capacitors, inductors, transmission lines, and matching networks.
* Optimize layouts for electrical performance, area, manufacturability, and reliability.
* Perform and debug DRC, LVS, and other physical verification checks.
* Support layout iterations based on simulation, extraction, and design feedback.
* Use Python scripting to improve productivity and automate repetitive layout and design-flow tasks.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing layout workflows through automation.
* Collaborate with software and automation engineers to translate practical layout requirements into automated solutions.

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on experience in RFIC, microwave, analog, or mixed-signal IC layout.
* Solid understanding of RF and analog layout techniques and physical design considerations.
* Experience with industry-standard IC layout and physical verification tools.
* Experience with DRC, LVS, and parasitic-aware layout.
* Ability to work closely with RF/analog circuit designers.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Requirements

Education Requirements

* Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.

Years of Experience

* 2-4 years experience developing, tuning, operationalizing, and monitoring enterprise ML models at scale.
* 2-4 years experience with public cloud platforms & systems (AWS, GCP, Azure).

* Strong knowledge of distributed computing, data structures, data mapping, data warehouse, data mining, business analytics, software development, replication, and distributed/relational databases.

* Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, with ability to communicate effectively.
* Experience to tracking projects and goals to successful completion (with visible metrics).
* Ability to stay abreast of significant technological developments that may impact the business.
* Equipped to effectively prioritize, collaborate and excel in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

Mindbody equips wellness entrepreneurs with technology to support thriving businesses and create exceptional experiences. Innovation and curiosity drive our culture, connecting businesses and individuals through cutting-edge solutions. Join us if you're passionate about enhancing wellness through technology.

**Your role**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll play a crucial leadership role in building scalable systems for the Mindbody ecosystem. You'll exercise autonomy in decision-making, take ownership of large technical projects, and provide leadership within your team and across engineering. You proactively identify and solve challenges your squad is facing, often leading medium-to-large features and cross-team efforts. You act as a multiplier for your team, mentoring engineers, sharing best practices, and contributing to a culture of growth and learning. You'll pursue continuous improvement to help Mindbody achieve its mission: Powering the world's fitness and wellness businesses and connecting them with more consumers, more effectively, than anyone else

You'll likely spend time working on

* Leading discussions with Product, Design, and QA to iterate on the design, implementation and deployment of our product.
* Build, maintain, and own backend systems and applications.
* Seeking different perspectives and soliciting honest feedback
* Practice engineering best practices (e.g., automated testing, code reviews, proper monitoring) while guiding others on their adoption, and contributing thoughtful, timely feedback during peer reviews.
* Mentoring and leading through code reviews, teaching best practices, and conducting technical interviews for engineers and managers.
* Leading retrospectives and incident postmortems for your squad.
* Helping attract and retain talent by building community inside and outside the organization
* Care about our studio partners and want to help them grow their business
* Take delight in delighting our users.

About the right team member

You love to design robust and easy to use APIs and services taking ownership of technical decisions. You're capable of leading complex technical projects with high levels of uncertainty, scale, and interdependencies—creating timelines, delegating tasks, and ensuring smooth launches. You learn quickly and ramp up on new systems, languages, or frameworks with minimal guidance. You're not afraid to ask questions early and often in unfamiliar territory. You are a sought-after contributor in code reviews, helping elevate code quality through timely and constructive feedback. You are an expert in one or more technical areas and are recognized within your team as a trusted source of insights and mentorship.

At Playlist we value people who are intellectually curious, who are pragmatic not dogmatic, and people who care about our product, their teammates, and their own personal growth. We are faced with an interesting set of technical challenges, and we believe in giving our engineers the autonomy to go and solve them. Much of our team comes from non-traditional computing backgrounds; we know that by bringing together a diverse set of voices we'll be able to build a better product, and a better company. We care less about what languages or frameworks you know, and care more that you are excited to produce high-quality code and be constantly learning. Our engineers work in cross-functional teams that are focused on impact, and movement between teams is encouraged. We work very closely with our brilliant product team to deliver a world class user experience, and ultimately to empower our users to live their fullest, healthiest lives.

**You'll thrive in this role with experience in**

* 8+ years' experience in programming large-scale SaaS products.
* Experience building backend services with an object-oriented language such as C# or Java.
* Experience designing and architecting backend services.
* Experience Designing and working with Microservice architecture.
* Experience with monitoring systems such as New Relic or Kibana.
* Familiarity with SDLC and programming design patterns, and Agile methodology.
* Experience reviewing new feature impact on an application and recognizing potential risks.
* Detail-oriented, professional and possesses a positive work attitude.
* Ability to communicate professionally both verbally and in writing.

**Nice to have**

* Experience building or operating payment flows end to end — authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, and reconciliation.
* Hands-on integration with a payment gateway or PSP, including webhook-driven state handling.
* Experience making payment operations safe to retry — idempotency, retries, and eventual consistency — so a request that fails partway through doesn't double-charge a customer.
* Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope, tokenization, and handling sensitive payment data safely.

**Technologies you'll be working with**

~ You don't need experience with every item below—what matters is strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly ~

* Experience building high-performing, high-quality backend systems. Our codebase is diverse and includes .NET, C#, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin, Python, React, and Ruby, but we're less focused on experience with a specific language and more interested in your ability to build reliable, well-designed systems.
* **Data:** PostgreSQL/MongoDB/DynamoDB, Redis, schema migrations, indexing, partitioning/sharding
* Strong understanding of SQL and relational dat

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Product
jobs.description:
**Build the platform that will power every type of financial institution onboarding**

Prelim is seeking a **Software Engineer, Product** to join our rapidly growing and fully remote US team. You'll have the opportunity to architect and build the platform that handles every conceivable type of financial institution onboarding, from simple deposit accounts to complex treasury services for millions of people. If you're passionate about solving massive-scale engineering challenges and eager to be part of a fast-paced remote startup culture, we encourage you to apply to join our team today!

As a **Software Engineer, Product** at Prelim, you will own critical parts of the platform that powers digital onboarding for financial institutions across the world. You'll work directly with our customers, product team, and engineering leadership to build systems that handle everything from online deposit account opening to in-branch experiences, account maintenance, treasury services onboarding, credit card applications, and every other type of financial institution onboarding imaginable.

**This isn't just another full-stack role, it's the chance to build the infrastructure that millions depend on.**  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Architect and build features across our entire stack handling massive scale and complexity.
* Build, enhance and fix the systems that seamlessly integrate with legacy bank infrastructure, core banking systems, and third-party compliance providers.
* Solve complex technical challenges around multi-tenant architecture, real-time data processing, and bank-grade reliability requirements.
* Work directly with major banks to understand their unique onboarding requirements and translate complex business logic into elegant technical solutions.
* Own the performance, scalability, and reliability of systems processing millions of applications across hundreds of different banking products.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience with modern web technologies (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL preferred). Whether you're a new graduate with impressive projects or an experienced engineer, we want to hear from you.
* Strong system design skills and experience with scalable architectures, you'll be building systems that immediately help millions.
* You thrive on solving complex technical problems with business context. You can break down complicated banking requirements and build elegant solutions.
* You care about business impact and can balance technical excellence with shipping features that move the business forward.
* You think deeply about user experience, whether you're building for every day people opening accounts or bank employees processing applications.
* You're excited about working directly with customers, understanding their complex needs, and iterating quickly based on feedback.
* You want to own significant parts of the product and help shape technical decisions as we scale.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering.
* Legally authorized to work in the United States and located within the continental United States

**About Prelim**

Prelim is a San Francisco and New York City-based startup that operates with fully remote positions across the US, helping banks onboard their customers. Our platform is designed to streamline the account opening process for both consumers and businesses, accelerating speed-to-market and enhancing the customer experience for financial institutions. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the banking industry, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Prelim. We are seeking individuals who are driven, ambitious, and eager to make a real impact in a traditional industry ready for technological innovation.

We offer equity, a sponsored 401K, parental leave, and fully paid health, vision, and dental insurance. Additional benefits include unlimited PTO, a remote work stipend, a life-style stipend, and twice-yearly company retreats.

Prelim values diversity and inclusion; people of all backgrounds are welcome to join our mission to transform banking.

Compensation Range: $140K - $230K

Our mission is to build a sustainable business that powers our transportation and protects our planet. As a leader in clean transportation, EVgo sits at the intersection of technology, infrastructure, and innovation.

We are rapidly expanding our national footprint through strategic partnerships with retailers, automakers, rideshare and, fleets, bringing fast charging to communities across the country. EVgo enables drivers of all makes and models to charge where they want, when they want.

At EVgo, sustainability is not just what we do; it is who we are. We are committed to reducing carbon emissions, advancing clean energy solutions, and building infrastructure that supports a more sustainable future. We believe great companies are built by great people. Our culture is mission driven, customer centric, collaborative, and innovative, with a strong focus on creating an environment where employees can grow and make a lasting positive impact. Join us as we charge forward.

The Software team at EVgo is dedicated to developing robust and scalable software solutions that enhance the charging experience for our customers and partners while keeping systems secure. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.

**Who we are looking for:**

Are you passionate about expanding housing opportunities? Do you want to play your part in addressing the affordable housing crisis in the US? We are hiring a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to join an exceptional team and become a technical domain expert in our Affordable Housing space. Our team aims to make applying for, living in, and managing affordable housing units feel effortless and simple. Affordable Housing is an enormously complex domain - requiring complex data gathering and recurring submission of that data for certification and compliance—all within a diverse and ever-shifting regulatory environment. Things get very complicated very fast and property managers can struggle to keep up. With this team’s focus, innovation, and attention to detail, we see a future where it doesn’t have to be this way.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who has a passion for building leading-edge software and is driven to help build a successful SaaS product used by thousands of happy businesses. Moving is one of the most stressful events in a person's life. Between signing a lease and settling in, a new resident has to set up utilities, secure renters insurance, and coordinate with a property team that is juggling dozens of other move-ins. Most of that work is still manual, fragmented across vendors, and easy to get wrong. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Resident Onboarding team and become a technical domain expert in making that transition effortless.

This is a domain that gets complicated quickly. Utility providers vary by address and change without notice. Insurance requirements differ by property and jurisdiction. Partner systems are unreliable, data arrives incomplete, and every gap surfaces as a phone call to a property manager on move-in day. We combine automated research, partner integrations, and careful data modeling to close those gaps before the resident ever notices them. Our systems serve every new resident on AppFolio's Real Estate Performance Management platform.

This is an ideal opportunity for an engineer who thinks in systems, cares about the shape of a codebase years from now, and wants to set technical direction on a small, empowered team. You will be the engineer others look to when a design decision is hard.

jobs.description:
AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.

**Realm-X** is AppFolio's AI-native platform powering this transformation. It enables a new generation of intelligent capabilities across our products, including Realm-X Assistant (copilot), Flows (AI Agentic workflows) and Performers (autonomous AI Agents). Realm-X serves as both a **foundation for internal teams to build and scale AI-powered products**, and a **core layer delivering intelligent, high-impact experiences directly to our customers**.

At its core, Realm-X is built on a **structured domain ontology and a set of shared business primitives**—such as transactions, actions, reports, metrics, and skills—that enable AI systems to deeply understand and operate across the full context of property management workflows. This foundation allows us to build **context-aware, action-oriented AI systems** that go beyond simple assistance to power real automation and decision-making.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to design and ship the next generation of voice and conversational AI agents within Realm-X. This role helps define AppFolio's production voice and chat agent pipelines, working at the intersection of LLM agent frameworks, real-time voice technology, and streaming infrastructure.

You will work with Product, Voice channel, and ML Platform teams to translate cutting-edge agent and voice research into reliable, low-latency, multi-channel experiences that scale across our entire customer base.

**Your Impact**

* **Ship Voice & Text Agents:** Architect and ship voice and text agent pipelines that handle real-time, multi-turn customer interactions.
* **Reasoning vs. Latency:** Make principled trade-offs between reasoning depth and latency across frontier LLMs, smaller models, and routing strategies.
* **Lead a Pod:** Lead a small pod of ML and platform engineers; raise the bar on agent evaluation, observability, and incident response.
* **Define Quality:** Partner with Product and Voice channel teams to define KPIs, eval harnesses, and acceptance criteria for agent quality.
* **Optimize for Voice:** Drive selective Small Language Model (SLM) fine-tuning and inference optimization for voice latency and cost.

**Qualifications**

* You have 5+ years of experience developing and scaling web-based applications, preferably in a SaaS environment.
* You have shipped production AI agents serving real users in voice and/or text channels.
* You think in pipelines and systems, not just models.
* You move fast, deliver impact, and maintain sound engineering judgment.
* You are humble, collaborative, and low-ego, and you elevate those around you.
* You value work-life balance as a foundation for sustained high performance.

**Must Have**

* **Agent frameworks:** Deep, shipped experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, and LangChain Deep Agents (or equivalent agent frameworks).
* **Voice stack:** Hands-on with Voice-to-Voice models and traditional TTS / STT pipelines; understands the trade-offs between end-to-end voice models and modular STT LLM TTS architectures.
* **LLM fluency:** Strong grasp of LLM reasoning behavior, tool use, structured output, and reasoning-vs-latency trade-offs across providers.
* **Telephony & cloud:** Production experience with Twilio (or comparable telephony) and AWS.
* **Engineering:** Expert Python, async programming, and WebSockets for real-time, bidirectional streaming.
* **ML fundamentals:** Solid foundation in deep learning, model evaluation, and inference optimization; able to deploy with Docker on AWS.
* **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead a small team, mentor engineers, and partner credibly with Product and Design.

**Nice to Have**

* Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or related technical discipline.
* Experience fine-tuning Small Language Models for domain-specific voice applications.
* Familiarity with RAG over structured business data and tool-using agents over API surfaces.
* Prior experience in regulated or customer-facing industries with strict reliability requirements.
* Publicly verifiable work on GitHub, in open-source agent frameworks, or in community competitions.

**Location**

This opportunity resides with **Global Security (GS).** Mission Technologies’ Global Security (GS) group comprises live, virtual, constructive (LVC) solutions; fleet sustainment; nuclear and environmental; and Australia business.
  
  
As a trusted partner to our military customers, HII designs, develops and operates the largest LVC enterprise that prepares warfighters for cross-domain battle. With advanced technologies to enable mission readiness, HII understands that preparation requires full coordination—not readiness in piece-parts.

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. * **Take Ownership** – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.

* Troubleshoot, debug, test, and resolve application defects, performance issues, and production problems.

* Participate in application design, code reviews, testing, configuration management, and release activities.

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer (Rust)
jobs.description:
Umbra is an American space technology company delivering advanced systems, from sensors to spacecraft, that empower customers worldwide with unmatched access to critical information from space. Our mission is simple and ambitious: redefine space—for people, systems, and missions in every domain. Umbra’s ecosystem operates through three business units: Remote Sensing (the data), Space Systems (the components), and Mission Solutions (the platforms).Together, our teams develop capabilities that deliver persistent access, resilient performance, and mission-ready solutions, advancing U.S. space leadership while keeping the world safe and informed.

**About the Team**

**Space Systems – The Components**

Space Systems is where Umbra turns hardware and software designs into on-orbit realities; developing, implementing and iterating mission-ready core technology, while simultaneously advancing the next generation of our own satellite constellation. Space Systems is vertically integrated across the satellite architecture, thus the team designs, builds, and tests an array of critical components and subsystems, including power systems, communications, control systems, deployment hardware, avionics, and payloads, as well as the flight software, firmware and digital design solutions to support the entire hardware stack. Our focus is on first principles engineering, and our mandate is simple: it has to work when it counts. Every bolt, board, and binary is proven on our own SAR constellation, ensuring flight-proven reliability where failure is not an option.

If you want to work on cutting edge space technology while maintaining the highest standard for innovation and mission ready performance, you belong here at Umbra.

**About the Job**

We are seeking a **Flight Software Engineer** who has experience in Rust programming language to take an active role in the development and delivery of embedded flight software specifically tailored for Umbra missions. In this pivotal role, you will be tasked with a range of critical responsibilities, including but not limited to the formulation and specification of software requirements, the comprehensive design of robust software architecture, and the actual writing and implementation of code. You will take lead responsibility for the essential processes of system integration and testing, ensuring that all components function seamlessly together.

In addition to your core development responsibilities, you will also be expected to provide expert guidance and mentorship in various aspects of software design, code development, and peer code reviews. Your role will include oversight of thorough documentation practices and the meticulous integration of the flight software with flight hardware, which encompasses conducting unit testing to ensure reliability and performance. Your contributions will be vital to the success of our missions, driving innovation and excellence in software engineering within our team.

**This position is based on-site in either our Santa Barbara/Goleta, CA office, Arlington, VA office, or Reston, VA office.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with a cross-disciplinary engineering team to design, develop, and maintain reliable, fault-tolerant flight and payload software.

* Develop command and control software for spacecraft flight operations, payloads, and peripheral electronics.
* Participate in and contribute to test campaigns, from unit-level testing to automated system and subsystem-level testing.
* Create and maintain documentation for software operation and interfaces with other system components.
* Take on additional professional duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of proven experience in high-reliability software development with **Rust** or C/C++.
* 1+ years developing concurrent code with **asynchronous Rust**.
* 3+ years of embedded software development with **Rust** or C/C++.
* Experience programming on embedded ARM cores supporting SoC architectures in Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal environments.
* Strong understanding of processor architecture, with the ability to optimize code for performance and memory usage.
* Experience leading software development processes, including version control, CI/CD, bug tracking, and design documentation.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with 5+ years of relevant experience.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic development environment.

* Familiarity with Python programming.

IdeaTek is looking for an **AI Software Developer** to build and deploy internal software solutions using AI-assisted development tools as a core part of the development process. This is a hands-on role for an experienced developer who knows how to use AI to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, and deployment while applying strong technical judgment to validate the quality of the output.

You’ll work directly with managers and business stakeholders to understand needs, determine priorities, and quickly turn ideas into usable solutions. The environment is agile, flexible, and highly iterative—you’ll be expected to move quickly, adapt as requirements evolve, and streamline the development lifecycle.

This role is open to remote candidates located in **Kansas**.

**A Day in the Life**

Your day may begin with a conversation with a manager or stakeholder to understand a business problem or new software need. From there, you’ll define the approach, use AI-assisted development tools to build an initial solution, test the output, and iterate based on feedback.

Throughout the day, you may be developing a new internal tool, enhancing an existing application, validating AI-generated code, troubleshooting an integration, or working directly with a stakeholder to refine requirements. You’ll balance speed with sound technical judgment—knowing when an AI-generated solution is ready to move forward and when it needs further review or refinement.

This isn’t a role built around long development cycles or rigid processes. You’ll be trusted to prioritize, experiment, iterate, and deliver practical solutions that solve real business problems.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next-generation AI capabilities.

While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies.

Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility.

By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure.

As an Embedded Software Engineer II, you will own specific components of our embedded stack, working close to the hardware on the real-time firmware that our safety devices depend on. Most of your time will be spent in RTOS environments (Zephyr and FreeRTOS) and on bare-metal targets, architecting safety-critical systems where reliability is a hard requirement. You will also work with our Embedded Linux platforms where the two worlds meet, so you will be comfortable moving between constrained real-time targets and richer application environments.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build the Core:** Design and implement robust C/C++ firmware for safety-critical embedded devices.
* **Real-Time Architecture:** Architect and implement RTOS-based firmware on Zephyr and FreeRTOS, including task and scheduling design, ISR handling, inter-task communication, memory and stack budgeting, and deterministic timing analysis.
* **Bare-Metal and Drivers:** Write low-level peripheral drivers and board support code, and bring up new silicon from reset vector through to a running application.
* **Platform Integration:** Interface RTOS devices with our Embedded Linux user-space applications, ensuring reliable communication and consistent behavior across the product.
* **Pipeline & Quality:** Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) to automate testing, including on-target and hardware-in-the-loop test execution.
* **Hardware Integration:** Bring up new hardware, debug complex issues using JTAG/GDB, and optimize for latency, power, and memory footprint.
* **Safety Compliance:** Collaborate with the safety team to ensure code adheres to rigorous standards (IEC 61508) while maintaining development velocity.

**What You Bring**

* **Experience:** 3-5 years of hands-on embedded software development, with a substantial portion on RTOS or bare-metal targets.
* **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in C, along with working proficiency in C++.
* **RTOS Knowledge:** Solid production experience with an RTOS such as Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or similar, including scheduling, synchronization primitives, and interrupt-driven design.
* **Microcontroller Fluency:** Comfort working directly with MCU peripherals, datasheets, reference manuals, linker scripts, and startup code.
* **Linux Exposure:** Familiarity with Embedded Linux user-space development, sufficient to integrate and debug across the RTOS and Linux boundary.
* **Connectivity:** Familiarity with IP networking protocols and standard interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, USB, CAN).
* **Tooling:** Experience with Python for scripting/automation and familiarity with CI/CD workflows.
* **Debugging:** Comfort using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, and GDB to troubleshoot hard-to-find bugs.
* **Education:** B.S. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with Zephyr specifically, including devicetree, Kconfig, and west-based workflows.
* Experience with wireless stacks (BLE, ISM, Wi-Fi) on constrained devices.
* Background in Functional Safety (FuSa) or working in regulated industries (Medical, Automotive, Aerospace).
* Low-level Linux knowledge of Board Support Packages (BSP) and device drivers.
* Familiarity with static analysis, MISRA C, or other coding standards used in safety-critical development.

#### **Compensation & Benefits**

**Base salary range:** $120,000–$150,000, based on experience and location.  
**Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; stock options; 3% 401(k) match, paid holidays, and parental leave.  
**Application window:** Applications accepted through the end of December 2026. This date will be updated if the window is extended.

FORT Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

FORT Robotics uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team review and organize applications. These tools do not make hiring decisions; all decisions are made by FORT employees. To request an accommodation or a review without these tools, contact HR@fortrobotics.com.

jobs.description:
**Our Mission:**

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

**Our People:**

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

**Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform**  
**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area or Austin, TX (Hybrid)

**About the Role**
------------------

6sense has agents and an MCP server in production today, used by real customers. This role takes them further by building more capable agents, strengthening the API and tool layer, and expanding an ecosystem that external agents, clients, and partners can connect to.

You'll work across the full path from a customer's agent to 6sense data and actions, including APIs, tools, MCP, orchestration, context, evaluation, and security.

6sense is working to become the default Contextual Intelligence layer for B2B, and agents and MCP are how that context reaches customers, partners, and their AI tools. You'll partner closely with the team building contextual intelligence, write production Python daily, own multi-month projects, support the teams and customers who depend on these systems, and keep the platform current as the agent tooling landscape evolves.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Agents and Orchestration**

* Extend LangGraph orchestrators with typed state, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointing, durable execution, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Select and implement routing, orchestrator-worker, plan-and-execute, reflection, and multi-agent handoff patterns based on business needs.
* Run agents headless through API-first and MCP-first architectures across in-app, chat, workflow, and partner surfaces from a shared core.
* Build and maintain reusable components for state management, memory, tool-calling, and agent-to-agent delegation with scoped permissions.

### **APIs, Tools, and MCP**

* Evolve the APIs and tools agents use to access 6sense data and take action for both human and LLM consumers.
* Optimize tool design for agent success, including naming, descriptions, schemas, response formats, error handling, and token efficiency.
* Re-design and scale the MCP layer for production workloads, including concurrency, per-tenant quotas, latency budgets, caching, graceful degradation, backward compatibility, and adoption of emerging MCP capabilities.
* Onboard external MCP clients, AI assistants, agent platforms, and partners. Develop integration guides and reference clients and define trust boundaries for third-party MCP server integrations.
* Strengthen platform reliability through idempotency, retries, rate limits, permissions, spend controls, and standards for tool contracts, versioning, and discovery.

### **Context and Evaluation**

* Partner with the Contextual Intelligence team to expose context through MCP, APIs, and tools, enabling a unified context layer across all customer touchpoints.
* Define and enforce contracts around returned data, freshness, provenance, and tenant and user-level access controls.
* Improve permission-aware retrieval and grounding through chunking, hybrid search, reranking, citations, context assembly, and memory management within token and latency constraints.
* Expand evaluation frameworks using golden datasets, tool-selection accuracy, tool-call accuracy, end-to-end task success metrics, regression testing, release gates, and context quality measurements.
* Enhance tracing and usage analytics while reporting on task success rates, tool-call precision, groundedness, latency, and cost efficiency.

### **Security, Privacy, and Trust**

* Make security a first-class consideration across every tool, API, agent, and MCP change.
* Review your own and teammates' work for vulnerabilities and security risks.
* Enforce tenant isolation and user-level authorization for all requests while maintaining short-lived, scoped credentials.
* Protect against prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agent autonomy, and data leakage through outputs, traces, and logs.
* Establish runtime guardrails around steps, tokens, execution time, and spend.

### **Customers and Engineering Excellence**

* Investigate and resolve customer-reported issues across agents, tools, models, and downstream systems.
* Participate in customer and partner technical discussions and support enablement teams through guidance, demonstrations, and documentation.
* Write design documents, evaluate trade-offs, conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and participate in on-call and incident response rotations.
* Stay current with developments in MCP, agent frameworks, and model capabilities, prototyping promising technologies and sharing evidence-based recommendations.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 5+ years of experience building and operating production software systems, with strong distributed systems fundamentals including idempotency, fault tolerance, backpressure, and failure recovery.
* 2+ years of experience building production LLM-powered systems, including customer-facing agents.
* Strong Python development skills and production experience with LangGraph or a comparable orchestration framework.
* Experience designing APIs and tool interfaces for LLM consumers, including schemas, descriptions, error handling, and tool selection optimization. Direct MCP experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience scaling customer- or partner-facing platforms, including authentication, rate limiting, versioning, and backward compatibility.

jobs.title: Junior/Mid Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Junior/Mid SOFTWARE ENGINEER (1 to 5 years of experience)**

  
  

**Overview**

We're looking for a Software Engineer who can operate independently within an Agile team, take ambiguous requirements from concept to production, and bring architectural judgment to how we structure and process data at scale. This is not a developer from a particular tech stack, but rather a true software engineer who can and will work with any number of languages without restriction.

We are only accepting candidates currently residing in the state of Florida, preferably in the greater Tampa/St. Petersburg area, at this time.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Work within a Scrum/Agile team through the full sprint cycle — backlog refinement, sprint planning, capacity estimation, daily standups, sprint review, and retrospectives.

* Participate in requirement refinement sessions with product owners and stakeholders, turning ambiguous asks into well-scoped, estimable stories.

* Apply modern software design patterns and enforce separation of concerns across the codebase, ensuring components remain loosely coupled and independently testable.

* Design and build proofs of concept (POCs) to validate new approaches before committing to full implementation.

* Design and implement systems that handle structured (CSV, relational), semi-structured (JSON), unstructured, and schema-bound formats like Avro, including the tradeoffs between them for storage, processing and schema evolution.

* Contribute to big data architecture and design patterns — batch and/or streaming pipelines, data partitioning, and scalable processing approaches.

* Collaborate with UI/UX on interface design decisions, ensuring frontend implementation aligns with usability and design intent.

  
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience working in Scrum/Agile teams, including sprint planning, capacity estimation, and iterative delivery.

* Strong grasp of modern design patterns (e.g., strategy, factory, repository, observer) and the "separation of concerns" principle — able to explain not just what it is, but why it matters for maintainability and testability.

* Experience with UI/UX collaboration and requirement refinement.

* Hands-on experience with structured, semi-structured, unstructured, and schema-based data formats (CSV, JSON, Avro).

* Big data technology experience (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Hadoop ecosystem or equivalent) and associated design patterns.

* Demonstrated experience building and validating POCs.

* Experience designing and building microservices architectures — service decomposition, inter-service communication (REST/gRPC/event-driven messaging), API contracts and independent deployability.

* Strong understanding of data layer and persistence design patterns — repository pattern, unit of work, CQRS, data access layer abstraction, ORM vs. raw query tradeoffs, caching strategies and both relational (SQL) and NoSQL database design.

* Experience with cloud platforms — AWS, Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — including core compute, storage, and managed data services on at least one major provider.

**Desirable**

* Proficiency in one or more modern languages beyond your primary stack — Python, Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Rust, TypeScript/Node.js or C# — with the versatility to pick up new languages as project needs evolve.

* Multi-cloud exposure across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and familiarity with cloud-native patterns (containers, Kubernetes, serverless, managed data/streaming services).

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Payment Interfaces
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.  
  
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  
  
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

#### **The Role**

Payment Interfaces builds and operates the APIs and services that power payment experiences across Block, including Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. Our systems process payment traffic worldwide, helping sellers accept payments and customers move money reliably and securely.

You'll design, build, and scale customer-facing payment APIs and the critical systems behind them. You'll bring experience in payments, lead complex projects from design through production, and help shape the team's technical direction. You'll learn the specifics of Block's products and payment processing on the job.

This is a hands-on engineering role with ongoing operational responsibility. Alongside building new capabilities, you'll maintain high-volume production systems, participate in on-call and incident response, and make improvements that prevent recurring problems. You'll use AI throughout your work while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of what you ship.

#### **You Will**

* Design, build, maintain, and scale customer-facing payment APIs with clear contracts, predictable behavior, and compatibility that developers can rely on.
* Lead complex projects end to end: clarify requirements, evaluate trade-offs, plan incremental delivery, and own testing, rollout, and ongoing maintenance.
* Operate critical payment systems serving worldwide traffic. Participate in the team's on-call rotation, investigate incidents, and follow through on fixes that improve reliability.
* Improve performance, observability, fault tolerance, and security. Use automation to reduce repetitive operational work and make systems safer to change.
* Work with product and engineering partners across Block to turn payment requirements into reusable capabilities.
* Use AI-assisted tools for design, implementation, testing, and debugging. Critically evaluate their output and help teammates adopt approaches that improve quality and delivery.
* Shape technical decisions within the team and develop others through design reviews, code reviews, documentation, and mentoring

#### **You Have**

* **Experience building, maintaining, and scaling customer-facing financial or payment APIs, together with a strong understanding of payments.** This is a requirement for the role.
* Experience designing and operating high-volume, highly available distributed systems where correctness, security, and reliability matter.
* An understanding of payment API concerns such as idempotency, retries, asynchronous processing, backward compatibility, and handling partial failures without compromising financial correctness.
* A record of leading complex engineering projects from unclear requirements through production, making technical trade-offs, and coordinating work with partner teams.
* Experience diagnosing production issues and improving systems through monitoring, incident response, and preventive engineering.
* Fluency with AI-assisted engineering tools and the judgment to validate generated code, protect sensitive data, and recognize when deeper investigation is needed.
* Clear written communication and experience helping other engineers develop their technical skills.
* A minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience

#### **Technologies We Use and Teach**

* Kotlin
* Go
* TypeScript
* AWS
* Kafka

Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and "fair chance" ordinances.  
  
We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Daymark Health is a value-based oncology company redefining the cancer care experience for patients, providers, and health plans. Daymark's comprehensive, personalized cancer care platform empowers patients with dedicated care navigation, symptom-focused support, behavioral health care, and social resources. Combined with evidence-based health interventions and a hybrid in-person + virtual care model, Daymark is improving the overall cancer experience for patients, providers, and health plans – and setting a new standard in cancer care.

Daymark's groundbreaking approach is led by CEO Dr. Justin Bekelman, a pioneer in transforming cancer care, alongside some of the nation's foremost leaders in oncology and value-based care. Daymark Health is backed by Maverick Ventures, Yosemite, Oncology Ventures, Healthier Capital, Blue Venture Fund, and Healthcare Foundry.

*Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Daymark Health email.*

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Software Engineer at Daymark Health, you will contribute to our technical strategy, build secure and scalable infrastructure, and play a key role in the development of our core product. You will work closely with our other engineers, product, and data teams, operational leadership, and external customers to shape a transformative cancer care experience across the stack. We expect you to hit the ground running and help bring our product to market:

* **Build alongside a strong team:** Contribute to the development of our cancer care platform, with an emphasis on user experience, workflow integration, and security. You'll need to move fast, so comfort with tools like Claude, Cursor, and openness to experimentation will help our team build and operate more efficiently.
* **Technical execution:** Collaborate with operations, product, data engineering, and analytics to build the core systems and tools that enable our care team to serve patients as efficiently and effectively as possible.
* **Security & compliance**: Follow secure development practices and handle protected health information (PHI) with care, working within the HIPAA and SOC 2 controls our team maintains.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* **Strong technical foundation**: You have 2+ years of experience designing and building user-centric products, and you write code you're proud to have reviewed. You're comfortable working across the stack and picking up unfamiliar parts of a system. Our stack uses python and AWS managed services (EventBridge, Lambda, DynamoDB).
* **AI-native builder:** You're fluent with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and actively incorporate them into your workflow to move faster and write better code. You see AI-assisted development as a core skill, not a shortcut.
* **Healthcare experience**: Familiarity with healthcare technology, including EHRs and interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7), is a plus.
* **Action-oriented**: You move with purpose and urgency, thriving in environments where speed and adaptability are crucial. You know how to prioritize and execute effectively in a fast-paced setting. We're early on in our journey and move quickly – we expect you to do the same.
* **Clear communicator**: You can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Customer-focused**: You enjoy engaging directly with customers, understanding their challenges, and leveraging their feedback to improve the product. You're comfortable explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and adjusting solutions based on real-world feedback.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity**: Startups are unpredictable, and you're skilled at adapting to rapid changes, balancing competing priorities, and navigating evolving business landscapes.

**Additional Information**

The expected compensation for this role is $145,000 to $160,000 annually, depending on location & experience.

This role is fully remote.

*Daymark Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*All Daymark Health patient-facing roles require Basic Life Support (BLS) certification and compliance with Daymark's Employee Vaccination and Testing policy. Candidates without these at the time of hire should coordinate with their recruiter and hiring manager to ensure they meet the requirements by their start date.*

*All roles that require in-home visits to patients must provide proof of a valid driver's license.*

**Company Description**

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.
